namespace = earn_recognition_events

earn_recognition_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	title = earn_recognition_events.1.t
	desc = earn_recognition_events.1.d
	flavor = earn_recognition_events.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_signed_contract"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by JE
	}

	immediate = {
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
				relations:root >= relations_threshold:amicable
			}
			save_scope_as = treaty_partner_country_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = earn_recognition_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		set_country_type = recognized
		change_relations = { country = scope:treaty_partner_country_scope value = 30 }
		create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
			type = catalyst_event_positive
			target = scope:treaty_partner_country_scope
		}
	}
}

gg_afghanistan.3 = { #Afghanistan petitions for assistance
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = gg_afghanistan.3.t
	desc = gg_afghanistan.3.d
	flavor = gg_afghanistan.3.f

	dlc = dlc010

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_redcoats"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		#Fired by Button
	}

	immediate = {

	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		exists = c:AFG
	}

	option = {
		name = gg_afghanistan.3.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 75
		}
		trigger = {
			can_create_treaty = {
				first_country = root
				second_country = scope:afghan_nation_scope
				is_draft = no
				binding_period = { years = 2 }
				articles_to_create = {
					{
						article = military_assistance
						source_country = root
						target_country = scope:afghan_nation_scope
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = committed_to_afghanistan_assistance
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:RUS ?= this
			}
			scope:afghan_nation_scope = {
				set_variable = { name = AFG_appealed_to_RUS days = very_long_modifier_time }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:GBR ?= this
			}
			scope:afghan_nation_scope = {
				set_variable = { name = AFG_appealed_to_GBR days = very_long_modifier_time }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					scope:afghan_nation_scope = {
						owes_obligation_to = ROOT
					}
				}
			}
			create_treaty = {
				first_country = root
				second_country = scope:afghan_nation_scope

				is_draft = no
				binding_period = { years = 2 }

				articles_to_create = {
					{
						article = military_assistance
						source_country = root
						target_country = scope:afghan_nation_scope
					}
				}
			}
			scope:afghan_nation_scope = {
				set_owes_obligation_to = {
					country = ROOT
					setting = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_afghan_military_training_costs
			days = short_modifier_time
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_small
		}
		scope:afghan_nation_scope = {
			post_notification = afghanistan_assistance_request_accepted
			remove_variable = pending_aid_request
		}
		create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
			type = catalyst_event_positive
			target = scope:afghan_nation_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:RUS ?= this
			}
			scope:afghan_nation_scope = {
				create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
					type = catalyst_event_negative
					target = c:GBR
				}
			}
			root.power_bloc = {
				add_leverage = { target = scope:afghan_nation_scope value = 25 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				c:GBR ?= this
			}
			scope:afghan_nation_scope = {
				create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
					type = catalyst_event_negative
					target = c:RUS
				}
			}
			root.power_bloc = {
				add_leverage = { target = scope:afghan_nation_scope value = 25 }
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = gg_afghanistan.3.b
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
		}
		scope:afghan_nation_scope = {
			post_notification = afghanistan_assistance_request_rejected
			remove_variable = pending_aid_request
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
				c:GBR ?= this
			}
			scope:afghan_nation_scope = {
				set_variable = player_GBR_denied_aid_request
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
				c:RUS ?= this
			}
			scope:afghan_nation_scope = {
				set_variable = player_RUS_denied_aid_request
			}
		}
	}
}

		#Fired by Unification
	}

	immediate = {

	}

		name = gg_afghanistan.4.a

			base = 75
		}
		ordered_country = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_state = {
					is_homeland_of_country_cultures = ROOT
				}
			}
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			ROOT = {
				create_incident = {
					country = PREV
					value = 15
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_state_region = {
					any_scope_state = {
						is_homeland_of_country_cultures = ROOT
						NOT = { owner = ROOT }
						NOT = { has_claim_by = ROOT }
					}
				}
			}
			every_state_region = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_state = {
						is_homeland_of_country_cultures = ROOT
						NOT = { owner = ROOT }
						NOT = { has_claim_by = ROOT }
					}
				}
				add_claim = ROOT
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_loyalists = {
				value = 0.05
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = unification_prestige
			days = very_long_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = {

		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = unification_prestige
			days = very_long_modifier_time
			multiplier = 2
		}
	}
}

gg_afghanistan.7 = { # The Man Who Would Be King
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = gg_afghanistan.7.t
	desc = gg_afghanistan.7.d
	flavor = gg_afghanistan.7.f

	dlc = dlc010

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_persian_court"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ep1_content
		c:KAF ?= this
		any_neighbouring_state = {
			owner = {
				NOT = {
					has_war_with = root
				}
				any_scope_character = {
					has_template = KAB_josiah_harlan
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			has_variable = man_who_would_be_king_var
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			exists = scope:the_man_who_would_be_king_scope
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = man_who_would_be_king_var
		random_neighbouring_state = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						has_war_with = root
					}
					any_scope_character = {
						has_template = KAB_josiah_harlan
					}
				}
			}
			owner = {
				random_scope_character = {
					limit = {
						has_template = KAB_josiah_harlan
					}
					save_scope_as = the_man_who_would_be_king_scope
				}
				save_scope_as = the_man_who_would_be_king_origin_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = gg_afghanistan.7.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 99
		}
		add_loyalists = {
			value = small_radicals
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = gg_afghanistan.7.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
		scope:the_man_who_would_be_king_scope = {
			transfer_character = root
			set_character_as_ruler = yes
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = josiah_harlan_guns_modifier
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = medium_radicals
		}
	}
}
﻿namespace = caucasuswar

#These events have been re-balanced to swap to single-fire on yearly pulse. They can possibly repeat if the JE remains longer than 20 years.
caucasuswar.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:invasion_base_state

	title = caucasuswar.1.t
	desc = caucasuswar.1.d
	flavor = caucasuswar.1.f

	dlc = dlc010

	event_image = {
		video = "gfx/event_pictures/unspecific_sick_in_hospital.bk2"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = short_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			exists = c:CIR
			exists = c:CHC
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		root = {
			save_scope_as = russia_scope
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = s:STATE_DAGESTAN
					state_region = s:STATE_KUBAN
					state_region = s:STATE_NORTH_CAUCASUS
				}
				is_split_state = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = invasion_base_state
		}
		scope:invasion_base_state = {
			this.state_region = {
				random_scope_state = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							c:RUS ?= owner
						}
						OR = {
							c:CHC ?= owner
							c:CIR ?= owner
						}
					}
					owner = {
						save_scope_as = adversary_scope
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = caucasuswar.1.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:invasion_base_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_failed_incursion
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
			this.state_region = {
				add_devastation = 15
			}
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
				culture = cu:circassian
			}
		}
		scope:adversary_scope = {
			post_notification = caucasus_russian_failed_attack_notification
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = caucasuswar.1.b
		scope:invasion_base_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_failed_incursion
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
			this.state_region = {
				add_devastation = 5
			}
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
				pop_type = officers
				culture = cu:russian
			}
			this.region = {
				random_scope_state = {
					limit = {
						owner = c:RUS
						any_scope_building = {
							is_building_type = building_barrack
						}
					}
					add_radicals_in_state = {
						value = small_radicals
						pop_type = officers
						culture = cu:russian
					}
				}
			}
		}
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_failed_to_cover_incursion
				months = 13
			}
		}
		scope:adversary_scope = {
			post_notification = caucasus_russian_failed_attack_notification
		}
	}
}

	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = caucasuswar.5.t
	desc = caucasuswar.5.d
	flavor = caucasuswar.5.f

	event_image = {
		video = "gfx/event_pictures/ep1_cossacks.bk2"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		c:RUS ?= this
		NOT = {
			has_variable = milyutin_memorandum
		}
		exists = c:CIR
		NOT = {
			has_truce_with = c:CIR
		}
		OR = {
			cultural_acceptance_base = { target = cu:circassian value < acceptance_status_4 }
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_religion
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			state_region = s:STATE_KUBAN
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		c:CIR ?= {
			save_scope_as = adversary_scope
		}
		create_character = {
			template = RUS_dmitry_milyutin
			save_scope_as = milyutin_scope
		}
		cu:circassian = {
			save_scope_as = circassian_culture
		}
		set_variable = milyutin_memorandum
	}

	option = {
		name = caucasuswar.5.a

caucasuswar.7 = { #Parliament of Independence
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = caucasuswar.7.t
	desc = caucasuswar.7.d
	flavor = caucasuswar.7.f

	dlc = dlc010

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_scales.dds"

	event_image = {
		video = "gfx/event_pictures/unspecific_ruler_speaking_to_people.bk2"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			has_truce_with = c:RUS
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		c:RUS ?= {
			save_scope_as = russia_scope
		}
		capital = {
			save_scope_as = capital_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = caucasuswar.7.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_professional_army
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_professional_army
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_caucasian
				}
			}
			add_primary_culture = cu:north_caucasian
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_circassian_last_stand
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		create_character = {
			template = CIR_qerandiqo_berzeg
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = caucasuswar.7.b
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_caucasian
				}
			}
			add_primary_culture = cu:north_caucasian
		}
		create_character = {
			template = CIR_qerandiqo_berzeg
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_circassian_diplomacy
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				country_rank >= rank_value:major_power
				has_interest_marker_in_region = sr:region_russia
				NOT = {
					c:RUS ?= THIS
				}
			}
			trigger_event = { id = caucasuswar.8 }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = caucasuswar.7.c
		trigger = {
			ruler.interest_group ?= {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
			}
			exists = c:CHC
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_scope_treaty = {
						binds = c:CHC
						any_scope_article = {
							has_type = alliance
						}
					}
				}
			}
			create_treaty = {
				first_country = root
				second_country = c:CHC

				is_draft = no
				binding_period = { years = 5 }

				articles_to_create = {
					{
						article = alliance
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_circassian_joint_struggle
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		c:CHC ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_circassian_joint_struggle
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		c:TUR ?= {
			trigger_event = { id = caucasuswar.8 }
		}
	}
}

		}
	}

		set_variable = circassia_defeated
		s:STATE_KUBAN = {
			random_scope_state = {
				save_scope_as = kuban_state
			}
		}
	}

	option = {

		default_option = yes

			}

		}
		scope:kuban_state = {

				name = modifier_settlers_privileges
				days = normal_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:kuban_state = {
				remove_modifier = caucasus_war_attacker
			}
		}
		scope:kuban_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_caucasian_war_sol
				days = normal_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
			state_region = {
				add_homeland = cu:russian
				add_homeland = cu:ukrainian
			}
		}
		if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = milyutin_memorandum_accepted
				NOT = {
					has_journal_entry = je_circassian_expulsions
				}
				cultural_acceptance_base = { target = cu:circassian value < acceptance_status_4 }
            }
            add_journal_entry = { type = je_circassian_expulsions }
        }
	}

	option = {
		name = caucasuswar_end.1.b
		trigger = {
			scope:kuban_state = {
				NOT = {
					has_modifier = modifier_milyutin_memorandum
				}
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:kuban_state = {
				remove_modifier = caucasus_war_attacker
			}
		}
		scope:kuban_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_caucasian_war_sol
				days = normal_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
			state_region = {
				add_homeland = cu:russian
				add_homeland = cu:ukrainian
			}
		}
	}
}

caucasus_expulsions.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:circassian_expulsion_state

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"
	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_ca_mountain_pass_civilian"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	title = caucasus_expulsions.1.t
	desc = caucasus_expulsions.1.d
	flavor = caucasus_expulsions.1.f

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = circassian_expulsion_stall }
		has_journal_entry = je_circassian_expulsions
		any_scope_state = {
			region = sr:region_russia
			any_scope_pop = {
				culture = cu:circassian
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			has_variable = circassian_events_hidden
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				region = sr:region_russia
				any_scope_pop = {
					culture = cu:circassian
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = circassian_expulsion_state
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_state = {
					OR = {
						state_region = s:STATE_EASTERN_THRACE
						state_region = s:STATE_KASTAMONU
						state_region = s:STATE_TRABZON
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = expulsion_destination_country
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						state_region = s:STATE_EASTERN_THRACE
						state_region = s:STATE_KASTAMONU
						state_region = s:STATE_TRABZON
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = expulsion_destination_state
			}
		}
		cu:circassian = {
			save_scope_as = circassian_culture_scope
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = circassian_expulsion_stall
			months = 3
		}
		ROOT = {
			save_scope_as = russia_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = caucasus_expulsions.1.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:circassian_expulsion_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:expulsion_destination_country = {
						has_variable = refused_circassian_refugees
					}
				}
				kill_population_percent_in_state = {
					percent = 0.06
					culture = cu:circassian
				}
			}
			else = {
				kill_population_percent_in_state = {
					percent = 0.04
					culture = cu:circassian
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = three_pops_deported_tt
				random_scope_pop = {
					limit = {
						culture = cu:circassian
						strata = lower
					}
					move_pop = scope:expulsion_destination_state
				}
				random_scope_pop = {
					limit = {
						culture = cu:circassian
						strata = middle
					}
					move_pop = scope:expulsion_destination_state
				}
				random_scope_pop = {
					limit = {
						culture = cu:circassian
						strata = upper
					}
					move_pop = scope:expulsion_destination_state
				}
			}
		}
		scope:expulsion_destination_country = {
			post_notification = ottoman_circassian_refugees_arrived
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = caucasus_expulsions.1.b
		scope:circassian_expulsion_state = {
			kill_population_percent_in_state = {
				percent = 0.01
				culture = cu:circassian
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = three_pops_deported_tt
				random_scope_pop = {
					limit = {
						culture = cu:circassian
						OR = {
							strata = lower
							strata = middle
						}
					}
					move_pop = scope:expulsion_destination_state
				}
				random_scope_pop = {
					limit = {
						culture = cu:circassian
						OR = {
							strata = middle
							strata = upper
						}
					}
					move_pop = scope:expulsion_destination_state
				}
			}
		}
		scope:expulsion_destination_country = {
			post_notification = ottoman_circassian_refugees_arrived
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = caucasus_expulsions.1.c
		set_variable = circassian_events_hidden
		custom_tooltip = hide_deportation_events_tt
		scope:circassian_expulsion_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:expulsion_destination_country = {
						has_variable = refused_circassian_refugees
					}
				}
				kill_population_percent_in_state = {
					percent = 0.06
					culture = cu:circassian
				}
			}
			else = {
				kill_population_percent_in_state = {
					percent = 0.04
					culture = cu:circassian
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = three_pops_deported_tt
				random_scope_pop = {
					limit = {
						culture = cu:circassian
						strata = lower
					}
					move_pop = scope:expulsion_destination_state
				}
				random_scope_pop = {
					limit = {
						culture = cu:circassian
						strata = middle
					}
					move_pop = scope:expulsion_destination_state
				}
				random_scope_pop = {
					limit = {
						culture = cu:circassian

					move_pop = scope:expulsion_destination_state
				}

﻿namespace = gg_core

gg_core.1 = { # Great Game victory
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = gg_core.1.t
	desc = gg_core.1.d
	flavor = gg_core.1.f

	dlc = dlc010

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_power_blocs"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = short_modifier_time }

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:GBR ?= this
			}
			c:RUS ?= {
				save_scope_as = opponent_scope
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:RUS ?= this
			}
			c:GBR ?= {
				save_scope_as = opponent_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = gg_core.1.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						c:GBR ?= THIS
						has_global_variable = great_game_gbr_progress
						global_var:great_game_gbr_progress <= 40
					}
					AND = {
						c:RUS ?= THIS
						has_global_variable = great_game_gbr_progress
						global_var:great_game_gbr_progress >= 160
					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_great_game_victor
				days = very_long_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						c:GBR ?= THIS
						has_global_variable = great_game_gbr_progress
						global_var:great_game_gbr_progress <= 80
					}
					AND = {
						c:RUS ?= THIS
						has_global_variable = great_game_gbr_progress
						global_var:great_game_gbr_progress >= 120
					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_great_game_victor
				days = very_long_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		else = { # Should never happen
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_great_game_victor
				days = very_long_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
				multiplier = 0.5
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			clear_great_game_variables = yes
		}
		scope:opponent_scope ?= {
			create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
				type = catalyst_event_positive
				target = root
			}
		}
	}
}

	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = short_modifier_time }

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:GBR ?= this
			}
			c:RUS ?= {
				save_scope_as = opponent_scope
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:RUS ?= this
			}
			c:GBR ?= {
				save_scope_as = opponent_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = gg_core.2.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						c:GBR ?= THIS
						has_global_variable = great_game_gbr_progress
						global_var:great_game_gbr_progress >= 160
					}
					AND = {
						c:RUS ?= THIS
						has_global_variable = great_game_gbr_progress
						global_var:great_game_gbr_progress <= 40
					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_great_game_defeated
				days = very_long_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
				multiplier = 1.5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						c:GBR ?= THIS
						has_global_variable = great_game_gbr_progress
						global_var:great_game_gbr_progress >= 120
					}
					AND = {
						c:RUS ?= THIS
						has_global_variable = great_game_gbr_progress
						global_var:great_game_gbr_progress <= 80
					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_great_game_defeated
				days = very_long_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		else = { # Should never happen
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_great_game_defeated
				days = very_long_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
				multiplier = 0.5
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			clear_great_game_variables = yes
		}
		scope:opponent_scope ?= {
			create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
				type = catalyst_event_negative
				target = root
			}
		}
	}
}

				value = 10
			}

				name = modifier_central_asian_bribe_payments

russian_central_asia.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	event_image = {
		video = "gfx/event_pictures/ep1_octopus.bk2"
	}

	desc = russian_central_asia.2.d
	flavor = russian_central_asia.2.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		#Triggered by JE
	}

	immediate = {
		ordered_country = {
        	limit = {
        		is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
        		OR = {
        			any_scope_state = {
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_india
						count >= 3
        			}
        			any_country = {
        				is_subject_of = prev
        				any_scope_state = {
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_india
							count >= 3
	        			}
        			}
        		}
        	}
        	order_by = country_rank
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
        	save_scope_as = india_overlord
		}
		ordered_state = {
        	limit = {
        		state_region = s:STATE_KABUL
        	}
			order_by = owner.country_rank
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
        	save_scope_as = kabul_state
        	owner = {
        		save_scope_as = afghan_scope
        	}
        }
        if = {
        	limit = {
        		any_interest_group = {
		        	NOR = {
	        			leader = {
	        				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pacifist
	        			}
	        			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_isolationist
	        		}
	        		law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_no_colonial_affairs
						value <= neutral
					}
		        }
        	}
        	random_interest_group = {
        		limit = {
        			NOR = {
	        			leader = {
	        				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pacifist
	        			}
	        			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_isolationist
	        		}
	        		law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_no_colonial_affairs
						value <= neutral
					}
        		}
        		save_scope_as = hawkish_ig
        	}
        }
        else = {
        	ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
        		save_scope_as = hawkish_ig
        	}
        }
	}

	option = {
		name = russian_central_asia.2.a
        default_option = yes
        trigger = {
        	exists = c:AFG
        }
        every_country_in_europe = {
        	limit = {
        		OR = {
        			any_scope_state = {
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_india
						count >= 3
        			}
        			any_country = {
        				is_subject_of = prev
        				any_scope_state = {
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_india
							count >= 3
	        			}
        			}
        		}
        	}
        	change_relations = {
        		country = c:RUS
        		value = -20
        	}
		}
		create_incident = {
			country = c:AFG
			value = 20
		}
		every_state_region = {
			limit = {
				is_homeland = cu:pashtun
			}
			add_claim = c:RUS
		}
	}

        default_option = yes

gg_korea.4 = { # Donghak Petition
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = gg_korea.4.ta
				trigger = {
					scope:petition_state = {
						state_region = s:STATE_YANGHO
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = gg_korea.4.tb
				trigger = {
					scope:petition_state = {
						NOT = {
							state_region = s:STATE_YANGHO
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	desc = gg_korea.4.d
	flavor = gg_korea.4.f

	dlc = dlc010

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_donghak_rebellion"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			has_variable = donghak_petition_event_var
		}
		radical_fraction = {
			value >= 0.2
		}
		ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			is_in_government = no
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
			save_scope_as = donghak_ig
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_state = {
					state_region = s:STATE_YANGHO
					radical_fraction = {
						value >= 0.1
					}
				}
			}
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					state_region = s:STATE_YANGHO
					radical_fraction = {
						value >= 0.1
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = petition_state
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					radical_fraction = {
						value >= 0.1
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = petition_state
			}
		}
		set_variable = donghak_petition_event_var
	}

	option = {
		name = gg_korea.4.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:donghak_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_donghak_petition_rejected
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:petition_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
				pop_type = peasants
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = gg_korea.4.b
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_gyojo_shinwon }
	}
}

gg_korea.7 = { # Korean Uprising

					}
				}
			}

							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

	desc = {

				}
			}

				desc = gg_korea.7.d.china
				trigger = {
					c:KOR ?= {
						is_subject_of = ROOT
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	flavor = gg_korea.7.f

	duration = 3

	immediate = {
		c:KOR ?= {
			save_scope_as = korea_scope

				save_scope_as = china_scope
			}
		}
		random_country_in_east_asia = {
			limit = {
				civil_war_origin_country ?= scope:korea_scope
			}
			save_scope_as = korea_rebellion_scope

				save_scope_as = korea_rebellion_capital
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # Side with the Korean government
		name = gg_korea.7.a
		default_option = yes

			base = 50
		}

			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
			}
			set_secret_goal = {
				country = scope:korea_rebellion_scope
				secret_goal = conquer
			}
			set_secret_goal = {
				country = scope:korea_scope
				secret_goal = protect
			}
		}
		je:je_korean_rebellion ?= {
			add_involved_country = ROOT
		}
		set_variable = sided_with_korean_gov
		scope:korea_scope ?= {
			create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
				type = catalyst_event_positive
				target = root
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # Side with the rebels
		name = gg_korea.7.b
		trigger = {
			scope:korea_scope = {
				NOT = {
					is_subject_of = ROOT
				}
			}
			scope:korea_rebellion_scope = {
				NOT = {
					ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
						is_in_government = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
			}
			set_secret_goal = {
				country = scope:korea_scope
				secret_goal = conquer
			}

				country = scope:korea_rebellion_scope
				secret_goal = protect
			}

		}

		}
	}

	option = {

        default_option = yes

				region = sr:region_central_asia

				}

					has_variable = persian_slave_liberate_var
				}

				}
				add_radicals_in_state = {
					culture = cu:uzbek
					value = medium_radicals
				}
			}
			set_variable = persian_slave_liberate_var
		}
	}

	option = {

		custom_tooltip = persia_events.5.tt

			}
			save_scope_as = herat_scope
		}
		if = {
        	limit = {

	        		exists = no
	        	}
	        	c:GBR ?= {
	        		any_subject_or_below = {

							country_has_primary_culture = cu:tajik
						}
	        		}
	        	}
	        }
	        c:GBR ?= {
		        random_subject_or_below = {
		        	limit = {
		        		OR = {
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:pashtun
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:tajik
						}
		        	}
		        	save_scope_as = british_afghan_subject
		        }
		    }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = persia_events.8.a
        default_option = yes
        custom_tooltip = {
        	text = britain_wants_herat_tt
			scope:britain_scope = {
				set_secret_goal = {
					country = root
					secret_goal = conquer
				}
			}
			set_secret_goal = {
				country = scope:britain_scope
				secret_goal = antagonize
			}
        }
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
					is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = did_not_bow_to_britain_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 7
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = persia_events.8.b
        if = {
        	limit = {
        		c:HER ?= {
        			NOT = {
        				is_subject_of = root
        			}
        		}
        	}
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					state_region = s:STATE_HERAT
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = modifier_herat_inspiration
					}
					remove_modifier = modifier_herat_inspiration
				}
				set_state_owner = c:HER
			}
			c:HER ?= {
        		change_relations = {
					country = c:GBR
					value = 50
				}
			}
        }
        else_if = {
        	limit = {
	        	NOT = {
					exists = c:HER
				}
	        }
        	create_country = {
        		tag = HER
        		origin = root
        		state = scope:herat_scope
        		on_created = {
        			change_relations = {
						country = c:GBR
						value = 50
					}
        		}
        	}
        }
        else_if = {
        	limit = {
	        	NOT = {
					exists = c:HER
				}
	        	c:GBR ?= {
	        		any_subject_or_below = {
						OR = {
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:pashtun
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:tajik
						}
	        		}
	        	}
	        }
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					state_region = s:STATE_HERAT
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = modifier_herat_inspiration
					}
					remove_modifier = modifier_herat_inspiration
				}
				set_state_owner = scope:british_afghan_subject
			}
        }
        else = {
			create_dynamic_country = {
				origin = root
				country_type = unrecognized
				culture = cu:persian
				religion = rel:sunni
				tier = principality
				capital = scope:herat_scope

					state_region = s:STATE_HERAT
				}
				on_created = {
        			change_relations = {
						country = c:GBR
						value = 50
					}
				}
			}
        }
		change_relations = {
			country = c:GBR
			value = 10
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
					is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = bowed_to_britain_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}

			base = 3

# Reconstruction
fsa_events.1 = {
	type = country_event

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_political_extremism"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	title = fsa_events.1.t
	desc = fsa_events.1.d
	flavor = fsa_events.1.f

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		# Fired via on_action
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = formation_country
		capital = {
			region = {
				save_scope_as = capital_region_scope
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_diplomatic_relevance = ROOT
			}
			post_notification = unification_notification_generic
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = unification_prestige
			days = very_long_modifier_time
		}
		unification_claims_effect = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = fsa_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_slavery_banned
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_slavery_banned
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_multicultural
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_multicultural
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = fsa_events.1.b
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_slavery_banned
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_slavery_banned
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_multicultural
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_multicultural
		}
		add_primary_culture = cu:afro_american
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reactionary
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_paternalistic
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_magnatial
					ig_has_carlist_ideology = yes
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderantist
					leader = {
						has_reactionary_ideology = yes
					}
				}
			}
			prev = {
				add_radicals = {
					value = medium_radicals
					interest_group = prev
				}
			}
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anti_slavery
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_egalitarian
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist # They approve of multiculturalism
				}
			}
			prev = {
				add_loyalists = {
					value = medium_radicals
					interest_group = prev
				}
			}
		}
		add_loyalists = {
			value = very_large_radicals
			culture = cu:afro_american
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = fsa_reparation_cost
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		every_scope_state = {
			custom = every_yankee_state_in_root
			limit = {
				state_region = { is_homeland = cu:yankee }
			}
			state_region = { add_homeland = cu:afro_american }
			add_modifier = {
				name = fsa_reparation_reward
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

hungary_events.2 = { # Serbian Revolt
	type = country_event
	placement = c:BNT.capital

	title = hungary_events.2.t
	desc = hungary_events.2.d
	flavor = hungary_events.2.f

	dlc = dlc014

	event_image = {
		video = "ip3_officer_inspecting_peasant_conscripts"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				any_scope_state = {
					state_region = s:STATE_DELVIDEK
				}
				any_scope_state = {
					state_region = {
						is_homeland = cu:serb
					}
					OR = {
						turmoil > 0.15
						obstinance >= 0.05
					}
				}
				country_average_culture_pop_acceptance = {
					culture = cu:serb
					value < acceptance_status_4
				}
				NOT = {
					exists = c:BNT
				}
				any_diplomatic_play = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							target = c:HUN
							initiator = c:AUS
						}
						AND = {
							target = c:AUS
							initiator = c:HUN
						}
					}
				}
			}
			c:AUS ?= this
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		c:HUN ?= {
			save_scope_as = hungary_country_scope
		}
		c:BNT ?= {
			save_scope_as = banat_country_scope
		}
		c:AUS ?= {
			save_scope_as = austria_country_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = { # The effects are only run by Hungary to avoid dupes
				c:HUN ?= this
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					capital = {
						state_region = s:STATE_DELVIDEK
					}
					any_scope_state = {
						state_region = s:STATE_CENTRAL_HUNGARY
					}
				}
				set_capital = STATE_CENTRAL_HUNGARY
			}
			create_country = {
				origin = root
				tag = BNT
				state = s:STATE_DELVIDEK.region_state:HUN
				on_created = {
					set_variable = serbian_voivoideship_var
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = {
								has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
							}
						}
						activate_law = law_type:law_monarchy
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							year < 1851
						}
						create_character = {
							template = BNT_stevan_supljikac
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							year < 1855
						}
						create_character = {
							template = BNT_josif_rajacic
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							year < 1855
						}
						create_character = {
							template = BNT_stevan_knicanin
						}
					}
					random_scope_state = {
						limit = {
							state_region = s:STATE_DELVIDEK
						}
						STATE_DELVIDEK_state_name_assign = yes
					}
					s:STATE_BANAT = {
						add_claim = c:BNT
					}
					c:AUS ?= {
						trigger_event = { id = hungary_events.2 popup = yes }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = hungary_events.2.a
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			c:HUN ?= this
		}
		add_fervor_target_modifier = { #changes target
			culture = cu:serb
			days = normal_modifier_time
			multiplier = 5
		}
		c:BNT ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_serbian_volunteers
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		random_diplomatic_play = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						target = c:HUN
						initiator = c:AUS
					}
					AND = {
						target = c:AUS
						initiator = c:HUN
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					target = c:HUN
				}
				add_initiator_backers = { c:BNT }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					initiator = c:HUN
				}
				add_target_backers = { c:BNT }
			}
			add_war_goal = {
				holder = c:HUN
				target_country = c:BNT
				type = annex_country
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					c:HUN ?= {
						any_scope_state = {
							state_region = s:STATE_BANAT
						}
					}
				}
				add_war_goal = {
					holder = c:BNT
					type = conquer_state
					target_state = s:STATE_BANAT.region_state:HUN
				}
			}
		}
	}

hungary_events.3 = { # Slovakian revolt
	type = country_event
	placement = c:SLV.capital

	title = hungary_events.3.t
	desc = hungary_events.3.d
	flavor = hungary_events.3.f

	dlc = dlc014

	event_image = {
		video = "ip3_officer_inspecting_peasant_conscripts"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				any_scope_state = {
					state_region = s:STATE_SLOVAKIA
				}
				any_scope_state = {
					state_region = {
						is_homeland = cu:slovak
					}
					OR = {
						turmoil > 0.15
						obstinance >= 0.05
					}
				}
				country_average_culture_pop_acceptance = {
					culture = cu:slovak
					value < acceptance_status_4
				}
				NOT = {
					exists = c:SLV
				}
				any_diplomatic_play = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							target = c:HUN
							initiator = c:AUS
						}
						AND = {
							target = c:AUS
							initiator = c:HUN
						}
					}
				}
			}
			c:AUS ?= this
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		c:HUN ?= {
			save_scope_as = hungary_country_scope
		}
		c:AUS ?= {
			save_scope_as = austria_country_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = { # The effects are only run by Hungary to avoid dupes
				c:HUN ?= this
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					capital = {
						state_region = s:STATE_SLOVAKIA
					}
					any_scope_state = {
						state_region = s:STATE_CENTRAL_HUNGARY
					}
				}
				set_capital = STATE_CENTRAL_HUNGARY
			}
			create_country = {
				origin = root
				tag = SLV
				state = s:STATE_SLOVAKIA.region_state:HUN
				on_created = {
					s:STATE_RUTHENIA = {
						add_claim = c:SLV
					}
					c:AUS ?= {
						trigger_event = { id = hungary_events.3 popup = yes }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = hungary_events.3.a
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			c:HUN ?= this
		}
		add_fervor_target_modifier = { #changes target
			culture = cu:slovak
			days = normal_modifier_time
			multiplier = 5
		}
		c:SLV ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_slovak_volunteers
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		random_diplomatic_play = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						target = c:HUN
						initiator = c:AUS
					}
					AND = {
						target = c:AUS
						initiator = c:HUN
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					target = c:HUN
				}
				add_initiator_backers = { c:SLV }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					initiator = c:HUN
				}
				add_target_backers = { c:SLV }
			}
			add_war_goal = {
				holder = c:HUN
				target_country = c:SLV
				type = annex_country
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					c:HUN ?= {
						any_scope_state = {
							state_region = s:STATE_RUTHENIA
						}
					}
				}
				add_war_goal = {
					holder = c:SLV
					type = conquer_state
					target_state = s:STATE_RUTHENIA.region_state:HUN
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = hungary_events.3.b
		trigger = {
			c:HUN ?= this
		}
		add_fervor_target_modifier = { #changes target
			culture = cu:slovak
			days = normal_modifier_time
			multiplier = 5
		}
		c:SLV ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_slovak_volunteers
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		play_as = c:SLV
		random_diplomatic_play = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						target = c:HUN
						initiator = c:AUS
					}
					AND = {
						target = c:AUS
						initiator = c:HUN
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					target = c:HUN
				}
				add_initiator_backers = { c:SLV }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					initiator = c:HUN
				}
				add_target_backers = { c:SLV }
			}
			add_war_goal = {
				holder = c:HUN
				target_country = c:SLV
				type = annex_country
			}
			if = {
				limit = {

							state_region = s:STATE_RUTHENIA
						}
					}
				}
				add_war_goal = {
					holder = c:SLV
					type = conquer_state
					target_state = s:STATE_RUTHENIA.region_state:HUN
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {

		default_option = yes

		}

				type = crown_land
			}
		}
		show_as_tooltip = {

				culture = cu:slovak
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = 5
			}
			c:SLV ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_slovak_volunteers
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
			random_diplomatic_play = {
				limit = {

						AND = {

						}

			}

				value = small_radicals

		}

		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = medium_radicals
			culture = cu:szekely
		}

			culture = cu:romanian
		}

hungary_events.6 = { # Austrian Ultimatum
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = hungary_events.6.t
	desc = hungary_events.6.d
	flavor = hungary_events.6.f

	dlc = dlc014

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_monarch_holding_court"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		c:AUS ?= {
			save_scope_as = austria_country_scope
			set_variable = hungarian_ultimatum_sent_var
		}
		c:HUN ?= {
			save_scope_as = hungary_country_scope
		}
	}

	cooldown = { days = short_modifier_time }

	option = {
		name = hungary_events.6.a
		default_option = yes
		c:AUS ?= {
			create_diplomatic_play = {
				name = hungarian_revolution
				type = dp_hungarian_revolution
				target_state = c:HUN.capital

				add_war_goal = {
					holder = c:HUN
					type = independence
					target_country = c:AUS
					primary_demand = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = hungary_events.6.b
		custom_tooltip = austrian_ultimatium_tt
		add_liberty_desire = -50
		add_radicals = {
			value = large_radicals
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_humiliated_by_austria
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		if = { # Undoes April Laws
			limit = {
				has_variable = hungarian_revolution_twelve_points_var
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = conservative_distribution_of_power_law
					has_variable = conservative_free_speech_law
					has_variable = conservative_internal_security_law
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							has_law = var:conservative_distribution_of_power_law
						}
					}
					activate_law = var:conservative_distribution_of_power_law
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							has_law = var:conservative_free_speech_law
						}
					}
					activate_law = var:conservative_free_speech_law
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							has_law = var:conservative_internal_security_law
						}
					}
					activate_law = var:conservative_internal_security_law
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = hungarian_revolution_annex_transylvania_button_var
			}
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						state_region = s:STATE_NORTHERN_TRANSYLVANIA
						state_region = s:STATE_SOUTHERN_TRANSYLVANIA
					}
				}
				set_state_owner = c:AUS
			}
		}
		set_variable = hungary_folded_to_austria_var
	}
}

					OR = {
						culture = cu:szekely
						culture = cu:hungarian
					}
				}
				retire_character = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { # The effects are only run by Hungary to avoid dupes
				c:HUN ?= this
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					capital = {
						state_region = s:STATE_SOUTHERN_TRANSYLVANIA
					}
					any_scope_state = {
						state_region = s:STATE_CENTRAL_HUNGARY
					}
				}
				set_capital = STATE_CENTRAL_HUNGARY
			}
			create_country = {
				origin = root
				tag = TRS
				state = s:STATE_SOUTHERN_TRANSYLVANIA.region_state:HUN
				on_created = {
					set_variable = romanian_transylvanian_revolt_var
					if = {
						limit = {
							year > 1844
							year < 1870
						}
						create_character = {
							template = trs_avram_iancu
							on_created = {
								set_character_as_ruler = yes
							}
						}
					}
					remove_primary_culture = cu:hungarian
					remove_primary_culture = cu:szekely
					random_scope_state = {
						limit = {
							state_region = s:STATE_SOUTHERN_TRANSYLVANIA
						}
						STATE_SOUTHERN_TRANSYLVANIA_state_name_assign = yes
					}
					s:STATE_NORTHERN_TRANSYLVANIA = {
						add_claim = c:TRS
					}
					c:AUS ?= {
						trigger_event = { id = hungary_events.8 popup = yes }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = hungary_events.8.a
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			c:HUN ?= this
		}
		add_fervor_target_modifier = { #changes target
			culture = cu:romanian
			days = normal_modifier_time

		}
		c:TRS ?= {

 	}

 		}
 	}

	}

 		default_option = yes

				activate_law = law_type:law_interventionism
				every_interest_group = {
					limit = {
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_census_voting
							value > neutral
						}
						ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					}
					add_modifier = {
						name = modifier_the_spirit_of_48
						days = moderately_long_modifier_time
						is_decaying = yes
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_revolutionary_fervor
					days = short_modifier_time
					is_decaying = yes
				}
			}
 		}
 		set_variable = austria_folded_to_hungary_var
 		ai_chance = {
 			base = 50
 		}
 	}

 	option = {
 		name = hungary_events.9.b
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				is_diplomatic_play_ally_of = c:HUN
			}
		}
		show_as_unavailable = {
			is_diplomatic_play_ally_of = c:HUN
		}

 		c:HUN ?= {
 			trigger_event = { id = hungary_events.6 popup = yes }
 		}
 		change_relations = { country = c:HUN value = -30 }
 		custom_tooltip = hungary_likely_lead_to_war_tt
 		create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
 			type = catalyst_event_negative
 			target = c:HUN
 		}
 		add_radicals = {
 			culture = cu:hungarian
 			value = medium_radicals
 		}

 			base = 200
 			modifier = {

 					}

﻿namespace = lobby_events

lobby_events.21 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_clandestine_meeting"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	title = lobby_events.21.t
	desc = lobby_events.21.d
	flavor = lobby_events.21.f

	dlc = dlc010

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = lobbies
		is_revolutionary = no
		any_interest_group = {
			is_member_of_any_lobby = no
			leader = {
				OR = { # is patriotically inclined
					has_reactionary_ideology = yes
					has_conservative_ideology = yes
					has_monarchist_ideology = yes
				}
			}
		}
		any_political_lobby = {
			is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
			target = {
				any_diplomatically_relevant_country = {
					NOT = {
						this = root
					}
					OR = {
						has_diplomatic_pact = {
							who = root
							type = rivalry
						}
						any_scope_state = {
							has_claim_by = root
						}
					}
					OR = {
						has_diplomatic_pact = {
							who = prev
							type = rivalry
						}
						any_scope_state = {
							has_claim_by = prev
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_member_of_any_lobby = no
				leader = {
					OR = { # is patriotically inclined
						has_reactionary_ideology = yes
						has_conservative_ideology = yes
						has_monarchist_ideology = yes
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_ig_scope
		}
		random_political_lobby = {
			limit = {
				is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
				target = {
					any_diplomatically_relevant_country = {
						NOT = {
							this = root
						}
						OR = {
							has_diplomatic_pact = {
								who = root
								type = rivalry
							}
							any_scope_state = {
								has_claim_by = root
							}
						}
						OR = {
							has_diplomatic_pact = {
								who = prev
								type = rivalry
							}
							any_scope_state = {
								has_claim_by = prev
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_lobby_scope
			target = {
				random_diplomatically_relevant_country = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							this = root
						}
						OR = {
							has_diplomatic_pact = {
								who = root
								type = rivalry
							}
							any_scope_state = {
								has_claim_by = root
							}
						}
						OR = {
							has_diplomatic_pact = {
								who = prev
								type = rivalry
							}
							any_scope_state = {
								has_claim_by = prev
							}
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = lobby_target_scope
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_country_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = lobby_events.21.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:relevant_lobby_scope = {
			add_lobby_member = scope:relevant_ig_scope
		}
		scope:relevant_lobby_scope = {
			change_appeasement = {
			   amount = 3
			   factor = appeasement_lobby_pleased
			}
		}
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:lobby_target_scope value = -20
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = lobby_events.21.b
		scope:relevant_lobby_scope = {
			add_lobby_member = scope:relevant_ig_scope
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = lobby_events.21.c
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				scope:relevant_lobby_scope = {
					add_lobby_member = scope:relevant_ig_scope
				}
			}
			9 = {
				scope:relevant_ig_scope = {
					add_modifier = {
						name = enemy_of_enemy_ig_modifier
						days = normal_modifier_time
					}
				}
			}
		}
		scope:relevant_lobby_scope = {
			change_appeasement = {
			   amount = -3
			   factor = appeasement_lobby_displeased
			}
		}
	}
}

lobby_events.24 = {
	type = country_event

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_redcoats"
	}

		has_dlc_feature = lobbies

			is_member_of_any_lobby = no
			is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
		}
		any_political_lobby = {
			is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
			target = {
				NOT = {
					has_war_with = root
				}
				techs_researched > {
				    value = root.techs_researched
				    multiply = 1.5
				}
				OR = {
					army_size > {
					    value = root.army_size
					    multiply = 1.5
					}
					navy_size > {
					    value = root.navy_size
					    multiply = 1.5
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_member_of_any_lobby = no
				is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_ig_scope
		}
		random_political_lobby = {
			limit = {
				is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
				target = {
					NOT = {
						has_war_with = root
					}
					techs_researched > {
					    value = root.techs_researched
					    multiply = 1.5
					}
					OR = {
						army_size > {
						    value = root.army_size
						    multiply = 1.5
						}
						navy_size > {
						    value = root.navy_size
						    multiply = 1.5
						}
					}
				}
			}
			target = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						army_size > {
						    value = root.army_size
						    multiply = 1.5
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = army_is_strongest_var
						days = short_modifier_time
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_country_scope
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_lobby_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = lobby_events.24.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:relevant_lobby_scope = {
			add_lobby_member = scope:relevant_ig_scope
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = lobby_events.24.b
		add_modifier = {
			name = officer_corps_unrest_modifier
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		scope:relevant_ig_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = affiliation_ban_enforced_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

# Impressive Tax Reform
lobby_events.40 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = lobby_events.40.t
	desc = lobby_events.40.d
	flavor = lobby_events.40.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_signed_contract"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	dlc = dlc010

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = lobbies
		is_revolutionary = no
		OR = {
			AND = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation
				any_interest_group = {
					is_member_of_any_lobby = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				any_political_lobby = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					target = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_graduated_taxation
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation
				any_interest_group = {
					is_member_of_any_lobby = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				any_political_lobby = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					target = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_proportional_taxation
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation
				any_interest_group = {
					is_member_of_any_lobby = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				any_political_lobby = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					target = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_graduated_taxation
					}
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					is_member_of_any_lobby = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_ig
			}
			random_political_lobby = {
				limit = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					target = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_graduated_taxation
					}
				}
				target = {
					save_scope_as = relevant_lobby_country
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_lobby
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation
				any_interest_group = {
					is_member_of_any_lobby = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				any_political_lobby = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					target = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_proportional_taxation
					}
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					is_member_of_any_lobby = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_ig
			}
			random_political_lobby = {
				limit = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					target = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_proportional_taxation
					}
				}
				target = {
					save_scope_as = relevant_lobby_country
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_lobby
			}
		}
		currently_enacting_law = {
    		save_scope_as = relevant_law_scope
    	}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:relevant_law_scope }
			NOT = { exists = scope:relevant_lobby }
			NOT = { exists = scope:relevant_lobby_country }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = lobby_events.40.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:relevant_lobby = {
			add_lobby_member = scope:relevant_ig
			change_appeasement = {
			   amount = 1
			   factor = appeasement_lobby_pleased
			}
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = ig_happy_with_law_enactment
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = lobby_events.40.b
		scope:relevant_lobby = {
			add_lobby_member = scope:relevant_ig
		}
		scope:relevant_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = ig_join_pol_str_positive
				days = short_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		add_loyalists = {
			value = small_radicals
			interest_group = scope:relevant_ig
		}
	}
}

lobby_events.31 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = lobby_events.31.t
	desc = lobby_events.31.d
	flavor = lobby_events.31.f

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_clandestine_meeting"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	dlc = dlc010

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = lobbies
		is_revolutionary = no
		OR = {
			AND = { # IG with progressive or liberal IG leader joins lobby that has a conservative or reactionary member
				any_interest_group = {
					is_member_of_any_lobby = no
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_progressive_ideology = yes
							has_liberal_ideology = yes
							has_socialist_ideology = yes
						}
					}
				}
				any_political_lobby = { # existing member has opposing ideology
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					target = { has_technology_researched = film }
					any_lobby_member = {
						leader = {
							OR = {
								has_conservative_ideology = yes
								has_reactionary_ideology = yes
								has_monarchist_ideology = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			AND = { # IG with conservative or reactionary IG leader joins lobby that has a progressive or liberal member
				any_interest_group = {
					is_member_of_any_lobby = no
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_conservative_ideology = yes
							has_reactionary_ideology = yes
							has_monarchist_ideology = yes
						}
					}
				}
				any_political_lobby = { # existing member has opposing ideology
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					target = { has_technology_researched = film }
					any_lobby_member = {
						leader = {
							OR = {
								has_progressive_ideology = yes
								has_liberal_ideology = yes
								has_socialist_ideology = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					is_member_of_any_lobby = no
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_progressive_ideology = yes
							has_liberal_ideology = yes
							has_socialist_ideology = yes
						}
					}
				}
				any_political_lobby = { # existing member has opposing ideology
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					target = { has_technology_researched = film }
					any_lobby_member = {
						leader = {
							OR = {
								has_conservative_ideology = yes
								has_reactionary_ideology = yes
								has_monarchist_ideology = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					is_member_of_any_lobby = no
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_progressive_ideology = yes
							has_liberal_ideology = yes
							has_socialist_ideology = yes
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_ig
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = relevant_ig_leader
				}
			}
			random_political_lobby = {
				limit = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					target = { has_technology_researched = film }
					any_lobby_member = {
						leader = {
							OR = {
								has_conservative_ideology = yes
								has_reactionary_ideology = yes
								has_monarchist_ideology = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
				random_lobby_member = {
					limit ={
						leader = {
							OR = {
								has_conservative_ideology = yes
								has_reactionary_ideology = yes
								has_monarchist_ideology = yes
							}
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = relevant_lobby_member
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_lobby
				target = {
					save_scope_as = relevant_lobby_country
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					is_member_of_any_lobby = no
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_conservative_ideology = yes
							has_reactionary_ideology = yes
							has_monarchist_ideology = yes
						}
					}
				}
				any_political_lobby = { # existing member has opposing ideology
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					target = { has_technology_researched = film }
					any_lobby_member = {
						leader = {
							OR = {
								has_progressive_ideology = yes
								has_liberal_ideology = yes
								has_socialist_ideology = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					is_member_of_any_lobby = no
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_conservative_ideology = yes
							has_reactionary_ideology = yes
							has_monarchist_ideology = yes
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_ig
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = relevant_ig_leader
				}
			}
			random_political_lobby = {
				limit = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					target = { has_technology_researched = film }
					any_lobby_member = {
						leader = {
							OR = {
								has_progressive_ideology = yes
								has_liberal_ideology = yes
								has_socialist_ideology = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
				random_lobby_member = {
					limit ={
						leader = {
							OR = {
								has_progressive_ideology = yes
								has_liberal_ideology = yes
								has_socialist_ideology = yes
							}
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = relevant_lobby_member
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_lobby
				target = {
					save_scope_as = relevant_lobby_country
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { exists = scope:relevant_lobby }
			NOT = { exists = scope:relevant_lobby_country }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = lobby_events.31.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:relevant_lobby = {
			add_lobby_member = scope:relevant_ig
			change_appeasement = {
			   amount = 2
			   factor = appeasement_lobby_pleased
			}
		}
		scope:relevant_lobby_member = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = ig_join_pol_str_positive
				days = normal_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = lobby_events.31.b
		scope:relevant_lobby = {
			add_lobby_member = scope:relevant_ig
		}
		scope:relevant_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = ig_join_pol_str_negative
				days = normal_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# A Shining Example
lobby_events.32 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = lobby_events.32.t
	desc = lobby_events.32.d
	flavor = lobby_events.32.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_ruler_speaking_to_people"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	dlc = dlc010

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = lobbies
		is_revolutionary = no
		any_interest_group = {
			is_member_of_any_lobby = no
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			leader = {
				OR = {
					has_conservative_ideology = yes
					has_reactionary_ideology = yes
				}
			}
		}
		any_political_lobby = {
			is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
			target = {
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_charitable_health_system
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_religious_schools
				}
				ruler = {
					OR = {
						has_conservative_ideology = yes
						has_reactionary_ideology = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_member_of_any_lobby = no
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				leader = {
					OR = {
						has_conservative_ideology = yes
						has_reactionary_ideology = yes
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_ig
		}
		random_political_lobby = {
			limit = {
				is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
				target = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_charitable_health_system
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_religious_schools
					}
					ruler = {
						OR = {
							has_conservative_ideology = yes
							has_reactionary_ideology = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_lobby
			target = {
				save_scope_as = relevant_lobby_country
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { exists = scope:relevant_lobby }
			NOT = { exists = scope:relevant_lobby_country }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = lobby_events.32.a
		default_option = yes
			scope:relevant_lobby = {
				add_lobby_member = scope:relevant_ig
			}
			scope:relevant_ig = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = ig_join_pol_str_positive
					days = normal_modifier_time
					is_decaying = yes
				}
			}
	}
	option = {
		name = lobby_events.32.b
		scope:relevant_lobby = {
			change_appeasement = {
			   amount = -2
			   factor = appeasement_lobby_displeased
			}
		}
		scope:relevant_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = lobby_events_ig_blocked
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_radicals = {
			pop_type = clergymen
			religion = root.religion
			value = medium_radicals
		}
	}
}

# Less Is More
lobby_events.33 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = lobby_events.33.t
	desc = lobby_events.33.d
	flavor = lobby_events.33.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_politicians_arguing"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	dlc = dlc010

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = lobbies
		is_revolutionary = no
		any_political_lobby = {
			OR = {
				is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
				is_political_lobby_type = lobby_anti_country
			}
			any_lobby_member = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				count >= 3
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_political_lobby = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_anti_country
				}
				any_lobby_member = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					count >= 3
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_lobby
			random_lobby_member = {
				limit = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_ig
			}
			random_lobby_member = { # another ig in the same lobby
				limit = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					NOT = { this = scope:relevant_ig }
				}
				save_scope_as = other_ig
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { exists = scope:relevant_lobby }
			NOT = { exists = scope:relevant_lobby_country }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = lobby_events.33.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:relevant_lobby = {
			remove_lobby_member = scope:relevant_ig
		}
		scope:other_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = ig_join_pol_str_positive
				days = normal_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # appears if relevant_ig is not in government
		name = lobby_events.33.b
		trigger = {
			scope:relevant_ig = {
				is_in_government = no
			}
		}
		scope:relevant_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = lobby_events_ig_blocked
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # appears if relevant_ig is in government
		name = lobby_events.33.c
		trigger = {
			scope:relevant_ig = {
				is_in_government = yes
			}
		}
		scope:relevant_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = lobby_events_ig_blocked
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = medium_radicals
			interest_group = scope:relevant_ig
		}
	}
}

lobby_events.36 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = lobby_events.36.t
	desc = lobby_events.36.d
	flavor = lobby_events.36.f

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_aristocrats"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	dlc = dlc010

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = { # Check if free trade is being enacted
		has_dlc_feature = lobbies
		is_revolutionary = no
		is_enacting_law = law_type:law_free_trade
		any_interest_group = {
			is_member_of_any_lobby = no
			law_stance = {
				law = law_type:law_free_trade
				value < neutral
			}
		}
		any_political_lobby = {
			is_political_lobby_type = lobby_anti_country
			target = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_free_trade
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_member_of_any_lobby = no
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_free_trade
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = relevant_ig_leader
			}
		}
		random_political_lobby = {
			limit = {
				is_political_lobby_type = lobby_anti_country
				target = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_free_trade
				}
			}
			random_lobby_member = {
				save_scope_as = relevant_lobby_member # An IG already in the lobby
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_lobby
			target = {
				save_scope_as = relevant_lobby_country
			}
		}
		currently_enacting_law = {
    		save_scope_as = relevant_law_scope
    	}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:relevant_law_scope }
			NOT = { exists = scope:relevant_lobby }
			NOT = { exists = scope:relevant_lobby_country }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = lobby_events.36.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:relevant_lobby = {
			add_lobby_member = scope:relevant_ig
			change_appeasement = {
			   amount = 1
			   factor = appeasement_lobby_pleased
			}
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = ig_unhappy_with_law_enactment
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = lobby_events.36.b
		scope:relevant_lobby = {
			add_lobby_member = scope:relevant_ig
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = small_radicals
			interest_group = scope:relevant_ig
		}
	}
}

	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	dlc = dlc010

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = lobbies
		is_revolutionary = no
		OR = {
			AND = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
				any_interest_group = {
					is_member_of_any_lobby = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				any_political_lobby = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					target = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_census_voting
				any_interest_group = {
					is_member_of_any_lobby = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_census_voting
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				any_political_lobby = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					target = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_census_voting
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
				any_interest_group = {
					is_member_of_any_lobby = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				any_political_lobby = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					target = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
					}
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					is_member_of_any_lobby = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_ig
			}
			random_political_lobby = {
				limit = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					target = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
					}
				}
				target = {
					save_scope_as = relevant_lobby_country
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_lobby
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_census_voting
				any_interest_group = {
					is_member_of_any_lobby = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_census_voting
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				any_political_lobby = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					target = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_census_voting
					}
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					is_member_of_any_lobby = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_census_voting
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_ig
			}
			random_political_lobby = {
				limit = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					target = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_census_voting
					}
				}
				target = {
					save_scope_as = relevant_lobby_country
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_lobby
			}
		}
		currently_enacting_law = {
    		save_scope_as = relevant_law_scope
    	}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:relevant_law_scope }
			NOT = { exists = scope:relevant_lobby }
			NOT = { exists = scope:relevant_lobby_country }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = lobby_events.37.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:relevant_lobby = {
			add_lobby_member = scope:relevant_ig
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = ig_law_enactment_speed_good
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = lobby_events.37.b
		scope:relevant_lobby = {
			add_lobby_member = scope:relevant_ig
			change_appeasement = {
			   amount = 1
			   factor = appeasement_lobby_pleased
			}
		}
	}
}

		}
	}

lobby_events.54 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = lobby_events.54.t
	desc = lobby_events.54.d
	flavor = lobby_events.54.f

		video = "unspecific_ruler_speaking_to_people"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = lobbies
		is_revolutionary = no
		any_scope_character = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			exists = home_country
			NOT = { home_country = ROOT }
			home_country = {
				save_temporary_scope_as = agitator_home_country_temp
			}
		}
		any_political_lobby = {
			OR = {
				is_political_lobby_type = lobby_anti_overlord
				is_political_lobby_type = lobby_anti_country
			}
			target = {
				scope:agitator_home_country_temp ?= THIS
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_role_of_type = agitator
				exists = home_country
				NOT = { home_country = ROOT }
			}
			home_country = {
				save_scope_as = agitator_home_country
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_agitator
		}
		random_political_lobby = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_anti_overlord
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_anti_country
				}
				target = {
					scope:agitator_home_country ?= THIS
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_lobby
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		scope:relevant_agitator = {
			is_character_alive = no
		}
	}

	option = { # Discouraged
		name = lobby_events.54.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:relevant_lobby = {
			change_appeasement = {
				amount = -1
				factor = appeasement_lobby_loss
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # Encouraged
		name = lobby_events.54.b
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:agitator_home_country
			value = -10
		}
	}
}

lobby_events.55 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = lobby_events.55.t
	desc = lobby_events.55.d
	flavor = lobby_events.55.f

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_transfer_of_authority"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = lobbies
		is_revolutionary = no
		NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_police }
		any_political_lobby = {
			OR = {
				is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_overlord
				is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
			}
			any_lobby_member = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				save_temporary_scope_as = temp_lobby_member
			}
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_political_lobby = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_overlord
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
				}
				any_lobby_member = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_lobby
			target = {
				save_scope_as = relevant_lobby_country
			}
			random_lobby_member = {
				limit = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_lobby_member
			}
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_state
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { exists = scope:relevant_lobby }
	}

	option = { # Allow the pro-lobby & police activity to continue
		name = lobby_events.55.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:relevant_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
			}
		}
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:relevant_lobby_country
			value = 5
		}

lobby_events.57 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = lobby_events.57.t

	}
