belle_epoque_events.1 = { #Eiffel Tower
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:eiffel_state

    title = belle_epoque_events.1.t
    desc = belle_epoque_events.1.d
    flavor = belle_epoque_events.1.f

    event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_world_fair"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

    duration = 3

    cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		owns_entire_state_region = STATE_ILE_DE_FRANCE
		any_scope_state = {
			has_building = building_eiffel_tower
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = eiffel_var }
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_building = building_eiffel_tower
			}
			save_scope_as = eiffel_state
		}
		set_variable = eiffel_var
	}

	option = { #yeeeehawwww
		name = belle_epoque_events.1.a
		add_modifier = {
			name = eiffel_tower_modifier #prestige bonus but it costs you some extra bureaucracy
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		create_character = {
			template = FRA_gustave_eiffel
			on_created = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = gustave_eiffel_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
				set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #it's lowkey ugly
		name = belle_epoque_events.1.b
		default_option = yes
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = eiffel_tower_intelligentsia_modifier #they agree
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = eiffel_tower_slander_modifier #it's perfect!
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		create_character = {
			template = FRA_gustave_eiffel
			on_created = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = gustave_eiffel_sad_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #we shall dismantle it as soon as the exposition ends
		name = belle_epoque_events.1.c
		scope:eiffel_state = { #outrageous!!!
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				pop_type = machinists #we worked so hard on this
				value = small_radicals
			}
			add_loyalists_in_state = { #thank god
				pop_type = academics
				value = medium_radicals
			}
		}
		create_character = {
			template = FRA_gustave_eiffel
			on_created = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = gustave_eiffel_angry_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

belle_epoque_events.2 = { #Art Nouveau
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:belle_epoque_state

    title = belle_epoque_events.2.t
	desc = belle_epoque_events.2.d
	flavor = belle_epoque_events.2.f

    event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_art_gallery"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

    duration = 3

	trigger = {
		any_primary_culture = {
			NOT = { has_cultural_obsession = fine_art }
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			any_scope_building = {
				is_building_type = building_art_academy
				level >= 3
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = art_nouveau_var }
	}

	immediate = {
		random_primary_culture = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_cultural_obsession = fine_art }
			}
			save_scope_as = obsessed_culture
		}
		random_scope_building = {
			limit = {
				is_building_type = building_art_academy
				level >= 3
			}
			save_scope_as = belle_epoque_building
		}
		set_variable = art_nouveau_var
	}

	option = { #great stuff
		name = belle_epoque_events.2.a
		scope:obsessed_culture = {
			add_cultural_obsession = fine_art
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = art_nouveau_love_modifier
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { #this sucks
		name = belle_epoque_events.2.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:belle_epoque_state = {

				pop_type = academics

			}

				pop_type = aristocrats
				value = medium_radicals
			}
		}
		scope:belle_epoque_building = {
			add_modifier = { #strike at the academy
				name = art_nouveau_strike_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

#IG leader joins the Symbolists
belle_epoque_events.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:symbolist_state
	title = belle_epoque_events.3.t
	desc = belle_epoque_events.3.d
	flavor = belle_epoque_events.3.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_art_gallery"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	trigger = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:french
		has_variable = symbolist_chain_2
		any_interest_group = {
			leader = {
				OR = {
					has_trait = romantic
					has_trait = hedonist
					has_trait = charismatic
					has_trait = brave
					has_trait = innovative
				}
				is_busy = no
				is_immortal = no
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = symbolist_var }
	}

	immediate = {
		remove_variable = symbolist_chain_2
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_trait = romantic
							has_trait = hedonist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_trait = romantic
							has_trait = hedonist
						}
						is_busy = no
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = symbolist_ig
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = symbolist_leader
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_trait = brave
							has_trait = innovative
							has_trait = charismatic
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = symbolist_ig
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = symbolist_leader
				}
			}
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_building = {
					is_building_type = building_art_academy
					level >= 3
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = symbolist_state
			random_scope_building = {
				limit = {
					is_building_type = building_art_academy
					level >= 3
				}
				save_scope_as = symbolist_building
			}
		}
		set_variable = symbolist_var
	}

	option = { #good for them
		name = belle_epoque_events.3.a
		scope:symbolist_leader = { #they gain traction
			add_modifier = {
				name = symbolist_leader_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:symbolist_ig = { #but they hate you
			add_modifier = {
				name = symbolist_ig_bad_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #enough with this childish behaviour
		name = belle_epoque_events.3.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:symbolist_leader = { #they lose traction
			add_modifier = {
				name = symbolist_leader_bad_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:symbolist_ig = { #but they like you
			add_modifier = {
				name = symbolist_ig_good_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #make him step down
		name = belle_epoque_events.3.c
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_censorship
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_secret_police
				infamy >= infamy_threshold:infamous
			}
		}
		scope:symbolist_leader = {
			hidden_effect = {
				retire_character = yes
			}
		}
		scope:belle_epoque_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				pop_type = academics
				value = medium_radicals
			}
		}
	}
}

		name = belle_epoque_events.4.b
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_censorship
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_secret_police
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = shut_down_cabaret_modifier #this costs some buraucracy
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
		else = {
			#costs nothing but you piss off people with your violence
			scope:belle_epoque_state = {
				add_radicals_in_state = {
					value = small_radicals
				}
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = cabaret_good_modifier
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}
}

					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "africa_animism"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
			is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_america
			is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = no
			NOR = {
				is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_america
				is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
				is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
			}
			count >= 3
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = no
				NOR = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_america
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = colonial_state
			random_scope_culture = {
				limit = {
					has_homeland = prev
				}
				save_scope_as = colonial_culture
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = belle_epoque_events.13.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:belle_epoque_state = {
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				strata = middle
				value = small_radicals
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = belle_epoque_events.13.b
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_multicultural
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_condemned_human_zoos
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_multicultural
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_condemned_human_zoos_negative
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_neighbouring_state = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						this = root
					}
					has_journal_entry = je_belle_epoque
				}
			}
			owner = {
				save_scope_as = haute_couture_country
			}
		}
	}

	option = {

﻿namespace = bic_breakup

# Independent British East India Company decides how to proceed
bic_breakup.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	title = bic_breakup.1.t
	desc = bic_breakup.1.d
	flavor = bic_breakup.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_sepoy_mutiny"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		c:BIC ?= this
		is_subject = no
		is_at_war = no
		NOT = {
			has_variable = bic_collapse_var
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_primary_culture = {
			save_scope_as = british_culture
		}
		cu:scottish = { # Making sure to cover for that one Scottish guy
			save_scope_as = scottish_culture
		}
		set_variable = bic_collapse_var
	}

	option = {
		name = bic_breakup.1.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 8 # this is the default pick for the AI
		}
		collapse_india_effect = yes
		change_tag = BGL
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_monarchy
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			every_primary_culture = {
				save_temporary_scope_as = primary_culture_to_remove
				PREV ?= { # scope:target
					remove_primary_culture = scope:primary_culture_to_remove
					every_scope_character = {
						limit = {
							scope:primary_culture_to_remove ?= culture 
						}
						retire_character = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add_primary_culture = cu:bengali
			set_state_religion = rel:sunni
			india_independence_ig_effects = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = modifier_india_crown_rule
				}
				remove_modifier = modifier_india_crown_rule
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule
				}
				remove_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule_upgraded
				}
				remove_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule_upgraded
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = modifier_indian_imperial_police
				}
				remove_modifier = modifier_indian_imperial_police
			}
			recalculate_pop_ig_support = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = bic_breakup.1.b
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			has_technology_researched = pan-nationalism
		}
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 1 # this will be quite rare for the AI
		}
		change_tag = BHT
		activate_law = law_type:law_presidential_republic
		hidden_effect = {
			every_primary_culture = {
				save_temporary_scope_as = primary_culture_to_remove
				PREV ?= { # scope:target
					remove_primary_culture = scope:primary_culture_to_remove
					every_scope_character = {
						limit = {
							scope:primary_culture_to_remove ?= culture 
						}
						retire_character = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add_primary_culture = cu:bengali
			add_primary_culture = cu:assamese
			add_primary_culture = cu:avadhi
			add_primary_culture = cu:bihari
			add_primary_culture = cu:gujarati
			add_primary_culture = cu:kannada
			add_primary_culture = cu:malayalam
			add_primary_culture = cu:marathi
			add_primary_culture = cu:oriya
			add_primary_culture = cu:panjabi
			add_primary_culture = cu:rajput
			add_primary_culture = cu:sindi
			add_primary_culture = cu:tamil
			add_primary_culture = cu:telegu
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_atheism
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						religion_percent_country = {
							target = rel:hindu
							value >= 0.5
						}
					}
					set_state_religion = rel:hindu
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						religion_percent_country = {
							target = rel:sunni
							value >= 0.5
						}
					}
					set_state_religion = rel:sunni
				}
				else = {
					set_state_religion = rel:hindu
				}
			}
			india_independence_ig_effects = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = modifier_india_crown_rule
				}
				remove_modifier = modifier_india_crown_rule
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule
				}
				remove_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule_upgraded
				}
				remove_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule_upgraded
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = modifier_indian_imperial_police
				}
				remove_modifier = modifier_indian_imperial_police
			}
			recalculate_pop_ig_support = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = bic_breakup.1.c
		ai_chance = {
			base = 0 # AI will never do this
		}
		default_option = yes
		add_radicals = {
			value = very_large_radicals
		}
		trigger_event = { id = independence.2 days = 1 }
	}
}

# The Qing and the Han
boxer_rebellion_events.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = boxer_rebellion_events.3.t
	desc = boxer_rebellion_events.3.d
	flavor = boxer_rebellion_events.3.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_union_leader"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	minor_left_icon = c:CHI

	trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		cu:manchu = {
			save_scope_as = manchu_culture
		}
		cu:han = {
			save_scope_as = han_culture
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = boxer_rebellion_events.3.a
		default_option = yes

		chi_remove_1_fragile_unity = yes
		add_radicals = {
			value = very_large_radicals
			culture = cu:han
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = boxer_rebellion_events.3.b
		custom_tooltip = boxer_rebellion_events.3.tt1
		set_variable = china_han_empire
		hidden_effect = {
			ruler = {
				kill_character = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_character = {
						is_heir_of_own_country = yes
					}
				}
				heir ?= {
					kill_character = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				year < 1862
			}
			create_character = {
				template = CHI_kong_fanhao
			}
			create_character = {
				template = CHI_kong_xiangke
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				year >= 1848
				year < 1876
			}
			create_character = {
				template = CHI_kong_xiangke
				on_created = {
					set_character_as_ruler = yes
				}
			}
			create_character = {
				template = CHI_kong_lingyi
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				year >= 1872
				year < 1920 # Should be 1919, but for the sake of script it is not
			}
			create_character = {
				template = CHI_kong_lingyi
				on_created = {
					set_character_as_ruler = yes
				}
			}
			create_character = {
				template = CHI_kong_teh_cheng
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				year >= 1921
				year < 1936
			}
			create_character = {
				template = CHI_kong_teh_cheng
				on_created = {
					set_character_as_ruler = yes
				}
			}
		}
		chi_remove_1_fragile_unity = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_national_supremacy
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_ethnostate
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_racial_segregation
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_cultural_exclusion
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_racial_segregation
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_multicultural
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_cultural_exclusion
		}
		remove_primary_culture = cu:manchu
		add_radicals = {
			value = 0.75
			culture = cu:manchu
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
		}
	}
}

					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = anti_slavery_society_legacy

		}
		change_relations = {
			country = c:BRZ
			value = 80
		}

# Brazilian Slaver Seized off [Coast] - GBR
brazilian_slavery.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:slaver_coastal_state_scope

	title = brazilian_slavery.2.t
	desc = brazilian_slavery.2.d
	flavor = brazilian_slavery.2.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_naval_battle"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_modifier = aberdeen_act_enforced_gbr
	}

	immediate = {
		c:BRZ ?= { save_scope_as = brazil_scope }
		c:GBR ?= { save_scope_as = britain_scope }
		c:BRZ ?= {
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_pop = {
						is_pop_type = slaves
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = enslaved_destination_state_scope
			}
		}
		random_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = sr:region_equatorial_africa
					region = sr:region_west_africa
					state_region = s:STATE_SOUTH_ATLANTIC_ISLANDS
				}
				is_coastal = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = slaver_coastal_state_scope
			set_variable = {
				name = slaver_coastal_state_var
				months = 2
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = brazilian_slavery.2.a
		default_option = yes
		change_infamy = 1
		change_relations = {
			country = c:BRZ
			value = -10
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_slave_trade
						value = strongly_disapprove
					}
				}
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_slave_trade
						value = strongly_disapprove
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = approves_of_slave_hunting_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
					multiplier = 2
				}
			}
		}
		scope:brazil_scope = {
			trigger_event = { id = brazilian_slavery.3 days = 0 popup = yes }
			set_variable = {
				name = arrested_slavers_var
				months = 2
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = brazilian_slavery.2.b
		change_relations = {
			country = c:BRZ
			value = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_slave_trade
						value = strongly_disapprove
					}
				}
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_slave_trade
						value = strongly_disapprove
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = approves_of_slave_hunting_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		scope:brazil_scope = {
			trigger_event = { id = brazilian_slavery.3 days = 0 popup = yes }
		}
	}
}

# Britain Seizes Brazilian Slaver off [Coast] - BRZ
brazilian_slavery.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	title = brazilian_slavery.3.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = { # Slavers Arrested
				desc = brazilian_slavery.3.d_1
				trigger = {
					has_variable = arrested_slavers_var
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = { # Slavers Not Arrested
				desc = brazilian_slavery.3.d_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = { has_variable = arrested_slavers_var }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = { # Slavers Arrested
				desc = brazilian_slavery.3.f_1
				trigger = {
					has_variable = arrested_slavers_var
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = { # Slavers Not Arrested
				desc = brazilian_slavery.3.f_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = { has_variable = arrested_slavers_var }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_naval_battle"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	trigger = {
		# triggered by brazilian_slavery.2
	}

	immediate = {
		c:BRZ ?= { save_scope_as = brazil_scope }
		c:GBR ?= { save_scope_as = britain_scope }
		random_state = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = slaver_coastal_state_var
			}
			save_scope_as = slaver_coastal_state_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = brazilian_slavery.3.a
		default_option = yes
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = slave_flow_disrupted_modifier
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			75 = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = slave_shipments_intercepted_small
					days = short_modifier_time
				}
			}
			25 = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = slave_shipments_intercepted_large
					days = short_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = brazilian_slavery.3.b
		add_radicals = {
			pop_type = aristocrats
			value = medium_radicals
		}
		random_list = {
			75 = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = slave_shipments_intercepted_small
					days = short_modifier_time
				}
			}
			25 = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = slave_shipments_intercepted_large
					days = short_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Slaver Spotted in Brazilian Waters - GBR
brazilian_slavery.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:slaver_coastal_state_scope_2

	title = brazilian_slavery.4.t
	desc = brazilian_slavery.4.d
	flavor = brazilian_slavery.4.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_naval_battle"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_modifier = aberdeen_act_enforced_gbr
		c:BRZ ?= {
			any_scope_state = {
				is_coastal = yes
				any_scope_pop = {
					is_pop_type = slaves
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		c:BRZ ?= { save_scope_as = brazil_scope }
		c:GBR ?= { save_scope_as = britain_scope }
		c:BRZ ?= {
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					is_coastal = yes
					any_scope_pop = {
						is_pop_type = slaves
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = slaver_coastal_state_scope_2
				set_variable = {
					name = slaver_coastal_state_var_2
					months = 2
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = brazilian_slavery.4.a
		default_option = yes
		change_infamy = 4
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_slave_trade
						value = strongly_disapprove
					}
				}
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_slave_trade
						value = strongly_disapprove
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = committed_abolitionists_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		scope:brazil_scope = {
			trigger_event = { id = brazilian_slavery.5 days = 0 popup = yes }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = brazilian_slavery.4.b
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_slave_trade
						value = strongly_disapprove
					}
				}
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_slave_trade
						value = strongly_disapprove
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = impotent_anti_slavery_squadron_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Royal Navy seizes slaver in Brazilian waters. - BRZ
brazilian_slavery.5 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:slaver_coastal_state_scope_2

	title = brazilian_slavery.5.t
	desc = brazilian_slavery.5.d
	flavor = brazilian_slavery.5.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_naval_battle"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	trigger = {
		# triggered by brazilian_slavery.4
	}

	immediate = {
		c:BRZ ?= { save_scope_as = brazil_scope }
		c:GBR ?= { save_scope_as = britain_scope }
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = slaver_coastal_state_var_2
			}
			save_scope_as = slaver_coastal_state_scope_2
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = brazilian_slavery.5.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = weakness_in_the_face_of_albion_modifier
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = small_radicals
		}
		random_list = {
			50 = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = slave_shipments_intercepted_small
					days = short_modifier_time
				}
			}
			50 = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = slave_shipments_intercepted_large
					days = short_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = brazilian_slavery.5.b
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			naval_power_projection >= 500
		}
		change_relations = {
			country = c:GBR
			value = -10
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = weakness_in_the_face_of_albion_modifier
			days = short_modifier_time
			multiplier = 0.5
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = slave_shipments_intercepted_small
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
	}
}

# Matter of Slavery Completion Event
brazilian_slavery.7 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	title = brazilian_slavery.7.t
	desc = brazilian_slavery.7.d
	flavor = brazilian_slavery.7.f

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_christianity"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	trigger = {
		# triggered by journal entry
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					OR = {
						is_heir_of_own_country = yes
						is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
					}
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_heir_of_own_country = yes
						is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
					}
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
				}
				save_scope_as = golden_rose_recipient_scope
			}
		}
		else = {
			ruler = {
				save_scope_as = golden_rose_recipient_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = brazilian_slavery.7.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = unfettered_pride_modifier
			days = very_long_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					OR = {
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_slave_trade
							value >= approve
						}
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
							value >= approve
						}
					}
				}
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					OR = {
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_slave_trade
							value >= approve
						}
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
							value >= approve
						}
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = old_order_upset_negative
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					OR = {
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_slave_trade
							value <= disapprove
						}
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
							value <= disapprove
						}
					}
				}
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					OR = {
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_slave_trade
							value <= disapprove
						}
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
							value <= disapprove
						}
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = old_order_upset_positive
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = brazilian_slavery.7.b
		add_modifier = {
			name = less_racist_brazil_modifier
			days = very_long_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					OR = {
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_slave_trade
							value >= approve
						}
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
							value >= approve
						}
					}
				}
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					OR = {
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_slave_trade
							value >= approve
						}
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
							value >= approve
						}
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = old_order_upset_negative
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					OR = {
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_slave_trade
							value <= disapprove
						}
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
							value <= disapprove
						}
					}
				}
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					OR = {
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_slave_trade
							value <= disapprove
						}
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
							value <= disapprove
						}
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = old_order_upset_positive
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:golden_rose_recipient_scope = {
					is_female = no
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = black_guard_male_modifier
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:golden_rose_recipient_scope = {
					is_female = yes
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = black_guard_female_modifier
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

# Slaves Flee / Refuse to Work
brazilian_slavery.8 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:slave_plantation_state_scope

	title = brazilian_slavery.8.t
	desc = brazilian_slavery.8.d
	flavor = brazilian_slavery.8.f

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_slaves_night"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = slavery_event_cooldown }
		any_scope_state = {
			any_scope_pop = {
				is_pop_type = slaves
				is_employed = yes
				workplace ?= {
					OR = {
						is_building_type = building_coffee_plantation
						is_building_type = building_cotton_plantation
						is_building_type = building_dye_plantation
						is_building_type = building_opium_plantation
						is_building_type = building_tea_plantation
						is_building_type = building_tobacco_plantation
						is_building_type = building_sugar_plantation
						is_building_type = building_banana_plantation
						is_building_type = building_silk_plantation
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = slavery_event_cooldown
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_pop = {
					is_pop_type = slaves
					is_employed = yes
					workplace ?= {
						OR = {
							is_building_type = building_coffee_plantation
							is_building_type = building_cotton_plantation
							is_building_type = building_dye_plantation
							is_building_type = building_opium_plantation
							is_building_type = building_tea_plantation
							is_building_type = building_tobacco_plantation
							is_building_type = building_sugar_plantation
							is_building_type = building_banana_plantation
							is_building_type = building_silk_plantation
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = slaves
					is_employed = yes
					workplace ?= {
						OR = {
							is_building_type = building_coffee_plantation
							is_building_type = building_cotton_plantation
							is_building_type = building_dye_plantation
							is_building_type = building_opium_plantation
							is_building_type = building_tea_plantation
							is_building_type = building_tobacco_plantation
							is_building_type = building_sugar_plantation
							is_building_type = building_banana_plantation
							is_building_type = building_silk_plantation
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = slave_plantation_slaves_scope
				workplace = {
					save_scope_as = slave_plantation_scope
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = slave_plantation_state_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = brazilian_slavery.8.a
		default_option = yes
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = masters_upset_over_concessions
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = brazilian_slavery.8.b
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = unrestrained_masters
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:slave_plantation_scope = {
			random_list = {
				3 = {
					add_modifier = {
						name = slave_shortages_modifier
						days = normal_modifier_time
					}
				}
				1 = {
					add_modifier = {
						name = slave_shortages_modifier
						days = normal_modifier_time
						multiplier = 0.5
					}
				}
			}
		}
		scope:slave_plantation_state_scope = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				pop_type = slaves
				value = small_radicals
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = brazilian_slavery.8.c
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slave_trade
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = slave_purchases_modifier
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_very_small
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
	}
}

# Slave Sabotage
brazilian_slavery.9 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:slowdown_slave_plantation_state_scope

	title = brazilian_slavery.9.t
	desc = brazilian_slavery.9.d
	flavor = brazilian_slavery.9.f

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_slaves_night"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = slavery_event_cooldown }
		any_scope_state = {
			any_scope_pop = {
				is_pop_type = slaves
				workplace ?= {
					OR = {
						is_building_type = building_coffee_plantation
						is_building_type = building_cotton_plantation
						is_building_type = building_dye_plantation
						is_building_type = building_opium_plantation
						is_building_type = building_tea_plantation
						is_building_type = building_tobacco_plantation
						is_building_type = building_sugar_plantation
						is_building_type = building_banana_plantation
						is_building_type = building_silk_plantation
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = slavery_event_cooldown
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_pop = {
					is_pop_type = slaves
					workplace ?= {
						OR = {
							is_building_type = building_coffee_plantation
							is_building_type = building_cotton_plantation
							is_building_type = building_dye_plantation
							is_building_type = building_opium_plantation
							is_building_type = building_tea_plantation
							is_building_type = building_tobacco_plantation
							is_building_type = building_sugar_plantation
							is_building_type = building_banana_plantation
							is_building_type = building_silk_plantation
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = slaves
					workplace ?= {
						OR = {
							is_building_type = building_coffee_plantation
							is_building_type = building_cotton_plantation
							is_building_type = building_dye_plantation
							is_building_type = building_opium_plantation
							is_building_type = building_tea_plantation
							is_building_type = building_tobacco_plantation
							is_building_type = building_sugar_plantation
							is_building_type = building_banana_plantation
							is_building_type = building_silk_plantation
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = slowdown_slave_plantation_slaves_scope
				workplace = {
					save_scope_as = slowdown_slave_plantation_scope
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = slowdown_slave_plantation_state_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_political_movement = {
					is_revolutionary = yes
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_slavery_banned
						value > neutral
					}
				}
			}
			civil_war_save_scopes = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = brazilian_slavery.9.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:slowdown_slave_plantation_state_scope = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				pop_type = slaves
				value = medium_radicals
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_slave_trade
						value <= disapprove
					}
				}
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_slave_trade
						value <= disapprove
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = widespread_slave_abuse
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = brazilian_slavery.9.b
		scope:slowdown_slave_plantation_scope = {
			random_list = {
				3 = {
					add_modifier = {
						name = plantation_slowdowns_slavery_modifier
						days = short_modifier_time
					}
				}
				1 = {
					add_modifier = {
						name = plantation_slowdowns_slavery_modifier
						days = normal_modifier_time
						multiplier = 0.75
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = brazilian_slavery.9.c
		trigger = {
			any_political_movement = {
				is_revolutionary = yes
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_slavery_banned
					value > neutral
				}
			}
		}

			add_civil_war_progress = revolution_advance_medium
		}
	}

# Slave Escape
brazilian_slavery.10 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:escape_slave_plantation_state_scope

	title = brazilian_slavery.10.t
	desc = brazilian_slavery.10.d
	flavor = brazilian_slavery.10.f

		video = "southamerica_slaves_night"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = slavery_event_cooldown }
		any_scope_state = {
			any_scope_pop = {
				is_pop_type = slaves
				workplace ?= {
					OR = {
						is_building_type = building_coffee_plantation
						is_building_type = building_cotton_plantation
						is_building_type = building_dye_plantation
						is_building_type = building_opium_plantation
						is_building_type = building_tea_plantation
						is_building_type = building_tobacco_plantation
						is_building_type = building_sugar_plantation
						is_building_type = building_banana_plantation
						is_building_type = building_silk_plantation
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = slavery_event_cooldown
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_pop = {

							is_building_type = building_coffee_plantation

							is_building_type = building_opium_plantation
							is_building_type = building_tea_plantation
							is_building_type = building_tobacco_plantation
							is_building_type = building_sugar_plantation
							is_building_type = building_banana_plantation

					}
				}

					add_modifier = {
						name = disastrous_slave_hunt
						days = normal_modifier_time
					}

				}

# Enforce the Aberdeen Act - GBR
brazilian_slavery.11 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	title = brazilian_slavery.11.t
	desc = brazilian_slavery.11.d
	flavor = brazilian_slavery.11.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_naval_battle"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	trigger = {
		# triggered by journal entry
	}

	immediate = {
		c:BRZ ?= { save_scope_as = brazil_scope }
		c:GBR ?= { save_scope_as = britain_scope }
	}

	option = {
		name = brazilian_slavery.11.a
		default_option = yes
		change_relations = {
			country = c:BRZ
			value = -50
		}
		# Makes up for part of the lost prestige and influence
		add_modifier = {
			name = aberdeen_act_enforced_gbr
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		# Large convoy and trade penalties
		show_as_tooltip = {
			c:BRZ ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = aberdeen_act_enforced_brz
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		c:BRZ ?= {
			trigger_event = { id = brazilian_slavery.12 popup = yes }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = aberdeen_act_pop_support_tt
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_diplomatic_relevance = c:BRZ
					has_diplomatic_relevance = c:GBR
				}
			}
			post_notification = aberdeen_act_notification
		}
	}
}

# Slavery Fail Event
brazilian_slavery.13 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	title = brazilian_slavery.13.t
	desc = brazilian_slavery.13.d
	flavor = brazilian_slavery.13.f

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_gunboat_diplomacy"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	trigger = {
		# triggered by journal entry
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:GBR ?= {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
				}
			}
			c:GBR ?= {
				save_scope_as = anti_slavery_great_power_scope
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
					country_rank = rank_value:great_power
				}
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
					country_rank = rank_value:great_power
				}
				save_scope_as = anti_slavery_great_power_scope
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
				}
				save_scope_as = anti_slavery_great_power_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = brazilian_slavery.13.a
		default_option = yes
        ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
            add_ideology = ideology_pro_slavery
        }
        add_modifier = {
            name = brazil_slaving_pariah_modifier
        }
        add_loyalists = {
        	pop_type = aristocrats
        	value = medium_radicals
        }
        add_radicals = {
        	culture = cu:afro_brazilian
        	value = large_radicals
        }
        every_country = {
        	limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
				country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
        	}
        	change_relations = { country = root value = -30 }
        }
	}
}

# Brazil navy start
brazil_navy.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = brazil_navy.1.t
	desc = brazil_navy.1.d
	flavor = brazil_navy.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "ep2_active_shipyard"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/bicorne_hat.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	trigger = {
		# triggered by je_brazil_navy
	}

	immediate = {
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = ruler_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_role_of_type = admiral
					commander_rank >= 5
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_role_of_type = admiral
					commander_rank >= 5
				}
				save_scope_as = admiral_scope
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_role_of_type = admiral
					commander_rank >= 4
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_role_of_type = admiral
					commander_rank >= 4
				}
				save_scope_as = admiral_scope
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_role_of_type = admiral
					commander_rank >= 3
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_role_of_type = admiral
					commander_rank >= 3
				}
				save_scope_as = admiral_scope
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_role_of_type = admiral
					commander_rank >= 2
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_role_of_type = admiral
					commander_rank >= 2
				}
				save_scope_as = admiral_scope
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}
				save_scope_as = admiral_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # Brazil needs a strong navy
		name = brazil_navy.1.a
		default_option = yes
		show_as_tooltip = {
			add_journal_entry = {
				type = je_brazil_navy
			}
		}
		scope:admiral_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = brz_navy_advocate
			}
		}
	}
}

# Navy complains that other countries are too relatively powerful
brazil_navy.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = brazil_navy.2.t
	desc = brazil_navy.2.d
	flavor = brazil_navy.2.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_naval_battle"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/bicorne_hat.dds"

	cooldown = { days = long_modifier_time }

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	trigger = {
		# triggered by je_brazil_navy
		OR = {
			any_country = {
				naval_power_projection > root.naval_power_projection
				count > 10
			}
			any_country = {
				naval_power_projection > root.naval_power_projection
				is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
			}
		}
		any_scope_character = {
			has_role_of_type = admiral
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = ruler_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_role_of_type = admiral
					NOT = { has_modifier = brz_navy_advocate }
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_role_of_type = admiral
					NOT = { has_modifier = brz_navy_advocate }
				}
				save_scope_as = admiral_scope
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}
				save_scope_as = admiral_scope
			}
		}
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			save_scope_as = navy_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					naval_power_projection > root.naval_power_projection
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
				}
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					naval_power_projection > root.naval_power_projection
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
				}
				save_scope_as = naval_rival
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					naval_power_projection > root.naval_power_projection
				}
				save_scope_as = naval_rival
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # We will have to do better
		name = brazil_navy.2.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:navy_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = brz_eclipsed_navy
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:admiral_scope = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_modifier = brz_navy_advocate }
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = brz_navy_advocate
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					value = 0.5

				add_loyalists_in_state = {
					pop_type = soldiers
					value = 0.25
				}
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_naval_administration
						level >= 1
					}
				}
				add_loyalists_in_state = {
					pop_type = officers
					value = 0.5
				}
				add_loyalists_in_state = {
					pop_type = soldiers
					value = 0.25
				}
			}
		}

		every_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					THIS = ROOT
				}
				has_interest_marker_in_region = sr:region_brazil
			}
			post_notification = brz_navy_completed
		}
	}

british_dictates.1 = { # Expand plantations

	placement = root

	desc = british_dictates.1.d

	event_image = {

	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ip2_content
		c:BIC ?= this
		is_subject = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = no_overlord_dictate_tt
			NOR = {
				has_journal_entry = je_british_dictate_plantations
				has_journal_entry = je_british_dictate_military
				has_journal_entry = je_british_dictate_law
				has_journal_entry = je_british_dictate_universities
			}
		}
		has_government_type = gov_chartered_company
		NOT = {
			has_variable = british_dictate_cooldown
		}
		OR = {
			AND = {
				top_overlord.market_capital.market = {
					mg:opium = { market_goods_pricier > 0 }
				}
				country_has_building_type_levels = {
					target = bt:building_opium_plantation
					value >= 10
				}
				any_scope_state = {
					can_construct_building = building_opium_plantation
				}
				ROOT.free_opium_producing_arable_land >= 50
			}
			AND = {
				top_overlord.market_capital.market = {
					mg:tea = { market_goods_pricier > 0 }
				}
				country_has_building_type_levels = {
					target = bt:building_tea_plantation
					value >= 10
				}
				any_scope_state = {
					can_construct_building = building_tea_plantation
				}
				ROOT.free_tea_producing_arable_land >= 50
			}
			AND = {
				top_overlord.market_capital.market = {
					mg:dye = { market_goods_pricier > 0 }
				}
				country_has_building_type_levels = {
					target = bt:building_dye_plantation
					value >= 10
				}
				any_scope_state = {
					can_construct_building = building_dye_plantation
				}
				ROOT.free_dye_producing_arable_land >= 50
			}
			AND = {
				top_overlord.market_capital.market = {
					mg:fabric = { market_goods_pricier > 0 }
				}
				country_has_building_type_levels = {
					target = bt:building_cotton_plantation
					value >= 10
				}
				any_scope_state = {
					can_construct_building = building_cotton_plantation
				}
				ROOT.free_cotton_producing_arable_land >= 50
			}
			AND = {
				top_overlord.market_capital.market = {
					mg:tobacco = { market_goods_pricier > 0 }
				}
				country_has_building_type_levels = {
					target = bt:building_tobacco_plantation
					value >= 10
				}
				any_scope_state = {
					can_construct_building = building_tobacco_plantation
				}
				ROOT.free_tobacco_producing_arable_land >= 50
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			is_subject_of = scope:overlord_scope
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = british_dictate_cooldown days = long_modifier_time }
		top_overlord = {
			save_scope_as = overlord_scope
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					is_in_government = yes
				}
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = board_of_control_character
				}
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			20 = {
				trigger = {
					top_overlord.market_capital.market = {
						mg:opium = { market_goods_pricier > -0.25 }
					}
					country_has_building_group_levels = {
						target = bt:building_opium_plantation
						value >= 10
					}
					ROOT.free_opium_producing_arable_land >= 50
				}
				set_variable = { name = dictate_plantation_type value = 1 }
			}
			20 = {
				trigger = {
					top_overlord.market_capital.market = {
						mg:tea = { market_goods_pricier > -0.25 }
					}
					country_has_building_type_levels = {
						target = bt:building_tea_plantation
						value >= 10
					}
					ROOT.free_tea_producing_arable_land >= 50
				}
				set_variable = { name = dictate_plantation_type value = 2 }
			}
			20 = {
				trigger = {
					top_overlord.market_capital.market = {
						mg:dye = { market_goods_pricier > -0.25 }
					}
					country_has_building_type_levels = {
						target = bt:building_dye_plantation
						value >= 10
					}
					ROOT.free_dye_producing_arable_land >= 50
				}
				set_variable = { name = dictate_plantation_type value = 3 }
			}
			20 = {
				trigger = {
					top_overlord.market_capital.market = {
						mg:fabric = { market_goods_pricier > -0.25 }
					}
					country_has_building_type_levels = {
						target = bt:building_cotton_plantation
						value >= 10
					}
					ROOT.free_cotton_producing_arable_land >= 50
				}
				set_variable = { name = dictate_plantation_type value = 4 }
			}
			20 = {

		}
		imposed_law = {

					liberty_desire > 40
				}
				add = 20
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					0.1 > "enactment_chance_for_law(imposed_law.type)"
					liberty_desire > 60
				}
				add = 50
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					0.1 > "enactment_chance_for_law(imposed_law.type)"
					scope:foreign_imposition_country = { relations:root <= relations_threshold:neutral }
				}
				add = 10
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					0.1 > "enactment_chance_for_law(imposed_law.type)"
					scope:foreign_imposition_country = { relations:root <= relations_threshold:poor }
				}
				add = 20
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					0.1 > "enactment_chance_for_law(imposed_law.type)"
					scope:foreign_imposition_country = { relations:root <= relations_threshold:cold }
				}
				add = 50
			}
		}
	}

	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = raj.1.t
	desc = raj.1.d
	flavor = raj.1.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_transfer_of_authority"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_scales.dds"

	minor_left_icon = c:GBR
	minor_right_icon = c:BIC

	trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		c:BIC ?= {
			save_scope_as = company_country
			trigger_event = { id = raj.7 days = 0 popup = yes }
		}
		c:GBR ?= {
			save_scope_as = british_raj_country
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = british_raj_var
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = raj.1.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = activate_british_raj
		hidden_effect = {
			# Remove the East India Company's ownership of the BIC country and then disband the company
			scope:company_country ?= {
				owning_company ?= {
					if = {
						limit = {
							is_company_type = company_type:company_east_india_company
						}
						remove_owned_country = scope:company_country
						owner ?= {
							remove_company = prev.type
						}
					}
				}
				set_country_type = colonial
				decrease_autonomy = yes
			}
		}
		show_as_tooltip = {
			remove_company = company_type:company_east_india_company
			create_diplomatic_pact = {
				country = c:BIC
				type = colony
			}
		}
		c:BIC ?= {
			set_variable = doctrine_of_lapse_ended
			custom_tooltip = doctrine_of_lapse_disabled
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule
				}
				remove_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule
			}
			if = { # Should never happen, but just in case
				limit = {
					has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule_upgraded
				}
				remove_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule_upgraded
			}
			add_modifier = modifier_india_crown_rule
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_appointed_bureaucrats
					}
				}
				activate_law = law_type:law_appointed_bureaucrats
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_autocracy
					}
				}
				activate_law = law_type:law_autocracy
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_hindu_caste_enforced
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_hindu_caste_codified
					}
				}
				activate_law = law_type:law_hindu_caste_codified
			}
			ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_government_of_india
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					game_date < 1862.1.1
					NOT = {
						has_variable = canning_var
					}
				}
				set_variable = canning_var
				create_character = {
					template = BIC_charles_canning
					on_created = {
						set_variable = { name = colonial_governor_term value = 0 }
						set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
						set_character_as_ruler = yes
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					game_date < 1879.1.1
					NOT = {
						has_variable = lawrence_var
					}
				}
				set_variable = lawrence_var
				create_character = {
					template = BIC_john_lawrence
					on_created = {
						set_variable = { name = colonial_governor_term value = 0 }
						set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
						set_character_as_ruler = yes
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				create_character = {
					culture = cu:british
					interest_group = ig:ig_industrialists
					on_created = {
						set_variable = { name = colonial_governor_term value = 0 }
						set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
						set_character_as_ruler = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

raj.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = raj.2.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = raj.2.d1
				trigger = {
					ruler = {
						age > 60
					}
					NOT = {
						exists = heir
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = raj.2.d2
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = raj.2.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_redcoats"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	minor_left_icon = c:BIC

	immediate = {
		c:BIC ?= {
			save_scope_as = overlord_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = raj.2.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 90
		}
		if = {
			limit = { # Should never happen, but just to be sure.
				is_player = yes
			}
			play_as = scope:overlord_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				gold_reserves > 0
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = transfers_treasury_to_eic_tt
				scope:overlord_scope ?= {
					add_treasury = {
						value = prev.gold_reserves
					}
				}
			}
		}
		scope:overlord_scope ?= {
			annex = ROOT
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = raj.2.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					liberty_desire > 25
				}
				add = 10
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					liberty_desire > 50
				}
				add = 25
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					liberty_desire > 75
				}
				add = 25
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_country = {
						any_scope_treaty = {
							binds = ROOT
							any_scope_article = {
								has_type = guarantee_independence
							}
						}
					}
				}
				add = 100
			}
		}
		create_diplomatic_play = {
			target_country = scope:overlord_scope
			type = dp_independence
			add_war_goal = { holder = scope:overlord_scope target_country = ROOT type = annex_country }
		}
	}
}

# Suspected Conversion Project
raj.5 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:missionaries_suspicion_state

	title = raj.5.t
	desc = raj.5.d
	flavor = raj.5.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_christianity"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = suspected_conversions }
		any_scope_state = {
			any_scope_pop = {
				OR = {
					religion = rel:hindu
					religion = rel:sunni
					religion = rel:shiite
				}
			}
			any_scope_pop = {
				is_pop_type = clergymen
				religion = { has_discrimination_trait = heritage_christian }
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = suspected_conversions
			years = 3
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_pop = {
					OR = {
						religion = rel:hindu
						religion = rel:sunni
						religion = rel:shiite
					}
				}
				any_scope_pop = {
					is_pop_type = clergymen
					religion = { has_discrimination_trait = heritage_christian }
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = missionaries_suspicion_state
			random_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						religion = rel:hindu
						religion = rel:sunni
						religion = rel:shiite
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = not_suspected_missionaries_pop
			}
			random_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = clergymen
					religion = { has_discrimination_trait = heritage_christian }
				}
				religion = { save_scope_as = suspected_missionaries }
				save_scope_as = suspected_missionaries_pop
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = raj.5.a
		scope:missionaries_suspicion_state = {
			# state_conversion_mult
			add_modifier = {
				name = promised_no_proselytization
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				AND = {
					c:BIC ?= this
					ig:ig_devout ?= {
						leader = {
		        			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist_minoritarian
		        		}
					}
				}
			}
			ig:ig_devout ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = promised_no_missionaries
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		scope:missionaries_suspicion_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				religion = scope:suspected_missionaries_pop.religion
				value = medium_radicals
			}
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 75
			modifier = { # If the EIC is quite unstable, the AI shouldn't rock the boat.
				trigger = {
					has_journal_entry = je_uneasy_raj
					je:je_uneasy_raj ?= {
						OR = {
							"scripted_bar_progress(sepoy_mutiny_progress_bar_bengal)" < uneasy_raj_stability_medium_upper_bound
							"scripted_bar_progress(sepoy_mutiny_progress_bar_bombay)" < uneasy_raj_stability_medium_upper_bound
							"scripted_bar_progress(sepoy_mutiny_progress_bar_madras)" < uneasy_raj_stability_medium_upper_bound
						}
					}
				}
				add = 25
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					has_journal_entry = je_uneasy_raj
					je:je_uneasy_raj ?= {
						OR = {
							"scripted_bar_progress(sepoy_mutiny_progress_bar_bengal)" < uneasy_raj_stability_medium_lower_bound
							"scripted_bar_progress(sepoy_mutiny_progress_bar_bombay)" < uneasy_raj_stability_medium_lower_bound
							"scripted_bar_progress(sepoy_mutiny_progress_bar_madras)" < uneasy_raj_stability_medium_lower_bound
						}
					}
				}
				add = 50
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = raj.5.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:missionaries_suspicion_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				religion = scope:not_suspected_missionaries_pop.religion
				value = small_radicals
			}
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				religion = scope:suspected_missionaries_pop.religion
				value = medium_radicals
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_journal_entry = je_uneasy_raj
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = sepoy_mutiny_progress_from_events_tt
				set_variable = {
					name = bengal_progress_from_events_var_add_6
					value = -1
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = bombay_progress_from_events_var_add_6
					value = -1
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = madras_progress_from_events_var_add_6
					value = -1
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 75
			modifier = { # If the EIC is quite unstable, the AI shouldn't rock the boat.
				trigger = {
					has_journal_entry = je_uneasy_raj
					je:je_uneasy_raj ?= {
						OR = {
							"scripted_bar_progress(sepoy_mutiny_progress_bar_bengal)" < uneasy_raj_stability_medium_upper_bound
							"scripted_bar_progress(sepoy_mutiny_progress_bar_bombay)" < uneasy_raj_stability_medium_upper_bound
							"scripted_bar_progress(sepoy_mutiny_progress_bar_madras)" < uneasy_raj_stability_medium_upper_bound
						}
					}
				}
				add = -25
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					has_journal_entry = je_uneasy_raj
					je:je_uneasy_raj ?= {
						OR = {
							"scripted_bar_progress(sepoy_mutiny_progress_bar_bengal)" < uneasy_raj_stability_medium_lower_bound
							"scripted_bar_progress(sepoy_mutiny_progress_bar_bombay)" < uneasy_raj_stability_medium_lower_bound
							"scripted_bar_progress(sepoy_mutiny_progress_bar_madras)" < uneasy_raj_stability_medium_lower_bound
						}
					}
				}
				add = -50
			}
		}
	}
}

					country = c:BIC
					type = colony
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_appointed_bureaucrats
					}
				}
				activate_law = law_type:law_appointed_bureaucrats
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_autocracy
					}
				}
				activate_law = law_type:law_autocracy
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_hindu_caste_enforced
						}
						NOT = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_hindu_caste_codified
						}
					}
				}
				activate_law = law_type:law_hindu_caste_codified
			}
		}
		# Remove exempt from service from medium loyalty vassals
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = sepoy_mutiny_princely_state_medium_loyalty_var
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					root = {
						has_diplomatic_pact = {
							who = prev
							type = exempt_from_service
						}
					}
				}
				root = {
					remove_diplomatic_pact = {
						country = prev
						type = exempt_from_service
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
﻿namespace = bulgaria_events

bulgaria_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = bulgaria_events.1.t
	desc = bulgaria_events.1.d
	flavor = bulgaria_events.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_before_the_battle"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ip3_content
	}

	immediate = {
	}

	option = { # Restore the Bulgarian Empire
		name = bulgaria_events.1.a
		default_option = yes

		set_variable = bul_pursued_bulgarian_empire

		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_bul_ultranationalist_rhetoric
			days = very_long_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = bulgarian_empire_claims_tt
			every_state_region_in_greater_bulgaria = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						any_scope_state = {
							owner ?= ROOT
							has_claim_by = ROOT
						}
					}
				}
				add_claim = root
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = bulgarian_empire_homeland_tt
		if = { # In case we already own any of the prerequisite states
			limit = {
				any_scope_state = {
					state_region = {
						OR = {
							this = s:STATE_EASTERN_THRACE
							this = s:STATE_MACEDONIA
							this = s:STATE_EASTERN_SERBIA
						}
					}
				}
			}
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					state_region = {
						OR = {
							this = s:STATE_EASTERN_THRACE
							this = s:STATE_MACEDONIA
							this = s:STATE_EASTERN_SERBIA
						}
					}
				}
				state_region = {
					add_homeland = cu:bulgarian
				}
			}
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 60
		}
	}

	option = { # Embrace Yugoslavism
		name = bulgaria_events.1.b
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				exists = c:YUG
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = bulgaria_unlock_yugoslavia_tt
		set_variable = bul_pursued_greater_yugoslavism

		create_political_movement = { type = movement_yugoslav_national }

		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_bul_pursuing_greater_yugoslavism
			days = very_long_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
		}

#Bulgarian Horrors Event.
bulgaria_events.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = bulgaria_events.3.t
	desc = bulgaria_events.3.d
	flavor = bulgaria_events.3.f

	event_image = {
		video = "ip3_angry_mob_raiding_minorities"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	duration = 4

	cooldown = { days = long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ip3_content
		has_variable = crushed_secession
		country_average_culture_pop_acceptance = { culture = scope:rebel_culture value <= acceptance_status_2 }
		NOT = {
			has_variable = bulgaria_events_3
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		#Uprising primary culture is saved as value of var:uprising_country_culture, which is saved on_actions at the end of a succession in c:TUR.
		ROOT ?= {
			save_scope_as = ottoman
			set_variable = bulgaria_events_3
		}
		set_closest_great_power = yes
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_role_of_type = general
			}
			save_scope_as = scapegoat
		}
	}


	option = { #Infamy
		name = bulgaria_events.3.a
		default_option = yes
		change_infamy = 20

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					infamy <= infamy_threshold:infamous
				}
				add = 4
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # Sacrifice General
		name = bulgaria_events.3.b
		trigger = {
			scope:scapegoat = {
				is_character_alive = yes
			}
		}
		change_infamy = 10
		scope:scapegoat = {
			interest_group ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_bul_scapegoated
					days = long_modifier_time
					is_decaying = yes
				}
			}
			kill_character = yes
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 5
		}
	}

	option = { # gp vouch for you
		name = bulgaria_events.3.c
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:closest_great_power
			scope:closest_great_power = {
				relations:root >= relations_threshold:cordial
			}
		}
		change_infamy = 10
		scope:closest_great_power = {
			change_relations = {
				country = root
				value = -30
			}
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 5
		}
	}

	option = { # embrace the villainy
		name = bulgaria_events.3.e
		change_infamy = 30
		add_modifier = {
			name = terrified_dissidents
			days = long_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 0

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					infamy <= infamy_threshold:infamous
				}
				add = 1
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ruler ?= {
						OR = {
							has_trait = cruel
							has_trait = wrathful
							has_trait = bigoted
							has_trait = war_criminal
							has_trait = ruthless
						}
					}
				}
				add = 1
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ruler ?= {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ethno_nationalist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
						}
					}
				}
				add = 1
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					infamy >= infamy_threshold:notorious
				}
				add = -1
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ruler ?= {
						OR = {
							has_trait = tactful
							has_trait = cautious
							has_trait = honorable
						}
					}
				}
				add = -1
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ruler ?= {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian_royalist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pacifist
						}
					}
				}
				add = -1
			}
		}
	}

	after = {
		scope:former_rebel_capital ?= { # state_region scope
			add_devastation = 20
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					owner = root
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_rebellion_horrific_reprisals
					days = long_modifier_time
					is_decaying = yes
				}
				kill_population_percent_in_state = {
					percent = 0.1
					culture = scope:rebel_culture
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
﻿namespace = bureaucracy

# Stall Event - Red Tape
bureaucracy.1 = {
	type = country_event

	title = bureaucracy.1.t
	desc = bureaucracy.1.d
	flavor = bureaucracy.1.f

	category = enactment

	event_image = {
		video = "africa_leader_arguing"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_hereditary_bureaucrats
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_appointed_bureaucrats
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_elected_bureaucrats
		}
		NOR = {
			has_modifier = red_tape_reduced
			has_modifier = red_tape
		}
		NOT = {
			currently_enacting_law = {
				has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_preserved_bureaucratic_caste
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_hereditary_bureaucrats
			}
			ig:ig_landowners ?= {
				save_scope_as = bureaucrat_class
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_appointed_bureaucrats
			}
			ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
				save_scope_as = bureaucrat_class
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_elected_bureaucrats
			}
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
				save_scope_as = bureaucrat_class
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = { # promise job retention
		name = bureaucracy.1.a
		default_option = yes
		currently_enacting_law = {
			add_amendment = {
				type = amendment_preserved_bureaucratic_caste
				sponsor = scope:bureaucrat_class
				cooldown = 120
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # get back to work
		name = bureaucracy.1.b
		trigger = {
			NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_secret_police }
		}
		# lose 15% success chance and bureaucracy mult
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = red_tape
		}
	}
	option = { # secret police will keep them in line
		name = bureaucracy.1.c
		trigger = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_secret_police
		}
		# lose 10% success chance
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = red_tape_reduced
		}
	}
	option = { # hire new bureaucrats
		name = bureaucracy.1.e
		trigger = {
			enactment_setback_count < max_setbacks_minus_one
		}
		highlighted_option = yes
		add_enactment_setback = 1
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = modifier_training_bureaucrat_replacements
		}
	}
}

# Advance event - Meritocracy
bureaucracy.2 = {
	type = country_event

	title = bureaucracy.2.t
	desc = bureaucracy.2.d
	flavor = bureaucracy.2.f

	category = enactment

	event_image = {
		video = "africa_leader_arguing"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_hereditary_bureaucrats
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_appointed_bureaucrats
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_elected_bureaucrats
		}
		NOT = { has_modifier = meritocracy }
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_appointed_bureaucrats
			}
			ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
				save_scope_as = meritocracy_ig
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_elected_bureaucrats
			}
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
				save_scope_as = meritocracy_ig
			}
		}
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			save_scope_as = bureaucrat_class
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = { # use this to pass the law
		name = bureaucracy.2.a
		default_option = yes
		# enactment success
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = meritocracy
			multiplier = 2
		}
	}
	option = { # use this to disempower landowners
		name = bureaucracy.2.b
		# less polstr
		scope:bureaucrat_class = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = meritocracy_ig
				days = short_modifier_time
				multiplier = -1
			}
		}
		# enactment success
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = meritocracy
		}
	}
	option = { # use this to empower new bureaucrat class
		name = bureaucracy.2.c
		# less polstr
		scope:meritocracy_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = meritocracy_ig
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
		# enactment success
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = meritocracy
		}
	}
}
