# Canadian colony absorbs a poorer neighbor
can_aus.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = can_aus.1.t
	desc = can_aus.1.d
	flavor = can_aus.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_transfer_of_authority"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		random_neighbouring_state = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_ai = yes
					relations:root >= relations_threshold:amicable
					capital = {
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_greater_canada
					}
					is_subject = yes
					NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
					top_overlord = {
						THIS = root.top_overlord
					}
					this.gdp < root.gdp
				}
			}
			owner = { save_scope_as = canada_annex_scope }
		}
		top_overlord = {
			save_scope_as = canada_overlord_country
			ruler = {
				save_scope_as = canada_overlord_ruler
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = can_aus.1.a
		default_option = yes
		hidden_effect = {
			every_state_in_canada = {
				limit = {
					has_claim_by = scope:canada_annex_scope
				}
				state_region = {
					remove_claim = scope:canada_annex_scope
					add_claim = ROOT
				}
			}
		}
		annex_with_incorporation = scope:canada_annex_scope
	}
}

# Britain mashes 2 Canadians together
can_aus.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = can_aus.2.t
	desc = can_aus.2.d
	flavor = can_aus.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_power_blocs"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		random_subject_or_below = {
			limit = {
				capital = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_greater_canada
				}
				relations:root >= relations_threshold:amicable
				is_ai = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = canada_scope_1
		}
		random_subject_or_below = {
			limit = {
				capital = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_greater_canada
				}
				relations:root >= relations_threshold:amicable
				is_ai = yes
				NOT = {
					scope:canada_scope_1 = THIS
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = canada_scope_2
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = can_aus.2.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:canada_scope_1.gdp > scope:canada_scope_2.gdp
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				every_state_in_canada = {
					limit = {
						has_claim_by = scope:canada_scope_2
					}
					state_region = {
						remove_claim = scope:canada_scope_2
						add_claim = scope:canada_scope_1
					}
				}
			}
			scope:canada_scope_1 = {
				annex_with_incorporation = scope:canada_scope_2
			}
		}
		else = {
			hidden_effect = {
				every_state_in_canada = {
					limit = {
						has_claim_by = scope:canada_scope_1
					}
					state_region = {
						remove_claim = scope:canada_scope_1
						add_claim = scope:canada_scope_2
					}
				}
			}
			scope:canada_scope_2 = {
				annex_with_incorporation = scope:canada_scope_1
			}
		}
	}
}

# Australian colony absorbs a poorer neighbor
can_aus.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = can_aus.1.t
	desc = can_aus.3.d
	flavor = can_aus.3.f

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_transfer_of_authority"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		random_neighbouring_state = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_ai = yes
					relations:root >= relations_threshold:amicable
					capital = {
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_australasia
					}
					is_subject = yes
					NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
					top_overlord = {
						THIS = root.top_overlord
					}
					this.gdp < root.gdp
				}
			}
			owner = { save_scope_as = canada_annex_scope }
		}
		top_overlord = {
			save_scope_as = canada_overlord_country
			ruler = {
				save_scope_as = canada_overlord_ruler
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = can_aus.1.a
		default_option = yes
		annex_with_incorporation = scope:canada_annex_scope
	}
}

# Britain mashes 2 Australians together
can_aus.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = can_aus.2.t
	desc = can_aus.4.d
	flavor = can_aus.3.f

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_power_blocs"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = australia_overlord_ruler
		}
		random_subject_or_below = {
			limit = {
				capital = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_australasia
				}
				relations:root >= relations_threshold:amicable
				is_ai = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = canada_scope_1
		}
		random_subject_or_below = {
			limit = {
				capital = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_australasia
				}
				relations:root >= relations_threshold:amicable
				NOT = {
					scope:canada_scope_1 = THIS
				}
				is_ai = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = canada_scope_2
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = can_aus.2.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:canada_scope_1.gdp > scope:canada_scope_2.gdp
			}
			scope:canada_scope_1 = {
				annex_with_incorporation = scope:canada_scope_2
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:canada_scope_2 = {
				annex_with_incorporation = scope:canada_scope_1
			}
		}
	}
}

		}
	}

						state_region = s:STATE_QUEBEC

						state_region = s:STATE_MANITOBA
						state_region = s:STATE_YUKON_TERRITORY
						state_region = s:STATE_NORTHWEST_TERRITORIES
						state_region = s:STATE_NUNAVUT
					}
					count >= 9
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = canada_country
		}

		}

			months = 120
		}
	}

		trigger = {

				has_variable = suez_canal_var
			}
		}
        random_country = {
            limit = {
				has_variable = suez_canal_var
            }
			trigger_event = { id = canal_events.4 }
        }
        custom_tooltip = canal_events.2_tt
	}
}

# Suez Survey Complete
canal_events.100 = {
	type = country_event

	title = expedition_events.400.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = expedition_events.400.d
				trigger = {
					any_scope_state = { state_region = s:STATE_SINAI }
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = canal_events.100.d
				trigger = {
					NOT = { any_scope_state = { state_region = s:STATE_SINAI } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = expedition_events.400.f

	event_image = {
		video = "africa_desert_expedition"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		# triggered by JE
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = suez_survey_complete
		s:STATE_SINAI = {
			save_scope_as = suez_state
			random_scope_state = {
				owner = {
					save_scope_as = suez_owner
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # we will attempt a diplomatic solution
		name = canal_events.100.a
		trigger = {
			NOT = { any_scope_state = { state_region = s:STATE_SINAI } }
		}
		default_option = yes
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_suez_canal
		}
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:suez_owner
			value = 10
		}
		set_variable = suez_canal_purchase
		custom_tooltip = suez_canal_purchase_available
		custom_tooltip = suez_canal_construction_available
	}

	option = { # we will take it by force
		name = canal_events.100.b
		trigger = {
			NOT = { any_scope_state = { state_region = s:STATE_SINAI } }
		}
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_suez_canal
		}
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:suez_owner
			value = -20
		}
		scope:suez_state = {
 			add_claim = ROOT
		}
		set_variable = suez_canal_purchase
		custom_tooltip = suez_canal_purchase_available
		custom_tooltip = suez_canal_construction_available
	}
	option = { # we should build the canal
		name = canal_events.100.c
		trigger = {
			any_scope_state = { state_region = s:STATE_SINAI }
		}
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_suez_canal
		}
		custom_tooltip = suez_canal_construction_available
	}
}

			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_role_of_type = general

		}

# The Basque Fueros
carlist_war.3 = {
    type = country_event
    placement = scope:basque_country_scope

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

    duration = 3

	title = carlist_war.3.t
	desc = carlist_war.3.d
	flavor = carlist_war.3.f

	dlc = dlc016

    event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_aristocrats"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_carlist_beret.dds"

    trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ip4_content
		has_variable = is_carlist_spain
		any_scope_state = {
			state_region = s:STATE_BASQUE_COUNTRY
		}
		has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
		has_law = law_type:law_subjecthood
	}

	immediate = {
		ruler ?= {
			save_scope_as = don_carlos_scope
		}
		random_scope_State = {
			limit = {
				state_region = s:STATE_BASQUE_COUNTRY
			}
			save_scope_as = basque_country_scope
		}
	}

	option = { # We love the Basque, dont we folks?
		name = carlist_war.3.a
		default_option = yes

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_journal_entry = je_the_two_spains
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = two_spains_fueros_conservative_drift_tt

				je:je_the_two_spains ?= {
					add_progress = {
						value = {
							add = two_spains_fueros_conservative_drift
							multiply = -1
						}
						name = je_two_spains_progress_bar
					}
				}
			}
		}
		active_law:lawgroup_citizenship ?= {
			add_amendment = {
				type = amendment_reinstated_fueros
				sponsor = PREV.ig:ig_rural_folk
			}
		}
		show_as_tooltip = {
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					state_region = s:STATE_BASQUE_COUNTRY
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = spc_state_fueros_restored
				}
			}
		}
		add_loyalists = {
			culture = cu:basque
			value = large_radicals
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 9
		}
	}
	option = { # Press this for Basque Space Program
		name = carlist_war.3.b

		je:je_the_two_spains ?= {
			add_progress = { value = 10 name = je_two_spains_tension_bar }
		}
		add_radicals = {
			culture = cu:basque
			value = {
				add = huge_radicals
				multiply = 2 # Yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_cultural_minority
						culture = cu:basque
					}
				}
			}
			create_political_movement = { type = movement_cultural_minority culture = cu:basque }
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					taking_loans = yes
				}
				add = 4
			}
		}
	}
}

		}

			}

					template = BIC_erode_venkatappa_ramasamy # E. V. Ramasamy aka Periyar
				}
			}

			limit = {
				game_date <= 1904.1.1
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = an_agitator_appears_tt

					interest_group = ig_rural_folk
	    			ideology = ideology_social_democrat
	    			is_agitator = yes
	    			culture = cu:tamil
    				religion = rel:atheist
				    traits = {
				        direct
				        brave
				        erudite
				    }
				}
			}
		}

					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_overlord
				}
			}

				limit = { is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_overlord }

					amount = -1
					factor = appeasement_lobby_loss
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = caste_conflict.1.b
		add_modifier = {
			name = current_system_supported
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {

			}
			custom_tooltip = {

				create_character = {
					template = BIC_erode_venkatappa_ramasamy # E. V. Ramasamy aka Periyar
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {

			}

			    traits = {

					set_variable = satyagraha_var
				}
			}

				has_variable = satyagraha_var
			}
			save_scope_as = character_scope
		}

	}

	cancellation_trigger = {

# Age of Caudillo startup event
caudillo.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = caudillo.1.t
	desc = caudillo.1.d
	flavor = caudillo.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_military_parade"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ig_icons/armed_forces.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		# triggered by generic monthly pulse
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_caudillismo
		}
		is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_latin_america
		any_scope_character = {
			has_role_of_type = general
		}
		NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_caudillo }
	}

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	immediate = {
		capital = {
			save_scope_as = capital_scope
		}
		set_global_variable = { # ensures military presidents aren't replaced super early
			name = continuismo_start_var
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			save_scope_as = army_scope
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_role_of_type = general
			}
			save_scope_as = general_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				ruler = {
					interest_group ?= {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
					}
				}
			}
			ruler = {
				save_scope_as = powerful_caudillo
			}
		}
		else = {
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = powerful_caudillo
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = caudillo.1.a
		default_option = yes
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_caudillo }
		if = { # Starts the Francia JE
			limit = {
				c:PRG ?= this
				NOR = {
					has_journal_entry = je_francocracia
					has_variable = death_of_francia_var
					year > 1836
				}
				has_dlc_feature = rp1_content
			}
			add_journal_entry = { type = je_francocracia }
		}
	}
}

# Continuismo
caudillo.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = caudillo.4.t
	desc = caudillo.4.d
	flavor = caudillo.4.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_military_parade"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ig_icons/armed_forces.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# triggered by je_caudillo
		NOT = { has_global_variable = continuismo_start_var }
		ruler = {
			interest_group ?= {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
			}
			is_immortal = no
		}
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_presidential_republic
		OR = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_autocracy
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_oligarchy
		}
		OR = {
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				leader = {
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				}
			}
			any_scope_character = {
				OR = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}
				interest_group ?= {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				}
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			save_scope_as = army_scope
		}
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = ruler_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
					leader = {
						is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					}
				}
			}
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = president_successor_scope
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					OR = {
						has_role_of_type = general
						has_role_of_type = admiral
					}
					interest_group ?= {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
					}
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_role_of_type = general
						has_role_of_type = admiral
					}
					interest_group ?= {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
					}
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = president_successor_scope
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = caudillo.4.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = gain_large_caudillo_points
			je:je_caudillo ?= {
				add_progress = { value = 200 name = je_caudillo_progress_bar }
			}
		}
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = continuismo
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 15
		}
	}
	option = { # his term is over, time to step down
		name = caudillo.4.b
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = retire_ruler
			ruler = {
				retire_character = yes
			}
		}
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = no_continuismo
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = lose_large_caudillo_points
			je:je_caudillo ?= {
				add_progress = { value = -200 name = je_caudillo_progress_bar }
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 3
		}
	}
	option = { # his successor takes over
		name = caudillo.4.c
		scope:president_successor_scope = {
			set_character_as_ruler = yes
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = gain_caudillo_points
			je:je_caudillo ?= {
				add_progress = { value = 100 name = je_caudillo_progress_bar }
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 7
		}
	}
}

caudillo.5 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = caudillo.5.t
	desc = caudillo.5.desc
	flavor = caudillo.5.f

		video = "unspecific_military_parade"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ig_icons/armed_forces.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		# triggered by on_action
	}

	immediate = {
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			save_scope_as = army_scope
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = army_leader
				set_variable = caudillo_kingmaker
			}
		}
		py:conservative_party ?= {
			save_scope_as = conservative_party
		}
		py:liberal_party ?= {
			save_scope_as = liberal_party
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_active_party = {
					party_has_members = yes
					is_party_type = communist_party
				}
			}
			py:communist_party = {
				save_scope_as = communist_party
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_active_party = {
					party_has_members = yes
					is_party_type = fascist_party
				}
			}
			py:fascist_party = {
				save_scope_as = fascist_party
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = caudillo.5.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_journal_entry = je_caudillo
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = gain_caudillo_points
				je:je_caudillo ?= {
					add_progress = { value = 100 name = je_caudillo_progress_bar }
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = armed_forces_support_conservative
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				leader = {
					set_variable = caudillo_conservative
				}
			}
		}
		update_party_support = yes
	}
	option = {
		name = caudillo.5.b
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:liberal_party
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_journal_entry = je_caudillo
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = gain_caudillo_points
				je:je_caudillo ?= {
					add_progress = { value = 100 name = je_caudillo_progress_bar }
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = armed_forces_support_liberal
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				leader = {
					set_variable = caudillo_liberal
				}
			}
		}
		update_party_support = yes
	}
	option = {
		name = caudillo.5.c
		trigger = {
			any_active_party = {
				party_has_members = yes
				is_party_type = communist_party
			}
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				leader = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
					}
				}
			}
		}
		highlighted_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_journal_entry = je_caudillo
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = gain_caudillo_points
				je:je_caudillo ?= {
					add_progress = { value = 100 name = je_caudillo_progress_bar }
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = armed_forces_support_communist
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				leader = {
					set_variable = caudillo_communist
				}
			}
		}
		update_party_support = yes
	}
	option = {
		name = caudillo.5.d
		trigger = {
			any_active_party = {
				party_has_members = yes
				is_party_type = fascist_party
			}

					OR = {

						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ethno_nationalist
					}
				}
			}
		}
		highlighted_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_journal_entry = je_caudillo
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = gain_caudillo_points
				je:je_caudillo ?= {
					add_progress = { value = 100 name = je_caudillo_progress_bar }
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = armed_forces_support_fascist
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				leader = {
					set_variable = caudillo_fascist
				}
			}
		}
		update_party_support = yes
	}

			exists = scope:army_leader
		}
	}

    flavor = expedition_events.2.f

    event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_jungle_expedition"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

    duration = 3

	trigger = {
		any_scope_character = {
			OR = {
				has_role_of_type = general
				has_role_of_type = admiral
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				OR = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader_1
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				OR = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}
				NOT = {
					this = scope:expedition_leader_1
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader_2
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				OR = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}
				NOR = {
					this = scope:expedition_leader_1
					this = scope:expedition_leader_2
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader_3
		}
		set_variable = central_africa_expedition_var
		central_africa_location_effect = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = expedition_events.502.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = expedition_costs_tt
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_large_expedition_cost
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
		}
		scope:expedition_leader_1 = {
			set_as_expedition_leader = yes
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader
		}
		trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.504 days = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = expedition_events.502.b
		custom_tooltip = expedition_costs_tt
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:expedition_leader_2
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_large_expedition_cost
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
		}
		scope:expedition_leader_2 = {
			set_as_expedition_leader = yes
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader
		}
		trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.504 days = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = expedition_events.502.c
		custom_tooltip = expedition_costs_tt
		trigger = {

		}
		add_modifier = {

expedition_events.560 = { #Leader runs out of vice
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location

    title = expedition_events.560.t
    desc = expedition_events.560.d
    flavor = expedition_events.560.f

    event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_jungle_expedition"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

    duration = 3

    trigger = {
    	trigger_if = {
    		limit = { exists = var:expedition_commander_vice }
    		NOT = { var:expedition_commander_vice > 3 }
    	}
		any_scope_character = {
			has_variable = expedition_leader_var
			OR = {
				has_trait = alcoholic
				has_trait = opium_addiction
				has_trait = cocaine_addiction
			}
		}
    }

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = on_expedition }
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:expedition_commander_vice }
			change_variable = {
				name = expedition_commander_vice
				add = 1
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = {
				name = expedition_commander_vice
				value = 1
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = congo_river_expedition_var }
			congo_river_expedition_location = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = niger_river_expedition_var }
			niger_river_expedition_location = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = central_africa_expedition_var }
			central_africa_location_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = west_america_expedition_var }
			west_america_expedition_location = yes
		}

		random_scope_character = {
			limit = { has_variable = expedition_leader_var }
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader
		}
	}

	option = { #Stop and get some more
		name = expedition_events.560.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = expedition_event_delayed_tt
	}

	option = { #Don't stop
		name = expedition_events.560.b
		add_small_peril_effect = yes
		expedition_minor_progress_effect = yes
		random_list = {
			90 = {
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							ROOT.modifier:country_expedition_events_explorer_mult > 0
						}
						add = 5
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:expedition_leader.modifier:character_expedition_events_explorer_mult > 0
						}
						add = 20
					}
				}
				scope:expedition_leader = {
					remove_trait = alcoholic
    				remove_trait = opium_addiction
    				remove_trait = cocaine_addiction
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

namespace = ai_expedition_simulator

ai_expedition_simulator.1 = {
	type = country_event
	hidden = yes
	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = AI_EXPEDITION_ANTARCTICA
			}
			random_list = {
				3 = {
					trigger_event = { id = cold.10 }
					add_modifier = {
						name = modifier_failed_expedition
						days = normal_modifier_time
						is_decaying	= yes
					}
				}
				2 = {
					trigger_event = { id = cold.7 }
					set_variable = antarctica_expedition_success_var
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = AI_EXPEDITION_NILE
			}
			random_list = {
				3 = {
					trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.512 }
					set_variable = failed_central_africa_expedition_var
				}
				2 = {
					trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.511 }
					set_variable = central_africa_expedition_success_var
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = AI_EXPEDITION_CONGO
			}
			random_list = {
				3 = {
					trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.612 }
					set_variable = failed_congo_river_var
				}
				2 = {
					trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.611 }
					set_variable = congo_river_expedition_success_var
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = AI_EXPEDITION_NIGER
			}
			random_list = {
				3 = {
					trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.12 }
					set_variable = failed_niger_river_var
				}
				2 = {
					trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.11 }
					set_variable = niger_river_expedition_success_var
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = AI_EXPEDITION_WAMERICA
			}
			random_list = {
				2 = {
					trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.205 }
				}
				1 = {
					trigger = { NOT = { has_global_variable = buenaventura_river_disproven } }
					trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.300 }
					set_variable = west_america_expedition_success_var
				}
				1 = {
					trigger = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oregon_trail_mapped } }
					trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.301 }
					set_variable = west_america_expedition_success_var
				}
				1 = {
					trigger = { NOT = { has_global_variable = great_salt_lake_mapped } }
					trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.302  }
					set_variable = west_america_expedition_success_var
				}
			}
		}
		trigger_event = { id = ai_expedition_simulator.2 days = 14 }
	}
}

# Central American Reunification
central_america.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = central_america.1.t
	desc = central_america.1.d
	flavor =  central_america.1.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_military_parade"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_fire.dds"

	trigger = {
		# triggered by reunify_central_america je
	}
	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = formation_country
		cu:central_american = {
			save_scope_as = unification_culture
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_diplomatic_relevance = ROOT
			}
			post_notification = unification_notification_one_culture
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = central_america.1.a
		add_modifier = {
			name = unification_prestige
			days = very_long_modifier_time
		}
		add_loyalists = {
			value = 0.1
		}
	}
}

# Dissolution of Central America
central_america.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = central_america.2.t
	desc = central_america.2.d
	flavor =  central_america.2.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_transfer_of_authority"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_fire.dds"

	trigger = {

	}

	immediate = {
		capital = {
			save_scope_as = capital_scope
		}

		# All remaining Central American states secede
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = s:STATE_GUATEMALA.region_state:UCA
				s:STATE_GUATEMALA.region_state:UCA = {
					is_capital = no
				}
			}
			create_country = {
				tag = GUA
				origin = this
				state = s:STATE_GUATEMALA.region_state:UCA
				on_created = {
					set_variable = ca_secession_country
				}
			}
			c:GUA ?= { save_scope_as = scope_GAU }
			#if = {
			#	limit = { exists = s:STATE_CHIAPAS.region_state:UCA }
			#	s:STATE_CHIAPAS.region_state:UCA = { set_state_owner = c:GUA }
			#}
		}
		# Los Altos, greatest of all central american nations
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { exists = c:ALT }
				exists = s:STATE_CHIAPAS.region_state:UCA
				s:STATE_CHIAPAS.region_state:UCA = {
					is_capital = no
				}
			}
			create_country = {
				tag = ALT
				origin = this
				state = s:STATE_CHIAPAS.region_state:UCA
				on_created = {
					set_variable = ca_secession_country
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = s:STATE_HONDURAS.region_state:UCA
				s:STATE_HONDURAS.region_state:UCA = {
					is_capital = no
				}
			}
			create_country = {
				tag = HON
				origin = this
				state = s:STATE_HONDURAS.region_state:UCA
				on_created = {
					set_variable = ca_secession_country
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = s:STATE_COSTA_RICA.region_state:UCA
				s:STATE_COSTA_RICA.region_state:UCA = {
					is_capital = no
				}
			}
			create_country = {
				tag = COS
				origin = this
				state = s:STATE_COSTA_RICA.region_state:UCA
				on_created = {
					set_variable = ca_secession_country
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = s:STATE_SAN_SALVADOR.region_state:UCA
				s:STATE_SAN_SALVADOR.region_state:UCA = {
					is_capital = no
				}
			}
			create_country = {
				tag = ELS
				origin = this
				state = s:STATE_SAN_SALVADOR.region_state:UCA
				on_created = {
					set_variable = ca_secession_country
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = s:STATE_NICARAGUA.region_state:UCA
				s:STATE_NICARAGUA.region_state:UCA = {
					is_capital = no
				}
			}
			create_country = {
				tag = NIC
				origin = this
				state = s:STATE_NICARAGUA.region_state:UCA
				on_created = {
					set_variable = ca_secession_country
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #Fine fine
		name = central_america.2.a
		default_option = yes
		# Change tag to whatever is appropriate ro your capital state
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { exists = c:NIC }
				capital = {
					state_region = s:STATE_NICARAGUA
				}
			}
			change_tag = NIC
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { exists = c:ELS }
				capital = {
					state_region = s:STATE_SAN_SALVADOR
				}
			}
			change_tag = ELS
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { exists = c:COS }
				capital = {
					state_region = s:STATE_COSTA_RICA
				}
			}
			change_tag = COS
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { exists = c:HON }
				capital = {
					state_region = s:STATE_HONDURAS
				}
			}
			change_tag = HON
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { exists = c:GUA }
				capital = {
					state_region = s:STATE_GUATEMALA
				}
			}
			change_tag = GUA
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { exists = c:ALT }
				capital = {
					state_region = s:STATE_CHIAPAS
				}
			}
			change_tag = ALT
		}
		capital = {
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				value = 0.5
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = ca_secession_country
			}
			change_relations = {
				country = ROOT
				value = 20
			}
			capital = {
				state_region = {
					add_devastation = 15
				}
				add_loyalists_in_state = {
					value = 0.5
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #We fight to the end
		name = central_america.2.b
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_reunify_central_america }
		capital = { #you also get loyalists
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				value = 0.5
			}
		}
		# Change tag to whatever is appropriate ro your capital state
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { exists = c:NIC }
				capital = {
					state_region = s:STATE_NICARAGUA
				}
			}
			change_tag = NIC
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { exists = c:ELS }
				capital = {
					state_region = s:STATE_SAN_SALVADOR
				}
			}
			change_tag = ELS
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { exists = c:COS }
				capital = {
					state_region = s:STATE_COSTA_RICA
				}
			}
			change_tag = COS
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { exists = c:HON }
				capital = {
					state_region = s:STATE_HONDURAS
				}
			}
			change_tag = HON
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { exists = c:GUA }
				capital = {
					state_region = s:STATE_GUATEMALA
				}
			}
			change_tag = GUA
		}
		# add claims on any state you just lost
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = ca_secession_country
			}
			capital = {
				state_region = {
					add_claim = ROOT
					add_devastation = 25
				}
				add_loyalists_in_state = {
					value = 0.5
				}
			}
			change_relations = {
				country = ROOT
				value = -50
			}
		}
	}
}

# State secedes
central_america.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:secession_capital
	title = central_america.3.t
	desc = central_america.3.d
	flavor =  central_america.3.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_aristocrats"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_fire.dds"

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			is_capital = no
			OR = {
				state_region = s:STATE_GUATEMALA
				state_region = s:STATE_HONDURAS
				state_region = s:STATE_COSTA_RICA
				state_region = s:STATE_SAN_SALVADOR
				state_region = s:STATE_NICARAGUA
			}
			turmoil > 0.2
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_capital = no
				OR = {
					state_region = s:STATE_GUATEMALA
					state_region = s:STATE_HONDURAS
					state_region = s:STATE_COSTA_RICA
					state_region = s:STATE_SAN_SALVADOR
					state_region = s:STATE_NICARAGUA
				}
				turmoil > 0.2
			}
			save_scope_as = secession_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:secession_state = {
					state_region = s:STATE_GUATEMALA
				}
			}
			create_country = {
				tag = GUA
				origin = this
				state = scope:secession_state
			}
			c:GUA ?= {
				save_scope_as = secession_country
				capital = {
					save_scope_as = secession_capital
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:secession_state = {
					state_region = s:STATE_HONDURAS
				}
			}
			create_country = {
				tag = HON
				origin = this
				state = scope:secession_state
			}
			c:HON ?= {
				save_scope_as = secession_country
				capital = {
					save_scope_as = secession_capital
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:secession_state = {
					state_region = s:STATE_COSTA_RICA
				}
			}
			create_country = {
				tag = COS
				origin = this
				state = scope:secession_state
			}
			c:COS ?= {
				save_scope_as = secession_country
				capital = {
					save_scope_as = secession_capital
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:secession_state = {
					state_region = s:STATE_SAN_SALVADOR
				}
			}
			create_country = {
				tag = ELS
				origin = this
				state = scope:secession_state
			}
			c:ELS ?= {
				save_scope_as = secession_country
				capital = {
					save_scope_as = secession_capital
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:secession_state = {
					state_region = s:STATE_NICARAGUA
				}
			}
			create_country = {
				tag = NIC
				origin = this
				state = scope:secession_state
			}
			c:NIC ?= {
				save_scope_as = secession_country
				capital = {
					save_scope_as = secession_capital
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Accept secession
	option = {
		name = central_america.3.a
		default_option = yes
		add_radicals = {
			value = large_radicals
		}
		scope:secession_country = {
			change_relations = {
				country = ROOT
				value = 20
			}
			capital = {
				state_region = {
					add_devastation = 15
				}
				add_loyalists_in_state = {
					value = 0.5
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Reject Secession
	option = {
		name = central_america.3.b
		scope:secession_capital = {
			state_region = {
				add_claim = ROOT
			}
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = large_radicals
		}
		scope:secession_country = {
			change_relations = {
				country = ROOT
				value = -50
			}
			capital = {
				state_region = {
					add_devastation = 25
				}
				add_loyalists_in_state = {
					value = 0.5
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

﻿namespace = character_events

character_events.2 = { #Rich industrialist wants to build a university
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:university_state

	title = character_events.2.t
	desc = character_events.2.d
	flavor = character_events.2.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:university_benefactor

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = academia
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				c:BIC ?= this
			}
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
		}
		trigger_else = {
			ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			has_building = building_urban_center
			NOT = {
				has_building = building_university
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:BIC ?= this
			}
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = university_benefactor
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = university_benefactor
				}
			}
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				has_building = building_urban_center
				NOT = {
					has_building = building_university
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = university_state
		}
	}

	option = {
		default_option = yes
		name = character_events.2.a
		scope:university_state = {
			create_building={
 				building="building_university"
 				level=1
 				reserves=1
 			}
		}
		scope:university_benefactor.interest_group ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_university_built
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = character_events.2.b
		scope:university_benefactor.interest_group ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_blocked_building_university
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

character_events.3 = { #The duel
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	title = character_events.3.t
	desc = character_events.3.d
	flavor = character_events.3.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = long_modifier_time }

	gui_window = event_window_2char

	left_icon = scope:duel_participant_1
	right_icon = scope:duel_participant_2

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/2Characters"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = duels_banned }

			is_busy = yes
			is_ruler_of_own_country = no
			character_is_valid_for_events = yes
			NOT = {
				has_trait = cautious
			}
			count >= 2
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_busy = no
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				NOT = {
					has_trait = cautious
				}
				is_immortal = no
			}
			save_scope_as = duel_participant_1
		}

		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_busy = no
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:duel_participant_1 }
				NOT = {
					has_trait = cautious
				}
				is_immortal = no
			}
			save_scope_as = duel_participant_2
		}
	}

	option = { #Duel
		default_option = yes

		name = character_events.3.a

								age >= 60
							}
						}
						add = -5
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:duel_participant_1 = {
								age >= 70
							}
						}
						add = -10
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:duel_participant_1 = {
								OR = {
									has_trait = bandit
									has_trait = social_bandit
								}
							}
						}
						add = 10
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:duel_participant_1 = {
								has_trait = wounded
							}
						}
						add = -10
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:duel_participant_1 = {
								has_trait = beetle_ear
							}
						}
						add = -5
					}
					if = {

							scope:duel_participant_1 = {
								has_trait = kidney_stones
							}
						}
						add = -5
					}
					if = {

								has_role_of_type = general
							}
						}
						add = -5
					}
				}
				scope:duel_participant_1 = {
					kill_character = yes
				}
			}
			50 = {
				modifier = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:duel_participant_1 = {
								age >= 50
							}
						}
						add = -10
					}

	option = { #Ban duels

			}
		}
	}
}

character_events.5 = { #A statue made of the king
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:statue_state

	title = character_events.5.t
	desc = character_events.5.d
	flavor = character_events.5.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:statue_ruler

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	trigger = {
		has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			has_building = building_urban_center
			NOT = { has_variable = ruler_statue_var }
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = ruler_statue_cooldown }
		NOT = { has_gov_regency = yes }
		NOT = {
			ruler = {
				has_trait = trait_child
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_bakufu
			}
			var:emperor_var ?= {
				save_scope_as = statue_ruler
			}
		}
		else = {
			ruler = {
				save_scope_as = statue_ruler
			}
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				has_building = building_urban_center
				NOT = { has_variable = ruler_statue_var }
			}
			save_scope_as = statue_state
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ruler_statue_cooldown
			days = very_long_modifier_time #20 years
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				exists = scope:statue_ruler
			}
			scope:statue_ruler = {
				is_character_alive = no
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #Do it
		name = character_events.5.a
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_statue_of_ruler #prestige
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		scope:statue_state = {
			set_variable = {
				name = ruler_statue_var
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			add_radicals_in_state = {
  				value = small_radicals
  			}
  			set_variable = {
  				name = fireworks_variable
  				value = yes
  				days = 5
  			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:FRA ?= this
				has_journal_entry = je_divided_monarchists
			}
			fra_favor_ruler_dynasty = yes
		}
	}

	option = { #No
		default_option = yes
		name = character_events.5.b
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_monarchy
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_ig_disapprove_of_no_statue
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:FRA ?= this
				has_journal_entry = je_divided_monarchists
			}
			fra_disfavor_ruler_dynasty = yes
		}
	}
}


character_events.6 = { #Statue torn down
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:statue_state

	title = character_events.6.t
	desc = character_events.6.d
	flavor = character_events.6.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_political_extremism"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			has_variable = ruler_statue_var
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = ruler_statue_var
			}
			save_scope_as = statue_state
		}
	}

	option = { #Do it
		name = character_events.6.a
		scope:statue_state = {
			remove_variable = ruler_statue_var
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_monarchy
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_ig_approve_statue_removal
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #No
		default_option = yes
		name = character_events.6.b
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_monarchy
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_ig_approve_no_statue_removal
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #we should just relocate it
		name = character_events.6.c
		trigger = {
			scope:statue_state = { NOT = { this = root.capital } }
			any_scope_state = {
				NOT = { has_variable = ruler_statue_var }
			}
		}
		scope:statue_state = {
			remove_variable = ruler_statue_var
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				value = small_radicals
			}
		}
		capital = {
			set_variable = {
				name = ruler_statue_var
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = small_radicals
			}
		}
	}
}

children_rights_events.1 = { #families hide their children so they won't have to work / advancement
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = children_rights_events.1.t
	desc = children_rights_events.1.d
	flavor = children_rights_events.1.f

	category = enactment

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_child_labor"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_election.dds"

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				has_law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed
				OR = {
					is_enacting_law = law_type:law_restricted_child_labor
					is_enacting_law = law_type:law_compulsory_primary_school
				}
			}
			AND = {
				has_law = law_type:law_restricted_child_labor
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_compulsory_primary_school
			}
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			law_stance = {
				law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
				value < neutral
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_modifier = hidden_children_modifier }
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				law_stance = {
					law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = child_labor_yes_scope
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = child_labor_state
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = { #look the other way
		name = children_rights_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = hidden_children_modifier
		}
	}

	option = { #help them hide the children
		name = children_rights_events.1.b
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = hidden_children_modifier
		}
		scope:child_labor_yes_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = helped_hidden_children_modifier
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

children_rights_events.6 = { #gatekeeping education / debate
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = children_rights_events.6.t
	desc = children_rights_events.6.d
	flavor = children_rights_events.6.f

	category = enactment

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_rich_and_poor"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_election.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_compulsory_primary_school
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_public_schools
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_religious_schools
		}
		OR = {
			has_law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed
			has_law = law_type:law_restricted_child_labor
			has_law = law_type:law_no_schools
		}
		NOT = { has_modifier = no_gatekeeping }
		any_interest_group = {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			OR = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_egalitarian
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_egalitarian_modern
				leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reformer
				}
			}
			NOR = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
				is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
				is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = child_labor_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_landowners ?= {
					is_powerful = yes
				}
			}
			ig:ig_landowners ?= {
				save_scope_as = gatekeeper_ig
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
					is_powerful = yes
				}
			}
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
				save_scope_as = gatekeeper_ig
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
					is_powerful = yes
				}
			}
			ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
				save_scope_as = gatekeeper_ig
			}
		}
		else = {
			ig:ig_landowners ?= {
				save_scope_as = gatekeeper_ig
			}
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_egalitarian
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_egalitarian_modern
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reformer
					}
				}
				NOR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
					is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = school_ig
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = { #we shall continue with this
		name = children_rights_events.6.a
		default_option = yes
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = no_gatekeeping
		}
		scope:gatekeeper_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = gatekeeping_education_no
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = -1
			}
		}
		scope:school_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = gatekeeping_education_no
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #lie to them
		name = children_rights_events.6.b
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_law = law_type:law_secret_police
				has_technology_researched = mass_propaganda
				scope:school_ig = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
					is_powerful = yes

﻿namespace = cholera

cholera.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:cholera_state

	title = cholera.1.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cholera.1.d1
				trigger = {
					exists = c:GBR
					c:GBR ?= THIS
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cholera.1.d2
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = cholera.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_sick_in_hospital"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = john_snow }
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			relative_infrastructure <= 5
			any_scope_building = {
				is_building_type = building_urban_center
				level > 10
			}
		}
		OR = {
			AND = {
				has_technology_researched = urban_planning
				NOT = { has_technology_researched = modern_sewerage }
			}
			AND = {
				has_technology_researched = medical_degrees
				NOT = { has_technology_researched = pharmaceuticals }
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = john_snow
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				relative_infrastructure <= 5
				any_scope_building = {
					is_building_type = building_urban_center
					level > 10
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = cholera_state
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = cholera.1.a
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			has_technology_researched = urban_planning
			NOT = { has_technology_researched = modern_sewerage }
		}
		add_technology_progress = {
			progress = 3500
			technology = modern_sewerage
		}
		scope:cholera_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = cholera_modifier
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = cholera.1.b
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			has_technology_researched = medical_degrees
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_technology_researched = pharmaceuticals }
			}
			add_technology_progress = {
				progress = 3500
				technology = pharmaceuticals
			}
		}
		scope:cholera_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = cholera_modifier
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = cholera.1.c
		trigger = {
			exists = c:GBR
			c:GBR ?= THIS
			ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
		}
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = john_snow_knows_nothing
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:cholera_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = cholera_modifier
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

citizenship_laws.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:phreonology_state
	title = citizenship_laws.1.t
	desc = citizenship_laws.1.d
	flavor = citizenship_laws.1.f

	category = enactment

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_engineer_blueprint"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# Check that the law is moving towards more discrimination
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_ethnostate
			AND = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
				OR = {
					has_law = law_type:law_racial_segregation
					has_law = law_type:law_cultural_exclusion
					has_law = law_type:law_multicultural
				}
			}
			AND = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_racial_segregation
				OR = {
					has_law = law_type:law_cultural_exclusion
					has_law = law_type:law_multicultural
				}
			}
			AND = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_cultural_exclusion
				has_law = law_type:law_multicultural
			}
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			has_building = building_university
		}
		NOT = { has_modifier = phrenological_justifications }
		NOT = { has_modifier = rejected_phrenology }
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_building = building_university }
			save_scope_as = phreonology_state
		}
		random_primary_culture = {
			save_scope_as = primary_culture_pop
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = {
		name = citizenship_laws.1.a
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = phrenological_justifications
		}
		scope:phreonology_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = phrenology_department
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = citizenship_laws.1.b
		default_option = yes
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = rejected_phrenology
		}
	}
}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# Check that the law is moving towards more discrimination
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_ethnostate
			AND = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
				OR = {
					has_law = law_type:law_racial_segregation
					has_law = law_type:law_cultural_exclusion
					has_law = law_type:law_multicultural
				}
			}
			AND = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_racial_segregation
				OR = {
					has_law = law_type:law_cultural_exclusion
					has_law = law_type:law_multicultural
				}
			}
			AND = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_cultural_exclusion

			}
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			has_building = building_art_academy
			any_scope_pop = {
				state = {
					state_average_culture_pop_acceptance = {
						culture = PREV.culture
						value >= acceptance_status_4
					}
				}
				will_be_accepted_culture = no
			}
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			law_enactment_stance = {
				law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
				value > neutral
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_modifier = rejected_cultural_contributions }
		NOT = { has_modifier = embraced_cultural_contributions }
		NOT = {
			currently_enacting_law = {
				has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_degenerate_art
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_building = building_art_academy
				any_scope_pop = {
					state = {
						state_average_culture_pop_acceptance = {
							culture = PREV.culture
							value >= acceptance_status_4
						}
					}
					will_be_accepted_culture = no
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = degenerate_art_state
			random_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					state = {
						state_average_culture_pop_acceptance = {
							culture = PREV.culture
							value >= acceptance_status_4
						}
					}
					will_be_accepted_culture = no
				}
				culture = { save_scope_as = degenerate_art_pop }
			}
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = censorship_ig
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = {
		name = citizenship_laws.2.a
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = rejected_cultural_contributions
		}
		currently_enacting_law = {
			add_amendment = {
				type = amendment_degenerate_art
				sponsor = scope:censorship_ig
				cooldown = 120
			}
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = large_radicals

	}

	trigger = {

			OR = {
				any_scope_building = {
					is_building_type = building_coffee_plantation
					level >= 20
					occupancy <= 0.9
				}
				any_scope_building = {
					is_building_type = building_livestock_ranch
					level >= 20
					occupancy <= 0.9
				}
				any_scope_building = {
					is_building_type = building_sugar_plantation
					level >= 20
					occupancy <= 0.9
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_coffee_plantation
						level >= 20
						occupancy <= 0.9
					}
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_livestock_ranch
						level >= 20
						occupancy <= 0.9
					}
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_sugar_plantation
						level >= 20
						occupancy <= 0.9
					}
				}
			}
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = population_state
			random_scope_building = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_building_type = building_coffee_plantation
						is_building_type = building_livestock_ranch
						is_building_type = building_sugar_plantation
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = population_building
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = coffee_with_milk.3.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:population_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_population_state_immigration
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = coffee_with_milk.3.b
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
			}
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_slave_trade
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_supported_slave_imports
				days = normal_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_slave_trade
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_supported_slave_imports_negative
				days = normal_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		scope:population_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_population_state_slavery
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

			save_scope_as = bandits_state
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_capital = no
				has_building = building_coffee_plantation
				has_building = building_livestock_ranch
				is_incorporated = yes
			}
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0

					scope:milk_state = this
				}

			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = coffee_state
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = coffee_with_milk.9.a
		default_option = yes
		set_variable = cangaco_var
		scope:bandits_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_the_cangaco
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			every_neighbouring_state = {
				limit = {
					owner = root
					NOT = {
						this = prev
					}
					is_incorporated = yes
					OR = {
						average_sol < average_expected_sol
						turmoil >= 0.25
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_the_cangaco
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {

				multiplier = 0.5
			}

					NOT = {

coffee_with_milk.10 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:bandits_state

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	title = coffee_with_milk.10.t
	desc = coffee_with_milk.10.d
	flavor = coffee_with_milk.10.f

	event_image = {
		video = "rp1_social_banditry"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_variable = cangaco_var
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			OR = {
				average_sol < average_expected_sol
				turmoil >= 0.25
			}
		}
		OR = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_tenant_farmers
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
		}
		has_technology_researched = camera
	}

	immediate = {
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			save_scope_as = landowners_scope
		}
		ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
			save_scope_as = rf_scope
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				OR = {
					average_sol < average_expected_sol
					turmoil >= 0.25
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = bandits_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				game_date > 1870.1.1
				game_date < 1890.1.1
			}
			create_character = {
				template = BRZ_jesuino_brilliant
				save_scope_as = bandit_scope
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				game_date > 1912.1.1
				game_date <= 1920.1.1
			}
			create_character = {
				template = BRZ_anesia_cauacu
				save_scope_as = bandit_scope
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				game_date > 1920.1.1
				game_date < 1936.1.1
			}
			create_character = {
				template = BRZ_virgulino_ferreira
				save_scope_as = bandit_scope
			}
		}
		else = {
			create_character = {
				is_agitator = yes
				interest_group = ig_rural_folk
				ideology = ideology_land_reformer
				traits = {
					social_bandit
					firebrand
					ambitious
				}
				save_scope_as = bandit_scope
			}
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_capital = no
				has_building = building_coffee_plantation
				has_building = building_livestock_ranch
				is_incorporated = yes
			}
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = milk_state
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_capital = no
				has_building = building_coffee_plantation
				is_incorporated = yes
				NOT = {
					scope:milk_state = this
				}
			}
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = coffee_state
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = coffee_with_milk.10.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:bandits_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
				interest_group = owner.ig:ig_rural_folk
			}
		}
		scope:bandit_scope = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_template = BRZ_virgulino_ferreira
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_lamp_character_modifier
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_social_bandit_character_modifier
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = coffee_with_milk.10.b
		scope:bandits_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
				interest_group = owner.ig:ig_rural_folk
			}
		}
		scope:bandit_scope = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_template = BRZ_virgulino_ferreira
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_lamp_hunted_character_modifier
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_social_bandit_hunted_character_modifier
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = coffee_with_milk.10.c
		trigger = {
			institution_investment_level = {
				institution = institution_police
				value >= 5
			}
		}
		highlighted_option = yes
		scope:bandits_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = large_radicals
				interest_group = owner.ig:ig_rural_folk
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			25 = {
				scope:bandit_scope = {
					exile_character_with_role_cleanup = yes
				}
			}
			25 = {
				scope:bandit_scope = {
					kill_character = yes
				}
			}
			50 = {
				scope:bandit_scope = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_template = BRZ_virgulino_ferreira
						}
						add_modifier = {
							name = modifier_lamp_hunted_character_modifier
						}
					}
					else = {
						add_modifier = {
							name = modifier_social_bandit_hunted_character_modifier
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	type = country_event
	placement = scope:newly_formed_colonial_nation_capital_scope

	desc = colonial_administration_events.1.d
	flavor = colonial_administration_events.1.f

	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { months = 3 }

	trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		random_subject_or_below = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = newly_formed_colonial_nation_var
			}
			save_scope_as = newly_formed_colonial_nation_scope
			capital = {
				save_scope_as = newly_formed_colonial_nation_capital_scope
				region = {
					save_scope_as = newly_formed_colonial_nation_region_scope
				}
			}
		}
		random_scope_pop = {
			limit = {
				has_state_religion = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = majority_religion
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = colonial_administration_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		create_diplomatic_pact = {
			country = scope:newly_formed_colonial_nation_scope
			type = chartered_company
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = colonial_administration_events.1_tt_1
			scope:newly_formed_colonial_nation_scope = {
				activate_law = law_type:law_colonial_administration
				activate_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
				activate_law = law_type:law_subjecthood
				active_law:lawgroup_citizenship ?= { # Subjecthood
					add_amendment = {
						type = amendment_racialized_subjecthood
						sponsor = PREV.ig:ig_armed_forces
					}
				}
				activate_law = law_type:law_extraction_economy
				activate_law = law_type:law_colonial_exploitation
				activate_law = law_type:law_no_schools
				activate_law = law_type:law_no_health_system

# Colonial Collapse event
colonial_administration_events.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	title = colonial_administration_events.2.t
	desc = colonial_administration_events.2.d
	flavor = colonial_administration_events.2.f

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_sepoy_mutiny"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		is_subject = no
		NOT = {
			has_variable = colonial_collapse_var
		}
		OR = {
			has_variable = senegal_subject_var
			has_variable = zanj_subject_var
			has_variable = southern_africa_subject_var
			has_variable = congo_subject_var
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = colonial_collapse_var
		ordered_state = {
			limit = {
				is_homeland_of_country_cultures = root
			}
			order_by = gdp
			save_scope_as = colonial_evacuation_state
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = colonial_administration_events.2.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = some_european_pops_abandon_africa_tt
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_european
					}
				}
				random_list = {
					25 = {
						move_pop = scope:colonial_evacuation_state
					}
					75 = {

					}
				}
			}
		}
		every_scope_culture = {
			limit = {
				root = {
					cultural_acceptance_base = { target = prev value <= acceptance_status_4 }
				}
			}
			prev = {
				add_radicals = {
					culture = prev
					value = 0.8
				}
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = colony_alone_modifier
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
		trigger_event = { id = independence.2 days = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = colonial_administration_events.2.b
		trigger = {
			has_technology_researched = nationalism
			OR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_colonial_affairs
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_multicultural
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
				any_political_movement = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_cultural_minority
					political_movement_support >= 0.10
				}
			}
		}
		highlighted_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = most_european_pops_abandon_africa_tt
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_european
					}
				}
				random_list = {
					75 = {
						move_pop = scope:colonial_evacuation_state
					}
					25 = {

					}
				}
			}
		}
		capital = {
			every_scope_culture = {
				limit = {
					has_homeland = prev
					NOT = {
						is_primary_culture_of = prev.owner
					}
				}
				prev.owner = {
					add_primary_culture = prev
				}
			}
		}
		every_primary_culture = {
			limit = {
				has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_european
			}
			prev = {
				remove_primary_culture = prev
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			country_remove_colonial_variables = yes
			every_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_european
					}
					is_immortal = no
				}
				retire_character = {
					hidden = yes
				}
			}
		}
		trigger_event = { id = independence.2 days = 1 }
	}
}

# ALL Event - decolonization
colonization.1 = {
	type = country_event

	title = colonization.1.t
	desc = colonization.1.d
	flavor = colonization.1.f

	category = enactment

	event_image = {
		video = "africa_city_center"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		is_enacting_law = law_type:law_no_colonial_affairs
		any_country = {
			is_subject_of = ROOT
			country_is_colonial_or_company = yes
		}
		NOR = {
			has_modifier = decolonization
			has_modifier = refused_to_release_colony
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_subject_of = ROOT
				country_is_colonial_or_company = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = colony_scope
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = { # free the colony
		name = colonization.1.a
		default_option = yes
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = decolonization
		}
		scope:colony_scope = {
			make_independent = yes
			change_relations = {
				country = ROOT
				value = 30
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # do not free the colony
		name = colonization.1.b
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = refused_to_release_colony
		}
		scope:colony_scope = {
			change_relations = {
				country = ROOT
				value = -30
			}
		}
	}
}

# Stall event - Outsourcing - movement to preserve, people concerned about jobs being outsourced to colonies
colonization.2 = {
	type = country_event

	title = colonization.2.t
	desc = colonization.2.d
	flavor = colonization.2.f

	category = enactment

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_politicians_arguing"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_law = law_type:law_no_colonial_affairs
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_colonial_exploitation
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_colonial_resettlement
		}
		any_political_movement = {
			law_stance = {
				law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
				value < neutral
			}
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			law_stance = {
				law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
				value < neutral
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			currently_enacting_law = {
				has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_restricted_colonial_outsourcing
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = outsourcing_scope
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = outsourcing_ig
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = { # try to alleviate their concerns
		name = colonization.2.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
		currently_enacting_law = {
			add_amendment = {
				type = amendment_restricted_colonial_outsourcing
				sponsor = scope:outsourcing_ig
				cooldown = 120
			}
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = fear_of_outsourcing_alleviated
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = colonization.2.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:outsourcing_scope ?= {
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.55
					}
				}
				add = -5
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:outsourcing_scope ?= {
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.375
					}
				}
				add = -3
			}
		}
		# grow the movement
		scope:outsourcing_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = outsourcing_anger
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

# Debate event - the ethics of exploitation
colonization.4 = {
	type = country_event

	title = colonization.4.t
	desc = colonization.4.d
	flavor = colonization.4.f

	category = enactment

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_election"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_colonial_exploitation
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_colonial_resettlement
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_frontier_colonization
		}
		NOT = {
			has_modifier = colonial_ethical_conviction
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = { # strongly support your side
		name = colonization.4.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_political_movement = {
						law_stance = {
							law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
							value < neutral
						}
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.55
					}
				}
				add = -5
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_political_movement = {
						law_stance = {
							law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
							value < neutral
						}
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.375
					}
				}
				add = -3
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				add_enactment_modifier = {
					name = colonial_ethical_conviction
				}
			}
			2 = {
				add_enactment_modifier = {
					name = colonial_ethical_conviction
					multiplier = 2
				}
			}
			2 = {
				add_enactment_modifier = {
					name = colonial_ethical_conviction
					multiplier = -1
				}
			}
		}
		# if there's a movement to preserve, it gets angrier
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_political_movement = {
					law_stance = {
						law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
						value < neutral
					}
				}
			}
			add_enactment_modifier = {
				name = ethically_condemned
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # make concessions to opposing side
		name = colonization.4.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
		random_list = {
			2 = {
				add_enactment_modifier = {
					name = colonial_ethical_conviction
				}
			}
			1 = {
				add_enactment_modifier = {
					name = colonial_ethical_conviction
					multiplier = 2
				}
			}
			1 = {
				add_enactment_modifier = {
					name = colonial_ethical_conviction
					multiplier = -1
				}
			}
		}
		# if there's a movement to preserve, it grows
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_political_movement = {
					law_stance = {
						law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
						value < neutral
					}
				}
			}
			add_enactment_modifier = {
				name = ethical_concessions
			}
		}
	}
}

			limit = {
				has_role_of_type = general
				is_busy = no
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				is_immortal = no
				OR = {
					has_trait = alcoholic
					has_trait = opium_addiction
					has_trait = cocaine_addiction
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = commander_with_addiction
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			exists = scope:commander_with_addiction
		}
	}

	option = { #Fire them
		name = commander_events.2.a
		custom_tooltip = commander_events.2.a.tt
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:commander_with_addiction = {
				retire_character = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #They'll be fine
		name = commander_events.2.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:commander_with_addiction = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_commander_with_addiction
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

			}

			character_is_valid_for_events = yes
			is_busy = no
			OR = {
				has_trait = alcoholic
				has_trait = opium_addiction
				has_trait = cocaine_addiction
			}
			OR = {
				has_trait = defense_in_depth_specialist
				has_trait = expert_artillery_commander
				has_trait = expert_naval_commander
				has_trait = expert_convoy_raider
				has_trait = celebrity_commander
			}
		}
		any_scope_character = {
			or = {
				has_role_of_type = general
				has_role_of_type = admiral
			}
			is_ruler_of_own_country = no
			character_is_valid_for_events = yes
			is_busy = no
			NOT = {
				has_trait = alcoholic
				has_trait = opium_addiction
				has_trait = cocaine_addiction
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				or = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no

					has_trait = alcoholic
					has_trait = opium_addiction
					has_trait = cocaine_addiction
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = arguing_commander_one
			interest_group ?= {
				save_scope_as = arguing_commander_one_IG
			}
		}

		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				or = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}

					has_trait = opium_addiction
					has_trait = cocaine_addiction

					has_trait = expert_artillery_commander
					has_trait = expert_naval_commander
					has_trait = expert_convoy_raider
					has_trait = celebrity_commander
				}
				NOT = { this = scope:arguing_commander_one }
			}
			save_scope_as = arguing_commander_two
		}
	}

		NOR = {
			exists = scope:arguing_commander_one

		}
