# Psychological Warfare
# in loving memory of Matthew J. Clohessy, now living a better life as a programmer, may his content not be forgotten

commander_events.6 = {
	type = country_event
    placement = ROOT

    title = commander_events.6.t
    desc = commander_events.6.d
    flavor = commander_events.6.f

    event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_before_the_battle"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

    duration = 3

    cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = psychological_warfare_var }
		any_scope_character = {
			is_ruler_of_own_country = no
			character_is_valid_for_events = yes
			is_busy = no
			has_role_of_type = general
			is_immortal = no
			OR = {
				has_trait = romantic
				has_trait = arrogant
				has_trait = bigoted
				has_trait = reckless
				has_trait = ambitious
				has_trait = imperious
				has_trait = charismatic
				has_trait = hedonist
				has_trait = persistent
			}
			NOR = {
				has_trait = meticulous
				has_trait = cautious
				has_trait = pious
			}
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			leader = {
				NOT = { has_trait = syphilis }
				is_female = no
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = psychological_warfare_var
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				has_role_of_type = general
				is_busy = no
				is_immortal = no
				OR = {
					has_trait = romantic
					has_trait = arrogant
					has_trait = bigoted
					has_trait = reckless
					has_trait = ambitious
					has_trait = imperious
					has_trait = charismatic
					has_trait = hedonist
					has_trait = persistent
				}
				NOR = {
					has_trait = meticulous
					has_trait = cautious
					has_trait = pious
				}
			}
			set_variable = seducer_commander_var
			save_scope_as = seducer_commander
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				leader = {
					NOT = {
						has_trait = syphilis
						has_variable = seducer_commander_var
					}
					is_female = no
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = cheated_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = cheated_leader
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOR = {
			exists = scope:seducer_commander
			exists = scope:cheated_leader
			scope:cheated_ig = { ig_counts_as_marginal = yes }
		}
	}

	option = { #cover the general
		name = commander_events.6.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = commander_events.6.a.tt
		scope:cheated_leader = {
			add_trait = syphilis
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_trait = alcoholic }
				}
				random_list = {
					10 = { add_trait = alcoholic }
					90 = { }
				}
			}
		}
		scope:seducer_commander = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_trait = syphilis } }
				add_trait = syphilis
			}
			remove_variable = seducer_commander_var
		}
		scope:cheated_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = covered_affair_modifier #disapprove
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #bruh
		name = commander_events.6.b
		custom_tooltip = commander_events.6.b.tt
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:seducer_commander = {
				retire_character = yes
				remove_variable = seducer_commander_var
			}
		}
		scope:cheated_leader = {
			add_trait = syphilis
		}
		scope:cheated_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = punished_commander_modifier #approve
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #let them fight
		name = commander_events.6.c
		trigger = { #if the leader has a reckless trait he punches the other guy
			scope:cheated_leader = {
				has_trait = reckless
			}
		}
		scope:cheated_leader = {
			add_trait = syphilis
			add_modifier = {
				name = punching_leader_modifier #popularity
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:seducer_commander = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = punched_commander_modifier #popularity bad
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			remove_variable = seducer_commander_var
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_trait = syphilis } }
				add_trait = syphilis
			}
		}
	}
}

communal_divides_events.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = communal_divides_events.2.t
	desc = communal_divides_events.2.d
	flavor = communal_divides_events.2.f

	event_image = {
		video = "ip2_intercommunal_tensions"
	}

	dlc = dlc011

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	trigger = {
		# triggered by JE
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_india
					OR = {
						country_has_state_religion = rel:sunni
						country_has_state_religion = rel:shiite
					}
					NOT = {
						is_subject_of = root
					}
				}
			}
			ordered_country = {
				limit = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_india
					OR = {
						country_has_state_religion = rel:sunni
						country_has_state_religion = rel:shiite
					}
					NOT = {
						is_subject_of = root
					}
				}
				order_by = gdp
				position = 0
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = muslim_indian_country_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = communal_divides_events.2.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country_in_india = {
					OR = {
						country_has_state_religion = rel:sunni
						country_has_state_religion = rel:shiite
					}
					NOT = {
						is_subject_of = root
					}
				}
			}
			every_country_in_india = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						country_has_state_religion = rel:sunni
						country_has_state_religion = rel:shiite
					}
					NOT = {
						is_subject_of = root
					}
				}
				change_relations = {
					country = root
					value = -30
				}
				create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
					type = catalyst_event_negative
					target = root
				}
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_intercommunal_violence
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = communal_divides_events.2.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_intercommunal_violence
			days = long_modifier_time
			multiplier = 1.5
		}
	}
}

# Completion event 1
communism.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = communism.1.t
	desc = communism.1.desc
	flavor = communism.1.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_political_extremism"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_election.dds"

	trigger = {
		# triggered by communsim JE 1
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_council_republic
						value > neutral
					}
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_council_republic
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				set_variable = communist_ig_var
				save_scope_as = unions
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = union_leader
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
				set_variable = communist_ig_var
				save_scope_as = unions
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = union_leader
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = je_communism_2_var
			value = 0
		}
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_communism_2
		}
	}

	option = { # wage controls
		name = communism.1.a
		trigger = {
			NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_wage_subsidies }
			NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_old_age_pension }
		}
		activate_law = law_type:law_wage_subsidies
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					has_variable = communist_ig_var
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = communist_unions.tt
		}
	}
	option = { # ban slavery
		name = communism.1.b
		trigger = {
			NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_slavery_banned }
		}
		activate_law = law_type:law_slavery_banned
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					has_variable = communist_ig_var
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = communist_unions.tt
		}
	}
	option = { # Regulatory bodies
		name = communism.1.c
		trigger = {
			NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_regulatory_bodies }
			NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_worker_protections }
		}
		activate_law = law_type:law_regulatory_bodies
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					has_variable = communist_ig_var
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = communist_unions.tt
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = communism.1.d
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					has_variable = communist_ig_var
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = communist_unions.tt
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = communist_government_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_loyalists = {
			value = medium_radicals
			strata = upper
		}
	}
}

# Completion event 2, choose ideology
communism.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = communism.2.t
	desc = communism.2.d
	flavor = communism.2.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_agitator_speaking"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	trigger = {
		# triggered by communsim JE 2
	}

	immediate = {
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			save_scope_as = unions
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = union_leader
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # vanguardism
		name = communism.2.a
		trigger = {
			has_technology_researched = political_agitation
			any_political_movement = {
				OR = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
					is_political_movement_type = movement_socialist
				}
			}
		}
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			set_variable = chose_vanguardism
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
					}
				}
			}
			create_political_movement = { type = movement_communist }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_political_movement = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
				}
			}
			random_political_movement = {
				limit = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
				}
				set_core_ideology = ideology_vanguardist_movement
				remove_character_ideology = ideology_communist
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = chose_vanguardism.tt
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:union_leader = {
					NOT = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist }
				}
			}
			scope:union_leader = {
				set_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = path_to_vanguardism
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
						}
					}
					count >= 3
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = vanguard_custom_tooltip
					NOT = {
						any_interest_group = {
							is_powerful = yes
							leader = {
								NOR = {
									has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
									has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
									has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			trigger_event = { id = communism.5 }
		}
		else = {
			add_journal_entry = {
				type = je_vanguard
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_5_year_plan
		}
	}
	option = { # communism
		name = communism.2.b
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { exists = c:RUS }
				NOT = { c:RUS = ROOT }
			}
		}
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			set_variable = chose_communism
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
					}
				}
			}
			create_political_movement = { type = movement_communist }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_political_movement = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
				}
			}
			random_political_movement = {
				limit = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
				}
				remove_character_ideology = ideology_vanguardist
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = chose_communism.tt
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:union_leader = {
					NOT = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist }
				}
			}
			scope:union_leader = {
				set_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = path_to_communism
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				root.bureaucracy > 0
				approaching_bureaucracy_shortage = no
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_public_schools
				institution_investment_level = {
					institution = institution_schools
					value = 5
				}
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_public_health_insurance
				institution_investment_level = {
					institution = institution_health_system
					value = 5
				}
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_old_age_pension
				institution_investment_level = {
					institution = institution_social_security
					value = 5
				}
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_worker_protections
				institution_investment_level = {
					institution = institution_workplace_safety
					value = 5
				}
			}
			trigger_event = {
				id = communism.6
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_journal_entry = {
				type = je_communist_welfare
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_5_year_plan
		}
	}
	option = { # russian communism
		name = communism.2.b2
		trigger = {
			exists = c:RUS
			c:RUS = ROOT
		}
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			set_variable = chose_communism
		}
		custom_tooltip = chose_communism.tt
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:union_leader = {
					NOT = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist }
				}
			}
			scope:union_leader = {
				set_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
					}
				}
			}
			create_political_movement = { type = movement_communist }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_political_movement = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
				}
			}
			random_political_movement = {
				limit = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
				}
				remove_character_ideology = ideology_vanguardist
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = path_to_communism
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				approaching_bureaucracy_shortage = no
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_public_schools
				institution_investment_level = {
					institution = institution_schools
					value = 5
				}
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_public_health_insurance
				institution_investment_level = {
					institution = institution_health_system
					value = 5
				}
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_old_age_pension
				institution_investment_level = {
					institution = institution_social_security
					value = 5
				}
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_worker_protections
				institution_investment_level = {
					institution = institution_workplace_safety
					value = 5
				}
			}
			trigger_event = {
				id = communism.6
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_journal_entry = {
				type = je_communist_welfare
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_5_year_plan
		}
	}
	option = { # anarchism

# IG Converted by Vanguard
communism.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = communism.3.t
	desc = communism.3.d
	flavor = communism.3.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_capitalists_meeting"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = political_agitation
		any_interest_group = {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = yes
			OR = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
				is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
				is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
			}
			any_scope_character = {
				NOR = {
					has_role_of_type = agitator
					has_role_of_type = ruler
				}
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
			}
			leader = {
				NOR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = yes
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
					is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				}
				leader = {
					NOR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = new_vanguard_ig
			set_variable = chose_vanguardism
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					NOR = {
						has_role_of_type = agitator
						has_role_of_type = ruler
					}
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
				}
				save_scope_as = new_vanguard_leader
				set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = communism.3.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = new_vanguard.tt
		scope:new_vanguard_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = new_vanguard_opinion
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = communism.3.b
		custom_tooltip = new_vanguard.tt
		scope:new_vanguard_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = new_vanguard_clout
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

		}
	}

# Rising socialist leader
communism.7 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = communism.7.t
	desc = communism.7.d
	flavor = communism.7.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_agitator_speaking"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
		any_interest_group = {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			any_scope_character = {
				OR = {
					has_role_of_type = politician
					has_role_of_type = agitator
				}
				NOT = { has_modifier = popular_socialist_leader }
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				any_scope_character = {
					OR = {
						has_role_of_type = politician
						has_role_of_type = agitator
					}
					NOT = { has_modifier = popular_socialist_leader }
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = popular_socialist_ig
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_role_of_type = politician
						has_role_of_type = agitator
					}
					NOT = { has_modifier = popular_socialist_leader }
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = popular_socialist_leader
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = communism.7.a
		trigger = {
			scope:popular_socialist_ig = {
				is_in_government = yes
			}
		}
		default_option = yes
		scope:popular_socialist_leader = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = popular_socialist_leader
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = communism.7.b
		trigger = {
			scope:popular_socialist_ig = {
				is_in_government = no
			}
		}
		default_option = yes
		scope:popular_socialist_leader = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = popular_socialist_leader
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
			}
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = large_radicals
				strata = lower
			}
		}
	}
}

# Worker coops, happy workers
 communism.9 = {
 	type = country_event
 	placement = scope:coop_state
 	title = communism.9.t
 	desc = communism.9.d
 	flavor = communism.9.f

 	duration = 3

 	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

 	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

 	event_image = {
 		video = "africa_prosperous_farm"
 	}

 	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

 	trigger = {
 		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_cooperative_ownership
 		any_scope_state = {
 			is_incorporated = yes
 			NOT = { has_modifier = coop_loyalty_modifier }
 			NOT = { has_modifier = coop_migration_modifier }
 			any_scope_pop = {
				pop_acceptance >= acceptance_status_4
 				standard_of_living > 15
 				workplace ?= {
					NOR = {
						is_building_type = building_manor_house
						is_building_type = building_financial_district
					}
 					cash_reserves_ratio > 0.25
 					weekly_profit > 5
 					occupancy >= 0.95
 					level >= 5
 				}
 			}
 		}
 	}

 	immediate = {
 		random_scope_state = {
 			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				NOT = { has_modifier = coop_loyalty_modifier }
				NOT = { has_modifier = coop_migration_modifier }
				any_scope_pop = {
					pop_acceptance >= acceptance_status_4
					standard_of_living > 15
					workplace ?= {
						NOR = {
							is_building_type = building_manor_house
							is_building_type = building_financial_district
						}
						cash_reserves_ratio > 0.25
						weekly_profit > 5
						occupancy >= 0.95
						level >= 5
					}
				}
 			}
 			save_scope_as = coop_state
 			random_scope_pop = {
 				limit = {
					pop_acceptance >= acceptance_status_4
					standard_of_living > 15
					workplace ?= {
						NOR = {
							is_building_type = building_manor_house
							is_building_type = building_financial_district
						}
						cash_reserves_ratio > 0.25
						weekly_profit > 5
						occupancy >= 0.95
						level >= 5
					}
 				}
 				save_scope_as = coop_pop
 				workplace = {
 					save_scope_as = coop_building
 				}
 			}
 		}
 	}

 	option = {
 		name = communism.9.a
 		default_option = yes
 		scope:coop_state = {
 			add_modifier = {
 				name = coop_loyalty_modifier
 				days = long_modifier_time
 			}
 		}
 	}

 	option = {
 		name = communism.9.b
 		scope:coop_state = {
 			add_modifier = {
 				name = coop_migration_modifier
 				days = long_modifier_time
 			}
 		}
 	}
 }

# The Red Scare
communist_elections.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = communist_elections.1.t
	desc = communist_elections.1.d1
	flavor = communist_elections.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_political_extremism"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_single_party_state }
		in_election_campaign = yes
		NOT = { has_variable = mute_election_events }
		NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
		NOT = { has_variable = red_scare_var }
		# Leftists are running in the election but aren't in government
		any_interest_group = {
			is_in_government = no
			has_party = yes
			party = {
				OR = {
					is_party_type = communist_party
					is_party_type = social_democrat_party
					is_party_type = anarchist_party
				}
			}
		}
		# Any government IG is in a non-leftist party
		any_interest_group = {
			is_in_government = yes
			has_party = yes
			party = {
				NOR = {
					is_party_type = communist_party
					is_party_type = social_democrat_party
					is_party_type = anarchist_party
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = red_scare_var
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_in_government = no
				has_party = yes
				party = {
					OR = {
						is_party_type = communist_party
						is_party_type = social_democrat_party
						is_party_type = anarchist_party
					}
				}
			}
			party = {
				save_scope_as = leftist_party
			}
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_in_government = yes
				has_party = yes
				party = {
					NOR = {
						is_party_type = communist_party
						is_party_type = social_democrat_party
						is_party_type = anarchist_party
					}
				}
			}
			party = {
				save_scope_as = anti_leftist_party
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		in_election_campaign = no
	}

	option = { # These leftists are traitors to [country]
		name = communist_elections.1.a
		scope:leftist_party = {
			add_momentum = momentum_large_decrease
		}
	}

	option = { # This rhetoric is needlessly alarmist
		name = communist_elections.1.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:leftist_party = {
			add_momentum = momentum_medium_decrease
		}
		add_modifier = { # reduced government opinion
			name = red_scare_minimized
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { # Ban communist literature
		name = communist_elections.1.c
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_censorship
			}
		}
		scope:leftist_party = {
			add_momentum = momentum_very_large_decrease
			every_member = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = red_scare_communists_annoyed
					days = short_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # Infiltrate and arrest the leadership
		name = communist_elections.1.d
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_secret_police
		}
		scope:leftist_party = {
			add_momentum = momentum_very_large_decrease
		}
		add_modifier = { # costs some authority
			name = infiltrating_communist_parties
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { # They have every right to spread their ideas
		name = communist_elections.1.e
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_right_of_assembly
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_protected_speech
			}
		}
		scope:leftist_party = {
			add_momentum = momentum_small
		}
		scope:anti_leftist_party = {
			every_member = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = red_scare_minimized
					days = short_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Workers vote in the Council Republic. Trade Union party strongly preferred.
communist_elections.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = communist_elections.2.t
	desc = communist_elections.2.d
	flavor = communist_elections.2.f

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_election"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_single_party_state }
		in_election_campaign = yes
		NOT = { has_variable = mute_election_events }
		NOT = { has_variable = council_elections_var }
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			has_party = yes
		}
		any_active_party = {
			party_has_members = yes
			NOT = {
				any_member = { is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions }
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = council_elections_var
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			save_scope_as = unions_ig
			party = {
				save_scope_as = unions_party
			}
		}
		random_active_party = {
			limit = {
				party_has_members = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:unions_party }
			}
			save_scope_as = anti_union_party
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		in_election_campaign = no
	}

	option = { # The workers are always right
		name = communist_elections.2.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:unions_party = {
			add_momentum = momentum_very_large
		}
	}
	option = { # voting for the worker's party is mandatory
		name = communist_elections.2.b
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = communist_elections.2.tt
				scope:unions_ig = {
					is_in_government = yes
				}
			}
			OR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_censorship
			}
		}
		scope:unions_party = {
			add_momentum = momentum_very_large
		}
		add_modifier = { # authority
			name = mandatory_communist_support
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
	}
	option = { # other voices should also be heard
		name = communist_elections.2.c
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_right_of_assembly
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_protected_speech
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = communist_elections.2.c.tt
				any_interest_group = {
					has_party = yes
					party = {
						NOT = { THIS = scope:unions_party }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				has_party = yes
				party = {
					NOT = { THIS = scope:unions_party }
				}
			}
			party = {
				add_momentum = momentum_large
			}
		}
	}
}

# International Socialism
communist_elections.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = communist_elections.3.t
	desc = communist_elections.3.d
	flavor = communist_elections.3.f

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_political_extremism"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_single_party_state }
		in_election_campaign = yes
		NOT = { has_variable = mute_election_events }
		NOT = { has_variable = international_socialism_var }
		any_country = {
			NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
			NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
			country_rank >= rank_value:major_power
			any_interest_group = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				leader = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
					}
				}
			}
		}
		any_active_party = {
			party_has_members = yes
			OR = {
				is_party_type = communist_party
				is_party_type = social_democrat_party
				is_party_type = anarchist_party
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = international_socialism_var
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				has_party = yes
				party = {
					OR = {
						is_party_type = communist_party
						is_party_type = social_democrat_party
						is_party_type = anarchist_party
					}
				}
			}
			party = {
				save_scope_as = socialist_party
			}
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
				NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
				country_rank >= rank_value:major_power
				any_interest_group = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = socialist_country
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = foreign_socialist_ig
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = foreign_socialist_leader
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		in_election_campaign = no
	}

	option = { # welcome international support
		name = communist_elections.3.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:socialist_party = {
			add_momentum = momentum_large
		}
		# improve relations with socialist country if the socialists are in power
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:foreign_socialist_ig = {
					is_in_government = yes
				}
			}
			scope:socialist_country = {
				change_relations = {
					country = ROOT
					value = 20
				}
			}
		}
		# owe a favor to the socialist country if you both have socialist governments
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { owes_obligation_to = scope:socialist_country }
				scope:foreign_socialist_ig = {
					is_in_government = yes
				}
				scope:socialist_party = {
					any_member = {
						is_in_government = yes
					}
				}
			}
			set_owes_obligation_to = {
				country = scope:socialist_country
				setting = yes
			}
		}
		# These variables increase the chances of generating new leaders with each ideology
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:foreign_socialist_leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = election_vanguardist_support
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
			custom_tooltip = election_socialist_support_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:foreign_socialist_leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = election_anarchist_support
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
			custom_tooltip = election_socialist_support_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:foreign_socialist_leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = election_communist_support
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
			custom_tooltip = election_socialist_support_tt
		}
	}

	option = { # Limit foreign influence
		name = communist_elections.3.b
		scope:socialist_party = {
			add_momentum = momentum_small
		}
	}

	option = { # expel foreign infiltrators
		name = communist_elections.3.c
		trigger = {
			scope:socialist_party = {
				NOT = {
					any_member = {
						is_in_government = yes
					}
				}
			}
			OR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_closed_borders
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_secret_police
			}
		}
		scope:socialist_party = {
			add_momentum = momentum_large_decrease
		}
		# harm relations with socialist country if they have a socialist government
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:foreign_socialist_ig = {
					is_in_government = yes
				}
			}
			scope:socialist_country = {
				change_relations = {
					country = ROOT
					value = -20
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Fascist paramilitaries intimidate voters
communist_elections.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = communist_elections.4.t
	desc = communist_elections.4.desc
	flavor = communist_elections.4.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_vandalized_storefront"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_single_party_state }
		in_election_campaign = yes
		NOT = { has_variable = mute_election_events }
		NOT = { has_variable = blackshirts_var }
		any_interest_group = {
			has_party = yes
			leader = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ethno_nationalist
				}
			}
			party = {
				is_party_type = fascist_party
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = blackshirts_var
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				has_party = yes
				leader = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ethno_nationalist
					}
				}
				party = {
					is_party_type = fascist_party
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = fascist_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = fascist_leader
			}
			party = {
				save_scope_as = fascist_party_scope
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		in_election_campaign = no
	}

	option = { # allow paramilitaries
		name = communist_elections.4.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:fascist_party_scope = {
			add_momentum = momentum_large
		}
		every_active_party = {
			limit = {
				party_has_members = yes
				NOT = { is_party_type = fascist_party }
			}
			add_momentum = momentum_small_decrease
		}
	}

	option = { # Support paramilitaries with the army and police
		name = communist_elections.4.b
		default_option = yes
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = communist_elections.4.tt
				scope:fascist_ig = {
					is_in_government = yes
				}
			}
			OR = {
				ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
					is_powerful = yes
				}
				institution_investment_level = {
					institution = institution_police
					value >= 3
				}
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_militarized_police
			}
		}
		scope:fascist_party_scope = {
			add_momentum = momentum_very_large
			# increase opinion
		}
		every_active_party = {
			limit = {
				party_has_members = yes
				NOT = { is_party_type = fascist_party }
			}
			add_momentum = momentum_medium_decrease
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_militarized_police
						value > neutral
					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = state_sanctioned_paramilitaries
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_militarized_police
						value < neutral
					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = state_sanctioned_paramilitaries
				days = short_modifier_time
				multiplier = -1
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # Discourage paramilitaries
		name = communist_elections.4.c
		scope:fascist_party_scope = {
			add_momentum = momentum_small
		}
		scope:fascist_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = paramilitaries_opposed
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
		every_active_party = {
			limit = {
				party_has_members = yes
				NOT = { is_party_type = fascist_party }
			}
			add_momentum = momentum_small_decrease
		}
	}

	option = { # Crack down on paramilitaries
		name = communist_elections.4.d
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_protected_speech
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_guaranteed_liberties
				institution_investment_level = {
					institution = institution_police
					value >= 3
				}
			}
		}
		scope:fascist_party_scope = {
			add_momentum = momentum_medium_decrease
		}
		scope:fascist_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = paramilitaries_opposed
				days = short_modifier_time
				multiplier = -2
			}
		}
	}
}

cable_street.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:fascist_rally_state

	desc = cable_street.1.d
	flavor = cable_street.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_political_extremism"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_single_party_state }
		in_election_campaign = yes
		NOT = { has_variable = mute_election_events }
		NOT = { has_variable = cable_street_var }
		any_interest_group = {
			has_party = yes
			party = {
				is_party_type = fascist_party
			}
			leader = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ethno_nationalist
				}
			}
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			leader = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cable_street_var
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = fascist_rally_state
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				has_party = yes
				party = {
					is_party_type = fascist_party
				}
				leader = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ethno_nationalist
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = fascist_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = fascist_leader
			}
			party = {
				save_scope_as = fascist_party
			}
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = antifa_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = antifa_leader
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		in_election_campaign = no
	}

	option = { # protect fascists right to march
		name = cable_street.1.a
		default_option = yes
		# outcome weighted in favor of fascists
		random_list = {
			2 = {
				scope:fascist_party = {
					add_momentum = momentum_very_large
				}
				scope:fascist_rally_state = {
					state_region = {
						add_devastation = 10
					}
				}
			}
			2 = {
				scope:fascist_party = {
					add_momentum = momentum_large
				}
			}
			1 = {
				scope:fascist_party = {
					add_momentum = momentum_large_decrease
				}
			}
			1 = {
				scope:fascist_party = {
					add_momentum = momentum_very_large_decrease
				}
				scope:fascist_rally_state = {
					state_region = {
						add_devastation = 10
					}
				}
			}
		}
		scope:antifa_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = protected_fascist_rally_antifa
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # keep the police out of it
		name = cable_street.1.b

		random_list = {
			1 = {
				scope:fascist_party = {
					add_momentum = momentum_very_large
				}
				scope:fascist_rally_state = {
					state_region = {
						add_devastation = 10
					}
				}
			}
			1 = {
				scope:fascist_party = {
					add_momentum = momentum_large
				}
			}
			1 = {
				scope:fascist_party = {
					add_momentum = momentum_large_decrease
				}
			}
			1 = {
				scope:fascist_party = {
					add_momentum = momentum_very_large_decrease
				}
				scope:fascist_rally_state = {
					state_region = {
						add_devastation = 10
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # ban the rally
		name = cable_street.1.c
		# outcome weighted against fascists
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				scope:fascist_party = {
					add_momentum = momentum_very_large
				}
				scope:fascist_rally_state = {
					state_region = {
						add_devastation = 10
					}
				}
			}
			1 = {
				scope:fascist_party = {
					add_momentum = momentum_large
				}
			}
			2 = {
				scope:fascist_party = {
					add_momentum = momentum_large_decrease
				}
			}

				scope:fascist_party = {
					add_momentum = momentum_very_large_decrease
				}
				scope:fascist_rally_state = {
					state_region = {
						add_devastation = 10
					}
				}

		}

congo_free_state_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:afs_capital_scope
	title = congo_free_state_events.1.t
	desc = congo_free_state_events.1.d
	flavor =  congo_free_state_events.1.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_ruler_speaking_to_people"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	trigger = {
		#triggered from the JE
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = free_state_created
		set_global_variable = free_state_created
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = free_state_monarch
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = no
				is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_africa
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					is_incorporated = no
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_africa
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = colonial_state
		}
		create_country = {
			origin = ROOT
			tag = AFS
			state = scope:colonial_state
		}
		c:AFS ?= {
			every_neighbouring_state = {
		 		limit = {
		 			owner = ROOT
		 		}
		 		set_state_owner = c:AFS
			}
			save_scope_as = free_state
			activate_law = law_type:law_autocracy
			activate_law = law_type:law_serfdom
			activate_law = law_type:law_debt_slavery
			capital = {
				save_scope_as = afs_capital_scope
			}
		}
		create_diplomatic_pact = {
			country = c:AFS
			type = personal_union
		}
	}

	option = { #Let it happen
		name = congo_free_state_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		set_variable = free_state_made
 		scope:free_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = free_state_mort
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_ruler_speaking_to_people"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	trigger = {
		#triggered by the JE
	}

	immediate = {
		c:AFS ?= {
			save_scope_as = free_state
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = free_state_monarch
		}
	}

	option = { #Reintegrate
		name = congo_free_state_events.5.a
		default_option = yes
		annex = c:AFS
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				ruler = {
					has_variable = free_state_monarch
				}
			}
			ruler = {
				remove_variable = free_state_created
				add_modifier = {
					name = free_state_monarch_modifier #popularity loss
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = free_state_monarchy_modifier #legitimacy head of state
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #Free Free State
		name = congo_free_state_events.5.b
		c:AFS ?= {
			make_independent = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				ruler = {
					has_variable = free_state_monarch
				}
			}
			ruler = {
				remove_variable = free_state_created
				add_modifier = {
					name = free_state_monarch_modifier #popularity loss
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = free_state_monarchy_modifier #legitimacy head of state
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

congo_free_state_events.6 = { #The Report
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:free_state.capital
	title = congo_free_state_events.6.t
	desc = congo_free_state_events.6.d
	flavor =  congo_free_state_events.6.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "africa_soldiers_breaking_protest"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	trigger = {
		var:free_state_international_opinion >= 90
		NOT = { has_variable = congo_free_state_cooldown }
	}

	immediate = {
		c:AFS ?= {
			save_scope_as = free_state
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = free_state_monarch
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = congo_free_state_cooldown
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = ignored_report_var }
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					country_rank >= rank_value:major_power #so it's relevant
				}
				save_scope_as = report_country
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					country_rank >= rank_value:great_power #we grab a scary boy
				}
				save_scope_as = report_country
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #Condemn it
		name = congo_free_state_events.6.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = congo_opinion_medium_tt
			change_variable = {
				name = free_state_international_opinion
				add = 10
			}
		}
		scope:free_state_monarch = {
			interest_group ?= {
				add_modifier = {
 					name = modifier_condemned_colony
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #Ignore
		name = congo_free_state_events.6.b
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = ignored_report_var }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = congo_opinion_small_tt
				change_variable = {
					name = free_state_international_opinion
					add = 5
				}
			}
			ROOT = {
				create_incident = {
					country = scope:report_country
					value = 20
				}
			}
			set_variable = ignored_report_var
		}
		else = {
			ROOT = { #you've ignored it more than once
				create_incident = {
					country = scope:report_country
					value = 40
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

expedition_events.602 = { #Choose commander
	type = country_event
    placement = ROOT

    title = expedition_events.2.t
    desc = expedition_events.2.d
    flavor = expedition_events.2.f

    duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_jungle_expedition"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	trigger = {
		any_scope_character = {
			OR = {
				has_role_of_type = general
				has_role_of_type = admiral
			}
			is_ruler_of_own_country = no
			character_is_valid_for_events = yes
			is_busy = no
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					is_busy = no
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					character_is_valid_for_events = yes
					OR = {
						has_role_of_type = general
						has_role_of_type = admiral
					}
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					has_trait = explorer
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					is_busy = no
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					character_is_valid_for_events = yes
					OR = {
						has_role_of_type = general
						has_role_of_type = admiral
					}
					has_trait = explorer
				}
				save_scope_as = expedition_leader_1
			}
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_busy = no
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				OR = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:expedition_leader_1 }
					NOT = {
						this = scope:expedition_leader_1
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader_2
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_busy = no
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				OR = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}
				NOR = {
					AND = {
						exists = scope:expedition_leader_1
						this = scope:expedition_leader_1
					}
					this = scope:expedition_leader_2
				}

			}
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader_3
		}
		set_variable = congo_river_expedition_var
		congo_river_expedition_location = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = expedition_events.602.a
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:expedition_leader_1
		}
		custom_tooltip = expedition_costs_tt
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_large_expedition_cost
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
		}
		scope:expedition_leader_1 = {
			set_as_expedition_leader = yes
		}
		trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.604 days = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = expedition_events.602.b
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:expedition_leader_2
		}
		custom_tooltip = expedition_costs_tt
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_large_expedition_cost
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
		}
		scope:expedition_leader_2 = {
			set_as_expedition_leader = yes
		}
		trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.604 days = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = expedition_events.602.c
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:expedition_leader_3
		}
		custom_tooltip = expedition_costs_tt
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_large_expedition_cost
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
		}
		scope:expedition_leader_3 = {
			set_as_expedition_leader = yes
		}
		trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.604 days = 30 }
	}
}

expedition_events.695 = { #you find another country's expedition
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location

    title = expedition_events.695.t
    desc = expedition_events.695.d
    flavor = expedition_events.695.f

    duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_sick_in_hospital"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			je:je_congo_expedition ?= {
				"scripted_bar_progress(expedition_progress_bar)" >= 3
			}
			je:je_central_africa_expedition ?= {
				"scripted_bar_progress(expedition_progress_bar)" >= 3
			}
			je:je_niger_river_expedition ?= {
				"scripted_bar_progress(expedition_progress_bar)" >= 3
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = expedition_lost_expedition_var }
		any_country = {
			NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_variable = failed_congo_river_var
					ROOT = { has_variable = congo_river_expedition_var }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = failed_central_africa_expedition_var
					ROOT = { has_variable = central_africa_expedition_var }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = failed_niger_river_var
					ROOT = { has_variable = niger_river_expedition_var }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = on_expedition }
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = expedition_lost_expedition_var
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = congo_river_expedition_var
			}
			congo_river_expedition_location = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = niger_river_expedition_var
			}
			niger_river_expedition_location = yes
		}
		else = {
			central_africa_location_effect = yes #Nile
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_variable = failed_congo_river_var
						ROOT = { has_variable = congo_river_expedition_var }
					}
					AND = {
						has_variable = failed_central_africa_expedition_var
						ROOT = { has_variable = central_africa_expedition_var }
					}
					AND = {
						has_variable = failed_niger_river_var
						ROOT = { has_variable = niger_river_expedition_var }
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = lost_expedition_country
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = { has_variable = expedition_leader_var }
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader
		}
	}

	option = { #guide them to a safe place
		name = expedition_events.695.a
		default_option = yes
		expedition_lose_progress_effect = yes
		expedition_peril_decrease_small_effect = yes
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:lost_expedition_country
			value = 30
		}
	}

	option = { #invite them to join you
		name = expedition_events.695.b
		add_small_peril_effect = yes
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:lost_expedition_country
			value = 10
		}
	}

	option = { #leave them to their fate
		name = expedition_events.695.c
		expedition_minor_progress_effect = yes
		add_small_peril_effect = yes
	}

	option = { #kill them
		name = expedition_events.695.e
		custom_tooltip = killed_lost_expedition_tt
		trigger = {
			scope:lost_expedition_country = {
				relations:root <= relations_threshold:cold
			}
		}
		set_variable = killed_lost_expedition_var #this will have consequences
		scope:lost_expedition_country = {
			set_variable = lost_expedition_country_var #we save them for the next event
		}
		expedition_peril_decrease_small_effect = yes
		scope:expedition_leader = {
			set_variable = expedition_leader_cruel_var
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:expedition_leader = {
					NOR = {
						has_trait = wrathful
						has_trait = cruel
					}
				}
			}
			scope:expedition_leader = {
				add_trait = cruel
			}
		}
	}
}

﻿namespace = conscription_laws

conscription_laws.1 = { #Rural folk worried about lack of workers
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = conscription_laws.1.t
	desc = conscription_laws.1.d
	flavor = conscription_laws.1.f

	category = enactment

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_before_the_battle"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_election.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_law = law_type:law_professional_army
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_peasant_levies
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_mass_conscription
		}
		NOT = {
			has_modifier = conscription_starting
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
			save_scope_as = rural_folk_conscription
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = { # high chance, upset rural folk
		name = conscription_laws.1.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = keep_marching_on
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = conscription_starting
			multiplier = 2
		}
	}

	option = { #lower success chance, keep it safe
		name = conscription_laws.1.b
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = conscription_starting
		}
	}
}

				add_enactment_modifier = {

		}

				}
			}

conscription_laws.3 = { #Government is unprepared for conscription
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = conscription_laws.3.t
	desc = conscription_laws.3.d
	flavor = conscription_laws.3.f

	category = enactment

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_before_the_battle"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_election.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_law = law_type:law_professional_army
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_peasant_levies
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_mass_conscription
		}
		NOT = { has_modifier = no_slowing_down }
		NOT = { has_modifier = conscription_stalled }
		any_interest_group = {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			OR = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_peasant_levies
					value < neutral
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_mass_conscription
					value < neutral
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				OR = {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_peasant_levies
						value < neutral
					}
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_mass_conscription
						value < neutral
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = anti_conscription_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = anti_conscription_advocate
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = { #invest to get low of no chance of failure
		name = conscription_laws.3.a
		default_option = yes
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = no_slowing_down
		}
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				add_enactment_modifier = {
					name = conscription_stalled
					multiplier = 1
				}
			}
			4 = {
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #do nothing
		name = conscription_laws.3.b
		random_list = {
			3 = {
				add_enactment_modifier = {
					name = conscription_stalled
					multiplier = 0.5
				}
			}
			1 = {
				add_enactment_modifier = {
					name = conscription_stalled
					multiplier = 1.5
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Corn Laws abolished
corn_laws.1 = {
	type = country_event

	title = corn_laws.1.t

	flavor = corn_laws.1.f

		video = "middleeast_courtroom_upheaval"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	option = {
		name = corn_laws.1.a
        default_option = yes

        if = {
        	limit = {
        		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
        			is_in_government = yes
        			leader = {
        				NOT = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal }
        			}
        		}
        	}
        	ig:ig_landowners ?= {
        		# interest_group_approval_add

        			name = repealed_corn_laws
        			days = long_modifier_time
        		}
        	}
        }
        add_loyalists = {
        	value = 0.1
        	pop_type = laborers
        }
        add_loyalists = {
        	value = 0.1
        	pop_type = peasants
        }
	}
}

# New Market Liberal Petit-Bourgeoisie agitator who opposes the laws
corn_laws.2 = {
	type = country_event

	title = corn_laws.2.t
	desc = corn_laws.2.d
	flavor = corn_laws.2.f

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_courtroom_upheaval"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = corn_law_opponent_event }
		ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
		}
		empty_agitator_slots >= 1
	}

	immediate = {
		ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= { save_scope_as = pb_ig }
		set_variable = corn_law_opponent_event
		create_character = {
			is_agitator = yes
			interest_group = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie
			ideology = ideology_market_liberal
			traits = {
				charismatic
				experienced_political_operator
			}
			save_scope_as = corn_laws_agitator_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = corn_laws.2.a
		custom_tooltip = corn_laws_agitator_appears_tt
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_political_movement = {
					OR = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_liberal
						is_political_movement_type = movement_orleanist
					}
				}
			}
			random_political_movement = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_liberal
						is_political_movement_type = movement_orleanist
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_anti_corn_laws_league
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_political_movement = {
				limit = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_modernizer
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_anti_corn_laws_league
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = corn_laws.2.b
        default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = corn_laws_agitator_appears_tt
		scope:corn_laws_agitator_scope ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_working_against_the_grain
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_loyalists = {
			value = large_radicals
			pop_type = aristocrats
		}
	}
}

# Advance: Certain trade unions align themselves with the regime.
corporate_state.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = corporate_state.1.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = corporate_state.1.d
				trigger = {
					is_enacting_law = law_type:law_corporate_state
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = corporate_state.1.d1
				trigger = {
					is_enacting_law = law_type:law_corporatized_unions
				}
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = corporate_state.1.f

	category = enactment

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_union_leader"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_corporate_state
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_social_monarchy
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_corporatized_unions
		}
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			leader = {
				NOR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
				}
			}
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			ig_approval > 0
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
    		save_scope_as = current_law_scope
    	}
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			save_scope_as = trade_unions_ig
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_political_movement = {
					law_stance = {
						law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
						value < neutral
					}
				}
			}
			random_political_movement = {
				limit = {
					law_stance = {
						law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
						value < neutral
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_movement
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_corporate_state
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_corporatized_unions
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_social_monarchy
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = corporate_state.1.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = modifier_corporate_state_national_unions
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = corporate_state.1.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = corporatist_leaders_boost_tt
			scope:trade_unions_ig = {
				set_variable = { name = corporatist_leaders_boost days = very_long_modifier_time }
			}
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = modifier_corporate_state_national_unions
			multiplier = 0.5
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = corporate_state.1.c
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_political_movement = {
						law_stance = {
							law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
							value < neutral
						}
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.50
					}
				}
				add = -5
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_political_movement = {
						law_stance = {
							law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
							value < neutral
						}
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.25
					}
				}
				add = -3
			}
		}
		trigger = {
			any_political_movement = {
				law_stance = {
					law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_corporate_state
		}
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_corporate_state_opposition_discredited
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

# Debate: Socialization, a la Mussolini in 1944.
corporate_state.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = corporate_state.2.t
	desc = corporate_state.2.d
	flavor = corporate_state.2.f

	category = enactment

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_capitalists_meeting"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		is_enacting_law = law_type:law_corporate_state
		has_technology_researched = central_planning
		NOT = {
			has_law = law_type:law_command_economy
		}
		OR = {
			has_law = law_type:law_single_party_state
			has_law = law_type:law_autocracy
			has_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
			has_law = law_type:law_technocracy
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			law_stance = {
				law = law_type:law_corporate_state
				value > neutral
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			currently_enacting_law = {
				OR = {
					has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_industrial_socialization
					has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_shop_councils
					has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_foreign_investment_seizures
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
    		save_scope_as = current_law_scope
    	}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_corporate_state
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = corporatist_ig
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { is_enacting_law = law_type:law_corporate_state }
	}

	option = {
		name = corporate_state.2.a
		add_radicals = {
			pop_type = capitalists
			value = large_radicals
		}
		currently_enacting_law = {
			add_amendment = {
				type = amendment_industrial_socialization
				sponsor = scope:corporatist_ig
				cooldown = 120
			}
		}
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_corporate_state_harmed_by_socialisation
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = modifier_corporate_state_socialisation
			multiplier = 2
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = corporate_state.2.b
		add_radicals = {
			pop_type = shopkeepers
			value = medium_radicals
		}
		currently_enacting_law = {
			add_amendment = {
				type = amendment_shop_councils
				sponsor = scope:corporatist_ig
				cooldown = 120
			}
		}
		ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_corporate_state_harmed_by_socialisation
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = modifier_corporate_state_socialisation
			multiplier = 2
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = corporate_state.2.c
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = every_investing_country_upset_tt
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						THIS = ROOT
					}
					ROOT = {
						"gdp_ownership_ratio(prev)" > 0.01
					}
				}
				change_relations = {
					country = ROOT
					value = -15
				}
			}
		}
		currently_enacting_law = {
			add_amendment = {
				type = amendment_foreign_investment_seizures
				sponsor = scope:corporatist_ig
				cooldown = 120
			}
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = modifier_corporate_state_socialisation
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = corporate_state.2.e
		default_option = yes
		add_loyalists = {
			pop_type = capitalists
			value = medium_radicals
		}
		add_loyalists = {
			pop_type = shopkeepers
			value = medium_radicals
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = modifier_corporate_state_no_socialisation
		}
	}
}

			name = modifier_corporate_state_labor_abuses
		}
	}

		name = corporate_state.3.b
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = modifier_corporate_state_labor_abuses_suppressed
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = corporate_state.3.c

			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_social_monarchy

		any_interest_group = {
			OR = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
				is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
				is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
			}
			ig_approval < 0
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
    		save_scope_as = current_law_scope
    	}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
					is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
					is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
				}
				ig_approval < 0
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_ig
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_corporate_state
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_social_monarchy
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = corporate_state.6.a
		default_option = yes
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = modifier_corporate_state_private_property_rights
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = corporate_state.6.b
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = modifier_corporate_state_private_property_carveouts
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = corporate_state.6.c
		add_enactment_setback = 1
		scope:relevant_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_corporate_state_private_property_ignored_ig
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

namespace = coup_pulse_events

coup_pulse_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = coup_pulse_events.1.t
	desc = coup_pulse_events.1.d
	flavor = coup_pulse_events.1.f

	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid
	left_icon = scope:accused_general

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/bicorne_hat.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_scope_character = {
			has_role_of_type = general
			is_ruler_of_own_country = no
			is_heir_of_own_country = no
			character_is_valid_for_events = yes
			NOT = {
				has_variable = golpista_var
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_role_of_type = general
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				is_heir_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				NOT = {
					has_variable = golpista_var
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = accused_general
			interest_group ?= {
				save_scope_as = accused_general_ig
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			scope:accused_general ?= {
				is_character_alive = no
			}
			NOT = { exists = scope:accused_general }
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_ip4_coup }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = coup_pulse_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:accused_general_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_persecuted_general
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = coup_pulse_events.1.a.tt
			scope:accused_general = {
				remove_character_role = character_role_general
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:accused_general_ig = {
					is_same_interest_group_type = scope:golpista_ig
				}
			}
			je:je_ip4_coup ?= {
				add_progress = { value = -15 name = je_ip4_coup_progress_bar }
			}
			custom_tooltip = coup_retreat_15_tt
		}
		else = {
			je:je_ip4_coup ?= {
				add_progress = { value = 15 name = je_ip4_coup_progress_bar }
			}
			custom_tooltip = coup_advance_15_tt
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = coup_pulse_events.1.b
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_uncertain_loyalties_country
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:accused_general = {
					interest_group ?= {
						is_same_interest_group_type = scope:golpista_ig
					}
				}
			}
			je:je_ip4_coup ?= {
				add_progress = { value = 15 name = je_ip4_coup_progress_bar }
			}
			custom_tooltip = coup_advance_15_tt
		}
		else = {
			je:je_ip4_coup ?= {
				add_progress = { value = -15 name = je_ip4_coup_progress_bar }
			}
			custom_tooltip = coup_retreat_15_tt
		}
	}
}

		has_variable = var_jack_ripper_possible
		is_player = yes
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			any_scope_building = {
				is_building_type = building_urban_center
				level >= 10
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_police }
		NOT = { has_variable = had_serial_killer_event }
		NOT = { has_variable = ongoing_assassination_je }
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = had_serial_killer_event
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				any_scope_building = {
					is_building_type = building_urban_center
					level >= 10
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = serial_killer_state
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = crime_events.10.a
		scope:serial_killer_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = serial_killer_state_mod
				days = very_long_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_serial_killer
			target = scope:serial_killer_state
		}
		set_variable = ongoing_serial_killer_je #so you don't get the assassination JE at the same time
	}
}

crime_events.11 = { #The Criminal was caught
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:serial_killer_state_scope

	title = crime_events.11.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = crime_events.11.d
				trigger = {
					NOT = { has_variable = important_killer_var }
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = crime_events.11.d2
				trigger = {
					has_variable = important_killer_var
				}
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = crime_events.11.f

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_police_breaking_door"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		# triggered by je_serial_killer pulse
		any_scope_character = {
			is_ruler_of_own_country = no
			character_is_valid_for_events = yes
			is_female = no
			is_immortal = no
			interest_group ?= {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
			age > 18
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				is_female = no
				is_immortal = no
				interest_group ?= {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				}
				age > 18
			}
			save_scope_as = important_killer
		}
		random_list = {
			80 = { }
			20 = {
				set_variable = important_killer_var
			}
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = serial_killer_state_mod
			}
			save_scope_as = serial_killer_state_scope
		}
		set_variable = serial_killer_caught
	}

	option = {
		name = crime_events.11.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_killer_caught
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = important_killer_var
			}
			scope:important_killer = {
				retire_character = yes
				interest_group ?= {
					add_modifier = {
						name = serial_killer_ig
						days = normal_modifier_time
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # cover up the identity of the killer
		name = crime_events.11.b
		trigger = {
			has_variable = important_killer_var
		}
		set_variable = serial_killer_caught
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
			}
			scope:important_killer = { # small popularity hit
				add_modifier = {
					name = suspected_serial_killer
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_censorship
			}
			scope:important_killer = { # moderate popularity hit
				add_modifier = {
					name = suspected_serial_killer
					multiplier = 2
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:important_killer = { # major popularity hit
				add_modifier = {
					name = suspected_serial_killer
					multiplier = 3
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Successful Cuba purchase - Cuba player
cuba_independencia.6 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = cuba_independencia.6.t
	desc = cuba_independencia.6.d
	flavor = cuba_independencia.6.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_transfer_of_authority"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	# If Cuba is a player and the USA/CSA isn't, CUB player switches to buyer country and annexes CUB. If CUB is player and so is USA/CSA, then USA/CSA puppets CUB. If neither are players, USA/CSA annexes CUB.
	option = {
		name = cuba_independencia.6.a
		default_option = yes

		scope:cuba_buyer = {
			hidden_effect = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = cuban_purchase
					days = long_modifier_time
					is_decaying = yes
					multiplier = je_cuba_join_usa_price
				}
			}

			trigger_event = {
				id = cuba_independencia.7
				popup = yes
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
				scope:cuba_buyer = {
					is_player = no
				}
			}
			play_as = scope:cuba_buyer

			scope:cuba_buyer = {
				annex = scope:cuba
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
				scope:cuba_buyer = {
					is_player = yes
				}
			}
			scope:cuba_buyer = {
				transfer_subject = root
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { is_subject_type = subject_type_dominion }
				}
				change_subject_type = subject_type_dominion
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = c:ATL
				c:ATL = { was_formed_from = CUB }
			}
			annex = c:ATL
		}
		else = {
			scope:cuba_buyer = {
				annex = c:CUB
			}
		}
	}

	# Triggered option for being just a US puppet, which only appears if Option A didn't already default to Cuba becoming a puppet due to specific circumstances
	option = {
		name = cuba_independencia.6.b
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				is_player = yes
				scope:cuba_buyer = {
					is_player = yes
				}
			}
		}

		scope:cuba_buyer = {
			hidden_effect = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = cuban_purchase
					days = long_modifier_time
					is_decaying = yes
					multiplier = je_cuba_join_usa_price
				}
			}

			transfer_subject = root

			trigger_event = {
				id = cuba_independencia.7
				popup = yes
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
