cuba_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = cuba_events.1.t
	desc = cuba_events.1.d
	flavor = cuba_events.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_gunboat_diplomacy"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc016

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ip4_content
	}

	immediate = {
		root.overlord = {
			save_scope_as = boss
		}
	}

	option = { # Keep good times flowing
		name = cuba_events.1.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_slave_revolt
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.60
					}
				}
				add = -5
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_slave_revolt
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.25
					}
				}
				add = -3
			}
		}
		trigger = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slave_trade
		}

        if = {
            limit = {
                has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slave_trade
            }
            add_modifier = {
				name = slavery_continues
				days = even_longer_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
			random_political_movement = {
				limit = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_slave_revolt
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = slave_revolt_risk
				}
			}
        }
    }

    option = { # good should be shared
		name = cuba_events.1.c
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
		trigger = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
		}
		if = {
 			limit = {
 				any_scope_pop = {
 					culture = cu:afro_caribeno
 				}
 			}
 			ROOT = {
 				add_culture_acceptance_modifier = {
					culture = cu:afro_caribeno
					multiplier = 20
				}
			}
 		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = cuba_share_success
			days = even_longer_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
		}
	  	if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_right_to_associate
                }
            }
            activate_law = law_type:law_right_to_associate
        }
	}


    option = { # time to modernise
		name = cuba_events.1.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = cuba_success_modernise
			days = even_longer_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
		}
	}

	option = { # Pro Independence
		name = cuba_events.1.independence
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
		trigger = {
			is_subject = yes
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = cuba_libre_from_trade
			days = stupidly_long_modifier_time
		}
	}
}

		}

			c:SPA ?= root.overlord
			c:SPA ?= {
				is_player = no
			}
		}
		cuba_annex_effects = yes
    }

    option = { # Viva Whoever you are, backup if overlord isn't Spain but is still Iberia, otherwise JE becomes invalid.
		name = cuba_events.2.b
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					exists = c:SPA
				}
				c:SPA != root.overlord
			}
			root.overlord ?= {
				is_player = no
			}
		}
		cuba_annex_effects = yes
    }

    option = { # become dominion
		name = cuba_events.2.c
		change_subject_type = subject_type_dominion
	}


    option = { # this is a terrible idea

			name = cuba_libre_from_trade
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}
}

cultural_homeland_events.1 = { #Majority Culture blames minority culture
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:culture_state

	title = cultural_homeland_events.1.t
	desc = cultural_homeland_events.1.d
	flavor = cultural_homeland_events.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_aristocrats"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			is_homeland_of_country_cultures = ROOT
			any_scope_culture = {
				NOT = { is_primary_culture_of = ROOT }
				PREV = {
					state_average_culture_pop_acceptance = { culture = prev value < acceptance_status_5 }
				}
			}
			any_scope_culture = {
				is_primary_culture_of = ROOT
			}
			average_sol < 10
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_homeland_of_country_cultures = ROOT
				any_scope_culture = {
					NOT = { is_primary_culture_of = ROOT }
					PREV = {
						state_average_culture_pop_acceptance = { culture = prev value < acceptance_status_5 }
					}
				}
				any_scope_culture = {
					is_primary_culture_of = ROOT
				}
				average_sol < 10
			}
			save_scope_as = culture_state
			random_scope_culture = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { is_primary_culture_of = ROOT }
					PREV = {
						state_average_culture_pop_acceptance = { culture = prev value < acceptance_status_5 }
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = state_minority_culture
			}
			random_scope_culture = {
				limit = {
					is_primary_culture_of = ROOT
				}
				save_scope_as = state_majority_culture
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			exists = scope:state_minority_culture
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = cultural_homeland_events.1.a
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_cultural_work
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { #Ignore it
		name = cultural_homeland_events.1.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:culture_state = {
			set_variable = {
				name = rising_cultural_tension
				value = yes
			}
			add_culture_standard_of_living_modifier = {
				culture = scope:state_minority_culture
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = -1
			}
		}
	}
}

				}
			}
			any_scope_culture = {
				is_primary_culture_of = ROOT
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = high_cultural_tension
				is_homeland_of_country_cultures = ROOT
				any_scope_culture = {
					NOT = { is_primary_culture_of = ROOT }
					PREV = {
						state_average_culture_pop_acceptance = { culture = prev value < acceptance_status_5 }
					}
				}
				any_scope_culture = {
					is_primary_culture_of = ROOT
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = culture_state
			random_scope_culture = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { is_primary_culture_of = ROOT }
					PREV = {
						state_average_culture_pop_acceptance = { culture = prev value < acceptance_status_5 }
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = state_minority_culture
			}
			random_scope_culture = {
				limit = {
					is_primary_culture_of = ROOT
				}
				save_scope_as = state_majority_culture
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = cultural_homeland_events.50.a
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_minority_members_defended
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		scope:culture_state = {
			add_culture_standard_of_living_modifier = {
				culture = scope:state_minority_culture
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = -5
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = cultural_homeland_events.50.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:culture_state = {
			set_variable = {
				name = high_cultural_tension
				value = yes
			}
			add_culture_standard_of_living_modifier = {
				culture = scope:state_minority_culture
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = -7
			}
		}
	}
}

# A New National Hero
culture_brazil.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:state

	title = culture_brazil.1.t
	desc = culture_brazil.1.d
	flavor = culture_brazil.1.f

	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:brazilian_national_hero

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# triggered by on_action on_battle_won pulse
		has_journal_entry = je_brazilian_nation_building
		OR = {
			AND = {
				NOT = { has_variable = brazilian_sulista_hero_var }
				NOT = { has_variable = sulistas_integrated }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { has_variable = brazilian_nordestino_hero_var }
				NOT = { has_variable = nordestinos_integrated }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { has_variable = brazilian_amazonic_hero_var }
				NOT = { has_variable = amazonics_integrated }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { has_variable = brazilian_paulista_hero_var }
				NOT = { has_variable = paulistas_integrated }
			}
		}
		# there exists a commander on the root side to be the national hero
		OR = {
			scope:attacker = {
				owner = ROOT
			}
			scope:defender ?= {
				owner = ROOT
			}
		}
		scope:enemy_country = {
			NOR = {
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:sulista
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:nordestino
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:amazonic
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:paulista
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:attacker = {
					owner = ROOT
				}
			}
			scope:attacker = {
				save_scope_as = brazilian_national_hero
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:defender = {
				save_scope_as = brazilian_national_hero
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				trigger = {
				 	AND = {
				 		NOT = { has_variable = brazilian_sulista_hero_var }
				 		NOT = { has_variable = sulistas_integrated }
				 	}
				}
				create_character = {
					ig_leader = no
					female = no
					is_general = yes
					culture = cu:sulista
					on_created = {
						set_variable = {
							name = brazilian_hero_scope
						}
					}
				}
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = {
				 	AND = {
				 		NOT = { has_variable = brazilian_paulista_hero_var }
				 		NOT = { has_variable = paulistas_integrated }
				 	}
				}
				create_character = {
					ig_leader = no
					female = no
					is_general = yes
					culture = cu:paulista
					on_created = {
						set_variable = {
							name = brazilian_hero_scope
						}
					}
				}
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = {
				 	AND = {
				 		NOT = { has_variable = brazilian_nordestino_hero_var }
				 		NOT = { has_variable = nordestinos_integrated }
				 	}
				}
				create_character = {
					ig_leader = no
					female = no
					is_general = yes
					culture = cu:nordestino
					on_created = {
						set_variable = {
							name = brazilian_hero_scope
						}
					}
				}
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = {
				 	AND = {
				 		NOT = { has_variable = brazilian_amazonic_hero_var }
				 		NOT = { has_variable = amazonics_integrated }
				 	}
		 		}
				create_character = {
					ig_leader = no
					female = no
					is_general = yes
					culture = cu:amazonic
					on_created = {
						set_variable = {
							name = brazilian_hero_scope
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		random_scope_character = {
			limit = { has_variable = brazilian_hero_scope }
			save_scope_as = brazilian_national_hero
			culture = {
				save_scope_as = brazilian_national_hero_culture
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = culture_brazil.1.a
		default_option = yes

		custom_tooltip = culture_brazil.1.hero_clarification

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:brazilian_national_hero = {
					culture = {
						cu:sulista = this
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = brazilian_sulista_hero_var
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:brazilian_national_hero = {
					culture = {
						cu:nordestino = this
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = brazilian_nordestino_hero_var
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:brazilian_national_hero = {
					culture = {
						cu:amazonic = this
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = brazilian_amazonic_hero_var
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:brazilian_national_hero = {
					culture = {
						cu:paulista = this
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = brazilian_paulista_hero_var
		}

		scope:brazilian_national_hero = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOR = {
						has_trait = traditionalist_commander
						has_trait = popular_commander
						has_trait = celebrity_commander
					}
				}
				add_trait = traditionalist_commander
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_trait = traditionalist_commander
				}
				remove_trait = traditionalist_commander
				add_trait = popular_commander
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_trait = popular_commander
				}
				remove_trait = popular_commander
				add_trait = celebrity_commander
			}
		}
	}


	option = {
		name = culture_brazil.1.b

		scope:brazilian_national_hero = {
			retire_character = yes
		}
	}
}

﻿namespace = culture_south_america

# Birth of a National Identity
culture_south_america.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = culture_south_america.1.t
	desc = culture_south_america.1.d
	flavor = culture_south_america.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_ruler_speaking_to_people"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		root = { save_scope_as = south_america_nation_scope }
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:ARG ?= this
			}
			cu:platinean = {
				save_scope_as = old_south_american_culture
			}
			cu:argentine = {
				save_scope_as = new_national_culture
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:PEU ?= this
			}
			cu:south_andean = {
				save_scope_as = old_south_american_culture
			}
			cu:peruvian = {
				save_scope_as = new_national_culture
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:NPU ?= this
			}
			cu:south_andean = {
				save_scope_as = old_south_american_culture
			}
			cu:peruvian = {
				save_scope_as = new_national_culture
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:SPU ?= this
			}
			cu:south_andean = {
				save_scope_as = old_south_american_culture
			}
			cu:peruvian = {
				save_scope_as = new_national_culture
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:BOL ?= this
			}
			cu:south_andean = {
				save_scope_as = old_south_american_culture
			}
			cu:bolivian = {
				save_scope_as = new_national_culture
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:ECU ?= this
			}
			cu:north_andean = {
				save_scope_as = old_south_american_culture
			}
			cu:ecuadorian = {
				save_scope_as = new_national_culture
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:CHL ?= this
			}
			cu:south_andean = {
				save_scope_as = old_south_american_culture
			}
			cu:chilean = {
				save_scope_as = new_national_culture
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:VNZ ?= this
			}
			cu:north_andean = {
				save_scope_as = old_south_american_culture
			}
			cu:venezuelan = {
				save_scope_as = new_national_culture
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:URU ?= this
			}
			cu:platinean = {
				save_scope_as = old_south_american_culture
			}
			cu:uruguayan = {
				save_scope_as = new_national_culture
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:PRG ?= this
			}
			cu:platinean = {
				save_scope_as = old_south_american_culture
			}
			cu:paraguayan = {
				save_scope_as = new_national_culture
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:CLM ?= this
			}
			cu:north_andean = {
				save_scope_as = old_south_american_culture
			}
			cu:colombian = {
				save_scope_as = new_national_culture
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = culture_south_america.1.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 90
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				c:ARG ?= this
			}
			add_primary_culture = cu:argentine
			remove_primary_culture = cu:platinean
			capital.state_region = {
				add_homeland = cu:argentine
				remove_homeland = cu:platinean
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					cu:argentine ?= {
						culture_national_awakening_occurred = no
					}
				}
				start_national_awakening = {
					culture =  cu:argentine
					months = 120
					state_region = capital.state_region
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					c:PEU ?= this
					c:NPU ?= this
					c:SPU ?= this
				}
			}
			add_primary_culture = cu:peruvian
			remove_primary_culture = cu:south_andean
			capital.state_region = {
				add_homeland = cu:peruvian
				remove_homeland = cu:south_andean
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					cu:peruvian ?= {
						culture_national_awakening_occurred = no
					}
				}
				start_national_awakening = {
					culture =  cu:peruvian
					months = 120
					state_region = capital.state_region
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:BOL ?= this
			}
			add_primary_culture = cu:bolivian
			remove_primary_culture = cu:south_andean
			capital.state_region = {
				add_homeland = cu:bolivian
				remove_homeland = cu:south_andean
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					cu:bolivian ?= {
						culture_national_awakening_occurred = no
					}
				}
				start_national_awakening = {
					culture =  cu:bolivian
					months = 120
					state_region = capital.state_region
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:ECU ?= this
			}
			add_primary_culture = cu:ecuadorian
			remove_primary_culture = cu:north_andean
			capital.state_region = {
				add_homeland = cu:ecuadorian
				remove_homeland = cu:north_andean
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					cu:ecuadorian ?= {
						culture_national_awakening_occurred = no
					}
				}
				start_national_awakening = {
					culture =  cu:ecuadorian
					months = 120
					state_region = capital.state_region
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:CHL ?= this
			}
			add_primary_culture = cu:chilean
			remove_primary_culture = cu:south_andean
			capital.state_region = {
				add_homeland = cu:chilean
				remove_homeland = cu:south_andean
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					cu:chilean ?= {
						culture_national_awakening_occurred = no
					}
				}
				start_national_awakening = {
					culture =  cu:chilean
					months = 120
					state_region = capital.state_region
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:VNZ ?= this
			}
			add_primary_culture = cu:venezuelan
			remove_primary_culture = cu:north_andean
			capital.state_region = {
				add_homeland = cu:venezuelan
				remove_homeland = cu:north_andean
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					cu:venezuelan ?= {
						culture_national_awakening_occurred = no
					}
				}
				start_national_awakening = {
					culture =  cu:venezuelan
					months = 120
					state_region = capital.state_region
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:URU ?= this
			}
			add_primary_culture = cu:uruguayan
			remove_primary_culture = cu:platinean
			capital.state_region = {
				add_homeland = cu:uruguayan
				remove_homeland = cu:platinean
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					cu:uruguayan ?= {
						culture_national_awakening_occurred = no
					}
				}
				start_national_awakening = {
					culture =  cu:uruguayan
					months = 120
					state_region = capital.state_region
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:PRG ?= this
			}
			add_primary_culture = cu:paraguayan
			remove_primary_culture = cu:platinean
			capital.state_region = {
				add_homeland = cu:paraguayan
				remove_homeland = cu:platinean
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					cu:paraguayan ?= {
						culture_national_awakening_occurred = no
					}
				}
				start_national_awakening = {
					culture =  cu:paraguayan
					months = 120
					state_region = capital.state_region
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:CLM ?= this
			}
			add_primary_culture = cu:colombian
			remove_primary_culture = cu:north_andean
			capital.state_region = {
				add_homeland = cu:colombian
				remove_homeland = cu:north_andean
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					cu:colombian ?= {
						culture_national_awakening_occurred = no
					}
				}
				start_national_awakening = {
					culture =  cu:colombian
					months = 120
					state_region = capital.state_region
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_south_american_national_identity
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					THIS = ROOT
				}
				has_interest_marker_in_region = root.capital.region
			}
			post_notification = sa_culture_genesis
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = 75_percent_of_upper_pops_assimilate_tt
			capital = {
				every_scope_pop = {
					limit = {
						strata = upper
						culture = scope:old_south_american_culture
					}
					change_pop_culture = {
						target = scope:new_national_culture
						value = 0.75
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Engineers want to get important road contract
decree_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:decree_state

	title = decree_events.1.t
	desc = decree_events.1.d
	flavor = decree_events.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_automobile"
	}

	duration = 3

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			has_decree = decree_road_maintenance
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			has_building = building_university
		}
		income >= 300
		NOR = {
			has_variable = road_maintenance_var
		}
		has_technology_researched = combustion_engine
	}


	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				has_decree = decree_road_maintenance
			}
			save_scope_as = decree_state
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				has_building = building_university
			}
			save_scope_as = engineers_state
		}
		set_variable = road_maintenance_var
	}

	option = { #engineer 1 wants it to have great drainage (expensive)
		name = decree_events.1.a
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_technology_researched = modern_sewerage
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = drainage_roads_cheaper_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = drainage_roads_cheaper_modifier_costs
				multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = drainage_roads_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = drainage_roads_modifier_costs
				multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #engineer 2 cheap one
		name = decree_events.1.b
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = cheaper_roads_modifier
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}

		add_modifier = {
			name = cheaper_roads_modifier_costs
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_very_small
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { #engineer 3 has great and risky ideas
		name = decree_events.1.c
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = risky_road_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}

				add_modifier = {
					name = risky_road_modifier_costs
					multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
			3 = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = risky_road_modifier_costs
					multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_very_small
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #we dont want to make our roads better
		name = decree_events.1.e
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = no_roads_sad_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

# More traffic increases pollution so people protest
decree_events.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:decree_state

	title = decree_events.2.t
	desc = decree_events.2.d
	flavor = decree_events.2.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_automobile"
	}

	duration = 3

	cooldown = {days = very_long_modifier_time}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			has_decree = decree_road_maintenance
			state_region = {
				pollution_amount > 50
			}
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			law_stance = {
				law = law_type:law_no_health_system
				value < neutral
			}
		}
		NOR = {
			has_modifier = addressed_pollution_modifier
			has_modifier = ignored_pollution_modifier
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				has_decree = decree_road_maintenance
				state_region = {
					pollution_amount > 50
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = decree_state
			set_variable = {
				name = pollution_amount
				value = state_region.pollution_amount
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = pollution_amount
				multiply = -0.50
			}
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_no_health_system
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = ecology_ig
		}
	}

	option = { #ignore it
		name = decree_events.2.b
		scope:decree_state.state_region = {
			add_pollution = 10
		}
		scope:ecology_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = ignored_pollution_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #take measures
		name = decree_events.2.a
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			scope:decree_state.state_region = {
				pollution_amount >= 50
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = addressed_pollution_modifier
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_very_small
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		scope:decree_state.state_region = {
			add_pollution = scope:decree_state.var:pollution_amount
		}
	}
}

# David Copperfield (a lowborn man becomes important IG leader)
decree_events.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:decree_state

	title = decree_events.3.t
	desc = decree_events.3.d
	flavor = decree_events.3.f

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_london_center"
	}

	duration = 3

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			has_decree = decree_promote_social_mobility
		}
		empty_agitator_slots >= 1
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				has_decree = decree_promote_social_mobility
			}
			save_scope_as = decree_state
		}
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			save_scope_as = ig_intelligentsia
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = c:GBR
				c:GBR = ROOT
			}
			create_character = {
				template = GBR_david_copperfield
				on_created = {
					add_modifier = {
						name = david_copperfield_modifier
						days = normal_modifier_time
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = david_copperfield_scope
			}
		}
		else = {
			create_character = {
				female = no
				interest_group = ig_intelligentsia
				role = character_role_politician
				on_created = {
					add_modifier = {
						name = david_copperfield_modifier
						days = normal_modifier_time
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = david_copperfield_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #support him to IG leader
		name = decree_events.3.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:david_copperfield_scope ?= {
			set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
		}
	}

	option = { #ignore him
		name = decree_events.3.b
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = ignored_david_copperfield_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:david_copperfield_scope ?= {
			replace_character_roles = { add = { agitator } remove_all = yes }
		}
	}
}

# Lowborn admiral
decree_events.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:decree_state

	title = decree_events.4.t
	desc = decree_events.4.d
	flavor = decree_events.4.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_naval_battle"
	}

	duration = 3

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			has_decree = decree_promote_social_mobility
			any_scope_building = {
				OR = {
					is_building_type = building_whaling_station
					is_building_type = building_fishing_wharf
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = social_mobility_var }
		any_scope_character = {
			is_ruler_of_own_country = no
			character_is_valid_for_events = yes
			age >= 35
			OR = {
				has_role_of_type = general
				has_role_of_type = admiral
				interest_group ?= {
					OR = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
						is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
						is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
						is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
					}
				}
			}
		}
		naval_power_projection > 0 # You must have at least a single boat for the admiral to crew
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				has_decree = decree_promote_social_mobility
			}
			save_scope_as = decree_state
			random_scope_building = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_building_type = building_whaling_station
						is_building_type = building_fishing_wharf
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = decree_building
			}
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				age >= 35
				OR = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					has_role_of_type = admiral
					interest_group ?= {
						OR = {
							is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
							is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
							is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
							is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
						}
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = noble_character
		}
		set_variable = social_mobility_var
	}


	option = { #they deserve this
		name = decree_events.4.a
		default_option = yes
		create_character = {
			is_admiral = yes
			interest_group = ig_trade_unions
			ig_leader = no
			noble = no
		}
		scope:decree_state = {
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				value = small_radicals
				pop_type = laborers
			}
		}
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = social_mobility_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #but the son of xxx wants it
		name = decree_events.4.b
		create_character = {
			is_admiral = yes
			interest_group = ig_landowners
			ig_leader = no
			noble = yes
		}
		scope:decree_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = small_radicals
				pop_type = laborers
			}
		}
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = social_mobility_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

					}

		}
		NOT = {
			any_scope_state = {
				OR = {
					has_modifier = decree_break_it_up
					has_modifier = decree_let_them_protest
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				NOT = { has_decree = decree_violent_suppression }
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					has_decree = decree_violent_suppression
				}
				any_scope_pop = {
					pop_has_primary_culture = no
					PREV = {
						state_average_culture_pop_acceptance = { culture = prev.culture value < acceptance_status_5 }
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = decree_increased_violence
			random_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					pop_has_primary_culture = no
					PREV = {
						state_average_culture_pop_acceptance = { culture = prev.culture value < acceptance_status_5 }
					}
				}
				culture = { save_scope_as = violent_suppression_discriminated }
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #more radicals but armed forces approval
		name = decree_events.109.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:decree_increased_violence = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = decree_break_it_up
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = decree_protests_dispersed
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { #migration pull in state and less radicals
		name = decree_events.109.b
		scope:decree_increased_violence = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = decree_let_them_protest
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = decree_protests_handled
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
	}

# Fired when scoped country refuses to have their sovereignty violated
# Any interested parties is given choice to aid them or not
diplomatic_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_courtroom_upheaval"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	title = diplomatic_events.1.t
	desc = diplomatic_events.1.d
	flavor = diplomatic_events.1.f

	duration = 3

	option = {
		name = diplomatic_events.1.a
		default_option = yes

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = violate_sovereignty_tt
			violate_sovereignty_join = {
				violator = scope:initiator
				target = scope:target_country
				join_violator = no
			}
		}

		save_scope_as = third_party_country

		scope:initiator = {
			post_notification = violate_sovereignty_third_party_joins
		}

		scope:target_country = {
			post_notification = violate_sovereignty_third_party_joins
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 0

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					"relations(scope:target_country)" >= relations_threshold:cordial
				}
				add = 10
			}

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					"relations(scope:target_country)" >= relations_threshold:amicable
				}
				add = 10
			}

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					"relations(scope:target_country)" >= relations_threshold:friendly
				}
				add = 10
			}

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					has_diplomatic_pact = {
						type = rivalry
						who = scope:initiator
					}
				}
				add = 50
			}

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:target_country = { is_subject_of = root }
				}
				add = 100
			}

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_scope_treaty = {
						binds = scope:target_country
						any_scope_article = {
							has_type = alliance
						}
					}
				}
				add = 200
			}

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_scope_treaty = {
						binds = scope:target_country
						any_scope_article = {
							has_type = defensive_pact
						}
					}
				}
				add = 200
			}

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					is_in_customs_union_with = scope:target_country
				}
				add = 100
			}
		}
	}

    option = {
		name = diplomatic_events.1.b
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:target_country
			value = -30
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 100

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					"relations(scope:initiator)" >= relations_threshold:cordial
				}
				add = 10
			}

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					"relations(scope:initiator)" >= relations_threshold:amicable
				}
				add = 10
			}

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					"relations(scope:initiator)" >= relations_threshold:friendly
				}
				add = 10
			}

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					has_diplomatic_pact = {
						type = rivalry
						who = scope:target_country
					}
				}
				add = 100
			}

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:initiator = { is_subject_of = root }
				}
				add = 100
			}

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_scope_treaty = {
						binds = scope:initiator
						any_scope_article = {
							has_type = alliance
						}
					}
				}
				add = 200
			}

							has_type = defensive_pact

					}
				}

﻿namespace = diplomatic_friction

diplomatic_friction.1 = { # Boost the trade unions
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = diplomatic_friction.1.t
	desc = diplomatic_friction.1.d
	flavor = diplomatic_friction.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_agitators_sneaking"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		country_rank >= rank_value:major_power
		any_country = {
			country_rank >= rank_value:major_power
			has_diplomatic_pact = {
				who = root
     			type = rivalry
     		}
     		relations:root <= relations_threshold:cold
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				country_rank >= rank_value:major_power
				has_diplomatic_pact = {
					who = root
	     			type = rivalry
	     		}
	     		relations:root <= relations_threshold:cold
			}
			save_scope_as = rival_scope
		}
	}

	option = { #Boost the trade union
		name = diplomatic_friction.1.a
		scope:rival_scope = {
			ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = foreign_trade_union_influence
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
			hidden_effect = { post_notification = rival_supports_trade_unions }
		}
	}

	option = { #Opt out
		name = diplomatic_friction.1.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:rival_scope = {
			ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = foreign_trade_union_influence_denied
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

		}
		save_scope_as = first_rival_country
		random_neighbouring_state = {
			limit = {
				owner = scope:rival_scope
			}
			save_scope_as = rival_state
		}
	}

	option = { #
		name = diplomatic_friction.2.a
		custom_tooltip = diplomatic_friction.2.a.tt
		set_variable = first_rival_country_var
		scope:rival_scope = {
			hidden_effect = {
				trigger_event = { id = diplomatic_friction.3 days = 10 }
			}
			show_as_tooltip = {
				scope:rival_scope = {
					add_modifier = {
						name = border_sovereignity_questioned
						days = normal_modifier_time
					}
				}
				ROOT = {
					create_incident = {
						country = scope:rival_scope
						value = 10
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #Opt out
		name = diplomatic_friction.2.b
		default_option = yes
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = border_cowardice
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_legacy_slavery

﻿namespace = discrimination_events

# Breaking Out of Segregation
discrimination_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = discrimination_events.1.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = discrimination_events.1.d.culture
				trigger = {
					exists = scope:discriminated_culture_pop
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = discrimination_events.1.d.religion
				trigger = {
					exists = scope:discriminated_religion_pop
				}
			}
		}
	}

	flavor = discrimination_events.1.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_rich_and_poor"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			any_scope_pop = {
				pop_has_primary_culture = no
				pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4
				wealth > 20
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				any_scope_pop = {
					pop_has_primary_culture = no
					pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4
					wealth > 20
				}
			}
			random_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					pop_has_primary_culture = no
					pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4
					wealth > 20
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						state = {
							state_average_culture_pop_acceptance = {
								culture = PREV.culture
							    value < acceptance_status_4
						   	}
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = discriminated_culture_pop
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						state = {
							state_average_religion_pop_acceptance = {
								religion = PREV.religion
							    value < religious_acceptance_medium
						   	}
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = discriminated_religion_pop
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOR = {
			exists = scope:discriminated_culture_pop
			exists = scope:discriminated_religion_pop
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = discrimination_events.1.a
		add_modifier = {
			name = enforced_segregation
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:discriminated_culture_pop
			}
			add_radicals = {
				value = small_radicals
				culture = scope:discriminated_culture_pop.culture
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:discriminated_religion_pop
			}
			add_radicals = {
				value = small_radicals
				religion = scope:discriminated_religion_pop.religion
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = discrimination_events.1.b
		default_option = yes

		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:discriminated_culture_pop }
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = segregation_eroding
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:discriminated_religion_pop }
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_state_religion
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = segregation_eroding
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:discriminated_culture_pop
			}
			add_loyalists = {
				value = small_radicals
				culture = scope:discriminated_culture_pop.culture
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:discriminated_religion_pop
			}
			add_loyalists = {
				value = small_radicals
				religion = scope:discriminated_religion_pop.religion
			}
		}
	}
}

# Stab-in-the-back Myth
discrimination_events.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = discrimination_events.2.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = discrimination_events.2.d.culture
				trigger = {
					exists = scope:discriminated_culture_pop
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = discrimination_events.2.d.religion
				trigger = {
					exists = scope:discriminated_religion_pop
				}
			}
		}
	}

	flavor = discrimination_events.2.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_political_extremism"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	trigger = {
		has_variable = recent_capitulation
		any_scope_pop = {
			pop_has_primary_culture = no
			pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_pop = {
			limit = {
				pop_has_primary_culture = no
				pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					state = {
						state_average_culture_pop_acceptance = {
							culture = PREV.culture
							value < acceptance_status_4
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = discriminated_culture_pop
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					state = {
						state_average_religion_pop_acceptance = {
							religion = PREV.religion
							value < religious_acceptance_medium
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = discriminated_religion_pop
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOR = {
			exists = scope:discriminated_culture_pop
			exists = scope:discriminated_religion_pop
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = discrimination_events.2.a
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:discriminated_culture_pop }
			add_radicals = {
				value = large_radicals
				culture = scope:discriminated_culture_pop.culture
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:discriminated_religion_pop }
			add_radicals = {
				value = large_radicals
				religion = scope:discriminated_religion_pop.religion
			}
		}

		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = stab_in_the_back_myth
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = py:fascist_party
				in_election_campaign = yes
			}
			py:fascist_party = { add_momentum = momentum_large }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = discrimination_events.2.b
		default_option = yes

		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = narrative_rejected
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = py:fascist_party
				in_election_campaign = yes
			}
			py:fascist_party = { add_momentum = momentum_medium_decrease }
		}
	}
}

# Discrimination in Industries
discrimination_events.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:discrimination_state

	title = discrimination_events.4.t
	desc = discrimination_events.4.d
	flavor = discrimination_events.4.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_rich_and_poor"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			any_scope_culture = {
				NOT = { is_primary_culture_of = ROOT }
				prev = {
					state_average_culture_pop_acceptance = {
						culture = prev
						value < acceptance_status_4
					}
				}
				save_temporary_scope_as = discrim_culture
			}
			culture_percent_state = {
			    target = scope:discrim_culture
			    value >= 0.1
			}
			any_scope_building = {
				is_building_group = bg_manufacturing
				occupancy >= 0.25
			}
			any_scope_pop = {
				culture = {
					this = scope:discrim_culture
				}
				pop_employment_building_group = bg_manufacturing
			}
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			law_stance = {
				law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
				value > neutral
			}
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		ROOT = {
			save_scope_as = home_country
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_culture = {
					NOT = { is_primary_culture_of = ROOT }
					PREV = {
						state_average_culture_pop_acceptance = {
							culture = PREV
							value < acceptance_status_4
						}
					}
					save_temporary_scope_as = discrim_culture
				}
				culture_percent_state = {
				    target = scope:discrim_culture
				    value >= 0.1
				}
				any_scope_building = {
					is_building_group = bg_manufacturing
					occupancy >= 0.25
				}
				any_scope_pop = {
					culture = {
						this = scope:discrim_culture
					}
					pop_employment_building_group = bg_manufacturing
				}
			}
			order_by = state_population
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = discrimination_state
			random_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					pop_has_primary_culture = no
					PREV = {
						state_average_culture_pop_acceptance = {
							culture = PREV.culture
							value < acceptance_status_4
						}
					}
					pop_employment_building_group = bg_manufacturing
				}
				culture = { save_scope_as = discriminated_culture_pop }
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOR = {
			exists = scope:discriminated_culture_pop
			exists = scope:discrimination_state
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = discrimination_events.4.a
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
						value > neutral
					}
					is_in_government = yes
				}
			}
			ordered_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
						value > neutral
					}
					is_in_government = yes
				}
				order_by = ig_clout
				position = 0
				check_range_bounds = no
				add_modifier = {
					name = segregation_eroding
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			ordered_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
						value > neutral
					}
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				}
				order_by = ig_clout
				position = 0
				check_range_bounds = no
				add_modifier = {
					name = segregation_eroding
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_industrial_barriers_nat_supremacy
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = discrimination_events.4.b
		default_option = yes

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = industrial_barriers_b_tt
			every_scope_state = {
				add_culture_standard_of_living_modifier = {
					culture = scope:discriminated_culture_pop
					days = normal_modifier_time
					multiplier = -2
				}
			}
		}
		scope:discrimination_state ?= {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
				culture = scope:discriminated_culture_pop
			}
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = small_radicals
			culture = scope:discriminated_culture_pop
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_industrial_barriers_against_nat_supremacy
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}
}
﻿namespace = distribution_of_power_laws

# Autocracy/Oligarchy: Advancement
distribution_of_power_laws.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = distribution_of_power_laws.1.t
	desc = distribution_of_power_laws.1.d
	flavor = distribution_of_power_laws.1.f

	category = enactment

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_politician_parliament_motion"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_autocracy
			AND = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
				NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_autocracy }
			}
		}
		ruler.popularity >= 25
		NOT = { has_modifier = seizing_power }
		NOT = { has_modifier = building_support }
		NOT = {
			currently_enacting_law = {
					has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_cult_of_personality
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		ruler = {
			interest_group ?= {
				save_scope_as = ruler_ig
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = {
		name = distribution_of_power_laws.1.a
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = seizing_power
		}
		currently_enacting_law = {
			add_amendment = {
				type = amendment_cult_of_personality
				sponsor = scope:ruler_ig
				cooldown = 120
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = distribution_of_power_laws.1.b
		default_option = yes
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = building_support
		}
		ruler = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = popular_authoritarian
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

			}
		}
		any_scope_pop = {
			is_pop_type = bureaucrats
		}
		NOT = { has_modifier = promised_bureaucratic_purge }
		NOT = { has_modifier = promised_bureaucratic_stability }
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = {
		name = distribution_of_power_laws.2.a
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = promised_bureaucratic_purge
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = medium_radicals
			pop_type = bureaucrats
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = distribution_of_power_laws.2.b
		default_option = yes
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = promised_bureaucratic_stability
		}
	}
}

# Autocracy/Oligarchy: Stall
distribution_of_power_laws.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = distribution_of_power_laws.3.t
	desc = distribution_of_power_laws.3.d
	flavor = distribution_of_power_laws.3.f

	category = enactment

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_politician_parliament_motion"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_autocracy
			AND = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
				NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_autocracy }
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_modifier = crushed_pro_democracy_protests }
		NOT = { has_modifier = pro_democracy_protests }
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = {
		name = distribution_of_power_laws.3.a
		trigger = {
			enactment_setback_count < max_setbacks_minus_one
		}
		add_enactment_setback = 1
		highlighted_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_law = law_type:law_landed_voting }
			add_radicals = {
				value = medium_radicals
				pop_type = aristocrats
			}
			add_radicals = {
				value = medium_radicals
				pop_type = officers
			}
			add_radicals = {
				value = medium_radicals
				pop_type = clergymen
			}
			add_radicals = {
				value = medium_radicals
				pop_type = capitalists
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_law = law_type:law_wealth_voting }
			add_radicals = {
				value = medium_radicals
				strata = upper
			}
			add_radicals = {
				value = small_radicals
				strata = middle
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_law = law_type:law_census_voting }
			add_radicals = {
				value = medium_radicals
				strata = upper
			}
			add_radicals = {
				value = medium_radicals
				strata = middle
			}
			add_radicals = {
				value = small_radicals
				strata = lower
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage }
			add_radicals = {
				value = medium_radicals
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_law = law_type:law_anarchy }
			add_radicals = {
				value = large_radicals
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = distribution_of_power_laws.3.b
		default_option = yes
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = pro_democracy_protests
		}
	}
}

distribution_of_power_laws.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = distribution_of_power_laws.4.t
	desc = distribution_of_power_laws.4.d
	flavor = distribution_of_power_laws.4.f

	category = enactment

	duration = 3

	gui_window = event_window_1char_propaganda

	left_icon = scope:supportive_commander

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_autocracy
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_elder_council
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_landed_voting
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_wealth_voting
		}
		OR = {
			has_law = law_type:law_census_voting
			has_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
		}
		any_scope_character = {
			OR = {
				has_role_of_type = general
				has_role_of_type = admiral
			}
			OR = {
				law_stance = { #they approve
					law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
					value > neutral
				}
				interest_group ?= { #their ig approves
					law_stance = {
						law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
						value > neutral
					}
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_modifier = fear_of_popular_uprising }
		NOT = { has_modifier = senior_military_support }
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}
				OR = {
					law_stance = {
						law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
						value > neutral
					}
					interest_group ?= {
						law_stance = {
							law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
							value > neutral
						}
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = supportive_commander
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = {
		name = distribution_of_power_laws.4.a
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = fear_of_popular_uprising
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = distribution_of_power_laws.4.b
		default_option = yes
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = senior_military_support
		}
		add_loyalists = {
			pop_type = officers
			value = 0.3
		}
	}
}

	}

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_autocracy
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_elder_council
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_landed_voting
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_wealth_voting
		}
		OR = {
			has_law = law_type:law_census_voting
			has_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
		}
		NOT = { has_modifier = uneducated_populus }
		NOT = { has_modifier = educated_citizens }
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = illiteracy_voting_mod
			value = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { literacy_rate >= 0.10	}
			change_variable = {
				name = illiteracy_voting_mod
				subtract = 1
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { literacy_rate >= 0.20	}
			change_variable = {
				name = illiteracy_voting_mod
				subtract = 1
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { literacy_rate >= 0.30	}
			change_variable = {
				name = illiteracy_voting_mod
				subtract = 1
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { literacy_rate >= 0.40	}
			change_variable = {
				name = illiteracy_voting_mod
				subtract = 1
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { literacy_rate >= 0.50	}
			change_variable = {
				name = illiteracy_voting_mod
				subtract = 1
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { literacy_rate >= 0.60	}
			change_variable = {
				name = illiteracy_voting_mod
				subtract = 1
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { literacy_rate >= 0.70	}
			change_variable = {
				name = illiteracy_voting_mod
				subtract = 1
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { literacy_rate >= 0.80	}
			change_variable = {
				name = illiteracy_voting_mod
				subtract = 1
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { literacy_rate >= 0.90	}
			change_variable = {
				name = illiteracy_voting_mod
				subtract = 1
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = {
		name = distribution_of_power_laws.5.a
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = caring_for_the_ignorant
			multiplier = var:illiteracy_voting_mod
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = uneducated_populus
			days = normal_modifier_time

distribution_of_power_laws.6 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = distribution_of_power_laws.6.t
	desc = distribution_of_power_laws.6.d
	flavor = distribution_of_power_laws.6.f

	category = enactment

	duration = 3

	gui_window = event_window_1char_propaganda

	left_icon = scope:opposing_politician

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_autocracy
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_elder_council
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_landed_voting
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_wealth_voting
		}
		OR = {
			has_law = law_type:law_census_voting
			has_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
		}
		any_scope_character = {
			has_role_of_type = politician
			is_ruler_of_own_country = no
			character_is_valid_for_events = yes
			interest_group ?= { is_in_government = yes }
			NOR = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
			}
			is_busy = no
			is_immortal = no
		}
		NOT = { has_modifier = internal_disagreements }
		NOT = { has_modifier = obstructing_politician }
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_role_of_type = politician
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				interest_group ?= { is_in_government = yes }
				NOR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
				}
				is_busy = no
				is_immortal = no
			}
			save_scope_as = opposing_politician
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = {
		name = distribution_of_power_laws.6.a
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = internal_disagreements
		}
		custom_tooltip = distribution_of_power_laws.6.a.tt
		scope:opposing_politician.interest_group ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = leadership_crisis
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:opposing_politician = {
				retire_character = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = distribution_of_power_laws.6.b
		default_option = yes
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = obstructing_politician
		}
		scope:opposing_politician.interest_group ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = leadership_crisis
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = -1
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = distribution_of_power_laws.6.c
		trigger = {
			enactment_setback_count < max_setbacks_minus_one
		}
		add_enactment_setback = 1
	}
}

distribution_of_power_laws.8 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = distribution_of_power_laws.8.t
	desc = distribution_of_power_laws.8.d
	flavor = distribution_of_power_laws.8.f

	category = enactment

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_election"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_census_voting
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
		}
		NOR = {
			has_law = law_type:law_census_voting
			has_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
		}
		any_political_movement = {
			law_stance = {
				law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
				value < neutral
			}
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			law_stance = {
				law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
				value > neutral
			}
			save_temporary_scope_as = universal_suffrage_ig
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			NOT = {
				scope:universal_suffrage_ig ?= this
			}
			law_stance = {
				law = law_type:law_census_voting
				value >  neutral
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_modifier = voting_age_25 }
		NOT = { has_modifier = voting_age_21_compromise }
		NOT = { has_modifier = voting_age_18 }
		NOT = {
			currently_enacting_law = {
				OR = {
					has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_voting_age_18
					has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_voting_age_21
					has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_voting_age_25
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = universal_voting_ig
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				NOT = {
					scope:universal_suffrage_ig ?= this
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_census_voting
					value >  neutral
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = census_voting_ig
		}
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = anti_voting_movement
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = {
		name = distribution_of_power_laws.8.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = voting_age_25
		}
		currently_enacting_law = {
			add_amendment = {
				type = amendment_voting_age_25
				sponsor = scope:census_voting_ig
				cooldown = 120
			}
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = medium_radicals
			pop_type = academics
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = medium_radicals
			pop_type = soldiers
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = distribution_of_power_laws.8.b
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = voting_age_21_compromise
		}
		currently_enacting_law = {
			add_amendment = {
				type = amendment_voting_age_21
				sponsor = scope:universal_voting_ig
				cooldown = 120
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = distribution_of_power_laws.8.c
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:anti_voting_movement ?= {
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.60
					}
				}
				add = -5
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:anti_voting_movement ?= {
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.25
					}
				}
				add = -3
			}
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = voting_age_18
		}
		currently_enacting_law = {
			add_amendment = {
				type = amendment_voting_age_18
				sponsor = scope:universal_voting_ig
				cooldown = 120
			}
		}
		scope:anti_voting_movement = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = too_low_voting_age
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

				pop_type = aristocrats
			}
			add_radicals = {
				value = small_radicals
				pop_type = capitalists
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_law = law_type:law_landed_voting }
			add_radicals = {
				value = small_radicals
				pop_type = aristocrats
			}
			add_radicals = {
				value = small_radicals
				pop_type = officers
			}
			add_radicals = {
				value = small_radicals
				pop_type = clergymen
			}
			add_radicals = {
				value = small_radicals
				pop_type = capitalists
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_law = law_type:law_wealth_voting }
			add_radicals = {
				value = small_radicals
				strata = upper
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = distribution_of_power_laws.9.b
		default_option = yes

		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = collaboration_with_old_leadership
		}

	}
}

		}

distribution_of_power_laws.11 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = distribution_of_power_laws.11.t
	desc = distribution_of_power_laws.11.d
	flavor = distribution_of_power_laws.11.f

	category = enactment

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_election"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = egalitarianism
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_landed_voting
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_wealth_voting
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_census_voting
		}
		OR = {
			has_law = law_type:law_autocracy
			has_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
			has_law = law_type:law_single_party_state
		}
		any_political_movement = {
			law_stance = {
				law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
				value < neutral
			}
			NOT = { has_modifier = fear_of_future_reforms }
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			law_stance = {
				law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
				value > neutral
			}
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
		}
		NOT = { has_modifier = current_election_focus }
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		law_type:law_universal_suffrage = {
			save_scope_as = universal_suffrage_type
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = {
		name = distribution_of_power_laws.11.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = current_election_focus
		}

		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = democratic_compromise
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = distribution_of_power_laws.11.b
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_political_movement = {
						law_stance = {
							law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
							value < neutral
						}
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.60
					}
				}
				add = -5
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_political_movement = {
						law_stance = {
							law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
							value < neutral
						}
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.25
					}
				}
				add = -3
			}
		}
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = fear_of_future_reforms
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

	}

		}
	}

	option = {
		name = dominican_events.5.a

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					c:SPA ?= this
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = samana_lease_tt
			}
			# Samana Treaty Port
			create_treaty = {
				name = treaty_name_treaty_of_samana
				first_country = root
				second_country = c:DOM

				is_draft = no
				binding_period = { years = 100 }

				articles_to_create = {
					{
						article = treaty_port
						source_country = c:DOM
						target_country = root
						inputs = {
							{ state = s:STATE_SANTO_DOMINGO.region_state:DOM }
						}

					{
						article = money_transfer
						source_country = root
						target_country = c:DOM
						inputs = {
							{ quantity = 2000 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			create_diplomatic_pact = {
				country = c:DOM
				type = protectorate
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				c:SPA ?= this
			}
			create_diplomatic_pact = {
				country = c:DOM
				type = puppet
			}
			c:DOM ?= {
				activate_law = law_type:law_colonial_administration
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_cibao_unrest
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:USA ?= {
					country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
					NOT = {
						root ?= this
					}
				}
			}
			c:USA ?= {
				change_relations = {
					country = root
					value = -30
				}
				create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
					type = catalyst_event_negative
					target = root
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = dominican_events.5.b
		c:DOM ?= {
			change_relations = {
				country = root
				value = -30
			}
			create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
				type = catalyst_event_negative
				target = root
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:USA ?= {
					country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
					NOT = {
						root ?= this
					}
				}
			}
			c:USA ?= {
				change_relations = {
					country = root
					value = 10
				}
			}
		}
	}

	after = {
		hidden_effect = { # Samana Americans live in Samana
			if = {
				limit = {
					s:STATE_SANTO_DOMINGO = {
						any_scope_state = {
							owner = {
								c:DOM ?= this
							}
						}
						any_scope_state = {
							is_treaty_port = yes
						}
					}
				}
				s:STATE_SANTO_DOMINGO = {
					random_scope_state = {
						limit = {
							is_treaty_port = yes
						}
						save_temporary_scope_as = samana_scope
					}
					random_scope_state = {
						limit = {
							owner = {
								c:DOM ?= this
							}
						}
						every_scope_pop = {
							limit = {
								culture = cu:afro_american
							}
							move_partial_pop = {
							 	state = scope:samana_scope
							 	population_ratio = 0.9
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

 dreadnought_hoax.1 = {
 	type = country_event
 	placement = ROOT

 	title = dreadnought_hoax.1.t
 	desc = dreadnought_hoax.1.d
 	flavor = dreadnought_hoax.1.f

 	event_image = {
 		video = "unspecific_naval_battle"
 	}

 	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

 	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

 	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		is_player = yes
		has_technology_researched = battleship_tech
		NOT = { has_variable = battleship_hoax_var }
		any_scope_building = {
			is_building_type = building_naval_administration
			level >= 3
			state = {
				is_incorporated = yes
			}
		}
		country_ship_type_fraction = {
			target = ship_type:ship_type_pre_dreadnought
			value >= 0.1
		}
 		any_scope_pop = {
 			is_pop_type = academics
 		}
 		any_country = {
 			is_country_alive = yes
 			has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
 			NOT = {
 				any_primary_culture = {
 					shares_heritage_trait_group_with_any_primary_culture = ROOT
 				}
 			}
 		}
 		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
 			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
 		}
 		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
 			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
 		}
 	}

 	immediate = {
 		set_variable = battleship_hoax_var
 		random_scope_building = {
 			limit = {
 				is_building_type = building_naval_administration
                level >= 3
                state = {
                    is_incorporated = yes
                }
 			}
 			save_scope_as = hoax_building
 			state = {
 				save_scope_as = hoax_state
 			}
 		}
 		random_country = {
 			limit = {
 				is_country_alive = yes
 				has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
 				NOT = {
 					any_primary_culture = {
 						shares_heritage_trait_group_with_any_primary_culture = ROOT
 					}
 				}
 			}
 			save_scope_as = hoax_country
 		}
 		random_country = {
 			limit = {
 				is_country_alive = yes
 				has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
 				NOT = {
 					any_primary_culture = {
 						shares_heritage_trait_group_with_any_primary_culture = ROOT
 					}
 				}
 				NOT = { THIS = scope:hoax_country }
 			}
 			save_scope_as = haox_country_2
 		}
 		random_scope_pop = {
 			limit = {
 				is_pop_type = academics
 			}
 			save_scope_as = hoax_pop
 		}
 		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
 			save_scope_as = navy_ig
 		}
 	}

 	option = {
 		name = dreadnought_hoax.1.a
 		default_option = yes
 		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
 			add_modifier = {
 				name = battleship_hoax
 				days = normal_modifier_time
 			}
 		}
 		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
 			add_modifier = {
 				name = battleship_hoax
 				days = normal_modifier_time
 				multiplier = -1
 			}
 		}
 	}

 	option = {
 		name = dreadnought_hoax.1.b
 		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
 			add_modifier = {
 				name = battleship_hoax
 				days = normal_modifier_time
 			}
 		}
 		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
 			add_modifier = {
 				name = battleship_hoax
 				days = normal_modifier_time
 				multiplier = -1
 			}
 		}
 	}
 }

	flavor = dreyfus.1.f

		video = "votp_hostile_court"
	}

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = voice_of_the_people_content
		c:FRA ?= ROOT
		has_technology_researched = political_agitation
		OR = {
			OR = {
				has_variable = recently_lost_war
				AND = {
					has_variable = recently_had_war
					NOT = {
						has_variable = recently_won_war
					}
				}
			}
			any_state_in_france = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						state_region = s:STATE_SAVOY
						AND = {
							state_region = s:STATE_PROVENCE
							state_region = {
								any_scope_state = {
									owner = root
								}
							}
							is_split_state = yes
						}
					}
					owner = root
				}
			}
		}
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
		}
		NOT = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_multicultural
		}
		NOT = {
			has_variable = dreyfus_convicted
		}
		any_scope_state = {
        	state_region = {
        		is_homeland = cu:french
        	}
        	any_scope_pop = {
        		religion = rel:jewish
        	}
		}

				who = root

			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {

				set_variable = alfred_dreyfus_var
			}
		}

				has_diplomatic_pact = {
					who = root
					type = rivalry
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = dreyfus_rival_country_scope
			set_variable = dreyfus_rival_country_var
		}
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			save_scope_as = dreyfus_armed_forces_scope
		}
		set_variable = dreyfus_convicted
	}

	option = {
		name = dreyfus.1.a
		highlighted_option = yes

			any_scope_state = {
				state_region = s:STATE_GUAYANA
			}
		}

			text = dreyfus.1.tt_1
		}
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = army_honor_defended
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = 2
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = dreyfus_autonomous_army
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = anti_semitic_demonstrations
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			trigger_event = { id = dreyfus.2 years = 2 popup = yes }
		}
		random_list = {
			50 = {
				scope:alfred_dreyfus_scope = {
					add_trait = psychological_affliction
				}
			}
			50 = {
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = dreyfus.1.b
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = dreyfus.1.tt_2
		}
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = army_honor_defended
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = dreyfus_autonomous_army
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = anti_semitic_demonstrations
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			trigger_event = { id = dreyfus.2 years = 2 popup = yes }
		}
	}
	option = {

		highlighted_option = yes

			}

		}
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {

				name = dreyfus_subject_of_inquiry

			}

		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = dreyfus.3.tt_2
				has_variable = dreyfus_early_investigation
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_dreyfus_affair
		}

# At-home Asphyxiation
dreyfus.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = dreyfus.4.t
	desc = dreyfus.4.d
	flavor = dreyfus.4.f

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_agitators_sneaking"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			any_scope_character = {
				has_variable = emile_zola_var
				is_busy = no
			}
			any_interest_group = {
				ig_is_dreyfusard = yes
				leader = {
					is_busy = no
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = zola_asphyxiation }
		var:rennes_retrial_var >= 35
	}

	immediate = {
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			save_scope_as = dreyfus_armed_forces_scope
		}
		random_character_in_void = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = alfred_dreyfus_var
			}
			save_scope_as = alfred_dreyfus_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_variable = emile_zola_var
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = emile_zola_var
					is_busy = no
				}
				save_scope_as = emile_zola_scope
				interest_group ?= {
					save_scope_as = zola_asphyxiation_ig_pro
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					ig_is_dreyfusard = yes
					leader = {
						is_busy = no
					}
				}
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = zola_asphyxiation_leader
				}
				save_scope_as = zola_asphyxiation_ig_pro
			}
		}
		set_variable = zola_asphyxiation
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					ig_is_anti_dreyfusard = yes
					NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces }
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					ig_is_anti_dreyfusard = yes
					NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces }
				}
				save_scope_as = zola_asphyxiation_ig_anti
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = dreyfus.4.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:zola_asphyxiation_leader = {
			kill_character = yes
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = dreyfus_case_strength_decrease_by_1
			change_variable = {
				name = dreyfus_case_var
				add = -1
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = dreyfus.4.b
		scope:zola_asphyxiation_leader = {
			kill_character = yes
		}
		scope:zola_asphyxiation_ig_pro = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = zola_state_funeral_positive
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:dreyfus_armed_forces_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = zola_state_funeral_negative
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:zola_asphyxiation_ig_anti
			}
			scope:zola_asphyxiation_ig_anti = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = zola_state_funeral_negative
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = zola_state_funeral_expenses
			days = short_modifier_time
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = dreyfus.4.c
		scope:zola_asphyxiation_leader = {
			kill_character = yes
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = dreyfus_case_strength_increase_by_1
			change_variable = {
				name = dreyfus_case_var
				add = 1
			}
		}
	}
}

			}
