# Accession of Komei
japan_monarchy.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					has_law = law_type:law_bakufu
				}
				desc = japan_monarchy.1.t1
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_bakufu
					}
				}
				desc = japan_monarchy.1.t2
			}
		}
	}
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					has_law = law_type:law_bakufu
				}
				desc = japan_monarchy.1.d1
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_bakufu
					}
				}
				desc = japan_monarchy.1.d2
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = japan_monarchy.1.f


	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:emperor_scope

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	dlc = dlc018

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/faction_icons/faction_japan_imperial_house.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ep2_content
		# Triggered by on_new_ruler
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { exists = scope:emperor_scope }
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_bakufu
			}
			create_character = {
				template = JAP_komei_yamato
				on_created = {
					ROOT = {
						set_variable = { name = emperor_var value = PREV }
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = emperor_scope
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_scope_character = { 
				limit = {
					has_template = JAP_komei_yamato
				}
				c:JAP ?= {
					set_variable = { name = emperor_var value = PREV }
				}
				save_scope_as = emperor_scope
			}
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					owner.ruler ?= this
					has_variable = house_yamato
				}
				interest_group ?= {
					OR = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
						is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
						is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = name_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = japan_monarchy.1.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = one_emperor_one_era
			}
			scope:emperor_scope ?= {
				set_first_name = TenkyU_
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:emperor_scope ?= {
				set_first_name = Komei
			}
		}
		show_as_tooltip = {
			scope:emperor_scope ?= {
				add_trait = special_character_japanese_emperor
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_bakufu
				}
			}
			show_as_tooltip = {
				scope:emperor_scope ?= {
					set_character_as_ruler = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

iwakura_mission.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = iwakura_mission.1.t
	desc = iwakura_mission.1.d
	flavor = iwakura_mission.1.f

    event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_steam_ship"
	}

	dlc = dlc018

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by decision
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	immediate = {
		ordered_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					has_role_of_type = ruler
					has_role_of_type = heir
					has_role_of_type = agitator
					has_variable = house_yamato # Please stop trying to send the Emperor to Sweden
				}
				interest_group ?= {
					is_in_government = yes
				}
			}
			position = 0
			order_by = prominence
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader_1
		}
		ordered_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					has_role_of_type = ruler
					has_role_of_type = heir
					has_role_of_type = agitator
					has_variable = house_yamato
				}
				interest_group ?= {
					is_in_government = yes
				}
				NOT = {
					scope:expedition_leader_1 ?= this
				}
			}
			position = 0
			order_by = prominence
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader_2
		}
		ordered_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					has_role_of_type = ruler
					has_role_of_type = heir
					has_role_of_type = agitator
					has_variable = house_yamato
				}
				interest_group ?= {
					is_in_government = yes
				}
				NOR = {
					scope:expedition_leader_1 ?= this
					scope:expedition_leader_2 ?= this
				}
			}
			position = 0
			order_by = prominence
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader_3
		}
		ordered_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					has_role_of_type = ruler
					has_role_of_type = heir
					has_role_of_type = agitator
					has_variable = house_yamato
				}
				interest_group ?= {
					is_in_government = yes
				}
				NOR = {
					scope:expedition_leader_1 ?= this
					scope:expedition_leader_2 ?= this
					scope:expedition_leader_3 ?= this
					has_variable = house_yamato
				}
			}
			position = 0
			order_by = prominence
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader_4
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = iwakura_mission.1.a
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:expedition_leader_1
		}
		scope:expedition_leader_1 = {
			set_character_busy_and_immortal = yes
			set_variable = expedition_leader_var
			ROOT = {
				set_variable = { name = expedition_leader_storage_var value = prev }
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = add_western_mission_je_1_tt
			add_journal_entry = { type = je_iwakura_mission }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = iwakura_mission.1.b
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:expedition_leader_2
		}
		scope:expedition_leader_2 = {
			set_character_busy_and_immortal = yes
			set_variable = expedition_leader_var
			ROOT = {
				set_variable = { name = expedition_leader_storage_var value = prev }
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = add_western_mission_je_2_tt
			add_journal_entry = { type = je_iwakura_mission }
		}
	}

	option = {

# Complete
iwakura_mission.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = iwakura_mission.2.t
	desc = iwakura_mission.2.d
	flavor = iwakura_mission.2.f

    event_image = {
		video = "ep2_intellectual_writer"
	}

	dlc = dlc018

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by JE completion
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	immediate = {
		ordered_in_list = {
			variable = iwakura_mission_law_learnings
			limit = {
				save_temporary_scope_as = iwakura_mission_law_proposal
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						ROOT = {
							var:iwakura_world_political_progressiveness >= 35 # If world progressiveness is above 35, and thus option 35 may be available, this can't be a land reform law
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						law_type:law_commercialized_agriculture ?= this.type
						law_type:law_peasant_proprietorship ?= this.type
						law_type:law_homesteading ?= this.type
					}
				}
				ROOT = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_in_government = yes
						law_enactment_stance = {
							law = scope:iwakura_mission_law_proposal.type
							value > neutral
						}
					}
				}
			}
			order_by = type.progressiveness
			position = 0
			save_scope_as = iwakura_desired_law
			owner ?= {
				save_scope_as = iwakura_desired_law_country
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:iwakura_world_political_progressiveness >= 35
			}
			ordered_in_list = {
				variable = iwakura_mission_law_learnings
				limit = {
					save_temporary_scope_as = iwakura_mission_law_proposal
					OR = {
						law_type:law_commercialized_agriculture ?= this.type
						law_type:law_peasant_proprietorship ?= this.type
						law_type:law_homesteading ?= this.type
					}
					NOT = {
						scope:iwakura_desired_law.type ?= this.type
					}
				}
				order_by = type.progressiveness
				position = 0
				save_scope_as = iwakura_land_reform_law
				owner ?= {
					save_scope_as = iwakura_land_reform_law_country
				}
			}
		}
		ordered_in_list = {
			variable = iwakura_mission_visited_countries
			limit = {
				country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
			}
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			save_scope_as = iwakura_good_economy_country
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = iwakura_mission.2.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_iwakura_mission_tech_bonus
			days = long_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
			multiplier = {
				value = var:iwakura_mission_tech_learnings
				max = 100
				min = 10
			}
		}
		ordered_in_list = {
			variable = iwakura_mission_visited_countries
			order_by = prestige
			min = 0
			max = 2
			create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
				type = catalyst_event_positive
				target = c:JAP
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = iwakura_mission.2.b
		trigger = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iwakura_mission_good_economy_tt
				exists = scope:iwakura_good_economy_country
			}
		}
		highlighted_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_iwakura_mission_production_tech_bonus
			days = long_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
			multiplier = {
				value = var:iwakura_mission_tech_learnings
				max = 100
				min = 5
			}
		}
		create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
			type = catalyst_event_positive
			target = scope:iwakura_good_economy_country
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = iwakura_mission.2.c
		trigger = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iwakura_mission_misc_laws_tt
				exists = scope:iwakura_desired_law
				exists = scope:iwakura_desired_law_country
			}
		}
		highlighted_option = yes
		activate_law = scope:iwakura_desired_law.type
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_iwakura_mission_society_tech_bonus
			days = long_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
			multiplier = {
				value = var:iwakura_mission_tech_learnings
				max = 100
				min = 5
			}
		}
		create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
			type = catalyst_event_positive
			target = scope:iwakura_desired_law_country
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = iwakura_mission.2.e
		trigger = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iwakura_mission_land_reform_laws_tt
				exists = scope:iwakura_land_reform_law
				exists = scope:iwakura_land_reform_law_country
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = high_world_progressiveness_tt
				var:iwakura_world_political_progressiveness >= 35
			}
		}
		highlighted_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:iwakura_land_reform_law.type ?= law_type:law_homesteading
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_peasant_proprietorship
		}
		else = {
			activate_law = scope:iwakura_land_reform_law.type
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_iwakura_mission_land_justice_bonus
			days = long_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
			multiplier = {
				value = var:iwakura_mission_tech_learnings
				max = 100
				min = 5
			}
		}
		create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
			type = catalyst_event_positive
			target = scope:iwakura_land_reform_law_country
		}
	}

	after = {
		iwakura_mission_cleanup = yes
		set_variable = iwakura_mission_finished
		change_variable = {
			name = meiji_var
			add = 1
		}
	}
}

# Jump Countries - Hidden
iwakura_mission.7 = {
	type = country_event
	hidden = yes

	trigger = {
		NOR = {
			has_variable = recalled_iwakura_mission
			has_variable = complete_iwakura_mission
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = japan_scope
		var:expedition_leader_storage_var ?= {
			save_scope_as = iwakura_scope
		}
		var:current_expedition_location_var ?= {
			set_variable = visited_by_iwakura_mission
			capital = {
				save_temporary_scope_as = state_to_evaluate_against
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						is_incorporated = yes
						owner = {
							is_country_type = recognized
							NOR = {
								this = scope:state_to_evaluate_against.owner
								has_variable = visited_by_iwakura_mission
								is_diplomatic_play_enemy_of = ROOT
							}
						}
					}
				}
				ordered_neighbouring_state = {
					limit = {
						is_incorporated = yes
						owner = {
							is_country_type = recognized
							NOR = {
								this = scope:state_to_evaluate_against.owner
								has_variable = visited_by_iwakura_mission
								is_diplomatic_play_enemy_of = ROOT
							}
						}
					}
					order_by = gdp
					position = 0
					owner = {
						ROOT = {
							set_variable = { name = current_expedition_location_var value = prev }
							add_to_variable_list = { name = iwakura_mission_visited_countries target = prev }
						}
						post_notification = iwakura_mission_visited
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				random_list = {
					50 = {
						trigger = {
							exists = c:SWI
							c:SWI ?= {
								NOR = {
									is_diplomatic_play_enemy_of = ROOT
									has_variable = visited_by_iwakura_mission
								}
							}
						}
						c:SWI ?= {
							ROOT = {
								set_variable = { name = current_expedition_location_var value = prev }
								add_to_variable_list = { name = iwakura_mission_visited_countries target = prev }
							}
							post_notification = iwakura_mission_visited
						}
					}
					50 = {
						trigger = {
							exists = c:SWE
							c:SWE ?= {
								NOR = {
									is_diplomatic_play_enemy_of = ROOT
									has_variable = visited_by_iwakura_mission
								}
							}
						}
						c:SWE ?= {
							ROOT = {
								set_variable = { name = current_expedition_location_var value = prev }
								add_to_variable_list = { name = iwakura_mission_visited_countries target = prev }
							}
							post_notification = iwakura_mission_visited
						}
					}
					50 = {
						ordered_country_in_europe = {
							limit = {
								NOR = {
									is_diplomatic_play_enemy_of = ROOT
									has_variable = visited_by_iwakura_mission
								}
								is_country_type = recognized
							}
							order_by = gdp
							position = 0
							ROOT = {
								set_variable = { name = current_expedition_location_var value = prev }
								add_to_variable_list = { name = iwakura_mission_visited_countries target = prev }
							}
							post_notification = iwakura_mission_visited
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

						has_trait = explorer
					}
				}
				add_trait = explorer
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_trait = masterful_diplomat
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_trait = basic_diplomat
					}
					remove_trait = basic_diplomat
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_trait = experienced_diplomat
					}
					remove_trait = experienced_diplomat
				}
				add_trait = masterful_diplomat
			}
			iwakura_character_change_ideology_with_world_politics = yes
		}
	}

	after = {
		set_variable = complete_iwakura_mission
		custom_tooltip = iwakura_mission_submits_report_tt
	}

﻿namespace = japan_earthquakes


# Ansei Great Earthquakes
# Tōkai/Kansai/Shikoku
# Tsunami
japan_earthquakes.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = s:STATE_TOKAI.region_state:JAP
	title = japan_earthquakes.1.t
	desc = japan_earthquakes.1.d
	flavor = japan_earthquakes.1.f
	
	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_devastation"
	}

	dlc = dlc018

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by japan_earthquake_events effect in on_yearly_pulse_country
		c:JAP ?= this
		has_dlc_feature = ep2_content
		year = 1854
		has_state_in_state_region = STATE_TOKAI
		has_state_in_state_region = STATE_KANSAI
		has_state_in_state_region = STATE_SHIKOKU
		# Check that there are daimyo assigned to all relevant states
		any_scope_character = {
			has_variable = daimyo_var
			var:daimyo_var ?= s:STATE_TOKAI
		}
		any_scope_character = {
			has_variable = daimyo_var
			var:daimyo_var ?= s:STATE_KANSAI
		}
		any_scope_character = {
			has_variable = daimyo_var
			var:daimyo_var ?= s:STATE_SHIKOKU
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		s:STATE_TOKAI ?= {
			start_harvest_condition = tsunami
		}
		s:STATE_KANSAI ?= {
			start_harvest_condition = tsunami
		}
		s:STATE_SHIKOKU ?= {
			start_harvest_condition = tsunami
		}
	}

	# Focus reconstruction efforts in Tōkai
	option = {
		name = japan_earthquakes.1.a
		default_option = yes
		every_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = daimyo_var
				NOT = { var:daimyo_var ?= s:STATE_TOKAI }
				NOT = { var:daimyo_var ?= s:STATE_KANSAI }
				NOT = { var:daimyo_var ?= s:STATE_SHIKOKU }
				var:daimyo_var ?= {
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						OR = {
							state_region = s:STATE_TOKAI
							state_region = s:STATE_KANSAI
							state_region = s:STATE_SHIKOKU
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = earthquake_assisting_daimyo
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
		s:STATE_TOKAI ?= { add_devastation = 10 }
		s:STATE_KANSAI ?= { add_devastation = 10 }
		s:STATE_SHIKOKU ?= { add_devastation = 10 }
	}

	# Focus reconstruction efforts in Kansai
	option = {
		name = japan_earthquakes.1.b
		every_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = daimyo_var
				OR = {
					var:daimyo_var ?= s:STATE_TOKAI
					var:daimyo_var ?= s:STATE_KANSAI
					var:daimyo_var ?= s:STATE_SHIKOKU
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = earthquake_affected_daimyo
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
		s:STATE_TOKAI ?= { add_devastation = 15 }
		s:STATE_KANSAI ?= { add_devastation = 15 }
		s:STATE_SHIKOKU ?= { add_devastation = 15 }
	}
}

	}

	option = {
		name = japan_earthquakes.3.a
		s:STATE_TOKAI ?= { add_devastation = 15 }

				value = 15

				country = root
				value = 15
			}
		}

			name = meteorological_observatories
		}

		}
	}
	option = {

		s:STATE_TOKAI ?= { add_devastation = 10 }

	desc = japan_earthquakes.4.d
	flavor = japan_earthquakes.4.f
	
	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "gfx/event_pictures/unspecific_devastation.bk2"
	}

	dlc = dlc018

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by japan_earthquake_events effect in on_yearly_pulse_country
		c:JAP ?= this
		has_dlc_feature = ep2_content
		year = 1896
		has_state_in_state_region = STATE_TOHOKU
	}

	immediate = {
		s:STATE_TOHOKU ?= {
			start_harvest_condition = tsunami
			set_variable = {
				name = natural_disaster_cooldown
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			region_state:JAP ?= { save_scope_as = japan_earthquake_state }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = japan_earthquakes.4.a
		s:STATE_TOHOKU = { add_devastation = 20 }
		s:STATE_TOHOKU.region_state:JAP = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = tsunami_stones
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = japan_earthquakes.4.b
		trigger = {
			any_scope_state = {
				state_region = {
					has_harvest_condition = tsunami
				}
				count > 1
			}
		}
		s:STATE_TOHOKU = { add_devastation = 20 }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				state_region = {
					has_harvest_condition = tsunami
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = tsunami_stones
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = japan_earthquakes.4.c
		default_option = yes
		s:STATE_TOHOKU = { add_devastation = 10 }
		add_modifier = {
			name = tsunami_relief_efforts
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
	}
}

# Meiji Postal System
japan_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = japan_events.1.t
	desc = japan_events.1.d
	flavor = japan_events.1.f

    event_image = {
		video = "ep2_japanese_cityscape"
	}

	dlc = dlc018

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ep2_content
		c:JAP ?= this
		has_variable = japan_restoration_complete
		NOR = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_closed_borders
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_isolationism
		}
		ig:ig_intelligentsia = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_constitutionalist
		}
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				has_social_hierarchy = edo_system #Overthrown the old feudal order and begun building a central state
			}
			literacy_rate > 0.50 #No need for postal system if the ppl cannot write or read
		}
		root.capital.region = sr:region_northeast_asia
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	immediate = {
		ig:ig_intelligentsia = {
			save_scope_as = intelligentsia_ig
		}
		random_scope_character ?= {
			limit = {
				has_template = JAP_maejima_hisoka
			}
			save_scope_as = JAP_maejima_hisoka
		}
	}

	option = { # Fully fund a national postal service
		name = japan_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		ig:ig_intelligentsia = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = japan_single_fire_events_enlightened_correspondence_mod
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = japan_single_fire_events_meji_stamping_out_chaos_mod
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { # Limit the system to cities only
		name = japan_events.1.b
		ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = japan_single_fire_events_enlightened_correspondence_mod
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				owner = ROOT
				region = sr:region_northeast_asia
			}
			order_by = gdp
			min = 1
			max = 4
			add_modifier = {
				name = japan_single_fire_events_meji_postal_system_mod
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = japan_single_fire_events_meji_urban_only_mod
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}
	option = { # Limit the system to rural areas only
		name = japan_events.1.c
		ig:ig_rural_folk = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = japan_single_fire_events_enlightened_correspondence_mod
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				owner = ROOT
				region = sr:region_northeast_asia
				state_has_building_type_levels = {
					target = bt:building_urban_center
					value < 1
				}
			}
			order_by = state_population
			min = 1
			max = 4
			add_modifier = {
				name = japan_single_fire_events_meji_postal_system_mod
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = japan_single_fire_events_meji_rural_only_mod
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}
	option = { # Entrust the Reform to Maejima Hisoka
		name = japan_events.1.e
		show_as_unavailable = {
			NOT = {
				any_scope_character ?= {
					has_template = JAP_maejima_hisoka
				}
			}
		}
		trigger = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = japan_single_fire_events_missing_maejima_hisoka_tt
				any_scope_character ?= {
					has_template = JAP_maejima_hisoka
				}
			}
		}
		highlighted_option = yes

		ig:ig_landowners = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = japan_single_fire_events_displaced_by_postal_modernization_mod
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
		ig:ig_intelligentsia = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = japan_single_fire_events_enlightened_correspondence_mod
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = japan_single_fire_events_meji_centralized_communications_mod
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}
	option = { # Preserve old courier system
		name = japan_events.1.g
		ig:ig_landowners = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = japan_single_fire_events_traditional_routes_preserved_mod
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

japan_events.2 = {

			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					NOT = { has_technology_researched = electric_telegraph }
				}
				desc = japan_events.2.f
			}
		}
	}

    event_image = {

		NOR = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_closed_borders
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_isolationism

			}
		}
	}
	option = { # Telegraph Implementation

		}
		trigger = { has_technology_researched = electric_telegraph }

		set_variable = {
			name = jap_gregorian_calendar_implemented
			months = 60
		}

		add_modifier = {
			name = japan_calendar_clockwork_administration_mod
			days = short_modifier_time
		}

		add_modifier = {
			name = japan_calendar_western_timekeeping_mod
			days = long_modifier_time
		}

		ig:ig_intelligentsia = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = japan_single_fire_events_enlightened_timekeeping_mod
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}

		ig:ig_rural_folk = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = japan_single_fire_events_tangled_seasons_mod
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # Delay reform and preserve the old system for now

japan_events.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = japan_events.3.t
	desc = japan_events.3.d
	flavor = japan_events.3.f

    event_image = {
		video = "asia_farmers_market"
	}

	dlc = dlc018

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ep2_content
		c:JAP ?= this
		has_variable = japan_restoration_complete
		NOR = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_closed_borders
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_isolationism
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation
		}
		has_variable = jap_gregorian_calendar_implemented
		root.capital.region = sr:region_northeast_asia
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	option = { # No Exceptions
		name = japan_events.3.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_political_movement = {
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.6
					}
				}
				add = -5
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_political_movement = {
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.3
					}
				}
				add = -3
			}
		}

        add_modifier = {
            name = japan_single_fire_events_lost_income_mod
            days = short_modifier_time
        }

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_land_based_taxation
			}
			add_radicals = {
				value = large_radicals
				pop_type = farmers
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_radicals = {
				value = medium_radicals
				pop_type = farmers
			}
		}

		add_radicals = {
			value = medium_radicals
			pop_type = shopkeepers
		}
	}
	option = { # Spread the Pain
		name = japan_events.3.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
        show_as_unavailable = {
			NOR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_proportional_taxation
			}
        }
        trigger = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = japan_single_fire_events_missing_tax_law_tt
				OR = {
               		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation
                	has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_proportional_taxation
				}
            }
        }
		highlighted_option = yes

        add_modifier = {
            name = japan_shortened_year_redistribute_burden_mod
            days = short_modifier_time
        }

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation
			}
			ig:ig_landowners = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = japan_shortened_year_unfair_practices_mod
					days = short_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # Accept Shortfall
		name = japan_events.3.c
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_liberal
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.60
					}
				}
				add = -5
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_liberal
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.30
					}
				}
				add = -3
			}
		}

        add_modifier = {
            name = japan_shortened_year_accept_shortfall_mod
            days = short_modifier_time
        }

		ig:ig_rural_folk = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = japan_shortened_year_fair_tax_burden_mod
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}

		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				is_political_movement_type = movement_liberal
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = japan_single_fire_events_shortfall_discontent_mod
				days = normal_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	}

	}

		default_option = yes

            name = japan_single_fire_events_name_order_westernized_mod
            days = normal_modifier_time
        }

		ig:ig_devout = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = japan_single_fire_events_name_order_resistance_mod
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}

		ig:ig_armed_forces = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = japan_single_fire_events_name_order_resistance_mod
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				ruler ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
				}
			}
			add_radicals = {
				value = medium_radicals
				pop_type = aristocrats
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_radicals = {
				value = small_radicals
				pop_type = aristocrats
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # Maintain traditional order
		name = japan_events.4.b

        add_modifier = {
            name = japan_single_fire_events_name_order_traditional_mod
            days = normal_modifier_time
        }

		if = {
			limit = {
				ruler ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
				}
			}
			add_loyalists = {
				value = medium_radicals
				pop_type = clergymen
			}
			add_loyalists = {
				value = medium_radicals
				pop_type = soldiers
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_loyalists = {
				value = small_radicals
				pop_type = clergymen
			}
			add_loyalists = {
				value = small_radicals
				pop_type = soldiers
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # Adopt in all contexts
		name = japan_events.4.c

		cu:japanese ?= {
			set_name_format = first_last
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owns_entire_state_region = STATE_RYUKYU_ISLANDS
			}
			cu:ryukyuan ?= {
				set_name_format = first_last
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owns_entire_state_region = STATE_SAKHALIN
				owns_entire_state_region = STATE_HOKKAIDO
			}
			cu:ainu ?= {
				set_name_format = first_last
			}
		}

        add_modifier = {
            name = japan_single_fire_events_name_order_westernized_mod
            days = normal_modifier_time
			multiplier = 2
        }

		ig:ig_devout = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = japan_single_fire_events_name_order_resistance_mod
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = 2
			}
		}

		ig:ig_armed_forces = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = japan_single_fire_events_name_order_resistance_mod
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = 2
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_landowners.leader ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
				}
			}
			add_radicals = {
				value = large_radicals
				pop_type = aristocrats
			}
			add_radicals = {
				value = medium_radicals
				pop_type = peasants
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_radicals = {
				value = medium_radicals
				pop_type = aristocrats
			}
			add_radicals = {
				value = small_radicals
				pop_type = peasants
			}
		}
	}
}

# The Language of Administration
japan_events.5 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = japan_events.5.t
	desc = japan_events.5.d
	flavor = japan_events.5.f

    event_image = {
		video = "ep2_important_japanese_men_negotiating"
	}

	dlc = dlc018

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ep2_content
		has_variable = japan_restoration_complete
		NOR = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_closed_borders
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_isolationism
		}
		c:JAP ?= this
		OR = {
			ruler ?= { has_trait = ambitious }
			ruler ?= { has_trait = innovative }
			ruler ?= { has_trait = inspirational_orator }
			ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		NOT = {
			any_primary_culture = {
				has_cultural_obsession = paper
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	option = { # Promote Vernacular Japanese
		name = japan_events.5.a
		default_option = yes

		random_primary_culture = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_cultural_obsession = paper }
			}
			add_cultural_obsession = paper
		}

		add_radicals = {
			value = small_radicals
			pop_type = clergymen
		}

		ig:ig_intelligentsia = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = japan_single_fire_events_language_reform_support_mod
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # Limited administrative reform
		name = japan_events.5.b

		add_modifier = {
			name = japan_language_partial_language_reform_mod
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}

		add_radicals = {
			value = small_radicals
			pop_type = bureaucrats
		}
	}
	option = { # Retain Classical Kanbun
		name = japan_events.5.c

		add_radicals = {
			value = small_radicals
			pop_type = clerks
		}

		ig:ig_devout = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = japan_single_fire_events_language_traditionalist_opposition_mod
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

japan_events.31 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:kabuki_theatre_state

	duration = 3

	title = japan_events.31.t
	desc = japan_events.31.d
	flavor = japan_events.31.f

    event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_fire"
	}

	dlc = dlc018

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ep2_content
		owner.active_law:lawgroup_edo_social_system ?= {
			has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_frugal_ordinance
		}
		NOT = {
			has_variable = theatre_burned_down_var
		}
		s:STATE_KANTO = {
			any_scope_state = {
				owner = root
			}
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			is_in_government = yes
			law_stance = {
				law = law_type:law_strict_edo_system
				value > neutral
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		scope:relevant_leader ?= {
			is_character_alive = no
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		s:STATE_KANTO = {
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					owner = root
				}
				save_scope_as = kabuki_theatre_state
			}
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_in_government = yes
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_strict_edo_system
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = relevant_leader
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = theatre_burned_down_var
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = japan_events.31.a
		default_option = yes
	    scope:relevant_ig ?= {
    		add_modifier = {
    			name = modifier_kabuki_regulated
    			days = normal_modifier_time
    		}
    	}
		scope:kabuki_theatre_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				pop_type = peasants
				value = medium_radicals
			}
		}

	}

	option = {
		name = japan_events.31.b
		set_variable = {
			name = rebuilt_kabuki_theatre_var
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_shogunate_opposition_ig_approval
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		scope:relevant_ig ?= {
    		leader ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_theatre_affronted_official
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
    	}
		scope:kabuki_theatre_state = {
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				pop_type = peasants
				value = medium_radicals
			}
		}
	}
}

japan_events.32 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:ukiyo_e_state

	duration = 3

	title = japan_events.32.t
	desc = japan_events.32.d
	flavor = japan_events.32.f

    event_image = {
		video = "ep2_important_japanese_men_negotiating"
	}

	dlc = dlc018

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ep2_content
		c:JAP ?= this
		NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_isolationism }
		any_scope_state = {
			owner = root
			is_production_method_active = {
				building_type = building_art_academy
				production_method = pm_traditional_art
			}
			any_scope_building = {
				is_building_type = building_art_academy
				level >= 1
				is_under_construction = no
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				owner = root
				is_production_method_active = {
					building_type = building_art_academy
					production_method = pm_traditional_art
				}
				any_scope_building = {
					count >= 1
					is_under_construction = no
					is_building_type = building_art_academy
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = ukiyo_e_state
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_isolationism
	}

	option = {
		name = japan_events.32.a
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = rebuilt_kabuki_theatre_var
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_ukiyo_e_prestige
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = 1.5
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_ukiyo_e_prestige
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = japan_events.32.b
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = rebuilt_kabuki_theatre_var
			}
			scope:ukiyo_e_state = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_ukiyo_e_production
					days = long_modifier_time
					multiplier = 1.5
					is_decaying = yes
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:ukiyo_e_state = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_ukiyo_e_production
					days = long_modifier_time
					is_decaying = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

japan_events.33 = {

	flavor = japan_events.33.f

	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:relevant_character

	dlc = dlc018

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ep2_content
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:japanese
		any_scope_character = {
			is_adult = yes
			OR = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
				has_role = character_role_emperor_of_japan
			}
			OR = {
				has_template = JAP_meiji_yamato
				has_template = JAP_showa_yamato
			}
		}
		any_political_movement = {
			is_political_movement_type = movement_cultural_majority
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
	 			OR = {
					has_template = JAP_meiji_yamato
					has_template = JAP_showa_yamato
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_character
		}
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				is_political_movement_type = movement_cultural_majority
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_political_movement
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_at_war = yes

				culture = cu:japanese
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = 5
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = japan_events.33.b
		scope:relevant_political_movement = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_traditional_sports_movement_support
				days = long_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				cu:japanese ?= {
					culture_national_awakening_occurred = no
				}
			}
			add_fervor_target_modifier = { #changes target
				culture = cu:japanese
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = 10
			}
		}
	}
}

japan_events.35 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:relevant_state

	duration = 3

	title = japan_events.35.t
	desc = japan_events.35.d
	flavor = japan_events.35.f

    event_image = {
		video = "ep2_important_japanese_men_negotiating"
	}

	dlc = dlc018

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_fire.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ep2_content
		c:JAP ?= this
		has_social_hierarchy = edo_system
		OR = {
			has_law = law_type:law_strict_edo_system
			has_law = law_type:law_intermediate_edo_system
		}
		NOT = {
			has_variable = meiji_var
		}
		market_capital.market = {
			mg:grain = { market_goods_pricier > 0.25 }
		}
		s:STATE_KANTO = {
			any_scope_state = {
	 			is_incorporated = yes
		 		radical_fraction = {
					value > 0.40
					strata = lower
				}
				has_building = building_rice_farm
	 		}
		}
		AND = {
			exists = ig:ig_landowners
			ig:ig_landowners ?= { is_in_government = yes }
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		g:grain = { save_scope_as = expensive_good }
		s:STATE_KANTO = {
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
		 			is_incorporated = yes
			 		radical_fraction = {
						value > 0.40
						strata = lower
					}
					has_building = building_rice_farm
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_state
			}
		}
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = relevant_leader
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_ig
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOR = {
			has_social_hierarchy = edo_system
			has_law = law_type:law_strict_edo_system
		}

	}

	option = {
		name = japan_events.35.a
		default_option = yes

			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_strict_edo_system
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_arson_measure_strict_ig
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:relevant_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_arson_measure_strict_pop
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
				strata = middle
			}
		}

	}

	option = {
		name = japan_events.35.b
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_strict_edo_system
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_arson_measure_lenient_ig
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}

korea_colonization.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = korea_colonization.2.t
	desc = korea_colonization.2.d
	flavor = korea_colonization.2.f

    event_image = {
		video = "ep2_japanese_cityscape"
	}

	dlc = dlc018

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_trade.dds"

	cooldown = { days = long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# triggered by je_colonize_korea
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { # checks if c:JAP still owns all five states
			any_scope_state = {
				is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_korea

			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		if = { # if je_colonize_korea is completed with company_mantetsu or company_oriental_development_company
			limit = {
				any_company = {
					AND = {
						OR = {
							is_company_type = company_type:company_mantetsu
							is_company_type = company_type:company_oriental_development_company
						}
						company_prosperity >= 75
					}
				}
			}
			random_company = {
				limit = {
					AND = {
						OR = {
							is_company_type = company_type:company_mantetsu
							is_company_type = company_type:company_oriental_development_company
						}
						company_prosperity >= 75
					}
				}
				executive = {
					save_scope_as = relevant_executive_scope
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_company_scope
			}
		}
		else = {  # if je_colonize_korea is completed with other prosperous companies
			random_company = {
				limit = {
					company_is_prosperous = yes
				}
				executive = {
					save_scope_as = relevant_executive_scope
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_company_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = korea_colonization.2.a # encourage more migration to the state regions
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_peninsula_control_prestige_authority
			days = moderately_long_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
		}
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = s:STATE_SEOUL
					state_region = s:STATE_BUSAN
					state_region = s:STATE_YANGHO
					state_region = s:STATE_SARIWON
					state_region = s:STATE_PYONGYANG
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_peninsula_control_assimilation_migration
				days = moderately_long_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = korea_colonization.2.b # business is crucial
		scope:relevant_executive_scope ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_peninsula_control_loyal_prominence
				days = moderately_long_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_peninsula_control_company_bonus
			days = moderately_long_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
		}
	}
}

korea_colonization.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = korea_colonization.3.t
	desc = korea_colonization.3.d
	flavor = korea_colonization.3.f

    event_image = {
		video = "ep2_important_japanese_men_negotiating"
	}

	dlc = dlc018

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_fire.dds"

	cooldown = { days = long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# triggered by je_colonize_korea
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_in_government = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_ig
			leader = { # this is needed since the character name is in the loc - ensures they don't die mid-event
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_immortal = no # checks if the relevant character isn't already immortal
					}
					set_variable = temp_immortality
					set_character_immortal = yes # makes the relevant character immortal only until the end of this event
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_ig_leader
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = korea_colonization.3.a # we only have ourselves to blame
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_peninsula_control_prestige_loss
			days = moderately_long_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = korea_colonization.3.b # blame on relevant_ig_leader
		scope:relevant_ig_leader ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_peninsula_control_loyal_prominence_loss
				days = moderately_long_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		scope:relevant_ig ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_peninsula_control_approval_pol_str_loss
				days = moderately_long_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
	}

	after = {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:relevant_ig_leader ?= {
						is_immortal = yes
						has_variable = temp_immortality
					}
				}
				scope:relevant_ig_leader ?= {
					set_character_immortal = no # sets relevant_character back to not immortal
					remove_variable = temp_immortality
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

ep2_meiji.1 = { # Sonnō Jōi
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = ep2_meiji.1.t
	desc = ep2_meiji.1.d
	flavor = ep2_meiji.1.f

    event_image = {
		video = "asia_westerners_arriving"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_fire.dds"

	cooldown = { days = long_modifier_time }

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	immediate = {
		ordered_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_in_government = yes
			}
			order_by = ig_clout
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = ruling_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = tairo_scope
				set_character_immortal = yes
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_strategy = ai_strategy_industrial_expansion
			set_strategy = ai_strategy_meiji_restoration
			set_strategy = ai_strategy_maintain_power_balance
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = ep2_meiji.1.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = forced_market_opening
			}
			every_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_shojoi
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = shogun_forced_to_open_market_character
					days = very_long_modifier_time
					is_decaying = yes
				}
			}
			random_political_movement = { 
				limit = { 
					is_political_movement_type = movement_tokugawa_loyalist 
				} 
				add_modifier = {
					name = shogun_forced_to_open_market
					days = long_modifier_time
					is_decaying = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_tokugawa_loyalist
						has_core_ideology = ideology:ideology_tokugawa_loyalist_movement
					}
				}
			}
			owner = {
				random_political_movement = {
					limit = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_tokugawa_loyalist
						has_core_ideology = ideology:ideology_tokugawa_loyalist_movement
					}
					set_core_ideology = ideology_tokugawa_loyalist_movement_2
					add_character_ideology = ideology_modernizer_leader
				}
			}
		}
	}

	after = {
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:tairo_scope ?= {
				set_character_immortal = no
			}
		}
	}
}

ep2_meiji.51 = { # Restoration - Resignation accepted
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = ep2_meiji.51.t
	desc = ep2_meiji.51.d
	flavor = ep2_meiji.51.f

    event_image = {
		video = "ep2_important_japanese_men_negotiating"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	cooldown = { days = long_modifier_time }

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	immediate = {
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = shogun_scope
		}
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				is_political_movement_type = movement_meiji_restorationist
			}
			save_scope_as = restorationist_movement_scope
		}
		ordered_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = daimyo_var
			}
			order_by = loyalty
			position = 0
			set_character_immortal = yes
			save_scope_as = loyal_daimyo_scope
		}
		ordered_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = daimyo_var
			}
			order_by = {
				value = loyalty
				multiply = -1
			}
			position = 0
			set_character_immortal = yes
			save_scope_as = disloyal_daimyo_scope
		}
		activate_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
	}

	option = {
		name = ep2_meiji.51.a
		default_option = yes
		show_as_tooltip = {
			scope:shogun_scope ?= {
				set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
			}
			heir ?= {
				retire_character = yes
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
		}
		je:je_meiji_restoration ?= {
			add_modifier = modifier_meiji_interregnum
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						scope:shogun_scope ?= { # If one is pursuing Unification of Court and Shogunate and somehow get to this point, Traditionalist shoguns will fail automatically
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
						}
						has_variable = kobu_gattai
					}
					government_legitimacy <= 50
				}
			}
			trigger_event = {
				id = ep2_meiji.6
				days = 7
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = { # If one is pursuing Unification of Court and Shogunate and somehow get to this point, non-Traditionalist shoguns will automatically switch to Parliamentary Government
				limit = {
					has_variable = kobu_gattai
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = kobu_gattai_no_longer_viable_tt
					remove_variable = kobu_gattai
					set_variable = kogi_yoron
				}
			}
			trigger_event = {
				id = ep2_meiji.7
				days = 7
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:loyal_daimyo_scope ?= {
				set_character_immortal = no
			}
			scope:disloyal_daimyo_scope ?= {
				set_character_immortal = no
			}
		}
	}
}

ep2_meiji.6 = { # Restoration - Meeting at Kogosho
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = ep2_meiji.6.t
	desc = ep2_meiji.6.d
	flavor = ep2_meiji.6.f

    event_image = {
		video = "ep2_intellectual_writer"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_fire.dds"

	cooldown = { days = long_modifier_time }

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = former_shogun_var # designates Taikun
			}
			save_scope_as = shogun_scope
		}
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				is_political_movement_type = movement_tokugawa_loyalist
			}
			save_scope_as = loyalist_movement_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = ep2_meiji.6.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:shogun_scope ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_role = character_role_politician # Should never evaluate true, but it is best to be safe
					}
				}
				add_character_role = character_role_politician
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_role = character_role_magnate
				}
				remove_character_role = character_role_magnate
			}
		}
		ordered_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
				NOT = {
					scope:shogun_scope ?= this
				}
				NOT = {
					has_variable = house_tokugawa
				}
			}
			order_by = prominence
			position = 0
			set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
		}
		scope:loyalist_movement_scope ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_retreat_to_osaka
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

ep2_meiji.9 = { # Restoration - Kogi Yoron Ending
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = ep2_meiji.9.t
	desc = ep2_meiji.9.d
	flavor = ep2_meiji.9.f

    gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:taikun_scope

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_scales.dds"

	cooldown = { days = long_modifier_time }

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	immediate = {
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = emperor_scope
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = former_shogun_var # designates Taikun
			}
			save_scope_as = taikun_scope
		}
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_meiji_main
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = ep2_meiji.9.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_continuity_and_enlightenment
			days = very_long_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = ep2_meiji.9.b
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_taikun_monarchy
			days = very_long_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
		}
		every_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = house_tokugawa
				NOT = { has_variable = former_shogun_var }
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_taikun_monarchy_character
				days = stupidly_long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	after = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_modernizer
					}
				}
			}
			create_political_movement = { type = movement_modernizer }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = completed_je_meiji_economy }
				in_default = no
				any_scope_state = {
					filter = {
						is_incorporated = yes
					}
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_urban_center
						level >= 5
					}
					has_building = building_railway
					percent > 0.7
				}
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = meiji_var
				add = 1
			}
			set_variable = completed_je_meiji_economy # If the player manages to skip je_meiji_economy we still need to set the variable
		}
		else = {
			add_journal_entry = {
				type = je_meiji_economy
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom }
				ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
					is_powerful = no
					is_in_government = no
				}
				has_technology_researched = napoleonic_warfare
				NOT = {
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_barrack
						OR = {
							has_active_production_method = pm_no_organization
							# has_active_production_method = pm_no_artillery
							# has_active_production_method = pm_cannon_artillery
						}
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = meiji_var
				add = 1
			}
			trigger_event = {
				id = meiji.3
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_journal_entry = {
				type = je_meiji_army
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_dlc_feature = ep2_content }
				NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_traditionalism }
				is_subject = no
				is_country_type = recognized
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = meiji_var
				add = 1
			}
			set_variable = completed_je_meiji_diplomacy # If the player manages to skip je_meiji_diplomacy we still need to set the variable
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_dlc_feature = ep2_content }
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_traditionalism
					is_subject = yes
					is_country_type = unrecognized
				}
			}
			add_journal_entry = {
				type = je_meiji_diplomacy
			}
		}
	}
}

namespace = ep2_meiji_pulse

# Pulse Events

ep2_meiji_pulse.1 = { # Namamugi Incident
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:relevant_treaty_port_state

	duration = 3

	title = ep2_meiji_pulse.1.t
	desc = ep2_meiji_pulse.1.d
	flavor = ep2_meiji_pulse.1.f

    event_image = {
		video = "ep2_important_japanese_men_negotiating"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	cancellation_trigger = {
		has_revolution = yes
	}

	trigger = {
		any_state_in_home_islands = {
			is_treaty_port = yes
			any_neighbouring_state = {
				owner = ROOT
			}
		}
		any_in_global_list = {
			variable = great_power_country_list
			has_strategic_region_interest_tier = {
				strategic_region = ROOT.capital.region
				value >= 1
			}
		}
		any_political_movement = {
			is_political_movement_type = movement_meiji_restorationist
			political_movement_radicalism > define:NPolitics|RADICALISM_AGITATING_THRESHOLD
		}
		any_scope_character = {
			has_variable = daimyo_var
			NOT = {
				var:daimyo_var ?= s:STATE_KYOTO # Hikone Domain is landlocked
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				is_political_movement_type = movement_meiji_restorationist
			}
			save_scope_as = restorationist_movement_scope
		}
		generate_1_common_name = {
			CULTURE_1 = primary_culture
		}
		random_state_in_home_islands = {
			limit = {
				owner = ROOT
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					is_treaty_port = yes
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_treaty_port_state
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = great_power_country_list
			limit = {
				has_strategic_region_interest_tier = {
					strategic_region = ROOT.capital.region
					value >= 1
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_gp
			random_primary_culture = {
				save_scope_as = relevant_gp_culture
			}
		}
		scope:relevant_gp ?= {
			create_character = {
				historical = yes
				culture = primary_culture
				role = character_role_magnate
				interest_group = ig_industrialists
				ideology = ideology_moderate
				holding_type = building_financial_district
				traits = {
					arrogant
					explorer
				}
				on_created = {
					transfer_character = c:JAP
				}
				save_scope_as = richardson_scope
			}
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = daimyo_var
				NOT = {
					var:daimyo_var ?= s:STATE_KYOTO # Hikone Domain is landlocked
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = daimyo_scope
			set_variable = namamugi_daimyo_var
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = ep2_meiji_pulse.1.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:richardson_scope ?= {
			show_as_tooltip = {
				kill_character = yes
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				place_character_in_void = 100
			}
		}
		scope:relevant_gp ?= {
			trigger_event = { id = ep2_meiji_pulse.11 days = 30 }
		}
	}

	after = {
		clear_generated_names = yes
	}
}

			}

		}
		s:STATE_CHUGOKU ?= {
			random_scope_state = {

					owner ?= ROOT
				}

			}

					value >= 1
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_gp
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = ep2_meiji_pulse.3.a
		default_option = yes
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				modifier = {
					add = {
						value = scope:choshu_state.gdp
						divide = 250000
					}
				}
				custom_tooltip = choshu_domain_beats_modern_warship_tt
				scope:choshu_state ?= {
					add_devastation = 5
				}
				scope:choshu_daimyo_scope ?= {
					add_modifier = {
						name = modifier_defeated_westerners
						days = normal_modifier_time
					}
				}
			}
			50 = {
				custom_tooltip = choshu_domain_loses_to_modern_warship_tt
				scope:choshu_state ?= {
					add_devastation = 25
				}
				 # TODO PRCAL-41245 force opening of strait
			}
		}
	}

						}
					}
				}
			}
			scope:relevant_gp ?= {

			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = ep2_meiji_pulse.3.c # TODO PRCAL-41245 force opening of strait
		trigger = {

					}
				}
			}

				first_country = c:JAP
				second_country = scope:relevant_gp

				binding_period = { years = 99 }

						source_country = c:JAP
						target_country = scope:relevant_gp
						inputs = {
							{ state = s:STATE_KANSAI.region_state:JAP }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_variable = order_to_expel_barbarians_var
		any_political_movement = {
			is_political_movement_type = movement_meiji_restorationist
			political_movement_radicalism > define:NPolitics|RADICALISM_AGITATING_THRESHOLD
		}
		any_in_global_list = {
			variable = great_power_country_list
			has_strategic_region_interest_tier = {
				strategic_region = ROOT.capital.region
				value >= 1
			}
		}
		has_state_in_state_region = STATE_KANTO
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		has_revolution = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = great_power_country_list
			limit = {
				has_strategic_region_interest_tier = {
					strategic_region = ROOT.capital.region
					value >= 1
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_gp
		}
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				is_political_movement_type = movement_meiji_restorationist
			}
			save_scope_as = restorationist_movement_scope
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				loyalty < 50
				has_variable = daimyo_var
				NOT = {
					has_variable = house_tokugawa
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = daimyo_scope
			var:daimyo_var ?= {
				random_scope_state = {
					limit = {
						owner ?= c:JAP
					}
					save_scope_as = daimyo_state
				}
			}
		}
		s:STATE_KANTO = {
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					owner = ROOT
				}
				save_scope_as = edo_state
			}
		}
	}

	option = {

		default_option = yes
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:relevant_gp
			value = -15
		}

ep2_meiji_pulse.5 = { # Assassination of Ii Naosuke
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:edo_state

	duration = 3

	title = ep2_meiji_pulse.5.t
	desc = ep2_meiji_pulse.5.d
	flavor = ep2_meiji_pulse.5.f

    gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:tairo_scope

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_political_movement = {
			is_political_movement_type = movement_meiji_restorationist
			political_movement_radicalism >= 0.35
		}
		any_scope_character = {
			loyalty < 50
			has_variable = daimyo_var
			NOT = {
				has_variable = house_tokugawa
			}
			save_temporary_scope_as = temp_daimyo_1
		}
		any_scope_character = {
			NOT = {
				scope:temp_daimyo_1 ?= this
			}
			loyalty < 50
			has_variable = daimyo_var
			NOT = {
				has_variable = house_tokugawa
			}
		}
		has_state_in_state_region = STATE_KANTO
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		has_revolution = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				is_political_movement_type = movement_meiji_restorationist
			}
			save_scope_as = restorationist_movement_scope
		}
		ordered_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_in_government = yes
			}
			order_by = ig_clout
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = ruling_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = tairo_scope
				set_character_immortal = yes
			}
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				loyalty < 50
				has_variable = daimyo_var
				NOT = {
					has_variable = house_tokugawa
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = daimyo_1_scope
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					scope:daimyo_1_scope ?= this
				}
				loyalty < 50
				has_variable = daimyo_var
				NOT = {
					has_variable = house_tokugawa
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = daimyo_2_scope
		}
		s:STATE_KANTO = {
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					owner = ROOT
				}
				save_scope_as = edo_state
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = ep2_meiji_pulse.5.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:tairo_scope ?= {
			kill_character = yes
		}
		scope:edo_state ?= {
			kill_population_in_state = {
				pop_type = soldiers
				value = 60
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_tairo_assassinated
			days = long_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
		}
	}
}

# Don't worry about what happened to event 1. Don't worry about it!

# Picking the Lock
ep2_sakoku.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = ep2_sakoku.2.t
	desc = ep2_sakoku.2.d
	flavor = ep2_sakoku.2.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_farmers_market"
	}

	dlc = dlc018

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_scales.dds"

	trigger = {
		# triggered by je_sakoku_stop_being_closed_button
	}

	immediate = {
		# if any IG is in favor of Free Trade, save them
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_in_government = yes
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_free_trade
					value > neutral
				}
				is_marginal = no
			}
			save_scope_as = free_trade_ig
		}

		# if Protectionism is an option, also save a pro-Protectionist IG.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_technology_researched = stock_exchange
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					is_in_government = yes
					NOT = { scope:free_trade_ig = this }
					law_enactment_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_protectionism
						value > neutral
					}
					is_marginal = no
				}
				save_scope_as = protectionism_ig
			}
		}

		remove_variable = je_sakoku_maybe_we_should_open_up
	}

	option = {
		name = ep2_sakoku.2.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
		activate_law = law_type:law_mercantilism
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_mercantilism
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = overdue_break_with_tradition
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ep2_sakoku.2.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:free_trade_ig
		}
		activate_law = law_type:law_free_trade
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_free_trade
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = overdue_break_with_tradition
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ep2_sakoku.2.c
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:protectionism_ig
		}
		activate_law = law_type:law_protectionism
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_protectionism
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = overdue_break_with_tradition
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	after = {
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_isolationism
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = forced_transition_from_tradition
				days = normal_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				is_political_movement_type = movement_meiji_restorationist
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_ended_sakoku_movement
				days = normal_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# The Morrison Incident
ep2_sakoku.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = ep2_sakoku.3.t
	desc = ep2_sakoku.3.d
	flavor = ep2_sakoku.3.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_westerners_arriving"
	}

	dlc = dlc018

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_country = {
			country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
			capital.state_region = {
				NOT = { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_asia }
			}
			OR = {
				has_interest_marker_in_region = sr:region_northeast_asia
				has_interest_marker_in_region = sr:region_oceania
				has_interest_marker_in_region = sr:region_north_china
				has_interest_marker_in_region = sr:region_south_china
			}
			NOT = {
				has_law = law_type:law_isolationism
			}
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			is_marginal = no
			law_stance = {
				law = law_type:law_isolationism
				value >= approve
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = japan_country
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
				capital.state_region = {
					NOT = { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_asia }
				}
				OR = {
					has_interest_marker_in_region = sr:region_northeast_asia
					has_interest_marker_in_region = sr:region_oceania
					has_interest_marker_in_region = sr:region_north_china
					has_interest_marker_in_region = sr:region_south_china
				}
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_isolationism
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = morrison_incident_country

			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = morrison_incident_country_namesake
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = ep2_sakoku.3.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:morrison_incident_country ?= {
			change_relations = {
				country = root
				value = -30
			}		
			post_notification = morrison_incident_has_incidented
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = ep2_sakoku.3.b
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_isolationism
					value > neutral
				}
				NOT = { has_modifier = light_hand_with_foreigners }
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = light_hand_with_foreigners
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = ep2_sakoku.3.c
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = government_ig_dislikes_sakoku_tt
				any_interest_group = {
					is_in_government = yes
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_isolationism
						value < neutral
					}
				}
				NOT = { has_variable = je_sakoku_maybe_we_should_open_up }
			}
		}
		show_as_unavailable = {
			NOT = { has_variable = je_sakoku_maybe_we_should_open_up }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = end_sakoku_button_now_available
			set_variable = je_sakoku_maybe_we_should_open_up
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_isolationism
					value > neutral
				}
				NOT = { has_modifier = light_hand_with_foreigners }
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = light_hand_with_foreigners
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_in_government = yes
				# whether the IG supported an end to sakoku/isolation or not, they were part of the government that signed off on this
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = caved_to_foreign_pressure_government
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
}

shogunate.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = shogunate.1.t
	desc = shogunate.1.d
	flavor = shogunate.1.f

    gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:shogun_scope

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	dlc = dlc018

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/faction_icons/faction_japan_tokugawa.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ep2_content
		# Triggered by on_new_ruler
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	immediate = {
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = shogun_scope
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_trait = special_character_japanese_emperor
			}
			save_scope_as = emperor_scope
		}
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			save_scope_as = daimyo_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = shogunate.1.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:shogun_scope ?= {
			remove_trait = reserved
			add_trait = imperious
		}
		show_as_tooltip = {
			scope:shogun_scope = {
				set_character_as_ruler = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

shogunate.2 = { # Debate about Iesada vs. Yoshinobu - Ieyoshi
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = shogunate.2.t
	desc = shogunate.2.d
	flavor = shogunate.2.f

    event_image = {
		video = "ep2_important_japanese_men_negotiating"
	}

	dlc = dlc018

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/faction_icons/faction_japan_tokugawa.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ep2_content
		game_date >= 1850.1.1
		ruler = {
			has_template = JAP_ieyoshi_tokugawa
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	immediate = {
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = shogun_scope
		}
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = armed_forces_leader
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_scope_character = {
						has_template = JAP_iesada_tokugawa
					}
				}
			}
			create_character = {
				template = JAP_iesada_tokugawa
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_scope_character = {
						has_template = JAP_yoshinobu_tokugawa
					}
				}
			}
			create_character = {
				template = JAP_yoshinobu_tokugawa
			}
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_template = JAP_iesada_tokugawa
			}
			save_scope_as = iesada_scope
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_template = JAP_yoshinobu_tokugawa
			}
			save_scope_as = yoshinobu_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = shogunate.2.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:iesada_scope ?= {
					is_heir_of_own_country = yes
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = iesada_stays_heir_tt
		}
		else = {
			set_heir = scope:iesada_scope
		}
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_japan_selected_shogun_candidate
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
			leader ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_power_behind_the_shogun
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_japan_capability_disregarded
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = shogunate.2.b
		trigger = {
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				is_in_government = yes
			}
			legitimacy >= 50
		}
		show_as_unavailable = {
			always = yes
		}
		highlighted_option = yes
		set_heir = scope:yoshinobu_scope
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:yoshinobu_scope ?= {
					is_adult = no
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = yoshinobu_is_the_guy_info_tt
		}
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_japan_selected_shogun_candidate
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
			leader ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_power_behind_the_shogun
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_japan_lineage_disregarded
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

shogunate.6 = { # Accession of Iemochi

	dlc = dlc018

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/faction_icons/faction_japan_tokugawa.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

		has_dlc_feature = ep2_content
		# Triggered by on_new_ruler
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_template = JAP_iemochi_tokugawa
			}
			save_scope_as = shogun_scope
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_trait = special_character_japanese_emperor
			}
			save_scope_as = emperor_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:shogun_scope ?= {
					age < 16
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						any_scope_character = {
							has_template = JAP_yoshinobu_tokugawa
						}
					}
				}
				create_character = {
					template = JAP_yoshinobu_tokugawa
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_template = JAP_yoshinobu_tokugawa
				}
				save_scope_as = yoshinobu_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = shogunate.6.a
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			scope:shogun_scope ?= {
				is_adult = yes
			}
		}
		scope:shogun_scope ?= {
			set_first_name = Iemochi
		}
		show_as_tooltip = {
			scope:shogun_scope = {
				set_character_as_ruler = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = shogunate.6.a_regency
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			scope:shogun_scope ?= {
				is_adult = no
			}
		}
		scope:shogun_scope ?= {
			set_first_name = Iemochi
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:shogun_scope ?= {
					is_adult = no
				}
			}
			add_regency_modifier = yes
			set_variable = { name = hide_ruler_change_notification days = 3 }
			create_character = {
				template = JAP_yoshiyori_tokugawa
				on_created = {
					set_character_as_ruler = yes
					set_variable = { name = regency_years value = 0 }
				}
			}
			set_heir = scope:shogun_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = shogunate.6.b_regency
		trigger = {
			scope:shogun_scope ?= {
				is_adult = no
			}
		}
		scope:shogun_scope ?= {
			set_first_name = Iemochi
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:shogun_scope ?= {
					is_adult = no
				}
			}
			add_regency_modifier = yes
			set_variable = { name = hide_ruler_change_notification days = 3 }
			scope:yoshinobu_scope ?= {
				set_character_as_ruler = yes
				set_variable = { name = regency_years value = 0 }
			}
			set_heir = scope:shogun_scope
		}
	}

	after = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:shogun_scope ?= {
					has_variable = daimyo_var
				}
			}
			scope:shogun_scope ?= {
				character_clear_daimyo_status = yes
			}
			create_character = {
				template = JAP_tokugawa_mochitsugu
			}
		}
	}
}

# Mandatory Reforms
tenpo_events.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = tenpo_events.3.t
	desc = tenpo_events.3.d
	flavor = tenpo_events.3.f

    event_image = {
		video = "ep2_important_japanese_men_negotiating"
	}

	dlc = dlc018

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# Triggered in history
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				tenpo_hardliner_goals_completed > tenpo_reformer_goals_completed
			}
			set_variable = tenpo_outcome_hardliner_var
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				tenpo_hardliner_goals_completed < tenpo_reformer_goals_completed
			}
			set_variable = tenpo_outcome_reformer_var
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				tenpo_hardliner_goals_completed = tenpo_reformer_goals_completed
			}
			set_variable = tenpo_outcome_balanced_var
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tenpo_events.3.a
		default_option = yes
		highlighted_option = yes
		show_as_unavailable = {
			always = yes
		}
		trigger = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = tenpo_outcome_hardliner_tt
				has_variable = tenpo_outcome_hardliner_var
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_tenpo_crisis_reward_hardliner
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
		add_loyalists = {
			value = medium_radicals
			strata = upper
		}
	}

		}
		add_loyalists = {
			value = medium_radicals

		}
	}

	option = {

		default_option = yes
		highlighted_option = yes

			always = yes
		}
		trigger = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = tenpo_outcome_balanced_tt
				has_variable = tenpo_outcome_balanced_var

		}
		add_modifier = {
