# Action and Inaction
tenpo_events.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = tenpo_events.4.t
	desc = tenpo_events.4.d
	flavor = tenpo_events.4.f

	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:roju_scope

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	dlc = dlc018

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# Triggered in history
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	immediate = {
		ordered_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_in_government = yes
			}
			order_by = ig_clout
			position = 0
			save_scope_as = government_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = roju_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tenpo_events.4.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = tenpo_events.4.tt_1
			scope:roju_scope = {
				kill_character = {
					hidden = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_tenpo_fail
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tenpo_events.4.b
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_active_law = {
					has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_frugal_ordinance
				}
			}
			random_active_law = {
				limit = {
					has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_frugal_ordinance
				}
				random_scope_amendment = {
					limit = {
						amendment_type:amendment_frugal_ordinance ?= this.type
					}
					remove_amendment = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_strict_edo_system
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_intermediate_edo_system
			add_radicals = {
				pop_type = aristocrats
				value = medium_radicals
			}
			add_loyalists = {
				pop_type = shopkeepers
				value = medium_radicals
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_lax_edo_system
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_intermediate_edo_system
			add_radicals = {
				pop_type = shopkeepers
				value = medium_radicals
			}
			add_loyalists = {
				pop_type = aristocrats
				value = medium_radicals
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_hereditary_bureaucrats
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_hereditary_bureaucrats
			add_radicals = {
				pop_type = bureaucrats
				value = medium_radicals
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_tenpo_fail
			days = normal_modifier_time
			multiplier = 0.5
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = tenpo_events.4.tt_1
			scope:roju_scope = {
				kill_character = {
					hidden = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					}

					}
					save_scope_as = port_state_scope
				}
			}
		}
		else = {

				save_scope_as = port_state_scope
			}

	}

		}

			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_journal_entry = je_sakoku
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_marginal = no

							is_ruler_of_own_country = no
							law_stance = {
								law = law_type:law_isolationism
								value > neutral
							}
						}
					}
				}

					limit = {
						is_marginal = no
						leader = {
							is_ruler_of_own_country = no
							law_stance = {
								law = law_type:law_isolationism
								value > neutral
							}
						}
					}
					leader = {
						set_ideology = ideology:ideology_modernizer_leader
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tenpo_events.6.b
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_censorship

			}
		}
		ai_chance = {

				}			
			}
			1 = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_opium_war_aftermath
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}			
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tenpo_events.6.c

		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_opium_war_aftermath

			multiplier = 0.5
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_defenses_strengthened
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}
	after = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_journal_entry = je_sakoku
				NOT = {

		country_has_primary_culture = cu:amhara

			is_player = yes

				any_country = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:amhara
					is_player = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = tewdoros_refused }
				}
			}
		}

		set_global_variable = tewodros_var
	}

			template = ETH_tewodros_solomon

				add_modifier = {
					name = tewodros_modifier

			}
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = medium_radicals
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ethiopia.1.b
		add_loyalists = {
			value = medium_radicals
		}
		remove_global_variable = tewodros_var
		set_variable = tewdoros_refused
	}
}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_scales.dds"

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		empty_agitator_slots >= 1
		any_interest_group = {
			ig_approval >= 5
			type = {
				save_temporary_scope_as = ex_ig_type
			}
		}
		any_character_in_exile_pool = {
			root = this.home_country
			interest_group_type = scope:ex_ig_type
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				exists = scope:exile_scope
			}
			scope:exile_scope ?= {
				OR = {
					is_character_alive = no
					is_in_exile_pool = no
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_approval >= 5
				any_character_in_exile_pool = {
					root = this.home_country
					this.interest_group_type = prev.type
				}
			}
			type = {
				save_temporary_scope_as = ex_ig_type
			}
			save_scope_as = exile_ig
		}
		random_character_in_exile_pool = {
			limit = {
				root = this.home_country
				this.interest_group_type = scope:ex_ig_type
			}
			save_scope_as = exile_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_events.5.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:exile_scope = {
			transfer_character = root
			hidden_effect = {
				free_from_exile_effect = yes
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_accepted_repentant_exile
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_events.5.b
		scope:exile_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_refused_repentant_exile
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

exiles_more_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	desc = exiles_more_events.1.d
	flavor = exiles_more_events.1.f

		video = "unspecific_armored_train"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/bicorne_hat.dds"

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_diplomatic_play = {
			is_war = yes
			target_is = ROOT
		}

			home_country ?= ROOT
			save_temporary_scope_as = ex_ig
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			ig_type_matches_former = yes
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_character_in_exile_pool  = {
			limit = {
				home_country ?= ROOT
			}
			save_temporary_scope_as = ex_ig
			save_scope_as = patriotic_exile_scope
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_type_matches_former = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = patriotic_exile_home_ig

			}
			scope:patriotic_exile_scope ?= {
				OR = {
					is_character_alive = no
					is_in_exile_pool = no
				}

		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.1.a
		default_option = yes

		scope:patriotic_exile_scope = {
			transfer_character = ROOT

				free_from_exile_effect = yes

			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.1.b

		scope:patriotic_exile_scope = {
			transfer_character = ROOT
			hidden_effect = {
				free_from_exile_effect = yes
			}
		}

		scope:patriotic_exile_scope = {
			add_character_role = general
		}

		scope:patriotic_exile_home_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = exile_welcomed_and_promoted
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

		name = exiles_more_events.1.c

		scope:patriotic_exile_home_ig = {

			}
		}

# Exile attempts to return to break law passage deadlock
exiles_more_events.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = exiles_more_events.2.t
	desc = exiles_more_events.2.d
	flavor = exiles_more_events.2.f

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_gunboat_diplomacy"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		enacting_any_law = yes

		OR = {
			AND = {
				any_interest_group = {
					law_stance = {
						law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
						value = strongly_approve
					}
					leader = {
						NOT = {
							has_modifier = ideological_victor
						}
					}
					save_temporary_scope_as = ex_ig
				}
				any_character_in_exile_pool = {
					home_country ?= ROOT
					ig_type_matches_former = yes
					law_stance = {
						law = root.currently_enacting_law.type
						value = strongly_approve
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				any_interest_group = {
					law_stance = {
						law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
						value = strongly_disapprove
					}
					leader = {
						NOT = {
							has_modifier = ideological_victor
						}
					}
					save_temporary_scope_as = ex_ig
				}
				any_character_in_exile_pool = {
					home_country ?= ROOT
					ig_type_matches_former = yes
					law_stance = {
						law = root.currently_enacting_law.type
						value = strongly_disapprove
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = interventionist_exile_law_scope
		}

		random_character_in_exile_pool = {
			limit = {
				home_country ?= root
				OR = {
					AND = {
						law_stance = {
							law = root.currently_enacting_law.type
							value = strongly_approve
						}
						interest_group_type = {
							save_temporary_scope_as = exile_ig_type
						}
						root = {
							any_interest_group = {
								this.type = scope:exile_ig_type
								law_stance = {
									law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
									value = strongly_approve
								}
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						law_stance = {
							law = root.currently_enacting_law.type
							value = strongly_disapprove
						}
						interest_group_type = {
							save_temporary_scope_as = exile_ig_type
						}
						root = {
							any_interest_group = {
								this.type = scope:exile_ig_type
								law_stance = {
									law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
									value = strongly_disapprove
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_as = ex_ig
			save_scope_as = interventionist_exile_scope
		}

		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_type_matches_former = yes
			}
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = interventionist_exile_ig_leader
			}
			save_scope_as = interventionist_exile_ig
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				exists = scope:interventionist_exile_scope
			}
			scope:interventionist_exile_scope ?= {
				OR = {
					is_in_exile_pool = no
					is_character_alive = no
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.2.a
		default_option = yes

		scope:interventionist_exile_scope = {
			transfer_character = ROOT
			hidden_effect = {
				free_from_exile_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.2.b

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:interventionist_exile_ig = {
					law_stance = {
						law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
						value = strongly_approve
					}
				}
			}
			add_enactment_modifier = {
				name = positive_exile_intervention
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:interventionist_exile_ig = {
					law_stance = {
						law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
						value = strongly_disapprove
					}
				}
			}
			add_enactment_modifier = {
				name = negative_exile_intervention
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.2.c
		highlighted_option = yes

		trigger = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = exiles_more_events.2.c.tt
				OR = {
					AND = {
						scope:interventionist_exile_scope = { has_liberal_ideology = yes }
						scope:interventionist_exile_ig = { leader = { has_liberal_ideology = no } }
					}
					AND = {
						scope:interventionist_exile_scope = { has_progressive_ideology = yes }
						scope:interventionist_exile_ig = { leader = { has_progressive_ideology = no } }
					}
					AND = {
						scope:interventionist_exile_scope = { has_socialist_ideology = yes }
						scope:interventionist_exile_ig = { leader = { has_socialist_ideology = no } }
					}
					AND = {
						scope:interventionist_exile_scope = { has_reactionary_ideology = yes }
						scope:interventionist_exile_ig = { leader = { has_reactionary_ideology = no } }
					}
					AND = {
						scope:interventionist_exile_scope = { has_conservative_ideology = yes }
						scope:interventionist_exile_ig = { leader = { has_conservative_ideology = no } }
					}
				}
			}
		}

		scope:interventionist_exile_ig = {
			leader = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = ideological_victor
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Agitator has no domestic support and sullenly goes into self-exile
exiles_more_events.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = exiles_more_events.3.t
	desc = exiles_more_events.3.d
	flavor = exiles_more_events.3.f

	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid
	left_icon = scope:the_loneliest_little_agitator

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_scope_character = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			character_supports_political_movement = yes
			political_movement ?= {
				political_movement_support < 0.1
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_role_of_type = agitator
				character_supports_political_movement = yes
				political_movement ?= {
					political_movement_support < 0.1
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = the_loneliest_little_agitator
			interest_group ?= {
				save_scope_as = the_loneliest_little_agitator_ig
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				exists = scope:the_loneliest_little_agitator
			}
			scope:the_loneliest_little_agitator ?= {
				is_character_alive = no
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.3.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}

		scope:the_loneliest_little_agitator = {
			exile_character_with_role_cleanup = yes
		}
	}

	option = { # Perhaps it's time for a little study and reflection?
		name = exiles_more_events.3.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
		highlighted_option = yes

		trigger = {
			scope:the_loneliest_little_agitator = {
				has_trait = erudite
			}
		}

		scope:the_loneliest_little_agitator = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = inspired_by_studies
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # time for something radical
		name = exiles_more_events.3.c
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:the_loneliest_little_agitator.political_movement ?= {
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.60
					}
				}
				add = -5
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_political_movement = {
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.25
					}
				}
				add = -3
			}
		}
		highlighted_option = yes

		trigger = {
			scope:the_loneliest_little_agitator = {
				not = { has_trait = cautious }
				character_supports_political_movement = yes
			}
		}

		random_list = {
			1 = {
				scope:the_loneliest_little_agitator = {
					political_movement ?= {
						add_modifier = {
							name = radical_new_approach
							days = normal_modifier_time
						}
					}
				}
			}
			1 = {
				scope:the_loneliest_little_agitator = {
					political_movement ?= {
						add_modifier = {
							name = failed_relaunch
							days = normal_modifier_time
						}
					}
				}
			}
			1 = {
				scope:the_loneliest_little_agitator = {
					political_movement ?= {
						add_modifier = {
							name = all_worked_up
							days = normal_modifier_time
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # There's no need for anything drastic like exile!
		name = exiles_more_events.3.dd
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
		highlighted_option = yes

		trigger = {
			scope:the_loneliest_little_agitator = {
				has_trait = cautious
				character_supports_political_movement = yes
			}
		}

		scope:the_loneliest_little_agitator = {
			political_movement ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = deliberate_deliberations
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# THE CALAMITOUS RETURN OF THE VILE [character name]
exiles_more_events.6 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = exiles_more_events.6.t
	desc = exiles_more_events.6.d
	flavor = exiles_more_events.6.f

	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid
	left_icon = scope:melodrama_villain

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_character_in_exile_pool = {
			home_country ?= ROOT
			OR = {
				has_trait = arrogant
				has_trait = reckless
				has_trait = ambitious
				has_trait = imperious
				has_trait = wrathful
				has_trait = cruel
				has_trait = imposing
			}
			save_temporary_scope_as = ex_ig
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			ig_type_matches_former = yes
			ig_approval < 0
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_character_in_exile_pool  = {
			limit = {
				home_country ?= ROOT
				OR = {
					has_trait = arrogant
					has_trait = reckless
					has_trait = ambitious
					has_trait = imperious
					has_trait = wrathful
					has_trait = cruel
					has_trait = imposing
				}
			}
			ideology = {
				save_scope_as = melodrama_villain_ideology
			}
			save_temporary_scope_as = ex_ig
			save_scope_as = melodrama_villain
			set_variable = {
				name = THE_NEFARIOUS_TOP_HAT
			}
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_type_matches_former = yes
				ig_approval < 0
			}
			save_scope_as = melodrama_villain_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = melodrama_villain_ig_leader
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				exists = scope:melodrama_villain
			}
			NOT = {
				exists = scope:melodrama_villain_ig_leader
			}
			scope:melodrama_villain ?= {
				OR = {
					is_in_exile_pool = no
					is_character_alive = no
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.6.a
		default_option = yes

		scope:melodrama_villain ?= {
			transfer_character = ROOT
			remove_variable = THE_NEFARIOUS_TOP_HAT
			hidden_effect = {
				free_from_exile_effect = yes
			}
		}

		scope:melodrama_villain_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = in_the_thrall_of_a_villain
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.6.b
		highlighted_option = yes

		trigger = {
			scope:melodrama_villain_ig_leader ?= {
				OR = {
					has_trait = arrogant
					has_trait = reckless
					has_trait = ambitious
					has_trait = imperious
					has_trait = wrathful
					has_trait = cruel
					has_trait = imposing
				}
			}
		}

		scope:melodrama_villain_ig_leader ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = apprentice_becomes_the_master
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:melodrama_villain ?= {
			remove_variable = THE_NEFARIOUS_TOP_HAT
			add_modifier = {
				name = foiled_again
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}


	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.6.c
		highlighted_option = yes

		trigger = {
			scope:melodrama_villain = {
				OR = {
					has_trait = ambitious
					has_trait = reckless
				}
			}
		}

		scope:melodrama_villain ?= {
			remove_variable = THE_NEFARIOUS_TOP_HAT
		}

		random_list = {
			1 = {
				scope:melodrama_villain = {
					transfer_character = ROOT
					hidden_effect = {
						free_from_exile_effect = yes
					}
				}

				scope:melodrama_villain = {
					set_as_interest_group_leader = yes

					custom_tooltip = {
						text = exiles_more_events.6.c.tt
						set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
					}

					add_modifier = {
						name = i_return_triumphant
						days = normal_modifier_time
					}
				}
			}
			1 = {
				scope:melodrama_villain = {
					add_modifier = {
						name = foiled_again
						days = normal_modifier_time
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.6.dd

		if = {
			limit = { scope:melodrama_villain_ig_leader ?= { NOT = { has_ideology = scope:melodrama_villain_ideology } } }
			scope:melodrama_villain_ig_leader ?= { set_ideology = scope:melodrama_villain_ideology }
		}
		else = {
			scope:melodrama_villain_ig = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = pawns_of_a_greater_mind
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		scope:melodrama_villain ?= {
			remove_variable = THE_NEFARIOUS_TOP_HAT
		}
	}
}

# Two competing exiles living in ROOT drive one or the other out of the country because they brought their problems with them

	type = country_event

	desc = exiles_more_events.7.d
	flavor = exiles_more_events.7.f

	right_icon = scope:second_ex_exile

		}

				was_exiled = yes
			}

		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { home_country ?= ROOT }

			}

		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {

			NOT = {

					is_character_alive = no
					is_in_exile_pool = no
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				exists = scope:second_ex_exile
			}
			scope:second_ex_exile ?= {
				OR = {
					is_character_alive = no
					is_in_exile_pool = no
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.7.a
		default_option = yes

		add_modifier = {
			name = their_spats_are_our_problems
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.7.b
		trigger = {
			scope:first_ex_exile = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
			}
		}
		scope:first_ex_exile = {
			exile_character_with_martyrdom = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.7.c
		trigger = {
			scope:second_ex_exile = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
			}
		}
		scope:second_ex_exile = {
			exile_character_with_martyrdom = yes
		}
	}
}

		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_type_matches_former = yes
				is_in_government = no
			}
			save_scope_as = dgaf_exile_home_ig
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				exists = scope:dgaf_exile_scope
			}
			scope:dgaf_exile_scope ?= {
				OR = {
					is_character_alive = no
					is_in_exile_pool = no
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.8.a
		default_option = yes

		scope:dgaf_exile_scope = {
			transfer_character = ROOT
			hidden_effect = {
				free_from_exile_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}


	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.8.b
		highlighted_option = yes

		trigger = {
			NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_guaranteed_liberties }
			institution_investment_level = {
				institution = institution_home_affairs
				value >= 2
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = exiles_more_events.8.b.tt
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.8.c

		add_modifier = {
			name = bargain_with_the_opposition
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		scope:dgaf_exile_home_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = bargain_with_the_government
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

# Foreign exile decides to set up shop in ROOT
exiles_more_events.9 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = exiles_more_events.9.t
	desc = exiles_more_events.9.d
	flavor = exiles_more_events.9.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_steam_ship"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		empty_agitator_slots >= 1
		any_character_in_exile_pool = {
			NOT = { home_country ?= ROOT }
			character_acceptance = { target = ROOT value < acceptance_status_5 }
			interest_group_type = {
				save_temporary_scope_as = exile_ig_type
			}
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			scope:exile_ig_type = this.type
			is_powerful = yes
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_character_in_exile_pool  = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { home_country ?= ROOT }
				character_acceptance = { target = ROOT value < acceptance_status_5 }
			}
			interest_group_type = {
				save_scope_as = exile_ig_type
			}
			save_scope_as = fertile_ground_exile_scope
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				scope:exile_ig_type ?= this.type
				is_powerful = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = fertile_ground_ig
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				exists = scope:fertile_ground_exile_scope
			}
			NOT = {
				exists = scope:fertile_ground_ig
			}
			scope:fertile_ground_exile_scope ?= {
				OR = {
					is_character_alive = no
					is_in_exile_pool = no
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.9.a
		default_option = yes

		scope:fertile_ground_exile_scope = {
			transfer_character = ROOT
			hidden_effect = {
				free_from_exile_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.9.b

		scope:fertile_ground_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = messed_with_the_wrong_ig
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.9.c
		highlighted_option = yes

		trigger = {
			scope:fertile_ground_ig = {
				is_in_government = no
			}
			OR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_censorship
			}
		}

		scope:fertile_ground_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = accused_of_subversion
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

	title = exiles_more_events.10.t
	desc = exiles_more_events.10.d

	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_revolution_ongoing = yes
		any_scope_character = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			interest_group ?= { # Loyal, but in opposition
				is_insurrectionary = no
				is_in_government = no
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_role_of_type = agitator
				interest_group ?= {
					is_insurrectionary = no
					is_in_government = no
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = unstable_element_agitator
			interest_group ?= {
				save_scope_as = unstable_element_ig
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				exists = scope:unstable_element_agitator
			}
			scope:unstable_element_agitator ?= {
				OR = {
					is_character_alive = no
					is_in_exile_pool = no
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.10.a
		default_option = yes

		scope:unstable_element_agitator = {
			exile_character_with_martyrdom = yes
		}
		scope:unstable_element_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = target_of_paranoia
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = exiles_more_events.10.b

		scope:unstable_element_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = the_velvet_glove_forgives
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

famine_political.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:famine_state
	title = famine_political.1.t
	desc = famine_political.1.d
	flavor = famine_political.1.f

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_dead_cattle_poor_harvest"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	trigger = {
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_traditionalism
		NOT = { has_modifier = made_economic_concessions }
		NOT = {
			any_interest_group = {
				has_modifier = refused_economic_concessions
			}
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			has_famine = yes
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_famine = yes }
			save_scope_as = famine_state
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = famine_political.1.a
		add_modifier = {
			name = economic_concessions
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_traditionalism
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = made_economic_concessions
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = famine_political.1.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:famine_state ?= {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				strata = lower
				value = 0.3
			}
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_traditionalism
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = refused_economic_concessions
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

﻿namespace = fascism_events

# Night of the Long Knives
fascism_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = fascism_events.1.t
	desc = fascism_events.1.d
	flavor = fascism_events.1.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_cops_march"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	trigger = {
		any_interest_group = {
			has_variable = og_fascist_ig
			is_in_government = yes
			leader = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			has_variable = long_knives_var
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = og_fascist_ig
			}
			save_scope_as = fascist_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = fascist_leader
			}
			set_variable = chose_fascism
		}

		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_role_of_type = general
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				is_busy = no
				is_immortal = no
			}
			save_scope_as = general_1
			set_variable = general_1_var
			interest_group ?= {
				set_variable = fascism_traitor_ig_var
			}
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_role_of_type = general
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				is_busy = no
				is_immortal = no
				NOT = { has_variable = general_1_var }
			}
			save_scope_as = general_2
			set_variable = general_2_var
			interest_group ?= {
				set_variable = fascism_traitor_ig_var
			}
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_role_of_type = general }
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				is_busy = no
				is_immortal = no
				NOT = { has_variable = general_1_var }
				NOT = { has_variable = general_2_var }
				NOT = { THIS = scope:fascist_leader }
			}
			save_scope_as = general_3
			interest_group ?= {
				set_variable = fascism_traitor_ig_var
			}
		}

		#We add two fascist generals to replace them
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:BRZ = this
			}
			create_character = {
				is_general = yes
				ig_leader = no
				interest_group = scope:fascist_ig
				ideology = ideology_integralist
			}
			create_character = {
				is_general = yes
				ig_leader = no
				interest_group = scope:fascist_ig
				ideology = ideology_integralist
			}
		}
		else = {
			create_character = {
				is_general = yes
				ig_leader = no
				interest_group = scope:fascist_ig
				ideology = ideology_fascist
			}
			create_character = {
				is_general = yes
				ig_leader = no
				interest_group = scope:fascist_ig
				ideology = ideology_fascist
			}
		}
		set_variable = long_knives_var
	}

	option = { #do it secretly
		name = fascism_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = night_of_the_long_knives.tt
		scope:general_1 = {
			kill_character = yes
		}
		scope:general_2 = {
			kill_character = yes
		}
		scope:general_3 = {
			kill_character = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					has_variable = fascism_traitor_ig_var
				}
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = fascism_traitor_ig_var
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = traitors_disappeared
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #take care of them publicly
		name = fascism_events.1.b
		custom_tooltip = night_of_the_long_knives.tt
		scope:general_1 = {
			kill_character = yes
		}
		scope:general_2 = {
			kill_character = yes
		}
		scope:general_3 = {
			kill_character = yes
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = traitors_executed_propaganda
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		scope:fascist_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = traitors_executed_approves
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					has_variable = fascism_traitor_ig_var
				}
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = fascism_traitor_ig_var
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = traitors_executed_disapproves
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #to jail!
		name = fascism_events.1.c
		custom_tooltip = fascism_to_jail_tt
		custom_tooltip = night_of_the_long_knives.tt
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:general_1 = {
				retire_character = yes
			}
			scope:general_2 = {
				retire_character = yes
			}
			scope:general_3 = {
				retire_character = yes
			}
		}
		scope:fascist_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = no_traitors_executed
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = traitors_jailed
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					has_variable = fascism_traitor_ig_var
				}
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = fascism_traitor_ig_var
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = no_traitors_executed_approves
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

fascism_events.2 = { #fascist leader gains popularity

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_agitator_speaking"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_scope_character = {
			OR = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = fascist_leader
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:fascist_leader = {
					has_role_of_type = politician
				}
			}
			scope:fascist_leader.interest_group ?= {
				save_scope_as = fascist_ig
			}
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_conservative_ideology = yes
					has_reactionary_ideology = yes
				}
				NOT = {
					scope:fascist_leader ?= THIS
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = fascist_leader_2
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:fascist_leader_2 = {
					has_role_of_type = politician
				}
			}
			scope:fascist_leader.interest_group ?= {
				save_scope_as = fascist_ig_2
			}
		}

	option = { #cool speech bro

				name = promoted_fascist_leader_modifier

			}
		}

			limit = {
				exists = scope:fascist_ig
			}
			scope:fascist_ig = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = promoted_fascist_leader_ig_modifier
					days = short_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #not super impressive
		name = fascism_events.2.b
		scope:fascist_leader = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = ignored_fascist_leader_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:fascist_ig
			}
			scope:fascist_ig = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = ignored_fascist_leader_ig_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #now THIS other guy is a good leader
		name = fascism_events.2.c
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:fascist_leader_2
		}
		scope:fascist_leader_2 = {

				name = promoted_fascist_leader_modifier
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:fascist_ig_2

			scope:fascist_ig_2 = {

fascism_events.4 = { #fascist ideology spread
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	title = fascism_events.4.t
	desc = fascism_events.4.d
	flavor = fascism_events.4.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_political_extremism"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		#triggered by JE
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = fascist_spread_var
			}
			var:fascist_spread_var < 3
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			has_variable = og_fascist_ig
			leader = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
				}
			}
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			NOR = {
				has_variable = chose_fascism
				has_variable = chose_conservatism
				has_variable = chose_ethno_nationalism
			}
			leader ?= {
				NOR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
				}
			}
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					c:BRZ ?= owner
				}
				ideology_integralist_valid_trigger = yes
			}
			any_scope_character = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				is_heir_of_own_country = no
				is_interest_group_leader = no
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						c:BRZ ?= owner
					}
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
				}
				trigger_else = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					has_variable = chose_fascism
					has_variable = chose_conservatism
					has_variable = chose_ethno_nationalism
				}
				leader ?= {
					NOR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
					}
				}
				OR = {
					NOT = {
						c:BRZ ?= owner
					}
					ideology_integralist_valid_trigger = yes
				}
				any_scope_character = {
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					is_heir_of_own_country = no
					is_interest_group_leader = no
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
							c:BRZ ?= owner
						}
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
					}
					trigger_else = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = new_fascist_ig
			ordered_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					is_heir_of_own_country = no
					is_interest_group_leader = no
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
							c:BRZ ?= owner
						}
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
					}
					trigger_else = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
						}
					}
				}
				order_by = prominence
				position = 0
				save_scope_as = fascisising_leader_scope
			}
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = { has_variable = og_fascist_ig }
			save_scope_as = fascist_ig
		}
	}

	option = { #only fascist leaders
		name = fascism_events.4.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = fascism_leaders.tt
		scope:new_fascist_ig = {
			set_variable = {
				name = chose_fascism
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_political_movement = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_fascist
				}
			}
			random_political_movement = {
				limit = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_fascist
				}
				remove_character_ideology = ideology_corporatist_leader
			}
		}
		scope:fascisising_leader_scope ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_role_of_type = agitator
				}
				replace_character_roles = { remove = { agitator } add = { politician } }
			}
			set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:fascist_spread_var }
			change_variable = {
				name = fascist_spread_var
				add = 1
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = {
				name = fascist_spread_var
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #any conservative leader
		name = fascism_events.4.b
		custom_tooltip = conservative_leaders.tt
		scope:new_fascist_ig = {
			set_variable = {
				name = chose_conservatism
			}
			ordered_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					is_heir_of_own_country = no
					is_interest_group_leader = no
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist_leader
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ethno_nationalist
					}
				}
				order_by = prominence
				position = 0
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_role_of_type = agitator
					}
					replace_character_roles = { remove = { agitator } add = { politician } }
				}
				set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:fascist_spread_var }
			change_variable = {
				name = fascist_spread_var
				add = 1
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = {
				name = fascist_spread_var
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #No.
		name = fascism_events.4.c
		scope:new_fascist_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_repressed_by_fascists
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

				limit = {
					NOT = { this = ROOT }
				}
				save_scope_as = rival_country
			}
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes

				}
			}

				}
				save_scope_as = anthem_building
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			50 = {

					name = first_and_second_lines
					value = 1
				}
			}
			50 = {
				set_variable = {

					value = 2
				}
			}

					value = 1
				}
			}

					value = 2
				}
			}
		}

	}
	
	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

					save_scope_as = non_fascist_leader
				}
			}
			else = {
				ROOT = {
					create_character = {
						role = character_role_politician
						ideology = ideology_moderate
						interest_group = scope:new_fascist_leader_ig
						save_scope_as = non_fascist_leader
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = fascism_events.9.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = fascism_government_remains_tt
	}

	option = {
		name = fascism_events.9.b
		scope:non_fascist_leader ?= {
			set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_government_refused_fascist_seat
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				empty_agitator_slots >= 1
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = fascist_becomes_agitator_tt
				scope:new_fascist_leader_scope = {
					replace_character_roles = { add = { agitator } remove_all = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:new_fascist_leader_scope = {
				exile_character_with_role_cleanup = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

fascism_events.11 = { # March on Rome
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	desc = fascism_events.11.d
	flavor = fascism_events.11.f

							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist

						}
					}
				}
			}
			ordered_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
						}
					}
				}
				order_by = ig_clout
				position = 0
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = fascist_ig
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = fascist_leader
					set_character_busy_and_immortal = yes
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			ordered_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_character = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
						}
					}
				}
				order_by = ig_clout
				position = 0
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = fascist_ig
				random_scope_character = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = fascist_leader
					set_character_busy_and_immortal = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = fascism_events.11.a
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_presidential_republic
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_theocracy
				}
			}
			scope:fascist_leader = {
				set_character_as_ruler = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:fascist_ig = {
					is_in_government = no
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:fascist_ig = {
						has_party = yes
					}
				}
				scope:fascist_ig.party = {
					set_ruling_party = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				scope:fascist_ig = {
					add_ruling_interest_group = yes
				}
			}
		}
		scope:fascist_ig = {

			}

		add_radicals = {

		}
		add_journal_entry = {

		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:fascist_leader = {
				set_character_busy_and_immortal = no
			}
		}
	}

	option = {

	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	duration = 3

	title = federation_of_india.1.t
	desc = federation_of_india.1.d
	flavor = federation_of_india.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "ip2_india_urban_scene"
	}

	dlc = dlc011

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by JE
	}

	immediate = {
		overlord = {
			save_scope_as = india_scope
		}
		save_scope_as = princely_state_scope
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_subject = no
			NOT = {
				exists = scope:india_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = federation_of_india.1.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:india_scope = {
						is_player = yes
					}
				}
				add = 10
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					liberty_desire < define:NDiplomacy|WAR_GOAL_INFAMY_LOW_LIBERTY_DESIRE_THRESHOLD
				}
				add = 10
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					liberty_desire < 15
				}
				add = 10
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					liberty_desire < 5
				}
				add = 10
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					liberty_desire = 0
				}
				add = 50
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					"relations(scope:india_scope)" >= relations_threshold:amicable
				}
				add = 10
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					"relations(scope:india_scope)" >= relations_threshold:friendly
				}
				add = 10
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					OR = {
						ruler = { age >= define:NCharacters|OLD_AGE }
						ruler = { is_adult = no }
					}
				}
				add = 10
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ruler = {
						OR = {
							has_trait = psychological_affliction
							has_trait = cancer
							has_trait = senile
							has_trait = wounded
						}
					}
				}
				add = 25
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			play_as = scope:india_scope
		}
		scope:india_scope = {
			post_notification = joins_union_of_india
			change_variable = { name = indian_states_annexed add = 1 }
			set_variable = update_privy_purse
			annex = ROOT
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = federation_of_india.1.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
		}
		add_liberty_desire = 10
		scope:india_scope = {
			change_relations = {
				country = ROOT
				value = -25
			}
		}
		scope:india_scope = {
			post_notification = refuses_to_join_union_of_india
		}
	}
}

# Pamphlet Distributed
free_speech_laws.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = free_speech_laws.1.t
	desc = free_speech_laws.1.d
	flavor = free_speech_laws.1.f

	category = enactment

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_union_leader"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOR = {
			has_modifier = free_speech_pamphlet_advance
			has_modifier = free_speech_pamphlet_risk_success
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_right_of_assembly
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_protected_speech
			}
			OR = {
				has_law = law_type:law_censorship
				has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
    		save_scope_as = current_law_scope
    	}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = { #Pro free speech Pamphlet
		name = free_speech_laws.1.a
		default_option = yes
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = free_speech_pamphlet_advance
		}
	}

	option = { #Use these Pamphlets to push a stronger message
		name = free_speech_laws.1.b
		trigger = {
			any_political_movement = {
				OR = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_liberal
					is_political_movement_type = movement_radical
					is_political_movement_type = movement_anarchist
				}
			}
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = free_speech_pamphlet_risk_success
		}
		every_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_liberal
					is_political_movement_type = movement_radical
					is_political_movement_type = movement_anarchist
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = free_speech_pamphlet_risk_success_movement
				years = 10
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Censoring Censorship
free_speech_laws.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = free_speech_laws.3.t
	desc = free_speech_laws.3.d
	flavor = free_speech_laws.3.f

	category = enactment

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_police_breaking_door"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOR = {
			has_modifier = free_speech_censorship_stall
			has_modifier = free_speech_censorship_stall_fail
			has_modifier = free_speech_censorship_stall_success
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_right_of_assembly
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_protected_speech
			}
			OR = {
				has_law = law_type:law_censorship
				has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
			}
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			law_stance = {
				law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
				value < neutral
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
    		save_scope_as = current_law_scope
    	}
    	random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				law_stance = {
					law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = book_burning_ig
    	}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = {
		name = free_speech_laws.3.a
		default_option = yes
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = free_speech_censorship_stall
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = free_speech_laws.3.b
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = free_speech_censorship_stall_success
		}
		scope:book_burning_ig ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = free_speech_censorship_stall_success_ig
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

	type = country_event

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_journal_entry = je_cement_the_rightful_dynasty
		var:french_dynastic_primary_progress_var < 100
		OR = {
			has_variable = orleanist_restoration_var
			has_variable = legitimist_restoration_var
			has_variable = bonapartist_restoration_var
		}
		ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
		}
		ig:ig_devout ?= {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
		}
	}
	immediate = {

	}
	option = { # Praise the rural folk
		name = french_pretenders.4.a
		default_option = yes

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = french_dynastic_progress_increase_small
			change_variable = {
				name = french_dynastic_primary_progress_var
				add = 5
			}
		}
		ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = backbone_of_the_real_country_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = orleanist_restoration_var

					leader = {
						NOT = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist }
					}
				}
			}

				leader = {
					set_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = legitimist_restoration_var
				ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
					leader = {
						NOT = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist }
					}
				}
			}
			ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
				leader = {
					set_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = bonapartist_restoration_var
				ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
					leader = {
						NOT = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist }
					}
				}
			}
			ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
				leader = {
					set_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # Praise the clergy

french_pretenders.5 = { # Startup event
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = french_pretenders.5.t
	desc = french_pretenders.5.d
	flavor = french_pretenders.5.f

	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:french_monarch

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/2Characters"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = french_pretender_startup_var }
	}
	immediate = {
		set_variable = french_pretender_startup_var
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = french_monarch
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
			}
			save_scope_as = bonapartist_character
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
			}
			save_scope_as = orleanist_character
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
			}
			save_scope_as = legitimist_character
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = reflexive_reference_france
		}
	}
	option = { # Support Bonapartism
		name = french_pretenders.5.a
		set_variable = chose_initial_french_dynasty
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = supporting_bonapartist_tt
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = supporting_orleanist_var
			}
			remove_variable = supporting_orleanist_var
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = supporting_legitimist_var
			}
			remove_variable = supporting_legitimist_var
		}

french_pretenders.6 = { # Second Republic
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = french_pretenders.6.t
	desc = french_pretenders.6.d
	flavor = french_pretenders.6.f

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_realist_household"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by JE
	}
	immediate = {
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = old_ruler_scope
		}
		springtime_save_conservative_laws = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_right_of_assembly
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_right_of_assembly
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_national_guard
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_national_guard
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_hereditary_bureaucrats
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_appointed_bureaucrats
		}
		set_variable = had_springtime_revolution
		scope:old_ruler_scope ?= {
			exile_character_with_martyrdom = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = french_pretenders.6.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = exile_old_ruler_tt
		}
		set_variable = france_had_revolution
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_presidential_republic
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			leader = {
				set_character_as_ruler = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_voting_franchise = yes
				in_election_campaign = no
			}
			call_election = {
				months = 3
			}
		}
		trigger_event = { id = peoples_springtime.10 days = 7 popup = yes }
	}
}

# The [Dynasty] World
french_pretenders_pulse.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = french_pretenders_pulse.1.t
	desc = french_pretenders_pulse.1.d
	flavor = french_pretenders_pulse.1.f

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"
	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:french_royalist_writer

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_interest_group = {
			leader = {
				NOT = { has_modifier = popular_royalist_writer }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
						owner = {
							has_variable = orleanist_restoration_var
						}
					}
					AND = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
						owner = {
							has_variable = legitimist_restoration_var
						}
					}
					AND = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						owner = {
							has_variable = bonapartist_restoration_var
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_trait = charismatic
					has_trait = inspirational_orator
					has_trait = demagogue
					has_trait = firebrand
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					NOT = { has_modifier = popular_royalist_writer }
					OR = {
						AND = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
							owner = {
								has_variable = orleanist_restoration_var
							}
						}
						AND = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
							owner = {
								has_variable = legitimist_restoration_var
							}
						}
						AND = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
							owner = {
								has_variable = bonapartist_restoration_var
							}
						}
					}
					OR = {
						has_trait = charismatic
						has_trait = inspirational_orator
						has_trait = demagogue
						has_trait = firebrand
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = french_royalist_writer_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = french_royalist_writer
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.1.a
		default_option = yes

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = french_pretenders_pulse_advance_by_fifteen_percent_tt
			change_variable = {
				name = french_dynastic_primary_progress_var
				add = 18
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.1.b
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_censorship
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = french_pretenders_pulse_advance_by_twenty_five_percent_tt
			change_variable = {
				name = french_dynastic_primary_progress_var
				add = 30
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.1.c
		scope:french_royalist_writer = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = popular_royalist_writer
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = popular_royalist_book
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = french_pretenders_pulse_advance_by_five_percent_tt
			change_variable = {
				name = french_dynastic_primary_progress_var
				add = 6
			}
		}
	}
}

french_pretenders_pulse.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = french_pretenders_pulse.2.t
	desc = french_pretenders_pulse.2.d
	flavor = french_pretenders_pulse.2.f

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_monarch_holding_court"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_election.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			has_variable = fra_divided_monarchists_freeze
		}
		OR = {
			AND = {
				ruler_is_bonapartist = yes
				any_interest_group = {
					is_in_government = yes
					NOT = { has_modifier = upset_royalist_hardliners }
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				ruler_is_orleanist = yes
				any_interest_group = {
					is_in_government = yes
					NOT = { has_modifier = upset_royalist_hardliners }
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				ruler_is_legitimist = yes
				any_interest_group = {
					is_in_government = yes
					NOT = { has_modifier = upset_royalist_hardliners }
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				ruler_is_bonapartist = yes
				any_interest_group = {
					is_in_government = yes
					NOT = { has_modifier = upset_royalist_hardliners }
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					is_in_government = yes
					NOT = { has_modifier = upset_royalist_hardliners }
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = royalist_hardliners
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ruler_is_orleanist = yes
				any_interest_group = {
					is_in_government = yes
					NOT = { has_modifier = upset_royalist_hardliners }
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					is_in_government = yes
					NOT = { has_modifier = upset_royalist_hardliners }
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = royalist_hardliners
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ruler_is_legitimist = yes
				any_interest_group = {
					is_in_government = yes
					NOT = { has_modifier = upset_royalist_hardliners }
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					is_in_government = yes
					NOT = { has_modifier = upset_royalist_hardliners }
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = royalist_hardliners
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.2.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:royalist_hardliners = {
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = bonapartist_progress_increase_10_tt
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
				add_progress = { value = 10 name = divided_monarchists_bonapartist_progress_bar }
			}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:royalist_hardliners = {
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = orleanist_progress_increase_10_tt
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
				add_progress = { value = 10 name = divided_monarchists_orleanist_progress_bar }
			}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:royalist_hardliners = {
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = legitimist_progress_increase_10_tt
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
				add_progress = { value = 10 name = divided_monarchists_legitimist_progress_bar }
			}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.2.b
		scope:royalist_hardliners = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = upset_royalist_hardliners
				days = normal_modifier_time

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_election.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			has_variable = fra_divided_monarchists_freeze
		}
		has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
		OR = {
			AND = {
				any_interest_group = {
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist }
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					is_in_government = no
					NOR = {
						has_modifier = solidarity_in_opposition
						has_modifier = alone_with_principles
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					ruler_is_orleanist = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				any_interest_group = {
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist }
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					is_in_government = no
					NOR = {
						has_modifier = solidarity_in_opposition
						has_modifier = alone_with_principles
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					ruler_is_legitimist = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				any_interest_group = {
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist }
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					is_in_government = no
					NOR = {
						has_modifier = solidarity_in_opposition
						has_modifier = alone_with_principles
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					ruler_is_bonapartist = yes
				}
			}
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			is_in_government = no
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			AND = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_presidential_republic
					value > neutral
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
					value > neutral
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_monarchy
					value < neutral
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist }
						is_in_government = no
						ig_counts_as_marginal = no
						NOT = {
							owner = {
								ruler_is_orleanist = yes
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist }
						is_in_government = no
						ig_counts_as_marginal = no
						NOT = {
							owner = {
								ruler_is_legitimist = yes
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist }
						is_in_government = no
						ig_counts_as_marginal = no
						NOT = {
							owner = {
								ruler_is_bonapartist = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = monarchists_in_opposition
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_in_government = no
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				AND = {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_presidential_republic
						value > neutral
					}
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
						value > neutral
					}
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_monarchy
						value < neutral
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = republicans_in_opposition
		}
	}


	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.3.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:monarchists_in_opposition.leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = bonapartist_progress_increase_10_tt
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
				add_progress = { value = 10 name = divided_monarchists_bonapartist_progress_bar }
			}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:monarchists_in_opposition.leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = orleanist_progress_increase_10_tt
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
				add_progress = { value = 10 name = divided_monarchists_orleanist_progress_bar }
			}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:monarchists_in_opposition.leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = legitimist_progress_increase_10_tt
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
				add_progress = { value = 10 name = divided_monarchists_legitimist_progress_bar }
			}
			}
		}
		scope:monarchists_in_opposition = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = solidarity_in_opposition
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			leader = {
				set_variable = monarchist_working_with_republicans
			}
		}
		scope:republicans_in_opposition = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = solidarity_in_opposition
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			leader = {
				set_variable = republican_working_with_monarchists
			}
		}
	}


	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.3.b

		scope:monarchists_in_opposition = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = alone_with_principles
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:republicans_in_opposition = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = alone_with_principles
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.3.c
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:monarchists_in_opposition.leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = bonapartist_progress_decrease_10_tt
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
					add_progress = { value = -10 name = divided_monarchists_bonapartist_progress_bar }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:monarchists_in_opposition.leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = orleanist_progress_decrease_10_tt
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
					add_progress = { value = -10 name = divided_monarchists_orleanist_progress_bar }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:monarchists_in_opposition.leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = legitimist_progress_decrease_10_tt
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
					add_progress = { value = -10 name = divided_monarchists_legitimist_progress_bar }
				}
			}
		}
		scope:monarchists_in_opposition = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = collaboration_collapsed
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:republicans_in_opposition = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = collaboration_collapsed
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

# Republican Apostasy
french_pretenders_pulse.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = french_pretenders_pulse.4.t
	desc = french_pretenders_pulse.4.d
	flavor = french_pretenders_pulse.4.f

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_monarch_holding_court"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	trigger = {
		var:french_dynastic_primary_progress_var > 5 # sanity check to prevent negative values from the options
		any_interest_group = {
			is_in_government = yes
			OR = {
				AND = {
					leader = {
						has_variable = monarchist_working_with_republicans
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
					}
					owner = {
						has_variable = orleanist_restoration_var
					}
				}
				AND = {
					leader = {
						has_variable = monarchist_working_with_republicans
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
					}
					owner = {
						has_variable = legitimist_restoration_var
					}
				}
				AND = {
					leader = {
						has_variable = monarchist_working_with_republicans
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
					}
					owner = {
						has_variable = bonapartist_restoration_var
					}
				}
			}
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			leader = {
				has_variable = republican_working_with_monarchists
				is_busy = no
				is_immortal = no
			}
			AND = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_presidential_republic
					value > neutral
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
					value > neutral
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_monarchy
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			OR = { # only pick IGs that are valid for both republicanism and the monarchist ideologies
				is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
				is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_in_government = yes
				OR = {
					AND = {
						leader = {
							has_variable = monarchist_working_with_republicans
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
						}
						owner = {
							has_variable = orleanist_restoration_var
						}
					}
					AND = {
						leader = {
							has_variable = monarchist_working_with_republicans
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
						}
						owner = {
							has_variable = legitimist_restoration_var
						}
					}
					AND = {
						leader = {
							has_variable = monarchist_working_with_republicans
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
						owner = {
							has_variable = bonapartist_restoration_var
						}
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = monarchist_french_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = monarchist_french_ig_leader
			}
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					has_variable = republican_working_with_monarchists
					is_busy = no
					is_immortal = no
				}
				AND = {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_presidential_republic
						value > neutral
					}
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
						value > neutral
					}
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_monarchy
						value < neutral
					}
				}
				OR = { # only pick IGs that are valid for both republicanism and the monarchist ideologies
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
					is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = republican_french_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = republican_french_ig_leader
			}
		}
	}


	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.4.a
		default_option = yes

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:monarchist_french_ig_leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
				}
			}
			scope:republican_french_ig_leader = {
				set_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:monarchist_french_ig_leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
				}
			}
			scope:republican_french_ig_leader = {
				set_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:monarchist_french_ig_leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
				}
			}
			scope:republican_french_ig_leader = {
				set_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
			}
		}


		custom_tooltip = {
			text = french_pretenders_pulse_advance_by_twenty_five_percent_tt
			change_variable = {
				name = french_dynastic_primary_progress_var
				add = 30
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.4.b

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = french_pretenders_pulse.4.b.tt
			hidden_effect = {
				scope:republican_french_ig_leader = {
					retire_character = yes
				}
			}
		}
		scope:republican_french_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = cryptomonarchists_in_our_ranks
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = french_pretenders_pulse_back_by_fifteen_percent_tt
			change_variable = {
				name = french_dynastic_primary_progress_var
				add = -18
			}
		}
	}
}

# The Eternal House of [house]
french_pretenders_pulse.5 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = french_pretenders_pulse.5.t
	desc = french_pretenders_pulse.5.d
	flavor = french_pretenders_pulse.5.f

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"
	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:monarch_of_france

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	# Triggered by completing the Cement the Dynasty JE

	immediate = {
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = monarch_of_france
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.5.a
		default_option = yes

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = french_pretenders_the_dynasty_is_secure
		}

		scope:monarch_of_france = {
			add_trait = special_character_restitutor_orbis
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.5.b

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = french_pretenders_the_dynasty_is_secure
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist }
						owner = { has_variable = orleanist_restoration_var }
					}
					AND = {
						leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist }
						owner = { has_variable = legitimist_restoration_var }
					}
					AND = {
						leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist }
						owner = { has_variable = bonapartist_restoration_var }
					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = stalwarts_of_the_restoration
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

# Bonapartists draw support from currently ongoing war.
french_pretenders_pulse.10 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = french_pretenders_pulse.10.t
	desc = french_pretenders_pulse.10.d
	flavor = french_pretenders_pulse.10.f

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_before_the_battle"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	cooldown = { days = short_modifier_time }

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			has_variable = fra_divided_monarchists_freeze
		}
		any_scope_character = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
		}
		any_scope_war = {
		    has_war_support = {
		        target = ROOT
		        value > 55
		    }
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
			}
			save_scope_as = bonapartist_character
		}
		capital = {
			save_scope_as = capital_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.10.a
		trigger = {
			ruler_is_bonapartist = yes
		}
		ruler = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_popular_french_monarch
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = bonapartist_progress_increase_10_tt
			je:je_divided_monarchists = {
				add_progress = { value = 10 name = divided_monarchists_bonapartist_progress_bar }
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.10.b
		default_option = yes
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_bonapartist_armed_forces_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = bonapartist_progress_increase_5_tt
			je:je_divided_monarchists = {
				add_progress = { value = 5 name = divided_monarchists_bonapartist_progress_bar }
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.10.c
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = bonapartist_progress_increase_15_tt
			je:je_divided_monarchists = {
				add_progress = { value = 15 name = divided_monarchists_bonapartist_progress_bar }
			}
		}
	}
}

	option = {

				name = modifier_legitimist_devout_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = legitimist_progress_increase_5_tt
			je:je_divided_monarchists = {
				add_progress = { value = 5 name = divided_monarchists_legitimist_progress_bar }
			}
