# Partisan IG leader endorses their preferred candidate
french_pretenders_pulse.13 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = french_pretenders_pulse.13.t
	desc = french_pretenders_pulse.13.d
	flavor = french_pretenders_pulse.13.f

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"
	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:partisan_character

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			has_variable = fra_divided_monarchists_freeze
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			AND = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				leader = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				AND = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_interest_group
			leader = {
				if = { # this is to ensure a character won't die during the event but an already immortal character doesn't lose immortality at the end of the event
					limit = {
						is_immortal = no # checks if the character isn't already immortal
					}
					set_character_immortal = yes # makes character immortal only until the end of this event
					set_variable = temp_immortality_pretenders_13
				}
				save_scope_as = partisan_character
			}
		}
		capital = {
			save_scope_as = capital_scope
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				exists = scope:partisan_character
			}
			scope:partisan_character = {
				is_character_alive = no
			}
			NOT = {
				exists = scope:relevant_interest_group
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.13.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:partisan_character = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = bonapartist_progress_increase_10_tt
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
				add_progress = { value = 10 name = divided_monarchists_bonapartist_progress_bar }
			}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:partisan_character = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = orleanist_progress_increase_10_tt
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
				add_progress = { value = 10 name = divided_monarchists_orleanist_progress_bar }
			}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:partisan_character = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = legitimist_progress_increase_10_tt
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
				add_progress = { value = 10 name = divided_monarchists_legitimist_progress_bar }
			}
			}
		}
		scope:partisan_character = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_reasonable_monarchist_partisan
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_variable = temp_immortality_pretenders_13
				}
			}
			scope:partisan_character = {
				hidden_effect = {
					set_character_immortal = no # sets character back to not immortal
					remove_variable = temp_immortality_pretenders_13
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.13.b
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:partisan_character = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = bonapartist_progress_increase_25_tt
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
					add_progress = { value = 25 name = divided_monarchists_bonapartist_progress_bar }
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = bonapartist_progress_decrease_tick_1_tt
				change_variable = { name = bonapartist_progress_from_effects add = -1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:partisan_character = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = orleanist_progress_increase_25_tt
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
					add_progress = { value = 25 name = divided_monarchists_orleanist_progress_bar }
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = orleanist_progress_decrease_tick_1_tt
				change_variable = { name = orleanist_progress_from_effects add = -1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:partisan_character = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = legitimist_progress_increase_25_tt
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
					add_progress = { value = 25 name = divided_monarchists_legitimist_progress_bar }
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = legitimist_progress_decrease_tick_1_tt
				change_variable = { name = legitimist_progress_from_effects add = -1 }
			}
		}
		if = {

# Opposition drags down leading party
french_pretenders_pulse.16 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = french_pretenders_pulse.16.t
	desc = french_pretenders_pulse.16.d
	flavor = french_pretenders_pulse.16.f

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_politicians_arguing"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	cooldown = { days = short_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			has_variable = fra_divided_monarchists_freeze
		}
		OR = {
			AND = {
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
					"scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_bonapartist_progress_bar)" > "scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_legitimist_progress_bar)"
					"scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_bonapartist_progress_bar)" > "scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_orleanist_progress_bar)"
				}
				any_interest_group = {
					is_in_government = yes
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
					"scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_orleanist_progress_bar)" > "scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_legitimist_progress_bar)"
					"scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_orleanist_progress_bar)" > "scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_bonapartist_progress_bar)"
				}
				any_interest_group = {
					is_in_government = yes
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
					"scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_legitimist_progress_bar)" > "scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_bonapartist_progress_bar)"
					"scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_legitimist_progress_bar)" > "scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_orleanist_progress_bar)"
				}
				any_interest_group = {
					is_in_government = yes
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
					"scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_bonapartist_progress_bar)" > "scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_legitimist_progress_bar)"
					"scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_bonapartist_progress_bar)" > "scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_orleanist_progress_bar)"
				}
				any_interest_group = {
					is_in_government = yes
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
				}
				save_scope_as = monarchist_leader
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					is_in_government = yes
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = monarchist_opposition
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
					"scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_orleanist_progress_bar)" > "scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_legitimist_progress_bar)"
					"scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_orleanist_progress_bar)" > "scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_bonapartist_progress_bar)"
				}
				any_interest_group = {
					is_in_government = yes
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
				}
				save_scope_as = monarchist_leader
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					is_in_government = yes
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = monarchist_opposition
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
					"scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_legitimist_progress_bar)" > "scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_bonapartist_progress_bar)"
					"scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_legitimist_progress_bar)" > "scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_orleanist_progress_bar)"
				}
				any_interest_group = {
					is_in_government = yes
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
				}
				save_scope_as = monarchist_leader
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					is_in_government = yes
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = monarchist_opposition
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.16.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				je:je_divided_monarchists = {
					"scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_bonapartist_progress_bar)" > "scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_legitimist_progress_bar)"
					"scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_bonapartist_progress_bar)" > "scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_orleanist_progress_bar)"
				}

					"scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_legitimist_progress_bar)" > "scripted_bar_progress(divided_monarchists_orleanist_progress_bar)"

			triggered_desc = {
				desc = french_pretenders_pulse.17.d1

					has_journal_entry = je_springtime_of_the_peoples

			}
		}
	}

	flavor = french_pretenders_pulse.18.f

		video = "southamerica_christianity"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	trigger = {
		game_date >= 1836.7.1
		NOT = {
			has_global_variable = charles_x_body_done
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		s:STATE_SLOVENIA ?= {
			random_scope_state = {
				owner = {
					save_scope_as = slovenia_owner_scope
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.18.a
		default_option = yes
		set_global_variable = charles_x_body_done
		add_loyalists = {
			value = small_radicals
			strata = middle
		}
	}

	option = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_variable = fra_divided_monarchists_freeze
			}
		}
		name = french_pretenders_pulse.18.b
		set_global_variable = charles_x_body_done
		capital = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = large_radicals
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = legitimist_progress_increase_40_tt
			je:je_divided_monarchists = {

﻿namespace = garibaldi_events

# Garibaldi Arrives
garibaldi_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	event_image = {
		video = "votp_garibaldi"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/bicorne_hat.dds"

	title = garibaldi_events.1.t
	desc = garibaldi_events.1.d
	flavor = garibaldi_events.1.f

	cooldown = { days = short_modifier_time }

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = voice_of_the_people_content
		year <= 1862 # Garibaldi was (sadly) not immortal
		NOT = {
			has_variable = rejected_garibaldi
		}
		NOT = {
			any_scope_character = {
				has_variable = garibaldi_var
			}
		}
		OR = { # Either Garibaldi is "dead" or he is an exile
			NOT = {
				has_global_variable = garibaldi_is_alive_global_var
			}
			any_character_in_exile_pool = {
				has_variable = garibaldi_var
			}
		}
		OR = {
			AND = { # You're a nation fighting the good cause (defensive war OR democratically-inclined revolution/secession)
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_anarchy
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_census_voting
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_wealth_voting
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_landed_voting
				}
				OR = {
					AND = {
						OR = {
							is_revolutionary = yes
							is_secessionist = yes
						}
						any_diplomatic_play = {
							is_war = yes
							initiator = root
							target = {
								OR = {
									has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_autocracy
									has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_oligarchy
									has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_single_party_state
								}
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						any_diplomatic_play = {
							is_war = yes
							target = root
							initiator = {
								is_secessionist = no
								# Garibaldi should only care to get involved defensively against significant revolutions
								OR = {
									is_revolutionary = no
									country_rank >= rank_value:major_power
								}
								# Garibaldi shouldn't be in the business of defending big powers against small ones
								OR = {
									is_revolutionary = yes
									country_rank >= root.country_rank
								}
								OR = {
									has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_autocracy
									has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_oligarchy
									has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_single_party_state
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			AND = { # You're fighting for Italy
				any_diplomatic_play = {
					is_war = yes
					OR = {
						AND = {
							initiator = {
								any_primary_culture = {
									has_discrimination_trait = heritage_italic
								}
								this = root
							}
							target = {
								NOT = {
									any_primary_culture = {
										has_discrimination_trait = heritage_italic
									}
								}
								any_scope_state = {
									state_region = {
										OR = {
											is_homeland = cu:north_italian
											is_homeland = cu:south_italian
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
						AND = {
							initiator = {
								any_primary_culture = {
									has_discrimination_trait = heritage_italic
								}
								this = root
								is_secessionist = yes
							}
						}
						AND = {
							target = {
								any_primary_culture = {
									has_discrimination_trait = heritage_italic
								}
								this = root
							}
							initiator = {
								NOT = {
									any_primary_culture = {
										has_discrimination_trait = heritage_italic
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			AND = { # You're fighting the Ragamuffin War against Brazil
				c:PNI ?= this
				year <= 1839
				any_diplomatic_play = {
					is_war = yes
					any_scope_play_involved = {
						c:BRZ ?= this
						has_war_with = root
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_character = {
						has_variable = garibaldi_var
					}
				}
			}
			create_character = {
				template = garibaldi_character_template
				on_created = {
					set_variable = garibaldi_var
					set_variable = {
						name = garibaldi_cooldown_var
						days = short_modifier_time
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = garibaldi_scope
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			random_character_in_exile_pool = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = garibaldi_var
				}
				transfer_character = root
				save_scope_as = garibaldi_scope
				set_variable = {
					name = garibaldi_cooldown_var
					days = short_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = global_var:garibaldi_fame_var }
			change_global_variable = {
				name = garibaldi_fame_var
				add = 1
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_global_variable = {
				name = garibaldi_fame_var
				value = 1
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_diplomatic_play = {
					is_war = yes
					target = root
				}
			}
			random_diplomatic_play = {
				limit = {
					is_war = yes
					target = root
				}
				initiator = {
					save_scope_as = garibaldi_spawn_foe_scope
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_diplomatic_play = {
					is_war = yes
					initiator = root
				}
			}
			random_diplomatic_play = {
				limit = {
					is_war = yes
					initiator = root
				}
				target = {
					save_scope_as = garibaldi_spawn_foe_scope
				}
			}
		}
		save_scope_as = garibaldi_new_home
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				exists = scope:garibaldi_scope
			}
			scope:garibaldi_scope = {
				is_character_alive = no
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = garibaldi_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:garibaldi_scope ?= {
			add_character_role = general
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:garibaldi_fame_var = 1
				scope:garibaldi_scope ?= {
					NOT = {
						has_modifier = garibaldi_popularity_modifier_tier_1
					}
				}
			}
			scope:garibaldi_scope ?= {
				add_modifier = garibaldi_popularity_modifier_tier_1
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:garibaldi_fame_var = 2
				scope:garibaldi_scope ?= {
					NOT = {
						has_modifier = garibaldi_popularity_modifier_tier_2
					}
				}
			}
			scope:garibaldi_scope ?= {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = garibaldi_popularity_modifier_tier_1
					}
					hidden_effect = {
						remove_modifier = garibaldi_popularity_modifier_tier_1
					}
				}
				add_modifier = garibaldi_popularity_modifier_tier_2
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:garibaldi_fame_var = 3
				scope:garibaldi_scope ?= {
					NOT = {
						has_modifier = garibaldi_popularity_modifier_tier_3
					}
				}
			}
			scope:garibaldi_scope ?= {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = garibaldi_popularity_modifier_tier_2
					}
					hidden_effect = {
						remove_modifier = garibaldi_popularity_modifier_tier_2
					}
				}
				add_modifier = garibaldi_popularity_modifier_tier_3
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:garibaldi_fame_var = 4
				scope:garibaldi_scope ?= {
					NOT = {
						has_modifier = garibaldi_popularity_modifier_tier_4
					}
				}
			}
			scope:garibaldi_scope ?= {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = garibaldi_popularity_modifier_tier_3
					}
					hidden_effect = {
						remove_modifier = garibaldi_popularity_modifier_tier_3
					}
				}
				add_modifier = garibaldi_popularity_modifier_tier_4
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:garibaldi_fame_var >= 5
				scope:garibaldi_scope ?= {
					NOT = {
						has_modifier = garibaldi_popularity_modifier_tier_5
					}
				}
			}
			scope:garibaldi_scope ?= {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = garibaldi_popularity_modifier_tier_4
					}
					hidden_effect = {
						remove_modifier = garibaldi_popularity_modifier_tier_4
					}
				}
				add_modifier = garibaldi_popularity_modifier_tier_5
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:garibaldi_fame_var >= 2
				scope:garibaldi_scope ?= {
					has_trait = basic_offensive_planner
				}
			}
			scope:garibaldi_scope ?= {
				random_list = {
					50 = {
						hidden_effect = {
							remove_trait = basic_offensive_planner
						}
						add_trait = experienced_offensive_planner
					}
					50 = {
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:garibaldi_fame_var >= 4
				scope:garibaldi_scope ?= {
					has_trait = experienced_offensive_planner
				}
			}
			scope:garibaldi_scope ?= {
				random_list = {
					50 = {
						hidden_effect = {
							remove_trait = experienced_offensive_planner
						}
						add_trait = expert_offensive_planner
					}
					50 = {
					}
				}
			}
		}

		every_country = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					ROOT = {
						is_player = yes
					}
					has_diplomatic_relevance = ROOT
					has_variable = garibaldi_has_been_here
				}
			}
			post_notification = garibaldi_is_here
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = garibaldi_has_been_here }
				}
				set_variable = garibaldi_has_been_here
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = garibaldi_events.1.b
		set_variable = rejected_garibaldi
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					OR = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
						is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
						is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
						is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
						is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
					}
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_social_democrat
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
						}
					}
				}
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
						is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
						is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
						is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
						is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
					}
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_social_democrat
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
						}
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = rejected_garibaldi_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_variable = garibaldi_var
				}
			}
			scope:garibaldi_scope ?= {
				exile_character = yes
				clean_up_exile_character_roles = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

				limit = {
					is_war = yes
					initiator = root
				}
				target = {
					save_scope_as = italian_legion_foe_scope
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			any_scope_character = {
				has_variable = garibaldi_var
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = garibaldi_events.3.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:garibaldi_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = italian_legionaries_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {

			save_scope_as = garibaldi_peasants_state_scope
		}
		random_diplomatic_play = {
			limit = {
				is_war = yes
				any_scope_play_involved = {
					has_war_with = root
				}
			}
			random_scope_play_involved = {
				limit = {
					has_war_with = root
				}
				save_scope_as = garibaldi_peasants_foe_scope
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			any_scope_character = {
				has_variable = garibaldi_var
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = garibaldi_events.4.a
		default_option = yes
		ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = emboldened_peasantry_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:garibaldi_peasants_state_scope = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				pop_type = farmers
				value = small_radicals
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = garibaldi_events.4.b
		highlighted_option = yes
		random_list = {
			80 = {
				scope:garibaldi_scope = {
					exile_character_with_role_cleanup = yes
				}
				set_variable = rejected_garibaldi
			}
			20 = {
			}
		}
	}
}

					commander_rank >= 3
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no

			}

				any_scope_character = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					popularity >= 50
					commander_rank <= 3
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				}
				any_scope_character = {
					has_role_of_type = general

					is_ruler_of_own_country = no

				}
			}

					has_role_of_type = general

					save_scope_as = low_rank_general_ig
				}

			random_scope_character = {

					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				}

					commander_rank >= 4
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					popularity >= 50
					commander_rank <= 3
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = low_rank_general
				interest_group ?= {
					save_scope_as = low_rank_general_ig
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					commander_rank >= 4
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = high_rank_general
				interest_group ?= {
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { THIS = scope:low_rank_general_ig }
						}
						save_scope_as = high_rank_general_ig
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_role_of_type = general

					commander_rank <= 2

﻿namespace = german_unification

# North/South German Confederation
german_unification.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = german_unification.1.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = german_unification.1.d1
				trigger = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_german
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = german_unification.1.d2
				trigger = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
				}
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = german_unification.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_signed_contract"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = je_german_confederate_unifier

		every_country_in_german_confederation = {
			limit = {
				country_rank < rank_value:great_power
				OR = {
					AND = {
						root = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_german }
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_german
					}
					AND = {
						root = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german }
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
					}
				}
				NOR = {
					THIS = ROOT
					is_subject_type = subject_type_colony
					is_subject_type = subject_type_dominion
					is_subject_type = subject_type_chartered_company
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = yes
					OR = {
						is_in_customs_union_with = root
						is_supporting_unification_candidate = { who = root country_formation = GER }
					}
				}
				root = { annex_with_incorporation = prev }
			}
			else = {
				trigger_event = { id = german_unification.2 days = 0 popup = yes }
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = german_unification.1.a
		default_option = yes
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_in_government = yes
			}
			leader = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = german_unification_popularity
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_german
				NOT = { exists = c:NGF }
				OR = {
					country_tier = kingdom
					country_tier = principality
				}
			}

			# Reconcile with Austria if we didn't conquer states from them or release any crucial territories
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = c:AUS
						c:AUS ?= {
							country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
							NOT = { has_claim = root }
							owns_entire_state_region = STATE_BOHEMIA
							owns_entire_state_region = STATE_CENTRAL_HUNGARY
							owns_entire_state_region = STATE_LOMBARDY
						}
					}

					c:AUS ?= {
						set_mutual_secret_goal = {
							country = root
							secret_goal = reconcile
						}
					}
				}
			}

			change_tag = NGF
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
				NOT = { exists = c:SGF }
				OR = {
					country_tier = kingdom
					country_tier = principality
				}
			}
			change_tag = SGF
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = german_unification.1.b
		add_modifier = {
			name = partial_german_unification_influence_prestige
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_german
				NOT = { exists = c:NGF }
				OR = {
					country_tier = kingdom
					country_tier = principality
				}
			}
			change_tag = NGF
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
				NOT = { exists = c:SGF }
				OR = {
					NOT = { exists = c:AUS }
					NOT = { c:AUS ?= THIS }
				}
				OR = {
					country_tier = kingdom
					country_tier = principality
				}
			}
			change_tag = SGF
		}
	}
}

	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = german_unification.2.t
	desc = german_unification.2.d
	flavor = german_unification.2.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_signed_contract"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	duration = 3

	immediate = {
		random_country = {
			limit = { is_unification_candidate = GER }
			save_scope_as = german_unification_candidate
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = german_unification.2.a
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				is_subject = no
				is_subject_of = scope:german_unification_candidate
			}
		}
		scope:german_unification_candidate = { annex_with_incorporation = root }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 9
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = german_unification.2.b
		default_option = yes
		add_radicals = {
			value = medium_radicals
			culture = cu:south_german
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = medium_radicals
			culture = cu:north_german
		}
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:german_unification_candidate
			value = -50
		}
		every_scope_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_claim_by = scope:german_unification_candidate }
				}
			}
			state_region = {
				add_claim = scope:german_unification_candidate
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:german_unification_candidate = {
				set_secret_goal = {
					country = root
					secret_goal = conquer
				}
			}
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
}

﻿namespace = goldrush

goldrush.1 = { #gold rush in state. Gold Discovery itself is a notification.
	type = state_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = goldrush.1.t
	desc = goldrush.1.d
	flavor = goldrush.1.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }  #State Cooldown

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_gold_prospectors"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_trade.dds"

	trigger = {
		has_building = building_gold_field #A gold rush is triggered when gold is discovered where there already is some gold.
		owner = {  #If these top two are true, will do hidden event goldrush.6. The last is the National cooldown
			NOR = {
				has_variable = gold_always_exploit
				has_variable = gold_always_attract
			}
			NOT = { has_variable = goldrush_active}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = gold_rush_state #Allows gold rush ended events
		save_scope_as = goldrush_state
		owner = {
			save_scope_as = goldrush_country
			set_variable = {
				name = goldrush_active
				days = very_long_modifier_time #National Cooldown. Not every discovery leads to a gold rush.
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #move everyone there
		name = goldrush.1.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = state_gold_rush
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { #exploit it
		name = goldrush.1.b
		add_modifier = {
			name = state_gold_rush_less_migration
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = state_gold_rush_exploitation
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { #always attract people
		name = goldrush.1.c
		add_modifier = {
			name = state_gold_rush
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = gold_always_attract_tt
			owner = {
				set_variable = gold_always_attract
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #always exploit it.
		name = goldrush.1.e
		add_modifier = {
			name = state_gold_rush_less_migration
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = state_gold_rush_exploitation
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = gold_always_exploit_tt
			owner = {
				set_variable = gold_always_exploit
			}
		}
	}
}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_trade.dds"

	trigger = { #Triggered by resources depleted
		has_variable = gold_rush_state
		owner = {
			NOR = { #If these are true, will do hidden event goldrush.7
				has_variable = gold_always_let_go
				has_variable = gold_always_make_stay
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = goldrush_no_more_state
		owner = {
			save_scope_as = goldrush_country
		}
		remove_variable = gold_rush_state
	}

	option = { #let them go
		name = goldrush.2.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = state_gold_rush
			}
			remove_modifier = state_gold_rush
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = state_gold_depleted
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { #try to retain them
		name = goldrush.2.b
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = state_gold_rush
			}
			remove_modifier = state_gold_rush
		}
		add_radicals_in_state = {
			pop_type = laborers
			value = very_large_radicals
		}
	}

	option = { #always let them go
		name = goldrush.2.c
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = state_gold_rush
			}
			remove_modifier = state_gold_rush
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = state_gold_depleted
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = gold_always_let_go_tt
			owner = {
				set_variable = gold_always_let_go
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #always try to retain them
		name = goldrush.2.e
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = state_gold_rush
			}
			remove_modifier = state_gold_rush
		}
		add_radicals_in_state = {
			pop_type = laborers
			value = very_large_radicals
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = gold_always_make_stay_tt
			owner = {
				set_variable = gold_always_make_stay
			}
		}
	}
}

goldrush.3 = { #foreign influx provokes outcry
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = goldrush.3.t
	desc = goldrush.3.d
	flavor = goldrush.3.f

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_gold_prospectors"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			has_modifier = state_gold_rush
		}
		OR = {
			ig:ig_landowners ?= {
				is_powerful = yes
			}
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				is_powerful = yes
			}
			ig:ig_devout ?= {
				is_powerful = yes
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = state_gold_rush
			}
			save_scope_as = pb_gold_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_landowners ?= {
					is_powerful = yes
				}
			}
			ig:ig_landowners ?= {
				save_scope_as = petty_ig
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_devout ?= {
					is_powerful = yes
				}
			}
			ig:ig_devout ?= {
				save_scope_as = petty_ig
			}
		}
		else = {
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				save_scope_as = petty_ig
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #we need them
		name = goldrush.3.a
		default_option = yes
		ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = pb_angry_at_foreign_miners
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #limit migration
		name = goldrush.3.b
		scope:pb_gold_state = {
			remove_modifier = state_gold_rush
			add_modifier = {
				name = state_limited_gold_rush
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

goldrush.4 = { #miners get organized
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = goldrush.4.t
	desc = goldrush.4.d
	flavor = goldrush.4.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "ip4_mining_scene"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			OR = {
				has_modifier = state_gold_rush
				has_modifier = state_limited_gold_rush
			}
		}
		NOR = {
			ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
				has_modifier = tu_mining_syndicates_formed
			}
			ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
				has_modifier = in_mining_conglomerates_formed
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_modifier = state_gold_rush
					has_modifier = state_limited_gold_rush
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = gr4_gold_state
		}
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			save_scope_as = trade_unions_ig
		}
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			save_scope_as = industrialists_ig
		}
	}

	option = { #trade unions
		name = goldrush.4.a
		default_option = yes
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = tu_mining_syndicates_formed
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = in_disrupted_paradigms
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #industralists
		name = goldrush.4.b
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = in_mining_conglomerates_formed
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = tu_miners_exploited
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

# The COUNTRY_ADJ Dream
goldrush.5 = {
	type = state_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = goldrush.5.t
	desc = goldrush.5.d
	flavor = goldrush.5.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time } #applies to state

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_gold_prospectors"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	trigger = {
		has_variable = gold_rush_state #must fire in gold rush state
		owner = {
			NOT = {
				has_variable = goldrush_dream_fired #only fires once
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = gold_rush_state
		owner = {
			save_scope_as = owner_country_scope
			set_variable = {
				name = goldrush_dream_fired
				days = stupidly_long_modifier_time #national cooldown
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #worrying
		name = goldrush.5.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = expecting_riches
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = expecting_riches_forever
			days = long_modifier_time
			multiplier = 2
		}
	}

	option = { #tell them to tone it down
		name = goldrush.5.b
		add_modifier = {
			name = expecting_riches_angry
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = expecting_riches_forever
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
	}
}

goldrush.6 = { #hidden event that does the effects if the player chooses to always exploit or always extract
	type = state_event
	hidden = yes

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time } #state cooldown

	trigger = {
		has_building = building_gold_field
		owner = {
			OR = {
				has_variable = gold_always_exploit
				has_variable = gold_always_attract
			}
			NOT = {
				has_variable = goldrush_active
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = gold_rush_state #Allows gold rush ended events
		save_scope_as = goldrush_state
		#Notification is done directly in on-action
		owner = {
			save_scope_as = goldrush_country
			set_variable = {
				name = goldrush_active
				days = very_long_modifier_time #National Cooldown. Not every discovery leads to a gold rush.
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = gold_always_exploit
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = state_gold_rush_less_migration
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = state_gold_rush_exploitation
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = state_gold_rush
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

goldrush.7 = { #hidden event that does the effects if the player chooses to always let the people go or always keep them in. Triggered by resource depleted.
	type = state_event
	hidden = yes
	trigger = {
		has_variable = gold_rush_state
		owner = {
			OR = {
				has_variable = gold_always_let_go
				has_variable = gold_always_make_stay
			}
		}
	}

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }#state cooldown

	immediate = {
		#notification is handled by on_actions
		save_scope_as = goldrush_state
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = state_gold_rush
			}
			remove_modifier = state_gold_rush
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = gold_always_let_go
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = state_gold_depleted
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				pop_type = laborers
				value = very_large_radicals
			}
		}
	}
}

# "Breeding and Education"
government_conflicts.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = government_conflicts.1.t
	desc = government_conflicts.1.d
	flavor = government_conflicts.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_capitalists_meeting"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_election.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_ruling_interest_group = ig_landowners
		has_ruling_interest_group = ig_intelligentsia
		NOR = {
			has_modifier = government_conflict
			any_interest_group = {
				has_modifier = disfavored_in_government
			}
			has_variable = ongoing_government_conflicts
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = ongoing_government_conflicts
			months = 3
		}
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			save_scope_as = landowners_ig
		}
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			save_scope_as = intelligentsia_ig
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = government_conflicts.1.a
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = disfavored_in_government
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						c:FRA ?= this
						has_journal_entry = je_divided_monarchists
					}
				}
				fra_disfavor_leader_ig_dynasty = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = government_conflicts.1.b
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = disfavored_in_government
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						c:FRA ?= this
						has_journal_entry = je_divided_monarchists
					}
				}
				fra_disfavor_leader_ig_dynasty = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = government_conflicts.1.c
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = government_conflict
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}
}

government_conflicts.6 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = government_conflicts.6.t
	desc = government_conflicts.6.d
	flavor = government_conflicts.6.f

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_middleclass_cafe"

﻿namespace = government_petition_events

government_petition_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	event_image = {
		trigger = {
			var:government_petition_variant = 1
		}
		video = "europenorthamerica_capitalists_meeting"
	}
	event_image = {
		trigger = {
			var:government_petition_variant = 2
		}
		video = "unspecific_ruler_speaking_to_people"
	}
	event_image = {
		trigger = {
			var:government_petition_variant = 3
		}
		video = "asia_politician_parliament_motion"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_scales.dds"

	title = government_petition_events.1.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = government_petition_events.1.d
				trigger = {
					has_variable = government_petition_variant
					var:government_petition_variant = 1
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = government_petition_events.1.d2
				trigger = {
					has_variable = government_petition_variant
					var:government_petition_variant = 2
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = government_petition_events.1.d3
				trigger = {
					has_variable = government_petition_variant
					var:government_petition_variant = 3
				}
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = government_petition_events.1.f
				trigger = {
					has_variable = government_petition_variant
					var:government_petition_variant = 1
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = government_petition_events.1.f2
				trigger = {
					has_variable = government_petition_variant
					var:government_petition_variant = 2
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = government_petition_events.1.f3
				trigger = {
					has_variable = government_petition_variant
					var:government_petition_variant = 3
				}
			}
		}
	}

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		#Triggered by JE
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
            limit = {
                is_in_government = yes
                ig_counts_as_marginal = no
                any_preferred_law = {
                    law_is_valid_for_ig_petition = yes
                }
            }
            save_scope_as = government_petition_ig
            ordered_preferred_law = {
                limit = {
					law_is_valid_for_ig_petition = yes
                }
                min = 0
                max = 2
                check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = government_petition_law
            }
			ordered_preferred_law = {
                limit = {
					law_is_valid_for_ig_petition = yes
					NOT = {
						scope:government_petition_law ?= THIS
					}
                }
                min = 1
                max = 3
                check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = government_petition_law_2
            }
			set_variable = { name = petitioning_ig days = 100 }
        }
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				set_variable = { name = government_petition_variant value = 1 }
			}
			4 = {
				trigger = {
					NAND = {  # Will not trigger twice in a row
						has_variable = government_petition_variant
						var:government_petition_variant = 2
					}
					scope:government_petition_ig ?= {
						ig_approval < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = government_petition_variant value = 2 }
			}
			4 = {
				trigger = {
					NAND = { # Will not trigger twice in a row
						has_variable = government_petition_variant
						var:government_petition_variant = 3
					}
					scope:government_petition_ig ?= { # Just in general a competent politician
						leader = {
							OR = {
								has_trait = basic_political_operator
								has_trait = experienced_political_operator
								has_trait = expert_political_operator
								has_trait = charismatic
								has_trait = inspirational_orator
								has_trait = firebrand
								has_trait = ambitious
								has_trait = persistent
							}
						}
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = government_petition_variant value = 3 }
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOR = {
			exists = scope:government_petition_ig
			exists = scope:government_petition_law
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = government_petition_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                exists = scope:government_petition_law
            }
            set_variable = { name = desired_law_var value = scope:government_petition_law }
        }
		custom_tooltip = government_petition_tt
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_government_petition
		}
		custom_tooltip = government_petition_active_warning_tt
		show_as_tooltip = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_active_government_petition
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = government_petition_events.1.b
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:government_petition_law_2
		}
        if = {
            limit = {
                exists = scope:government_petition_law_2
            }
            set_variable = { name = desired_law_var value = scope:government_petition_law_2 }
        }
		custom_tooltip = government_petition_2_tt
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_government_petition
		}
		custom_tooltip = government_petition_active_warning_tt
		show_as_tooltip = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_active_government_petition
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = government_petition_events.1.c1
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				scope:government_petition_ig = {
					has_variable = government_petition_rejected
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = government_petition_blown_off_tt
		scope:government_petition_ig = {
			set_variable = { name = government_petition_rejected years = 20 }
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_petition_rejected_legitimacy
			days = normal_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
		}
		scope:government_petition_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_petition_rejected_ig_opinion
				days = normal_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = government_petition_events.1.c2
		trigger = {
			scope:government_petition_ig = {
				has_variable = government_petition_rejected
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = government_petition_blown_off_2_tt
		scope:government_petition_ig = {
			set_variable = { name = government_petition_rejected years = 20 }
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_petition_rejected_legitimacy
			days = normal_modifier_time
			multiplier = 3
			is_decaying = yes
		}
		scope:government_petition_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_petition_rejected_ig_opinion
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = 4
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

namespace = government_collapse

government_collapse.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_courtroom_upheaval"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	title = government_collapse.1.t
	desc = government_collapse.1.d
	flavor = government_collapse.1.f

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		#Triggered by on_action
	}

	cooldown = { days = 91 }

	immediate = {
		random_active_party = {
			save_scope_as = relevant_party
		}
		ordered_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				has_party = yes
				is_in_government = no
				is_insurrectionary = yes
			}
			order_by = ig_clout
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = relevant_ig
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = government_collapse.1.a
		default_option = yes
		random_active_party = {
			disband_party = yes
		}
		scripted_effect_parties_disappearence = yes
		activate_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
	}
	option = {
		name = government_collapse.1.b
		trigger = {
			exists = currently_enacting_law
			scope:relevant_ig = {
				law_stance = {
					law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
					value < neutral
				}
			}
		}
		scope:relevant_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_last_minute_compromise
				days = short_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		cancel_enactment = yes
	}
}

exhibition_events.4 = { #The Exhibition caused controversy as its opening approached. Some conservatives feared that the mass of visitors might become a revolutionary mob

	type = country_event
	placement = root

	title = exhibition_events.4.t
	desc = exhibition_events.4.d
	flavor = exhibition_events.4.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_political_extremism"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			ig:ig_devout ?= {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
			ig:ig_landowners ?= {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = exhibition_controversy_var }
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_landowners ?= {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				}
			}
			ig:ig_landowners ?= {
				save_scope_as = conservative_ig
			}
		}
		else = {
			ig:ig_devout ?= {
				save_scope_as = conservative_ig
			}
		}
		capital = {
			save_scope_as = grand_exhibition_state
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = exhibition_controversy_var
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { #ignore them
		name = exhibition_events.4.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:conservative_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = ignored_conservatives_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #we should look into this
		name = exhibition_events.4.b
		custom_tooltip = exhibition_controversy_tt
		change_variable = {
			name = grand_exhibition_points_change
			add = -1
		}
	}
}

exhibition_events.5 = { #toilets event!
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	title = exhibition_events.5.t
	desc = exhibition_events.5.d
	flavor = exhibition_events.5.f
	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_world_fair"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = modern_sewerage
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
		}
		any_country = {
			is_country_alive = yes
			owner = {
				relations:root >= relations_threshold:amicable
				is_player = no
				NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = exhibition_toilets_var }
	}

	immediate = {
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			save_scope_as = anti_toilet_ig
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				owner = {
					relations:root >= relations_threshold:amicable
					is_player = no
					NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = visiting_country
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = exhibition_toilets_var
			value = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { #install them!
		name = exhibition_events.5.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = grand_exhibition_toilets_modifier #cost money
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_very_small
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		scope:anti_toilet_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = grand_exhibition_toilets_ig_modifier #disapprove
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		capital = {
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				value = 0.2
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #it's going to stink!
		name = exhibition_events.5.b
		capital = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = small_radicals
			}
		}
		scope:visiting_country = {
			change_relations = {
				country = ROOT
				value = -10
			}
		}
		scope:anti_toilet_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = grand_exhibition_toilets_no_ig_modifier #approve
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

﻿namespace = gran_colombia

#Gran Colombia start event
gran_colombia.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	title = gran_colombia.1.t
	desc = gran_colombia.1.d
	flavor = gran_colombia.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_ruler_speaking_to_people"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by JE
	}

	immediate = {
		root = {
			save_scope_as = colombia_seeker_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = gran_colombia.1.a
		default_option = yes
		random_country_in_north_andes = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
				OR = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_andean
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:venezuelan
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:colombian
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:ecuadorian
				}
			}
			ROOT = {
				create_incident = {
					country = PREV
					value = 10
				}
			}
		}
		every_state_region_in_north_andes = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_scope_state = {
						owner = ROOT
					}
				}
			}
			add_claim = ROOT
		}
		s:STATE_PASTAZA = {
			add_claim = ROOT
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_seeking_gran_colombia
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_journal_entry = je_caudillo
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = gain_large_caudillo_points
				je:je_caudillo ?= {
					add_progress = { value = 200 name = je_caudillo_progress_bar }
				}
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_andean
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:venezuelan
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:colombian
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:ecuadorian
					}
				}
				post_notification = gran_colombia_seeking_warning
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = gran_colombia.1.b
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
				OR = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_andean
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:venezuelan
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:colombian
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:ecuadorian
				}
			}
			change_relations = { country = ROOT value = 10 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_journal_entry = je_caudillo
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = lose_caudillo_points
				je:je_caudillo ?= {
					add_progress = { value = -100 name = je_caudillo_progress_bar }
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = gran_colombia_b_tt
			set_variable = rejected_gran_colombia
		}
	}
}

#Gran Colombia formation event
gran_colombia.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by JE
	}

	immediate = {
		root = {
			save_scope_as = gco_scope
		}
		cu:caribeno = {
			save_scope_as = caribeno_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = gran_colombia.2.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_founded_gran_colombia
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					THIS = ROOT
				}
				has_interest_marker_in_region = sr:region_gran_colombia
			}
			post_notification = gco_unification
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = gran_colombia.2.b
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:caribeno
			}
			change_relations = { country = ROOT value = 10 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = c:HAI
			}
			set_variable = haiti_friend
			c:HAI ?= {
				post_notification = gran_colombia_meddling_haiti
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = radicalise_haitian_caribenos_tt
					add_radicals = {
						value = very_large_radicals
						culture = cu:caribeno
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_founded_gran_colombia
			days = normal_modifier_time
			multiplier = 0.5
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					THIS = ROOT
				}
				has_interest_marker_in_region = sr:region_gran_colombia
			}
			post_notification = gco_unification
		}
	}
}

				}
			}

				limit = {
					NOT = { THIS = ROOT }

						country_has_primary_culture = cu:argentine
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:uruguayan
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:paraguayan

	}

	}

							owner = ROOT

					}
				}

					limit = {
						NOT = {
							owner = ROOT
						}
					}

						save_scope_as = thrace_owner
					}
				}
			}
		}
		s:STATE_EASTERN_THRACE = {
			random_scope_state = {
				save_scope_as = thrace_scope
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {

						}
					}
				}

						}
					}

					}
				}
			}
		}
		s:STATE_AYDIN = {

				save_scope_as = aydin_scope
			}
		}
		set_variable = byzantium_event_fired
	}

	option = {

		if = {

					OR = {
						owns_entire_state_region = STATE_MACEDONIA
						owns_entire_state_region = STATE_WESTERN_THRACE
						owns_entire_state_region = STATE_EAST_AEGEAN_ISLANDS
						owns_entire_state_region = STATE_CRETE
					}
				}
			}
			change_relations = {
				country = c:TUR
				value = -20
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_EASTERN_THRACE }
			}
			s:STATE_EASTERN_THRACE = {
				add_claim = ROOT
			}
		}
		if = {

				NOT = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_AYDIN }

				add_claim = ROOT
			}

				save_scope_as = ionian_overlord

					save_scope_as = ionian_overlord_capital
				}
			}
		}
		c:GRE ?= {
			save_scope_as = greek_country
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			exists = scope:ionian_overlord
		}
	}

			custom_tooltip = {
				text = ion_will_be_annexed
			}

				id = greece.3
				days = 0
				popup = yes
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = greece.6.b
		trigger = { # Player can choose the ahistorical option to reject the proposal.
			is_player = yes
		}
		scope:greek_country = {
			create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
				type = catalyst_event_negative
				target = root
			}
			post_notification = ion_proposal_rejected_message
		}
		change_infamy = 5
	}
}

hawaii_events.2 = { #JE success
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = hawaii_events.2.t
	desc = hawaii_events.2.d
	flavor = hawaii_events.2.f

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_factory_opening"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		remove_global_variable = gp_hawaii_interest
		set_global_variable = hawaiian_je_success
	}

	option = { #get an extra defense modifier
		name = hawaii_events.2.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 75
		}
		default_option = yes
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = { is_incorporated = yes }
			add_modifier = {
				name = national_defence_modifier
				days = very_long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = { #deport businessmen thinking of coup
		name = hawaii_events.2.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
						ig_approval < -5
					}
				}
				add = -25
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
				add = -25
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = national_defence_modifier
			days = long_modifier_time
			multiplier = 0.5
		}
		set_variable = deported_americans
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = deporting_disloyal_igs
				days = long_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					leader = {
						culture = {
							NOT = { this = cu:hawaiian }
						}
					}
				}
				leader = {
					retire_character = yes
				}
			}
		}
		ig:ig_devout ?= {
			set_interest_group_name = ig_evangelicals
			remove_ideology = ideology_laissez_faire
			if = {
				limit = {
					leader = {
						culture = {
							NOT = { this = cu:hawaiian }
						}
					}
				}
				leader = {
					retire_character = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
			}
			ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_intelligentsia
				remove_ideology = ideology_republican
				add_ideology = ideology_constitutionalist
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					has_variable = hawaii_interest
				}
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = hawaii_interest
				}
				trigger_event = {
					id = hawaii_events.5
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	immediate = {
		remove_global_variable = gp_hawaii_interest
		set_global_variable = hawaiian_coup
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject = yes
			}
			overlord = {
				save_scope_as = hawaiian_coup
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = power_bloc
				is_power_bloc_leader = no
			}
			power_bloc ?= {
				power_bloc_leader ?= {
					save_scope_as = hawaiian_coup
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					has_variable = hawaii_interest
				}
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = hawaii_interest
				}
				weight = {
					base = 1
					modifier = {
						je:je_hawaiian_interest ?= {
							has_modifier = influence_over_hawaii
						}
						add = 300
					}
					modifier = {
						c:USA ?= this
						add = 300
					}
					modifier = {
						c:USA ?= this
						is_player = yes
						add = 300
					}
					modifier = {
						has_diplomatic_pact = {
							who = root
							type = fund_lobbies
						}
						add = 150
					}
					modifier = {
						has_treaty_foreign_investment_rights_with = { TARGET = root }
						add = 150
					}
					modifier = {
						has_treaty_trade_privilege_with = { TARGET = root }
						add = 150
					}
					modifier = {
						"relations(root)" >= relations_threshold:cordial
						"relations(root)" < relations_threshold:amicable
						add = 100
					}
					modifier = {
						"relations(root)" >= relations_threshold:amicable
						"relations(root)" < relations_threshold:friendly
						add = 200
					}
					modifier = {
						"relations(root)" >= relations_threshold:friendly
						add = 300
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = hawaiian_coup
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #Government overthrown policy change
		name = hawaii_events.3.a
		default_option = yes
		activate_law = law_type:law_presidential_republic
		activate_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
		ruler = {
			retire_character = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:hawaiian_coup
			}
			scope:hawaiian_coup = {
				trigger_event = {
					id = hawaii_events.4
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

healthcare_laws.1 = { #famers want healthcare due to accidents
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:farming_accidents_state

	title = healthcare_laws.1.t
	desc = healthcare_laws.1.d
	flavor = healthcare_laws.1.f

	category = enactment

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_russian_serfs"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_election.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		has_law = law_type:law_no_health_system
		or = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_charitable_health_system
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_private_health_insurance
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_public_health_insurance
		}
		NOT = {
			has_modifier = farming_accident_chance
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			any_scope_building = {
				OR = {
					is_building_type = building_rye_farm
					is_building_type = building_wheat_farm
					is_building_type = building_rice_farm
					is_building_type = building_maize_farm
					is_building_type = building_millet_farm
				}
				NOT = {
					has_active_production_method = pm_tools_disabled
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			currently_enacting_law = scope:healthcare_system
		}
	}

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = healthcare_system
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_building = {
					OR = {
						is_building_type = building_rye_farm
						is_building_type = building_wheat_farm
						is_building_type = building_rice_farm
						is_building_type = building_maize_farm
						is_building_type = building_millet_farm
					}
					NOT = {
						has_active_production_method = pm_tools_disabled
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = farming_accidents_state
		}
	}

	option = { # no mortality increase, lower chance success
		name = healthcare_laws.1.a
		default_option = yes
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = farming_accident_chance
		}
	}

	option = { #mortality increase, higher chance success
		name = healthcare_laws.1.b
		scope:farming_accidents_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = farming_accidents_mort
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = farming_accident_chance
			multiplier = 4
		}
	}

	option = { #highest mortality, higher chance success
		name = healthcare_laws.1.c
		trigger = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_private_health_insurance
		}
		scope:farming_accidents_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = farming_accidents_mort
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = 3
			}
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = farming_accident_chance
			multiplier = 5
		}
	}
}
