# Missionary activity in the south of China
heavenly.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:missionary_state

	title = heavenly.1.t
	desc = heavenly.1.d
	flavor = heavenly.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_christianity"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_scales.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		# Fired by journal entry
	}
	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = missionary_works_counter value = 1 }
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				any_scope_pop = {
					NOT = {
						religion = rel:protestant
					}
				}
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					is_treaty_port = yes
					owner = {
						religion = {
							has_discrimination_trait = heritage_christian
						}
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = missionary_state
			random_neighbouring_state = {
				limit = {
					is_treaty_port = yes
					owner = {
						religion = {
							has_discrimination_trait = heritage_christian
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = treaty_port_scope
				owner = {
					save_scope_as = treaty_port_owner
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = heavenly.1.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					has_modifier = opium_wars_lost
				}
				add = 80
			}
		}
		scope:missionary_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = missionary_schools_hospitals
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			convert_population = {
				target = rel:protestant
				value = 0.05
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = heavenly.1.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
		}

		change_relations = {
			country = scope:treaty_port_owner
			value = -10
		}
		scope:missionary_state = {
			convert_population = {
				target = rel:protestant
				value = 0.01
			}
		}
	}
}

# The God Worshipping Society
heavenly.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:cult_state

	title = heavenly.2.t
	desc = heavenly.2.d
	flavor = heavenly.2.f

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_union_leader"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = god_worshippers
			}
			save_scope_as = cult_state
			set_variable = {
				name = cult_center
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = heavenly.2.a
		scope:cult_state = {
			show_as_tooltip = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = god_worshippers
					days = short_modifier_time
				}
			}
			convert_population = {
				target = rel:protestant value = 0.1
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				empty_agitator_slots >= 1
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_dlc_feature = voice_of_the_people_content
					game_date < 1880.1.1
				}
				create_character = {
					template = TPG_hong_xiuquan
					on_created = {
						replace_character_roles = { add = { agitator } remove_all = yes }
						set_variable = hong_var
						add_modifier = {
							name = modifier_brother_of_christ
							days = long_modifier_time
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				create_character = {
					culture = cu:han
					religion = rel:protestant
					interest_group = ig_devout
					ideology = ideology_theocrat
					is_agitator = yes
					on_created = {
						add_modifier = {
							name = modifier_brother_of_christ
							days = long_modifier_time
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Cult Grows
# Repeatable
heavenly.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:cult_growth_state

	title = heavenly.3.t
	desc = heavenly.3.d
	flavor = heavenly.3.f

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_union_leader"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { months = 6 }

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			has_variable = cult_center
			religion_percent_state = {
				target = rel:protestant
				value >= 0.01
			}
			any_neighbouring_state = {
				owner = ROOT
				turmoil >= 0.10
				NOT = {
					has_variable = cult_center
				}
				NOT = { is_capital = yes }
				state_region = {
					OR = {
						is_homeland = cu:han
						is_homeland = cu:hakka
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = cult_center
				religion_percent_state = {
					target = rel:protestant
					value >= 0.01
				}
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					owner = ROOT
					turmoil >= 0.10
					NOT = {
						has_variable = cult_center
					}
					state_region = {
						OR = {
							is_homeland = cu:han
							is_homeland = cu:hakka
						}
					}
					NOT = { is_capital = yes }
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = cult_center
			random_neighbouring_state = {
				limit = {
					owner = ROOT
					turmoil >= 0.10
					NOT = {
						has_variable = cult_center
					}
					state_region = {
						OR = {
							is_homeland = cu:han
							is_homeland = cu:hakka
						}
					}
					NOT = { is_capital = yes }
				}
				save_scope_as = cult_growth_state
				set_variable = {
					name = cult_center
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = heavenly.3.a
		scope:cult_growth_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = god_worshippers
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			convert_population = {
				target = rel:protestant value = 0.1
			}
		}
	}
}

# Heavenly Kingdom spawn
heavenly.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = heavenly.4.t
	desc = heavenly.4.d
	flavor = heavenly.4.f

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_union_leader"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_fire.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {

	}
	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = hong_var
				}
				kill_character = yes
			}
			random_character_in_exile_pool = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = hong_var
				}
				kill_character = yes
			}
		}
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = god_worshippers
			}
			remove_modifier = god_worshippers
		}
		c:CHI ?= {
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					is_incorporated = yes
				}
				set_variable = saved_incorporated_state
			}
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = cult_center
				religion_percent_state = {
					target = rel:protestant
					value >= 0.01
				}
				state_religious_acceptance = {
					target = rel:protestant
					value <= religious_acceptance_low
				}
				radical_fraction = { value >= 0.15 }
			}
			save_scope_as = heavenly_kingdom_spawn
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = TPG
			origin = this
			state = scope:heavenly_kingdom_spawn
			on_created = {
				ig:ig_devout ?= {
					set_interest_group_name = ig_taiping_god_worshippers
					remove_ideology = ideology_moralist
					add_ideology = ideology_heavenly_kingdom_theocratic
					add_modifier = {
						name = taiping_god_worshippers
						days = very_long_modifier_time
						is_decaying = yes
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							has_ruling_interest_group = ig_devout
						}
					}
					ig:ig_devout ?= {
						leader = {
							set_ideology = ideology:ideology_theocrat
						}
						add_ruling_interest_group = yes
					}
				}
				every_interest_group = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
							is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
							is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
							is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
						}
					}
					add_modifier = {
						name = taiping_taiping_revolution
						days = long_modifier_time
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = taiping_land_socialization
					days = long_modifier_time
					is_decaying = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							has_law = law_type:law_theocracy
						}
					}
					activate_law = law_type:law_theocracy
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							has_law = law_type:law_state_religion
						}
					}
					activate_law = law_type:law_state_religion
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							has_law = law_type:law_peasant_levies
						}
					}
					activate_law = law_type:law_peasant_levies
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							has_law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
						}
					}
					activate_law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							has_law = law_type:law_no_workers_rights
						}
					}
					activate_law = law_type:law_no_workers_rights
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							has_law = law_type:law_peasant_proprietorship
						}
					}
					activate_law = law_type:law_peasant_proprietorship
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							has_law = law_type:law_no_migration_controls
						}
					}
					activate_law = law_type:law_no_migration_controls
				}

				add_modifier = {
					name = taiping_army_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
					is_decaying = yes
				}
			}
		}
		c:TPG ?= {
			save_scope_as = heavenly_kingdom_scope
			set_variable = { name = gold_transfer value = c:CHI.gold_reserves } #This shouldn't be in the immediate, but it will throw a million errors if you put it somewhere else. DO NOT TOUCH.
			change_variable = { name = gold_transfer divide = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = gold_transfer_nil value = var:gold_transfer }
			change_variable = { name = gold_transfer_nil divide = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_journal_entry = je_warlord_china }
			chi_remove_1_fragile_unity = yes
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = taiping_taiping_rebellion
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
		c:TPG ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = taiping_taiping_rebellion
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}

		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_taiping
		}
		c:TPG ?= {
			add_journal_entry = {
				type = je_taiping_revolution
			}
		}
		assign_taiping_states = yes
		scope:heavenly_kingdom_scope ?= {
			create_diplomatic_play = {
				name = taiping_rebellion
				target_country = c:CHI
				type = dp_taiping_rebellion
			}
			hidden_effect = { #Why? Because the Taiping Rebellion play grants an insane amount of infamy.
				change_infamy = -150
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			c:TPG ?= {
				create_taiping_characters = yes
				c:CHI ?= {
					add_treasury = prev.var:gold_transfer_nil
				}
				add_treasury = var:gold_transfer
			}
			random_diplomatic_play = {
				limit = {
					c:TPG ?= {
						is_diplomatic_play_initiator = yes
					}
					c:CHI ?= {
						is_diplomatic_play_target = yes
					}
				}
				add_diplomatic_play_war_support = { target = c:TPG value = 50 }
			}
			c:CHI ?= {
				every_scope_state = {
					limit = {
						is_split_state = yes
						state_region = {
							any_scope_state = {
								is_treaty_port = yes
							}
						}
					}
					this.state_region = {
						add_claim = c:TPG
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = heavenly.4.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}
	option = {
		name = heavenly.4.b
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
		play_as = scope:heavenly_kingdom_scope
	}
}

# Aftermath event
heavenly.5 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = heavenly.5.t
	desc = heavenly.5.d
	flavor = heavenly.5.f

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_union_leader"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		# triggered by journal entry
	}

	immediate = {
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				owner = ROOT
				has_variable = saved_incorporated_state
			}
			set_state_owner = c:CHI #Just in case.
			set_state_type = incorporated
			remove_variable = saved_incorporated_state
		}
		root.religion = {
			save_scope_as = state_religion_scope
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = china_scope
		}
	}

	option = { # mass re-conversions
		name = heavenly.5.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = mass_reconversion_tt
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_pop = {
						religion = rel:protestant
					}
				}
				add_religion_standard_of_living_modifier = {
					religion = rel:protestant
					multiplier = -3
				}
				convert_population = {
					target = rel:confucian value = 0.1
				}
			}
		}
		ordered_country = {
			limit = {
				country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
				religion = {
					has_discrimination_trait = heritage_christian
				}
			}
			order_by = country_rank
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = christian_gp
		}
		create_incident = {
			country = scope:christian_gp
			value = 25
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
				religion = {
					has_discrimination_trait = heritage_christian
				}
			}
			change_relations = {
				country = root
				value = -25
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # mercy and pardons
		name = heavenly.5.b
		add_loyalists = {
			value = 0.2
			religion = rel:protestant
		}
	}
}


# Aftermath event - TPG
heavenly.6 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = heavenly.6.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					exists = c:CHI
				}
				desc = heavenly.6.d1
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
				desc = heavenly.6.d
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = heavenly.6.f

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_politician_parliament_motion"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		# triggered by journal entry
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = c:CHI
			}
			c:CHI ?= {
				save_scope_as = china_scope
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reformer
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
						}
					}
				}
			}
			ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = hong_rengan_scope
				}
			}
		}
		cu:manchu = {
			save_scope_as = manchu_culture
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = heavenly.6.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_conversion_of_china
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = heavenly.6.b
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reformer
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_accepted_new_treatise
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_new_treatise_on_administration
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = heavenly.6.b1
		trigger = {
			ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
				leader = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reformer
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
					}
				}
			}
		}
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_accepted_new_treatise
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_new_treatise_on_administration
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = heavenly.6.c
		trigger = {
			exists = c:CHI
		}
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			leader = {
				set_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = hawkish_neighbor_relations
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_second_crusade_against_manchu
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = heavenly.6.e
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
				religion = {
					has_discrimination_trait = heritage_christian
				}
			}
			change_relations = {
				country = c:TPG
				value = 10
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_relations_with_west
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
	}
}

# Missionaries

namespace = CHI_missionaries

# Evangelisation in a state
CHI_missionaries.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:evangelisation_state

	title = CHI_missionaries.1.t
	desc = CHI_missionaries.1.d
	flavor = CHI_missionaries.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_union_leader"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			has_variable = open_to_missionaries_state
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = open_to_missionaries_state
			}
			save_scope_as = evangelisation_state
		}
		change_variable = { name = missionary_works_counter add = 1 }
	}
	option = {
		name = CHI_missionaries.1.a
		scope:evangelisation_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_china_state_evangelisation
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			convert_population = {
				target = rel:protestant
				value = 0.03
			}
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = small_radicals
				religion = rel:confucian
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = CHI_missionaries.1.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:evangelisation_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_china_state_evangelisation
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = 0.5
			}
			convert_population = {
				target = rel:protestant
				value = 0.01
			}
		}
	}
}

# Missionaries attempted to go where they shouldn't
CHI_missionaries.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:forbidden_state

	title = CHI_missionaries.2.t
	desc = CHI_missionaries.2.d
	flavor = CHI_missionaries.2.f

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_union_leader"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_closed_borders
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			any_neighbouring_state = {
				owner = ROOT
				has_variable = open_to_missionaries_state
			}
			NOT = {
				has_variable = open_to_missionaries_state
			}
			NOT = {
				has_variable = missionary_fear
			}
		}
		any_country = {
			has_diplomatic_relevance = root
			religion = rel:protestant
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					owner = ROOT
					has_variable = open_to_missionaries_state
				}
				NOT = {
					has_variable = open_to_missionaries_state
				}
				NOT = {
					has_variable = missionary_fear
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = forbidden_state
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				has_diplomatic_relevance = root
				religion = rel:protestant
			}
			save_scope_as = missionary_country
		}
		change_variable = { name = missionary_works_counter add = 1 }
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				region = sr:region_central_asia
			}
			save_scope_as = deportation_state
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = CHI_missionaries.2.a
		scope:missionary_country = {
			change_relations = {
				country = ROOT
				value = -15
			}
		}
		scope:forbidden_state = {
			custom_tooltip = missionaries_forbidden_10_years_tt
			set_variable = { name = missionary_fear years = 10 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = CHI_missionaries.2.b
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			any_scope_state = {
				region = sr:region_central_asia
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = deport_to_central_asia_tt
		}
		scope:missionary_country = {
			change_relations = {
				country = ROOT
				value = -10
			}
		}
		scope:deportation_state = {
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				pop_type = aristocrats
				value = small_radicals
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = CHI_missionaries.2.c
		scope:forbidden_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
				religion = rel:confucian
			}
			custom_tooltip = open_to_missionaries_tt
			set_variable = open_to_missionaries_state
		}
	}
}

# Missionary schools

# Missionary hospitals
CHI_missionaries.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:missionary_hospitals_state

	title = CHI_missionaries.4.t
	desc = CHI_missionaries.4.d
	flavor = CHI_missionaries.4.f

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_union_leader"
	}

			base = 1
		}

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			has_variable = open_to_missionaries_state
		}
		any_country = {
			has_diplomatic_relevance = root
			religion = rel:protestant
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = open_to_missionaries_state
			}
			save_scope_as = missionary_strife_state
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				has_diplomatic_relevance = root
				religion = rel:protestant
			}
			save_scope_as = missionary_country
		}
		change_variable = { name = missionary_works_counter add = 1 }

		name = CHI_missionaries.5.a

				value = medium_radicals

	option = {
		name = CHI_missionaries.5.b
		scope:missionary_strife_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = small_radicals
			}
		}

			}
		}

	trigger = {
		# JE completion event (Haiti)
	}

	immediate = {
		c:FRA ?= {
			save_scope_as = france_scope
			# Cleanup modifier removal, just in case
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = modifier_haitian_independence_payments_1
				}
				remove_modifier = modifier_haitian_independence_payments_1
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = modifier_haitian_independence_payments_2
				}
				remove_modifier = modifier_haitian_independence_payments_2
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = modifier_haitian_independence_payments_3
				}
				remove_modifier = modifier_haitian_independence_payments_3
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = modifier_haitian_independence_payments_4
				}
				remove_modifier = modifier_haitian_independence_payments_4
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = hispaniola_events.1.b
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = pearl_of_the_antilles_modifier

# Haiti Requests Debt Renegotiation
hispaniola_events.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	title = hispaniola_events.3.t
	desc = hispaniola_events.3.d
	flavor = hispaniola_events.3.f

	event_image = {
		video = "africa_diplomats_negotiating"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_scales.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		c:HAI ?= {
			save_scope_as = haiti_scope
			set_variable = haiti_debt_renegotiated_var
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = hispaniola_events.3.a
		default_option = yes
		c:HAI ?= {
			trigger_event = { id = hispaniola_events.4 popup = yes }
		}
		show_as_tooltip = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					c:FRA ?= {
						owes_obligation_to = c:HAI
					}
				}
				c:FRA ?= {
					set_owes_obligation_to = {
						country = c:HAI
						setting = no
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				c:HAI ?= {
					set_owes_obligation_to = {
						country = c:FRA
						setting = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = modifier_haitian_independence_payments_4
			}
			remove_modifier = modifier_haitian_independence_payments_4
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_haitian_independence_payments_3
				months = -1
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = modifier_haitian_independence_payments_3
			}
			remove_modifier = modifier_haitian_independence_payments_3
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_haitian_independence_payments_2
				months = -1
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = modifier_haitian_independence_payments_2
			}
			remove_modifier = modifier_haitian_independence_payments_2
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_haitian_independence_payments_1
				months = -1
			}
		}
		change_relations = {
			country = c:HAI
			value = 20
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 75
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = hispaniola_events.3.b
		c:HAI ?= { trigger_event = { id = hispaniola_events.5 popup = yes } }
		change_relations = {
			country = c:HAI
			value = -20
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
		}
	}
}

				}
			}

	desc = historical_agitators.5.d
	flavor = historical_agitators.5.f

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = voice_of_the_people_content
		empty_agitator_slots >= 1
		c:USA ?= this
		NOT = { has_variable = american_civil_war }
		game_date > 1840.1.1
		game_date < 1870.1.1
		OR = {
			active_law:lawgroup_slavery ?= {
				has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_american_fugitive_slaves_act
			}
			has_variable = USA_wilmot_proviso
			has_variable = bleeding_kansas_happened
		}
		NOT = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
		}
		NOT = { has_global_variable = jbrown_spawn }
	}

		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_slavery_banned
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = slaver_ig
		}
		set_global_variable = jbrown_spawn
	}

	option = {
		name = historical_agitators.5.a
		default_option = yes

			create_character = {
				template = usa_john_brown_character_template

		}
	}
	option = {
		name = historical_agitators.5.b
		show_as_tooltip = {
			create_character = {
				template = usa_john_brown_character_template
			}
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = medium_radicals
			pop_type = slaves
		}
		scope:slaver_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_slavers_upset_by_john_brown
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

historical_agitators.6 = { #Charles Maurras
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid
	left_icon = scope:historic_agitator_scope

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	title = historical_agitators.6.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					has_journal_entry = je_dreyfus_affair
					any_character_in_void = {
						has_variable = alfred_dreyfus_var
					}
				}
				desc = historical_agitators.6.d1
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_dreyfus_affair }
				}
				desc = historical_agitators.6.d2
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					has_journal_entry = je_dreyfus_affair
				}
				desc = historical_agitators.6.f1
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_dreyfus_affair }
				}
				desc = historical_agitators.6.f2
			}
		}
	}

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = voice_of_the_people_content
		empty_agitator_slots >= 1
		c:FRA ?= this
		game_date > 1895.1.1
		OR = {
			has_journal_entry = je_dreyfus_affair
			has_variable = dreyfus_trial_reincarceration
			has_variable = dreyfus_trial_lesser_sentence
			has_variable = dreyfus_trial_exoneration
			has_technology_researched = political_agitation
		}
		NOT = { has_global_variable = maurras_spawn }
	}

	immediate = {
		create_character = {
			template = fra_maurras_character_template
			on_created = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							has_journal_entry = je_divided_monarchists
						}
					}
					set_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = historic_agitator_scope
		}
		set_global_variable = maurras_spawn
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_character_in_void = {
					has_variable = alfred_dreyfus_var
				}
			}
			random_character_in_void = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = alfred_dreyfus_var
				}
				save_scope_as = alfred_dreyfus_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = historical_agitators.6.a
		default_option = yes
		show_as_tooltip = {
			create_character = {
				template = fra_maurras_character_template
			}
		}
		scope:historic_agitator_scope = {
			add_trait = special_character_maurras_popularity
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = historical_agitators.6.b
		show_as_tooltip = {
			create_character = {
				template = fra_maurras_character_template
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_maurras_antisemitism
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		capital = {
			add_religion_standard_of_living_modifier = {
				religion = rel:jewish
				multiplier = -2
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = historical_agitators.6.c
		show_as_tooltip = {
			create_character = {
				template = fra_maurras_character_template
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_maurras_monarchism
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
			}
			add_loyalists = {
				value = medium_radicals
				pop_type = shopkeepers
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_loyalists = {
				value = medium_radicals
				pop_type = shopkeepers
			}
		}
	}
}

	placement = ROOT

	title = ig_leaders.20.t

	flavor = ig_leaders.20.f

	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_ruling_interest_group_count >= 2
       any_interest_group = {
    		is_in_government = yes
            leader ?= {
                has_trait = reckless
            }
        }
		NOT = { has_variable = the_gamble_var }
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
    			is_in_government = yes
				leader = {
					has_trait = reckless
				}
	        }
			save_scope_as = reckless_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = reckless_leader
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = the_gamble_var
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { #gamble
		name = ig_leaders.20.a
		random_list = {
			50 = {
				trigger_event = { id = ig_leaders.1 days = 10 } #success
			}
			50 = {
				trigger_event = { id = ig_leaders.2 days = 10 } #fail
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #dont gamble
		name = ig_leaders.20.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:reckless_leader = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = gamble_denied_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

ig_leaders.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = ig_leaders.1.t
	desc = ig_leaders.1.d
	flavor = ig_leaders.1.f

	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:reckless_ig.leader

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_ruling_interest_group_count >= 2
       any_interest_group = {
    		is_in_government = yes
            leader = {
                has_trait = reckless
            }
            NOT = {
            	has_modifier = ig_party_prospers
				has_modifier = ig_fall_from_grace
            }
        }
        NOT = {
        	has_modifier = ig_nation_prospers
			has_modifier = ig_compromised_government
        }
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
    			is_in_government = yes
	            leader = {
	                has_trait = reckless
	            }
	            NOT = {
	            	has_modifier = ig_party_prospers
	            }
			}
			save_scope_as = reckless_ig
			leader = { save_scope_as = reckless_leader }
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		scope:reckless_leader = {
			is_character_alive = no
		}
	}

	option = { #focus on the party
		name = ig_leaders.1.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:reckless_ig = {
	        add_modifier = {
	            name = ig_party_prospers
	            days = normal_modifier_time
	        }
		}
	}

	option = { #focus on the nation
		name = ig_leaders.1.b
	    add_modifier = {
	        name = ig_nation_prospers
	        days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}
}

	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		in_election_campaign = yes
		NOT = { has_variable = election_event_cooldown }
		NOT = { has_variable = mute_election_events }
    	any_interest_group = {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
            leader = {
                has_trait = meticulous
            }
			has_party = yes
        }
        NOT = { has_variable = the_gran_plan_var }
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = election_event_cooldown
			months = election_event_cooldown_months
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
    			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
	            leader = {
	                has_trait = meticulous
	            }
	            has_party = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = meticulous_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = meticulous_leader
			}
			party = { save_scope_as = gran_plan_party }
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = the_gran_plan_var
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		scope:meticulous_leader = {
			is_character_alive = no
		}
	}

	option = { #support the party
		name = ig_leaders.3.a
		scope:gran_plan_party = {
		   add_momentum = momentum_large #lots of momentum because it's a relatively rare event
		}
	}

	option = { #nation first
		name = ig_leaders.3.b
		default_option = yes
	    add_modifier = {
	        name = ig_national_dividends
	        days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}
}

	                has_trait = arrogant
	            }
            }
        }
	}

	            leader = {
	            	OR = {
		                has_trait = imperious
		                has_trait = arrogant
		            }
	            }
			}
			save_scope_as = smug_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = smug_leader
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = smug_ig_flag
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		scope:smug_leader = {
			is_character_alive = no
		}
	}

	option = { #dont agree
		name = ig_leaders.5.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:smug_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = imperious_leader_dont_agree_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:smug_leader = {
			add_modifier = { #popularity bad
				name = imperious_leader_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:smug_ig = {
				remove_variable = smug_ig_flag
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #agree
		name = ig_leaders.5.b
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_in_government = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = smug_ig_flag }
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = imperious_leader_agree_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:smug_leader = {
			add_modifier = { #popularity good
				name = imperious_leader_good_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:smug_ig = {
				remove_variable = smug_ig_flag
			}
		}
	}

				}

			}

# Landowners wants to roll back suffrage
ig_petitions.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = ig_petitions.1.t
	desc = ig_petitions.1.d
	flavor = ig_petitions.1.f

	category = enactment

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_capitalists_meeting"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_election.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		is_enacting_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			is_powerful = yes
			is_in_government = no
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = landowners_petition_var }
		NOT = {
			currently_enacting_law = {
				has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_voter_suppression_policies
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		ig:ig_landowners ?= { save_scope_as = landowners_ig }
		currently_enacting_law = {
    		save_scope_as = current_law_scope
    	}
		set_variable = {
			name = landowners_petition_var
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { #they have a point
		name = ig_petitions.1.a
		currently_enacting_law = {
			add_amendment = {
				type = amendment_voter_suppression_policies
				sponsor = scope:landowners_ig
				cooldown = 60
			}
		}
		scope:landowners_ig = {
			improve_law_stance = yes
			add_modifier = {
				name = tarnished_reputation_modifier #pop attraction bad
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #u wot mate
		name = ig_petitions.1.b
		default_option = yes
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = landowners_petition_rejected_modifier
		}
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = rejected_petition
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			is_powerful = yes
			is_in_government = no
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = armed_forces_petition_var }
	}

	immediate = {
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { save_scope_as = armed_forces_ig }
		currently_enacting_law = {
    		save_scope_as = current_law_scope
    	}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = { is_incorporated = yes }
			save_scope_as = conscription_state
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = armed_forces_petition_var
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { #focus on the conscription sentiment
		name = ig_petitions.19.a
		default_option = yes
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = conscription_law_modifier
		}
		scope:conscription_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = conscription_efforts_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #focus on passing the law
		name = ig_petitions.19.b
		add_modifier = { #bad bureaucracy but good army power projection
			name = army_resources_modifier
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = army_resources_ig_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

			name = petty_bourgeoisie_national_supremacy
		}
	}
}

### IN POWER ###

#   Reckless/Ambitious - In The Balance

ig_revolutions.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = ig_revolutions.1.t
	desc = ig_revolutions.1.d
	flavor = ig_revolutions.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_conspiring"
	}

	category = revolution

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = revolution_event_cooldown }
		has_insurrectionary_interest_groups = yes
       	any_interest_group = {
    		is_in_government = no
    		ig_counts_as_marginal = no
    		AND = {
	    		ig_approval <= -1
	    		ig_approval > -8
	    	}
            leader = {
            	OR = {
	                has_trait = reckless
	                has_trait = ambitious
	               }
            }
            is_revolutionary = no
            NOT = {
            	has_modifier = ig_powerbrokers
            }
        }
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		has_insurrectionary_interest_groups = no
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
    			is_in_government = no
    			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				AND = {
					ig_approval <= -1
					ig_approval > -8
				}
	            leader = {
	            	OR = {
		                has_trait = reckless
		                has_trait = ambitious
		            }
	            }
	            NOT = {
	            	has_modifier = ig_powerbrokers
	            }
			}
			save_scope_as = ig_on_the_edge
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = ig_on_the_edge_leader
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = revolution_event_cooldown days = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = ig_revolutions.1.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:ig_on_the_edge = {
	        add_modifier = {
	            name = ig_powerbrokers
	            months = 48
	        }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = ig_revolutions.1.b
	    scope:ig_on_the_edge = {
	    	join_revolution = yes
	    }
	}
}

# Landowners are angry, but not quite angry enough
ig_revolutions.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = ig_revolutions.2.t
	desc = ig_revolutions.2.d
	flavor = ig_revolutions.2.f

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_conspiring"
	}

	category = revolution

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = revolution_event_cooldown }
		has_insurrectionary_interest_groups = yes
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			is_revolutionary = no
			is_in_government = no
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
    		AND = {
	    		ig_approval <= -1
	    		ig_approval > -8
	    	}
			NOT = { has_modifier = ig_concessions_and_appeasement }
			NOT = { has_modifier = ig_unappeased }
			NOT = { has_modifier = ig_mass_arrests }
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		has_insurrectionary_interest_groups = no
	}

	immediate = {
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			save_scope_as = ig_lo_on_the_edge
		}
		set_variable = { name = revolution_event_cooldown days = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = ig_revolutions.2.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
		}
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
	        add_modifier = {
	            name = ig_concessions_and_appeasement
	            months = 36
	        }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = ig_revolutions.2.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 15
		}
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
	    	join_revolution = yes
	        add_modifier = {
	            name = ig_unappeased
	            months = 36
	        }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = ig_revolutions.2.c
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_dedicated_police
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_militarized_police
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ig:ig_landowners ?= {
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
				add = -10
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ig:ig_landowners ?= {
						ig_approval < -3
					}
				}
				add = -10
			}
		}
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
	        add_modifier = {
	            name = ig_mass_arrests
	            months = 12
	        }
		}
	}
}

		NOT = { has_variable = revolution_event_cooldown }
		has_insurrectionary_interest_groups = yes
		ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
			is_revolutionary = no
			is_in_government = no
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
    		AND = {
	    		ig_approval <= -1
	    		ig_approval > -8
	    	}
			NOT = { has_modifier = ig_concessions_and_appeasement }
			NOT = { has_modifier = ig_unappeased }
			NOT = { has_modifier = ig_mass_arrests }
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		has_insurrectionary_interest_groups = no
	}

	immediate = {
		ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
			save_scope_as = ig_pb_on_the_edge
		}
		set_variable = { name = revolution_event_cooldown days = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = ig_revolutions.8.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
		}
		ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
	        add_modifier = {
	            name = ig_concessions_and_appeasement
	            months = 36
	        }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = ig_revolutions.8.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 15
		}
		ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
	    	join_revolution = yes
	        add_modifier = {
	            name = ig_unappeased
	            months = 36
	        }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ig_revolutions.8.c
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_dedicated_police
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_militarized_police
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
				add = -10
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
						ig_approval < -3
					}
				}
				add = -10
			}
		}
		ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
	        add_modifier = {
	            name = ig_mass_arrests
	            months = 12
	        }
		}
	}
}

ig_suppression_events.1 = { #pst kid do you want to scheme?
	type = country_event

	title = ig_suppression_events.1.t
	desc = ig_suppression_events.1.d
	flavor = ig_suppression_events.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_aristocrats"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# triggered by on_yearly_pulse_country
		NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_ig_suppression_1 }
		NOT = { has_variable = dismissed_ig_suppresion_var }
		NOT = { has_variable = completed_ig_suppression_je_var }
		any_interest_group = {
			is_powerful = yes
			is_in_government = no
			ig_approval <= unhappy
		}
		OR = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_censorship
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_national_guard
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_secret_police
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = yes
				is_in_government = no
				ig_approval <= unhappy
			}
			save_scope_as = suppressed_ig
		}
	}

	option = { #of course I do
		name = ig_suppression_events.1.a
		custom_tooltip = ig_suppression_tt
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_ig_suppression_1
			target = scope:suppressed_ig
		}
	}

	option = { #nah I'm fine
		name = ig_suppression_events.1.b
		default_option = yes
		set_variable = {
			name = dismissed_ig_suppresion_var
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		custom_tooltip = dismissed_ig_suppression_tt
	}
}

ig_suppression_events.2 = { #scandal / es can da lo es un escandalo
	type = country_event

	title = ig_suppression_events.2.t
	desc = ig_suppression_events.2.d

		video = "southamerica_aristocrats"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		#triggered by JE
		scope:target ?= {

			}

	}

	immediate = {

			}
		}
		set_variable = {

			days = short_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { #be a bit... sneaky
		name = ig_suppression_events.2.a
		highlighted_option = yes

			OR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_secret_police

					ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
						is_powerful = yes
					}
					scope:target = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
					}
				}
			}
		}
		scope:target = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = undermined_ig_modifier

			}
		}

			name = ig_leader_exposed_var
		}
		trigger_event = { id = ig_suppression_events.3 days = 60 }
	}

	option = { #spread the word at upper class balls

				name = undermined_upper_class_modifier

						}
						add = 25
					}

						limit = {
							has_technology_researched = political_agitation
						}
						add = 10
					}
				}
			}
			50 = {
				modifier = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { has_technology_researched = dialectics }
						}
						add = 10
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = suppression_discovered
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_variable = {
				name = ig_leader_exposed_var
			}
		}
		trigger_event = { id = ig_suppression_events.3 days = 60 }
	}

	option = { #let the poor people spread the word
		name = ig_suppression_events.2.c
		default_option = yes
		scope:target = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = undermined_lower_class_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			50 = {
				modifier = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_censorship
						}
						add = 25
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_technology_researched = labor_movement
						}
						add = 10
					}
				}
			}

				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:suppressed_leader = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = suppression_leader_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #this has gone too far

				}
			}
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = plot_backing_down_bad_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { this = scope:target }
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = plot_backing_down_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

		}

			capital = {
				add_radicals_in_state = {
  					value = medium_radicals
  				}
			}

					10 = { #Success
						scope:suppressed_leader = {
							kill_character = yes
						}

						ROOT = {
							post_notification = ig_leader_assassination
						}
					}

					10 = { #Failure
						ROOT = {
								post_notification = ig_leader_assassination_failed
						}

					}
			}
	}



	option = { #Nothing happens
		name = ig_suppression_events.1003.b
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:target = {
					NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces }
				}
			}
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = plot_backing_down_bad_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { this = scope:target }
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = plot_backing_down_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

}

# Startup event
independence.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = independence.1.t
	desc = independence.1.d
	flavor = independence.1.f

    event_image = {
		video = "asia_sepoy_mutiny"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by on_action
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		is_subject = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		civil_war_origin_country = {
			save_scope_as = former_colonial_government
			overlord ?= {
				save_scope_as = former_colonial_overlord
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = independence.1.a
		default_option = yes
		activate_law = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
	}

	option = {
		name = independence.1.b
		activate_law = law_type:law_presidential_republic
	}

	option = {
		name = independence.1.c
		trigger = {
			any_interest_group = {
				is_in_government = yes
				is_strongest_ig_in_government = yes
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_monarchy
					value >= approve
				}
			}
		}
		activate_law = law_type:law_monarchy
	}

	option = {
		name = independence.1.e
		trigger = {
			any_interest_group = {
				is_in_government = yes
				is_strongest_ig_in_government = yes
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_corporate_state
					value >= approve
				}
			}
		}
		activate_law = law_type:law_corporate_state
	}

	option = {
		name = independence.1.g
		trigger = {
			any_interest_group = {
				is_in_government = yes
				is_strongest_ig_in_government = yes
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_council_republic
					value >= approve
				}
			}
		}
		activate_law = law_type:law_council_republic
	}

	option = {
		name = independence.1.h
		trigger = {
			any_interest_group = {
				is_in_government = yes
				is_strongest_ig_in_government = yes
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_theocracy
					value >= approve
				}
			}
		}
		activate_law = law_type:law_theocracy
	}

	after = {
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_type = recognized
		}
	}
}

indian_famines.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = indian_famines.1.t
	desc = indian_famines.1.d
	flavor = indian_famines.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_dead_cattle_poor_harvest"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			c:BIC ?= this
			any_primary_culture = {
				has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_south_asian
			}
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			OR = {
				region = sr:region_south_india
				region = sr:region_north_india
			}
			has_famine = yes
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = sr:region_south_india
					region = sr:region_north_india
				}
				has_famine = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = indian_famine_state_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = indian_famines.1.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:indian_famine_state_scope = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = small_radicals
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = indian_famines.1.b
		scope:indian_famine_state_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = reduced_taxation_due_to_famine
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				value = small_radicals
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = indian_famines.1.c
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = not_recently_had_war
				is_at_war = no
				NOT = {
					has_variable = recently_had_war
				}
			}
		}
		scope:indian_famine_state_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = no_taxation_due_to_famine
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = famine_relief_aid_costs
			days = normal_modifier_time
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_very_small
		}
	}
}

indian_famines.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = indian_famines.2.t
	desc = indian_famines.2.d
	flavor = indian_famines.2.f

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_dead_cattle_poor_harvest"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			has_variable = hunger_strike_var
		}
		c:BIC ?= this
		any_scope_state = {
			OR = {
				region = sr:region_south_india
				region = sr:region_north_india
			}
			has_famine = yes
			any_scope_building = {
				OR = {
					is_building_type = building_cotton_plantation
					is_building_type = building_dye_plantation
				}
				level >= 5
			}
		}
		any_scope_character = {
			culture = {
				has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_south_asian
			}
			has_role_of_type = agitator
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = hunger_strike_var
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = sr:region_south_india
					region = sr:region_north_india
				}
				has_famine = yes
				any_scope_building = {
					OR = {
						is_building_type = building_cotton_plantation
						is_building_type = building_dye_plantation
					}
					level >= 5
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = indian_famine_state_scope
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				culture = {
					has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_south_asian
				}
				has_role_of_type = agitator
			}
			save_scope_as = hunger_strike_agitator_scope
			set_variable = hunger_striker_var
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = indian_famines.2.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = indian_famines.2.tt
		show_as_tooltip = {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						region = sr:region_south_india
						region = sr:region_north_india
					}
					has_famine = yes
					any_scope_building = {
						OR = {
							is_building_type = building_cotton_plantation
							is_building_type = building_dye_plantation
						}
						level >= 5
					}
				}
				order_by = gdp
				position = 0
				check_range_bounds = no
				add_modifier = {
					name = temporary_switch_to_food_crops
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
				add_loyalists_in_state = {
					value = small_radicals
				}
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						region = sr:region_south_india
						region = sr:region_north_india
					}
					has_famine = yes
					any_scope_building = {
						OR = {
							is_building_type = building_cotton_plantation
							is_building_type = building_dye_plantation
						}
						level >= 5
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = temporary_switch_to_food_crops
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
				add_loyalists_in_state = {
					value = small_radicals
				}
			}
		}
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = bowed_to_food_crop_demands
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = indian_famines.2.b
		random_list = {
			9 = {
				trigger_event = { id = indian_famines.3 popup = yes days = 30 }
			}
			1 = {
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = following_applied_to_every_owned_state
		show_as_tooltip = {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				add_radicals_in_state = {
					value = small_radicals
				}
				order_by = gdp
				position = 0
				check_range_bounds = no
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			every_scope_state = {
				add_radicals_in_state = {
					value = small_radicals
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

india_home_rule_events.1 = { # The Indian Home Rule Act
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	duration = 3

	title = india_home_rule_events.1.t
	desc = india_home_rule_events.1.d
	flavor = india_home_rule_events.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "ip2_india_urban_scene"
	}

	dlc = dlc011

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	option = {
		name = india_home_rule_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		change_tag = BHT
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = south_asian_primary_cultures_tt
			every_scope_culture = {
				limit = {
					has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_south_asian
					save_temporary_scope_as = temp_culture_scope
					ROOT = {
						any_scope_state = {
							state_region = {
								is_homeland = scope:temp_culture_scope
							}
						}
					}
				}
				ROOT = {
					add_primary_culture = prev
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_atheism
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					religion_percent_country = {
						target = rel:hindu
						value >= 0.5
					}
				}
				set_state_religion = rel:hindu
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					religion_percent_country = {
						target = rel:sunni
						value >= 0.5
					}
				}
				set_state_religion = rel:sunni
			}
			else = {
				set_state_religion = rel:hindu
			}
		}
		india_independence_ig_effects = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = modifier_india_crown_rule
			}
			remove_modifier = modifier_india_crown_rule
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule
			}
			remove_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule_upgraded
			}
			remove_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule_upgraded
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = modifier_indian_imperial_police
			}
			remove_modifier = modifier_indian_imperial_police
		}
		recalculate_pop_ig_support = yes
		call_election = {
			months = 6
		}
	}
}

					state_region = s:STATE_HILL_PUNJAB
				}
			}
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					state_region = s:STATE_HILL_PUNJAB
				}
				save_scope_as = jallianwala_bagh_state
				random_scope_culture = {
					limit = {
						has_homeland = prev
					}
					save_scope_as = relevant_culture
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_india
				}
				save_scope_as = jallianwala_bagh_state
				random_scope_culture = {
					limit = {
						has_homeland = prev
					}
					save_scope_as = relevant_culture
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				game_date > 1900.1.1
				game_date < 1924.1.1
			}
			create_character = {
				template = BIC_reginald_dyer
				on_created = {
					set_character_busy_and_immortal = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = dyer_scope
			}
		}
		else = {
			create_character = {
				is_general = yes
				culture = cu:british
				interest_group = ig_armed_forces
				ideology = ideology_authoritarian
				traits = {
					war_criminal
					cruel
					plains_commander
				}
				on_created = {
					set_character_busy_and_immortal = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = dyer_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = india_home_rule_events.3.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = home_rule_is_over_tt
		scope:jallianwala_bagh_state = {
			kill_population_in_state = {
				value = 500
				culture = scope:relevant_culture
			}
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = large_radicals
				culture = scope:relevant_culture
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_constitutionalist
				}
			}
			ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
				remove_ideology = ideology_constitutionalist
				add_ideology = ideology_republican
			}
		}
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				is_political_movement_type = movement_india_pan_national
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_india_massacred_protesters
				days = very_long_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		trigger_event = { id = india_home_rule_events.4 days = 2 }
	}
}

				target = top_overlord

				add_interest_group = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie
				lobby_formation_reason = diplomacy
			}
			set_variable = { name = inc_formed months = 3 }
		}
		else = {
			random_political_lobby = {
				limit = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_anti_overlord
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							any_lobby_member = {
								is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
							}
						}
					}
					add_lobby_member = ig:ig_intelligentsia
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							any_lobby_member = {
								is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
							}
						}
					}
					add_lobby_member = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie
				}
			}
		}
		random_political_lobby = {
			limit = {
				is_political_lobby_type = lobby_anti_overlord
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_lobby
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = india_home_rule_events.7.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = inc_formed
			}
			custom_tooltip = independence_lobby_formed_tt
		}
		scope:intelligentsia_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_indian_national_movement_ig
				days = normal_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		scope:petty_bourgeoisie_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_indian_national_movement_ig
				days = normal_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = india_home_rule_events.7.b
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = inc_formed
			}
			custom_tooltip = independence_lobby_formed_tt
		}
		scope:intelligentsia_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_indian_national_movement_ig
				days = normal_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
				multiplier = 2
			}
		}
		scope:petty_bourgeoisie_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_indian_national_movement_ig
				days = normal_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
				multiplier = 2
			}
		}
		scope:relevant_lobby = {
			change_appeasement = {
				amount = 1
				factor = appeasement_lobby_loss
			}
		}
	}
}

india_home_rule_events.9 = { # Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms
	type = country_event
	placement = root

				limit = {
					is_in_government = yes
					OR = {
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_no_colonial_affairs
							value > neutral
						}
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_cultural_exclusion
							value > neutral
						}
					}
				}
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = montagu_scope
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = overlord_scope
		}
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = chelmsford_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = india_home_rule_events.9.a
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			any_political_movement = {
				is_political_movement_type = movement_india_pan_national
				political_movement_radicalism <= 0.5
			}
		}
		activate_law = law_type:law_wealth_voting
		activate_law = law_type:law_elected_bureaucrats
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = simon_commission_in_ten_years_tt
			trigger_event = { id = india_home_rule_events.10 years = 10 }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = india_home_rule_events.9.b
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			any_political_movement = {
				is_political_movement_type = movement_india_pan_national
				political_movement_radicalism > 0.5
			}
		}
		activate_law = law_type:law_wealth_voting
		activate_law = law_type:law_elected_bureaucrats
		add_liberty_desire = 5
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = simon_commission_in_ten_years_tt
			top_overlord = {
				trigger_event = { id = india_home_rule_events.10 years = 10 }
			}
		}
	}

										has_socialist_ideology = yes

# Most of these events use global variables, due to the fact that the BIC tag can disappear if a native-ruled India is created.

india_events.1 = { # Kaisar-i-Hind
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = india_events.1.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = india_events.1.d_1
				trigger = {
					country_has_voting_franchise = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = india_events.1.d_2
				trigger = {

						is_pop_type = peasants

					position = 0
					check_range_bounds = no
					goods = {
						save_scope_as = british_trade_route_goods
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			market = {
				ordered_market_goods = {
					limit = {
						is_tradeable = yes
						market_goods_sell_orders > 200
					}
					order_by = "market.market_imports_reliance(scope:probably_britain_scope.market)"
					position = 0
					check_range_bounds = no
					goods = {
						save_scope_as = british_trade_route_goods	# need a good to be called on for loc in the non-trade-route path
					}
				}
			}
		}
		top_overlord = {
			save_scope_as = probably_britain_scope
			trigger_event = { id = india_non_cooperation.2 }
		}
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				is_political_movement_type = movement_india_pan_national
				movement_is_causing_obstinance = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = indian_independence_movement

			if = {
				limit = {
					any_supporting_character = {
						# repeating the requirements for sending someone to jail
						is_in_exile_pool = no
						is_in_void = no
						is_ruler_of_own_country = no
						is_heir_of_own_country = no
						has_role_of_type = agitator
						is_immortal = no
					}
				}
				random_supporting_character = {
					limit = {
						is_in_exile_pool = no
						is_in_void = no
						is_ruler_of_own_country = no
						is_heir_of_own_country = no
						has_role_of_type = agitator
						is_immortal = no
					}
					save_scope_as = indian_independence_movement_agitator
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = india_non_cooperation.1.a
		default_option = yes

		if = {
			limit = { has_journal_entry = je_india_home_rule }
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = india_bar_advance_10_tt
				je:je_india_home_rule ?= {
					add_progress = { value = 10 name = je_india_home_rule_progressbar }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_small_indian_radicals = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = india_non_cooperation.1.b
		highlighted_option = yes

		trigger = {
			NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_guaranteed_liberties }
			exists = scope:indian_independence_movement_agitator
		}

		scope:indian_independence_movement_agitator = {
			save_scope_as = prisoner_scope
		}
		trigger_event = { id = jail.1 popup = yes }
	}
}

		}

				has_homeland = prev
			}

		}

			limit = {

			}

				order_by = ig_clout
				position = 0
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = powerful_movement_ig
			}

			random_supporting_character = {
				limit = {
					is_in_exile_pool = no
					is_in_void = no
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					is_heir_of_own_country = no
					OR = {
						has_role_of_type = agitator
						has_role_of_type = politician
					}
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pacifist
					}
					is_immortal = no
				}
				save_scope_as = nonviolent_movement_leader
				interest_group ?= {
					save_scope_as = nonviolent_movement_leader_ig
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = india_non_cooperation.5.a
		default_option = yes

		scope:indian_independence_movement = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = failure_of_non_cooperation
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}

		scope:chauri_chaura_state = {
			state_region = {
				add_devastation = 10
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = india_non_cooperation.5.b
		trigger = { exists = scope:nonviolent_movement_leader }

		custom_tooltip = indian_nationalist_leader_retires_tt
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:nonviolent_movement_leader = {
					has_role_of_type = agitator
					NOT = { has_role_of_type = politician }
				}
			}
			scope:nonviolent_movement_leader = {
				hidden_effect = {
					retire_character = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { empty_agitator_slots > 0 }
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = an_agitator_appears_tt
					create_character = {
						interest_group = scope:powerful_movement_ig
		    			ideology = ideology_sovereignist_leader
		    			is_agitator = yes
		    			culture = scope:firebrand_movement_leader
					    trait_generation = {
							if = {
								limit = {
									trait_value < 3
								}
								add_trait = demagogue
							}
							if = {
								limit = {
									trait_value < 3
								}
								add_trait = charismatic
							}
							if = {
								limit = {
									trait_value < 3
								}
								add_trait = ambitious
							}
					    }
					}
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:nonviolent_movement_leader = {
					has_role_of_type = politician
				}
			}
			scope:nonviolent_movement_leader = {
				hidden_effect = {
					retire_character = yes
				}
			}
			create_character = {
				role = character_role_politician
				interest_group = scope:nonviolent_movement_leader_ig
    			ideology = ideology_sovereignist_leader
				culture = scope:firebrand_movement_leader
			    trait_generation = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							trait_value < 3
						}
						add_trait = demagogue
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							trait_value < 3
						}
						add_trait = charismatic
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							trait_value < 3
						}
						add_trait = ambitious
					}
			    }
    		}
    	}

		scope:chauri_chaura_state = {
			add_devastation = 10
		}
	}
}

# Train Robbery
india_railway.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:relevant_state
	title = india_railway.1.t
	desc = india_railway.1.d
	flavor = india_railway.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_trains"
	}

	dlc = dlc011

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_fire.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by Purveyor of Progres JE
		is_subject = yes
		liberty_desire >= 25
		any_scope_state = {
			has_building = building_railway
			NOT = { has_variable = railway_robbery_happened }
			NOT = { has_variable = railway_trial_completed }
			any_scope_pop = {
				pop_has_primary_culture = no
				pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4
			}
			any_scope_pop = {
				pop_acceptance >= acceptance_status_4
				culture = {
					has_discrimination_trait = language_anglophone
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_building = building_railway
				NOT = { has_variable = railway_robbery_happened }
				NOT = { has_variable = railway_trial_completed }
				any_scope_pop = {
					pop_has_primary_culture = no
					pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4
				}
				any_scope_pop = {
					pop_acceptance >= acceptance_status_4
					culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait = language_anglophone
					}
				}
			}
			random_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					pop_has_primary_culture = no
					pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4
				}
				save_scope_as = discriminated_pop
				culture = { save_scope_as = discriminated_culture }
			}
			random_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					pop_acceptance >= acceptance_status_4
					culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait = language_anglophone
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = not_discriminated_pop
					culture = { save_scope_as = not_discriminated_culture }
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_state
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		is_subject = no
	}

	option = {
		name = india_railway.1.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = do_control_the_press
			days = normal_modifier_time
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_very_small
		}
		scope:relevant_state = {
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
				culture = scope:not_discriminated_culture
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				set_variable = railway_robbery_happened
			}
		}

	}
	option = {
		name = india_railway.1.b
		add_modifier = {
			name = not_control_the_press
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		scope:relevant_state = {
			hidden_effect = {
				set_variable = railway_robbery_happened
			}
		}
	}
}

			any_scope_pop = {
				pop_has_primary_culture = no
				pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4
			}
			has_famine = yes
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_building = building_railway
				any_scope_pop = {
					pop_has_primary_culture = no
					pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4
				}
				has_famine = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_state
		}

	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		is_subject = no
	}

	option = {
		name = india_railway.3.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:relevant_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = railway_famine
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = railway_hunger_relief
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_individualist
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal }
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = railway_ig_disapproval
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}

	}
	option = {
		name = india_railway.3.b
		scope:relevant_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = railway_famine
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = railway_hunger_no_relief
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		every_interest_group = {

		video = "ip2_intercommunal_tensions"
	}

	dlc = dlc011

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by Purveyor of Progres JE
		is_subject = yes
		any_scope_state = {
			has_building = building_railway
			any_scope_pop = {
				pop_has_primary_culture = no
				pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4
			}
			any_scope_pop = {
				pop_acceptance >= acceptance_status_4
				culture = {
					has_discrimination_trait = language_anglophone
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_building = building_railway
			}
			random_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					pop_has_primary_culture = no
					pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4
				}
				save_scope_as = discriminated_pop
				culture = { save_scope_as = discriminated_culture }
			}
			random_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					pop_acceptance >= acceptance_status_4
					culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait = language_anglophone
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = not_discriminated_pop
				culture = { save_scope_as = not_discriminated_culture }
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_state
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		is_subject = no
	}

	option = {
		name = india_railway.4.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:relevant_state = {
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
				culture = scope:not_discriminated_pop.culture
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = rising_intracommunal_tension
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = india_railway.4.b
		scope:relevant_state = {
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
				culture = scope:discriminated_pop.culture
			}
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
				culture = scope:not_discriminated_pop.culture
			}
		}
	}
}

			limit = {
				state_region = s:STATE_BOMBAY
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_state
		}

			limit = {
				is_subject = yes
			}
			top_overlord = {
				save_scope_as = relevant_overlord
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
	}

	option = {
		name = india_railway.5.a

			limit = {

			}

					name = india_railway_reward
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						region = sr:region_south_india
						region = sr:region_north_india
					}
				}
				order_by = gdp
				position = 0
				check_range_bounds = no
				add_modifier = {
					name = india_railway_reward
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Anti-Catholic Edict Enforcement
indochina.1 = {
	type = country_event
	#placement = ROOT

	title = indochina.1.t
	desc = indochina.1.d
	flavor = indochina.1.f

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_hostile_court"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_scales.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = voice_of_the_people_content
		NOT = { has_global_variable = indochina_intervention_happened }
		capital = {
			region = sr:region_indochina
		}
		NOT = {
			country_has_state_religion = rel:catholic
			has_variable = indochina_campaign_target
		}
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_religion
		any_scope_pop = {
			religion = rel:catholic
		}
		any_country = { # there must be a Catholic Great Power who can react to all this
			country_has_state_religion = rel:catholic
			country_rank = rank_value:great_power
			capital = {
				NOT = { region = sr:region_indochina }
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					country_has_state_religion = rel:catholic
					country_rank = rank_value:great_power
					capital = {
						NOT = { region = sr:region_indochina }
					}
					is_player = yes
				}
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					country_has_state_religion = rel:catholic
					country_rank = rank_value:great_power
					capital = {
						NOT = { region = sr:region_indochina }
					}
					is_player = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = potential_imperial_power
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					country_has_state_religion = rel:catholic
					country_rank = rank_value:great_power
					capital = {
						NOT = { region = sr:region_indochina }
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = potential_imperial_power
			}
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_pop = {
					religion = rel:catholic
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = catholic_activity_in_state
		}
		save_scope_as = persecuting_indochinese_state
	}

	option = {
		name = indochina.1.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
		}
		scope:catholic_activity_in_state ={
			add_religion_standard_of_living_modifier = {
				religion = rel:catholic
				multiplier = -3
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_variable = indochina_campaign_target
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = you_will_regret_this
			scope:potential_imperial_power = {
				trigger_event = { id = indochina.3 days = 30 }
			}
		}

		every_country = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					ROOT = {
						is_player = yes
					}
					has_diplomatic_relevance = ROOT
					scope:potential_imperial_power = this
				}
			}
			post_notification = indochina_catholic_persecutions_begins
		}
	}


	option = {
		name = indochina.1.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 15
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pious
					}
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ethno_nationalist
					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = too_gentle_on_missionaries
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

indochina.2 = {
	type = country_event
	#placement = ROOT

	desc = indochina.2.d
	flavor = indochina.2.f

	event_image = {
