movement_events.4 = { # Petition sent to the government for the relevant issue.
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = movement_events.4.t
	desc = movement_events.4.d
	flavor = movement_events.4.f

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_capitalists_meeting"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = short_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_political_movement = {
            exists = most_desired_law
			NOT = {
				ROOT.currently_enacting_law.type ?= this.most_desired_law
			}
			is_revolutionary = no
            political_movement_radicalism >= 0.25
			NOT = {
				is_political_movement_type = movement_slave_revolt
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			researched_mass_politics = yes
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			exists = scope:relevant_movement
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
                exists = most_desired_law
				NOT = {
					ROOT.currently_enacting_law.type ?= this.most_desired_law
				}
				is_revolutionary = no
                political_movement_radicalism >= 0.25
				NOT = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_slave_revolt
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_movement
			most_desired_law ?= {
				save_scope_as = relevant_law
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = movement_events.4.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 10
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_movement_petition_accepted
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		scope:relevant_movement ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_movement_petition_accepted_movement
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = movement_events.4.b
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 10
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:relevant_movement ?= {
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.65
					}
				}
				add = -5
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:relevant_movement ?= {
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.25
					}
				}
				add = -3
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:relevant_movement.political_movement_support >= 0.10
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_movement_petition_rejected_legitimacy
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
		random_political_movement = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_movement_petition_rejected_movement
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = movement_events.4.c
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_secret_police
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_national_guard
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_censorship
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 10
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:relevant_movement ?= {
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.60
					}
				}
				add = -5
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:relevant_movement ?= {
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.125
					}
				}
				add = -3
			}
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = small_radicals
			strata = middle
		}
		scope:relevant_movement ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_movement_petition_rejected_movement
				days = short_modifier_time
				multiplier = 2
			}
		}
	}
}

movement_events.7 = { # National campaign of postering for a given issue.
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = movement_events.7.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = movement_events.7.d1
				trigger = {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_revolutionary = no
                        political_movement_radicalism >= 0.25
						any_supporting_character = {
							has_role_of_type = agitator
						}
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = movement_events.7.d2
				trigger = {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_revolutionary = no
                        political_movement_radicalism >= 0.25
						any_influenced_interest_group = {
							ig_counts_as_marginal = no
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = movement_events.7.f

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_printing_press"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = short_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_political_movement = {
            exists = most_desired_law
			NOT = {
				ROOT.currently_enacting_law.type ?= this.most_desired_law
			}
			is_revolutionary = no
            political_movement_radicalism >= 0.25
			OR = {
				any_influenced_interest_group = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				}
				any_supporting_character = {
					has_role_of_type = agitator
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				is_political_movement_type = movement_slave_revolt
			}
		}
		researched_mass_politics = yes
		NOT = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOR = {
			exists = scope:relevant_movement
			scope:relevant_agitator ?= {
				OR = {
					is_in_exile_pool = no
					is_character_alive = no
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
                exists = most_desired_law
				NOT = {
					ROOT.currently_enacting_law.type ?= this.most_desired_law
				}
				is_revolutionary = no
                political_movement_radicalism >= 0.25
				OR = {
					any_influenced_interest_group = {
						ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					}
					any_supporting_character = {
						has_role_of_type = agitator
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_slave_revolt
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_movement
			most_desired_law ?= {
				save_scope_as = relevant_law
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_influenced_interest_group = {
						ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					}
				}
				random_influenced_interest_group = {
					limit = {
						ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					}
					save_scope_as = relevant_ig
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_supporting_character = {
						has_role_of_type = agitator
					}
				}
				random_supporting_character = {
					save_scope_as = relevant_agitator
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = movement_events.7.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 1
		}
		scope:relevant_movement ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_movement_postering_campaign
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = movement_events.7.b
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 1
		}
		scope:relevant_agitator ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_movement_postering_campaign_suppressed_character
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:relevant_ig ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_movement_postering_campaign_suppressed_ig
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

mughal.1 = { # Heiring Grievances
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	title = mughal.1.t
	desc = mughal.1.d
	flavor = mughal.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_politician_parliament_motion"
	}

	dlc = dlc011

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = long_modifier_time } # the chances of this happening twice are slim, but Akbar insisting again years later sounds appropriate for him.

	trigger = {
		is_subject = yes
		ruler = {
			has_template = mug_akbar_ii
		}
		any_scope_character = {
			is_heir_of_own_country = yes
			has_template = mug_bahadur_ii
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			ruler = {
				NOT = { has_template = mug_akbar_ii } # event cancels if Akbar dithered and didn't press the succession issue either way
			}
			is_subject = no
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		overlord = {
			save_scope_as = probably_east_india_company_scope
		}
		top_overlord = {
			save_scope_as = probably_britain_scope
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = hindustan
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = { has_template = mug_akbar_ii }
			save_scope_as = akbar_ii
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = { has_template = mug_bahadur_ii }
			save_scope_as = bahadur_ii
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = mughal.1.a
		default_option = yes

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}

		add_liberty_desire = -5
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = mirza_salim_will_probably_die
			trigger_event = {
				id = mughal.2
				months = 3
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = mughal.1.b

		ai_chance = {
			base = 0

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					OR = {
						has_attitude = {
							who = scope:probably_east_india_company_scope
							attitude = DEFIANT
						}
						has_attitude = {
							who = scope:probably_east_india_company_scope
							attitude = REBELLIOUS
						}
					}
				}
				add = 10
			}
		}

		add_modifier = {
			name = assertive_mughals
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = belated_british_interference
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		overlord = {
			change_relations = {
				country = root
				value = -50
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = mirza_salim_succeeds
			create_character = {
				template = mug_mirza_salim
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			trigger_event = {
				id = mughal.3 # separate event to fire BIC notification, so Mirza Salim can be scoped to in loc properly
			}
		}
	}
}

	trigger = {

		taking_loans = yes
	}

			is_character_alive = no
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = mughal.5.a
        default_option = yes

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_scope_character = {
						is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
						OR = {
							has_trait = ambitious
							has_template = mug_mirza_salim
						}
					}
				}
				add = -1
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:hindustan_ruler = {
						has_template = mug_bahadur_ii
					}
				}
				add = 1
			}
		}

		add_modifier = {
			name = reliant_on_temporary_stipend
			days = short_modifier_time
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dlc_feature = lobbies
				any_political_lobby = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_anti_overlord
				}
			}
			random_political_lobby = {
				limit = { is_political_lobby_type = lobby_anti_overlord }
				change_appeasement = {
					amount = -1
					factor = appeasement_lobby_loss
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = mughal.5.b

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_scope_character = {
						is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
						OR = {
							has_trait = ambitious
							has_template = mug_mirza_salim
						}
					}
				}

			}
		}

				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}

mughal.6 = { # The British India Society
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	title = mughal.6.t
	desc = mughal.6.d
	flavor = mughal.6.f

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_persian_court"
	}

	dlc = dlc011

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	immediate = {
		overlord = {
			save_scope_as = probably_east_india_company_scope
		}
		top_overlord = {
			save_scope_as = probably_britain_scope
		}

		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = hindustan_ruler
		}

		root = {
			save_scope_as = hindustan
			ruler = {
				save_scope_as = hindustan_ruler
			}

		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned }
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				}
			}
			i:ideology_abolitionist = {
				save_scope_as = potentially_swayed_mug_ideology
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_role_of_type = politician
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no # but it is okay if an heir is targeted with this
					character_is_valid_for_events = yes
					OR = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
						is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
						is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
						is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
						is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
					}
					NOT = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist }
				}
				save_scope_as = potentially_swayed_mug_politician
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
				NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom }
				has_technology_researched = egalitarianism
			}
			i:ideology_radical = {
				save_scope_as = potentially_swayed_mug_ideology
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_role_of_type = politician
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no # but it is okay if an heir is targeted with this
					character_is_valid_for_events = yes
					OR = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
						is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
						is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
						is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
						is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
					}
					NOT = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical }
				}
				save_scope_as = potentially_swayed_mug_politician
			}
		}
		else = {
			i:ideology_abolitionist = {
				save_scope_as = potentially_swayed_mug_ideology
			}
		}

		random_political_lobby = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_overlord
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
				}
				target = scope:probably_britain_scope
			}
			save_scope_as = pro_probably_britain_lobby_scope
		}

		set_variable = engaged_with_british_india_society
	}

	trigger = {
		empty_agitator_slots >= 1
		is_subject = yes
		exists = overlord
		exists = top_overlord
		overlord = {
			is_subject = yes
			is_direct_subject_of = top_overlord
		}
		NOT = {
			has_variable = engaged_with_british_india_society
		}
		OR = {
			overlord = {
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:british
			}
			top_overlord = {
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:british
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_subject = no
			NOT = { exists = scope:probably_east_india_company_scope }
			NOT = { exists = scope:probably_britain_scope }
			NOT = { scope:probably_east_india_company_scope = { is_direct_subject_of = scope:probably_britain_scope } }
		}
		empty_agitator_slots = 0
	}

	option = {
		name = mughal.6.a
        default_option = yes

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_scope_character = {
						is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver
					}
				}
				add = -1
			}
		}

		create_character = {
			template = mug_george_thompson

			# if MUG does not have any laws an abolitionist would object to, George Thompson will be radical instead
			on_created = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
							NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom }
							has_technology_researched = egalitarianism
						}
					}
					set_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
				}
			}
		}

		add_modifier = {
			name = british_india_society_support # +0.05 liberty desire, but for a very long time
			days = very_long_modifier_time
		}

		random_list = {
			1 = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = mughal_6_slavers_offended
					every_interest_group = {
						limit = {
							OR = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pro_slavery
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pro_slavery_colonial
								leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver }
							}
						}
						add_modifier = {
							name = ig_slavers_mad
							days = short_modifier_time
							multiplier = 0.66
						}
					}
				}
			}
			1 = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = scope:potentially_swayed_mug_politician
					}
					custom_tooltip = {
						text = mughal_6_moderate_swayed_to_ideology

						scope:potentially_swayed_mug_politician = {
							set_ideology = scope:potentially_swayed_mug_ideology
						}
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						exists = scope:potentially_swayed_mug_ideology
						any_interest_group = {
							leader = { has_ideology = scope:potentially_swayed_mug_ideology }
						}
					}
					every_interest_group = {
						limit = {
							leader = { has_ideology = scope:potentially_swayed_mug_ideology }
						}
						add_modifier = {
							name = ideology_surge_in_popularity
							days = short_modifier_time
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
						add_modifier = {
							name = ideology_surge_in_popularity
							days = short_modifier_time
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = mughal.6.b

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pro_slavery
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pro_slavery_colonial

			}

	option = {

				name = britains_baleful_eye		# decreases LD for BIC and increases LD for ALL BIC subjects
				days = short_modifier_time

		}
	}

						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_india
						owner = {
							is_player = no
							relations:root >= 20
							OR = {
								is_subject = no
								is_subject_of = scope:bic_scope
							}
							any_primary_culture = {
								shares_heritage_trait_group_with_any_primary_culture = ROOT
							}
						}
					}
	    		}

									owner = ROOT
								}
							}
						}
						order_by = gdp
						position = 0
						check_range_bounds = no
						save_temporary_scope_as = to_be_annexed
					}

					if = {
						limit = {
							exists = scope:to_be_annexed
							exists = scope:bic_scope
							scope:to_be_annexed = { is_subject_of = scope:bic_scope }
						}
						scope:bic_scope = {
							change_relations = {
								country = root
								value = -10
							}
						}
					}

					if = {
						limit = { exists = scope:to_be_annexed }

							name = mughal_annex_count
							add = 1
						}
					}
					else = {
						change_variable = {
							name = mughal_annex_count
							add = 3 # just force it to end
						}
					}
				}
			}
    	}
    }

						change_variable = {
							name = mughal_annex_count
							add = 3 # just force it to end
						}
					}
				}
			}
    	}
    }
}
}

# John Ross' Protest Petition
native_resettlement.2 = {
	type = country_event
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_scales.dds"
	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_native_american"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	title = native_resettlement.2.t
	desc = native_resettlement.2.d
	flavor = native_resettlement.2.f

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = john_ross_petition }
		NOT = { has_variable = trail_of_tears_stall }
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = john_ross_petition
		cu:cherokee = {
			save_scope_as = cherokee_culture
		}
		c:SEQ ?= {
			save_scope_as = indian_territory_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_variable = is_andrew_jackson
							has_trait = bigoted
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_variable = is_andrew_jackson
							has_trait = bigoted
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = jackson_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = native_resettlement.2.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:jackson_scope
			}
			scope:jackson_scope = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = USA_rejected_ross_petition
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = native_resettlement.2.b
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_enacting_law = law_type:law_multicultural
					is_enacting_law = law_type:law_no_colonial_affairs
				}
			}
			add_enactment_modifier = { # enactment success chance
				name = john_ross_enactment
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:jackson_scope
			}
			scope:jackson_scope = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = USA_accepted_ross_petition
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = trail_of_tears_stalled
			set_variable = {
				name = trail_of_tears_stall
				months = 36
			}
		}
	}
}

# Preparing for Removal
native_resettlement.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:indian_removal_state

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"
	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_native_american"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	title = native_resettlement.3.t
	desc = native_resettlement.3.d
	flavor = native_resettlement.3.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = 270 }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = trail_of_tears_stall }
		has_journal_entry = je_indian_removal
		any_scope_state = {
			any_scope_pop = {
				culture = cu:cherokee
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = trail_of_tears_stall
			months = 12
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_pop = {
					culture = cu:cherokee
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = indian_removal_state
		}
		c:SEQ ?= {
			save_scope_as = indian_territory_scope
			capital = {
				save_scope_as = oklahoma_state
			}
		}
		cu:cherokee = {
			save_scope_as = cherokee_culture
		}
	}

	option = { # use force
		name = native_resettlement.3.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:indian_removal_state = {
			kill_population_percent_in_state = {
				percent = 0.10
				culture = cu:cherokee
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					culture = cu:cherokee
				}
				move_pop = scope:oklahoma_state
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = indian_removal_force_tt
			set_variable = { # affects severity of trail of tears
				name = indian_removal_force
				value = 2
				months = 36
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # pay their way
		name = native_resettlement.3.b
		scope:indian_removal_state = {
			kill_population_percent_in_state = {
				percent = 0.05
				culture = cu:cherokee
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					culture = cu:cherokee
				}
				move_pop = scope:oklahoma_state
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = USA_paying_removal_costs
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_very_small
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = indian_removal_normal_tt
			set_variable = { # affects severity of trail of tears
				name = indian_removal_force
				value = 1
				months = 36
			}
		}
	}
}

# The Trail of Tears
native_resettlement.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:oklahoma_state

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_poor_people_moving"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"


	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	title = native_resettlement.4.t
	desc = native_resettlement.4.d
	flavor = native_resettlement.4.f

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		has_variable = indian_removal_force
		c:SEQ ?= {
			capital = {
				NOT = {
					has_modifier = trail_of_tears_modifier
				}
				any_scope_pop = {
					culture = cu:cherokee
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		c:SEQ ?= {
			capital = {
				save_scope_as = oklahoma_state
			}
		}
		cu:cherokee = {
			save_scope_as = cherokee_culture
		}
	}

	option = { # we did what we could
		name = native_resettlement.4.a
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				root.var:indian_removal_force < 2
				NOT = {
					has_variable = indian_removal_force
				}
			}
		}
		default_option = yes
		scope:oklahoma_state = {
			add_modifier = { # cherokee sol
				name = trail_of_tears_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_enacting_law = law_type:law_multicultural
					is_enacting_law = law_type:law_no_colonial_affairs
				}
			}
			add_enactment_modifier = { # enactment success chance
				name = trail_of_tears_enactment
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # their blood is on our hands
		name = native_resettlement.4.b
		trigger = {
			root.var:indian_removal_force >= 2
		}
		default_option = yes
		scope:oklahoma_state = {
			add_modifier = { # cherokee sol
				name = trail_of_tears_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = 2
			}
		}
	}
}

		video = "southamerica_war_civilians"
	}

	desc = native_resettlement.5.d
	flavor = native_resettlement.5.f

	duration = 3

		c:SEQ ?= {
			save_scope_as = indian_territory_scope
		}
		cu:cherokee = {
			save_scope_as = cherokee_culture
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = native_resettlement.5.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_trait = bigoted
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_trait = bigoted
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
						}
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = indian_removal_approval
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pacifist
					}
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pacifist
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = indian_removal_approval
					days = normal_modifier_time
					multiplier = -1
				}
			}
		}
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				state_region = {
					is_homeland = cu:cherokee
				}
			}
			state_region = {
				remove_homeland = cu:cherokee
			}
		}
	}
}

			}

				}

		}
		else = {

				name = native_american_rights
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

﻿namespace = natural_borders

# start event
natural_borders.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = natural_borders.1.t
	desc = natural_borders.1.d
	flavor = natural_borders.1.f

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_signed_contract"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	trigger = {
		# triggered by je_french_natural_borders
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = yes
				is_in_government = yes
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ethno_nationalist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_authoritarian
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			leader = { save_scope_as = borders_leader }
		}
		s:STATE_SAVOY = {
			random_scope_state = {
				save_scope_as = savoy_state
			}
		}
		s:STATE_NORTH_RHINE = {
			random_scope_state = {
				save_scope_as = rhineland_state
			}
		}
		s:STATE_FLANDERS = {
			random_scope_state = {
				save_scope_as = flanders_state
			}
		}
		c:FRA ?= { save_scope_as = france_scope }
	}

	option = {
		name = natural_borders.1.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_WALLONIA }
			}
			s:STATE_WALLONIA = {
				add_claim = ROOT
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_FLANDERS }
			}
			s:STATE_FLANDERS = {
				add_claim = ROOT
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_RHINELAND }
			}
			s:STATE_RHINELAND = {
				add_claim = ROOT
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_NORTH_RHINE }
			}
			s:STATE_NORTH_RHINE = {
				add_claim = ROOT
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_SAVOY }
			}
			s:STATE_SAVOY = {
				add_claim = ROOT
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = france_natural_borders_pursuit
			days = very_long_modifier_time
			# country_infamy_decay_mult
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
				any_scope_state = {
					OR = {
						state_region = s:STATE_WALLONIA
						state_region = s:STATE_FLANDERS
						state_region = s:STATE_RHINELAND
						state_region = s:STATE_NORTH_RHINE
						state_region = s:STATE_SAVOY
					}
				}
			}
			trigger_event = { id = natural_borders.4 }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_diplomatic_relevance = c:FRA
					NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
				}
				post_notification = fra_natural_borders_notification
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # imperialist IG's unhappy
		name = natural_borders.1.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = dismiss_natural_borders_tt
			set_variable = reject_natural_borders
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = yes
				is_in_government = yes
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ethno_nationalist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_authoritarian
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = no_natural_borders
				days = long_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
				# interest_group_approval_add
			}
		}
	}
}

# France annexes Savoy
natural_borders.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:savoy_state
	title = natural_borders.3.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = natural_borders.3.d
				trigger = {
					exists = scope:nice_state
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = natural_borders.3.d2
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = natural_borders.3.f

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_signed_contract"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	trigger = {
		# triggered by france_annex_savoy
	}

	immediate = {
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_at_war = no
				any_scope_state = {
					state_region = s:STATE_SAVOY
					is_split_state = no
					is_capital = no
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = savoy_country
			ruler = {
				save_scope_as = savoy_ruler
			}
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					state_region = s:STATE_SAVOY
					is_split_state = no
					is_capital = no
				}
				save_scope_as = savoy_state
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_state = {
						state_region = s:STATE_PROVENCE
					}
				}
				random_scope_state = {
					limit = {
						state_region = s:STATE_PROVENCE
					}
					save_scope_as = nice_state
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # incorporate Savoy into France
		name = natural_borders.3.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_owed_obligation_by = scope:savoy_country
			}
			scope:savoy_country = {
				set_owes_obligation_to = {
					country = ROOT
					setting = no
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = fra_savoy_sardinia
			}
			show_as_tooltip = {
				set_owes_obligation_to = {
					country = scope:savoy_country
					setting = yes
				}
			}
		}
		scope:savoy_state = {
			set_state_owner = ROOT
			set_state_type = incorporated
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:nice_state
			}
			scope:nice_state = {
				set_state_owner = ROOT
			}
		}
		s:STATE_SAVOY = {
			remove_homeland = cu:north_italian
		}
	}

	option = { # conduct a plebiscite
		name = natural_borders.3.b
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_owed_obligation_by = scope:savoy_country
			}
			scope:savoy_country = {
				set_owes_obligation_to = {
					country = ROOT
					setting = no
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = fra_savoy_sardinia
			}
			show_as_tooltip = {
				set_owes_obligation_to = {
					country = scope:savoy_country
					setting = yes
				}
			}
		}
		scope:savoy_state = {
			set_state_owner = ROOT
			set_state_type = unincorporated
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				culture = cu:french
				value = very_large_radicals
			}
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				culture = cu:francoprovencal
				value = very_large_radicals
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:nice_state
			}
			scope:nice_state = {
				set_state_owner = ROOT
			}
		}
		s:STATE_SAVOY = {
			remove_homeland = cu:north_italian
		}
	}
}

namespace = rhine_confederation

rhine_confederation.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = rhine_confederation.1.t
	desc = rhine_confederation.1.d
	flavor = rhine_confederation.1.f

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_signed_contract"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	trigger = {

	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					is_subject_of = ROOT
					capital = {
						OR = {
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_germany_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_germany_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_rhine_old
						}
					}
					NOT = {
						has_diplomatic_pact = {
							who = ROOT
							type = personal_union
							is_initiator = no
						}
					}
					is_player = yes
				}
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					is_subject_of = ROOT
					capital = {
						OR = {
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_germany_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_germany_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_rhine_old
						}
					}
					NOT = {
						has_diplomatic_pact = {
							who = ROOT
							type = personal_union
							is_initiator = no
						}
					}
					is_player = yes
				}
				change_tag = RHN
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					is_subject_of = ROOT
					capital = {
						OR = {
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_germany_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_germany_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_rhine_old
						}
					}
					NOT = {
						has_diplomatic_pact = {
							who = ROOT
							type = personal_union
							is_initiator = no
						}
					}
				}
			}
			ordered_country = {
				limit = {
					is_subject_of = ROOT
					capital = {
						OR = {
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_germany_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_germany_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_rhine_old
						}
					}
					NOT = {
						has_diplomatic_pact = {
							who = ROOT
							type = personal_union
							is_initiator = no
						}
					}
				}
				order_by = country_rank
				position = 0
				check_range_bounds = no
				change_tag = RHN
			}
		}
		else = {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					state_region = {
						OR = {
							is_homeland = cu:south_german
							is_homeland = cu:north_german
						}
					}
					OR = {
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_germany_old
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_germany_old
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_rhine_old
					}
					is_incorporated = no
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
							ROOT = {
								country_has_primary_culture = cu:french
							}
						}
						NOR = {
							state_region = s:STATE_RHINELAND
							state_region = s:STATE_NORTH_RHINE
							state_region = s:STATE_WALLONIA
							state_region = s:STATE_FLANDERS
						}
					}
				}
				order_by = gdp
				position = 0
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = rhine_state
			}
			create_country = {
				tag = RHN
				origin = ROOT
				state = scope:rhine_state
			}
			ROOT = {
				create_diplomatic_pact = {
					country = c:RHN
					type = puppet
				}
			}
		}
		c:RHN ?= {
			save_scope_as = rhine_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = rhine_confederation.1.a
		trigger = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:french
			any_state_in_french_natural_borders = {
				NOT = {
					owner = ROOT
				}
			}
		}
		every_country_in_german_confederation = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					c:RHN ?= THIS
				}
				is_subject_of = ROOT
				NOT = {
					has_diplomatic_pact = {
						who = ROOT
						type = personal_union
						is_initiator = no
					}
				}
			}
			c:RHN ?= {
				annex_with_incorporation = prev
			}
		}
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				state_region = {
					OR = {
						is_homeland = cu:south_german
						is_homeland = cu:north_german
					}
				}
				is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_german_confederation
				NOR = {
					state_region = s:STATE_RHINELAND
					state_region = s:STATE_NORTH_RHINE
					state_region = s:STATE_WALLONIA
					state_region = s:STATE_FLANDERS
				}
				is_incorporated = no
			}
			set_state_owner = c:RHN
			set_state_type = incorporated
		}
		every_state_in_french_natural_borders = {
			limit = {
				c:RHN ?= owner
			}
			set_state_owner = root
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = rhine_confederation.1.b
		default_option = yes
		every_country_in_german_confederation = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					c:RHN ?= THIS
				}
				is_subject_of = ROOT
				NOT = {
					has_diplomatic_pact = {
						who = ROOT
						type = personal_union
						is_initiator = no
					}
				}
			}
			c:RHN ?= {
				annex_with_incorporation = prev
			}
		}
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				state_region = {
					OR = {
						is_homeland = cu:south_german
						is_homeland = cu:north_german
					}
				}
				is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_german_confederation
				is_incorporated = no
			}
			set_state_owner = c:RHN
			set_state_type = incorporated
		}
	}
}
﻿namespace = natural_disaster_events

natural_disaster_events.1 = { #Small Earthquake
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:earthquake_state

	title = natural_disaster_events.1.t
	desc = natural_disaster_events.1.d
	flavor = natural_disaster_events.1.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_devastation"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			state_region = {
				is_vulnerable_to_earthquakes = yes
				has_harvest_condition = earthquake
				NOT = { has_variable = natural_disaster_cooldown }
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				state_region = {
					is_vulnerable_to_earthquakes = yes
					has_harvest_condition = earthquake
					NOT = { has_variable = natural_disaster_cooldown }
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = earthquake_state
			state_region = {
				set_variable = {
					name = natural_disaster_cooldown
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #No extra help
		name = natural_disaster_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:earthquake_state.state_region = {
			add_devastation = 20
		}
	}

	option = { #Extra help
		name = natural_disaster_events.1.b
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_earthquake_relief
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		scope:earthquake_state.state_region = {
			add_devastation = 10
		}
	}
}

natural_disaster_events.3 = { #Mega Flood
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:mega_flood_state

	title = natural_disaster_events.3.t
	desc = natural_disaster_events.3.d
	flavor = natural_disaster_events.3.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_devastation"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			state_region = {
				has_harvest_condition = flood
				NOT = { has_variable = natural_disaster_cooldown }
			}
		}

		NOT = {
			has_variable = mega_flood
		}

		NOT = {
			global_var:number_of_mega_floods > 5
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				state_region = {
					has_harvest_condition = flood
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = mega_flood_state
			state_region = {
				set_variable = {
					name = natural_disaster_cooldown
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = mega_flood
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:number_of_mega_floods }
			change_global_variable = {
				name = number_of_mega_floods
				add = 1
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_global_variable = {
				name = number_of_mega_floods
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #No extra help
		name = natural_disaster_events.3.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:mega_flood_state.state_region = {
			add_devastation = 40
		}
	}

	option = { #Extra help
		name = natural_disaster_events.3.b
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_mega_flood_relief
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_large
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		scope:mega_flood_state.state_region = {
			add_devastation = 20
		}
	}
}

﻿namespace = naval_tech_events
 naval_tech_events.1 = {
 	type = country_event
 	placement = root

 	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

 	event_image = {
 		video = "unspecific_naval_battle"
 	}

 	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

 	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

 	title = naval_tech_events.1.t
 	desc = naval_tech_events.1.d
 	flavor = naval_tech_events.1.f

	trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = dreadnought_tech
		is_at_war = yes
		any_scope_fleet = {
			exists = commander
			any_scope_ship = {
				is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_dreadnought
			}
			formation_ship_type_fraction = {
				target = ship_type:ship_type_dreadnought
				value >= 0.1
			}
		}
	}

 	immediate = {
		random_scope_fleet = {
			limit = {
				exists = commander
				any_scope_ship = {
					is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_dreadnought
				}
				formation_ship_type_fraction = {
					target = ship_type:ship_type_dreadnought
					value >= 0.1
				}
			}
			commander ?= {
 				save_scope_as = dreadnought_tech_commander
			}
		}
 	}

 	option = {
 		name = naval_tech_events.1.a
 		add_modifier = {
 			name = fearless_navy # country_prestige_mult
 			days = normal_modifier_time
 		}
 	}

 	option = {
 		name = naval_tech_events.1.b
 		default_option = yes
 		add_modifier = {
 			name = not_just_for_show # country_navy_power_projection_mult
 			days = normal_modifier_time
 		}
 	}
 }

﻿namespace = negotiation

###Negotiation Documentation

##Welcome to negotiations! These are designed to be completely modular. At the time of writing it is designed as a single event. But don't be deceived, there are many variations within.

##Event loc and the events image are pulled from a random list, with 3 possibilities for each level, based on whether negotiations are Collaborative, Pragmatic, or Tense. It is possible to add more images and loc simply by adjusting the set_negotiation_loc scripted effect, in 04_neg_event_options_scripted_effects...  This can be done either independently or synced with the options, so art, loc.

##Then then the event options are generated in he set_neg_options scripted effect, also in 04_neg_event_options_scripted_effects. Note there are other files for the other more practical negotiations scripted effects, triggers, and script values.

##Options are chosen from this random list in the immediate, with each option having triggers, and some with modified chances (e.g. making more likely to be chosen by a certain IG). Some have effects run in the immediate. A big gotcha here is that scopes cannot be saved here, since its all in a random list which does not save permanent scopes (at the time of writing). Use temporary scopes and save as variables instead.

##Finally, the options themselves have effects. Most of these are multiplied by GDP at some point, and also by the severity of the negotiations. Tense Negotiations have multipliers of 4, Pragmatic negotiations of 2, and Collaborative of 1.

##Many options then start a corresponding Journal Entry. The Journal entry effects are also multiplied by the level of negotiations. Negotiation journal entries are designed to be punishing if players fail, but don't offer great rewards. This is because players have already received their award upfront when they got the boost on the enacted law.

##Scripted effects are used extensively to keep negotiations consistent and aid in adjusting balance. To ensure a value (like the amount of buildings the player is promising to build) remains consistent in the event option's localisation and in the promise journal entries, all these tend to be saved as variables on the interest group. E.g. var:promise_quest_degree saves the degree of negotiations (tense, etc), var:promised_building_type is the building type, var:building_level_increase is the amount promised to reach, var:promise_quest_type powers the script value which adjusts the failure effects based on how close the player gets to fulfilling the goal, based on the quest type - all these are saved on the IG.

##The Promise Journal entries have some logic which grabs the right interest group and then sets up the journal entry based on these variables, carrying right to the end of the JE, where they are finally cleared in the quest_cleanup scripted effect so they do not interfere with any future negotiations. (Don't forget that.)

##However, it is possible to skip this whole system and go ahead and create a entirely new negotiation event, with specific triggers, options, loc and art. The main reason you wouldn't want to do this is, by simply adding triggered loc and options in the existing system, the existing set of options can be reused. If you want to create entirely new options for a very specific event, then it is a good case to make a separate event - though make sure an appropriately long cooldown is used to ensure balance.

##To do this, simply add the event to the list on the on_negotiate_with on-action (you'll see negotiation.1 there) and ensure it contains is_popup = yes. You may want to look at the immediate of the original event and at the negotiation_end scripted trigger, especially with the finish_negotiation effect. Another essential scripted effect is improve_law_stance, which does some of the heavy lifting and tooltip work on top of the raw improve_stance from code, ensuring it works as intended when making the Interest group swap stances to stop stalling or start supporting the law.

##Last of all, remember to set appropriate AI weights for each option.

				add = 25
			}
			modifier = { #accumulates with above, promised law is easy to pass and wanted
				trigger = {
					scope:ig.var:desired_law_var.type = {
						law_is_valid_for_ig_petition = yes #AI would want this law
						law_estimated_enactment_chance > law_estimated_stall_chance
					}
				}
				add = 50
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = { #also resets petition cooldown
			text = promise_pass_law_tt
			set_variable = { name = gov_petition_cooldown years = 15 }
			set_variable = { name = gov_petition_fired months = 3 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = promise_pass_law_extra_help_tt
		scope:ig = {
			finish_negotiation = "negotiation.1.o4"
			set_variable = {
				name = promise_quest_type
				value = 2 #law
			}
		}
		promise_quest = yes
		if = { #must do this last to ensure variables set.
			limit = {
				has_journal_entry = je_government_petition_negotiation_version
			}
			add_journal_entry = { #add duplicate version for 2nd law promise
				type = je_government_petition_negotiation_version_b
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_journal_entry = {
				type = je_government_petition_negotiation_version
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #Promise to build specific buildings
		name = negotiation.1.o5
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				var:negotiation_option_a = 5
				var:negotiation_option_b = 5
				var:negotiation_option_c = 5
			}
		}

		ai_chance = { #AI should never do this
			base = 0
		}


		custom_tooltip = {
			text = promise_build_tt
		}
		scope:ig = {
			finish_negotiation = "negotiation.1.o5"
			set_variable = {
				name = promise_quest_type
				value = 3 #buildings
			}
		}
		promise_quest = yes
		construction_balance_effects = yes
		add_journal_entry = { #must do this last
			type = je_negotiate_buildings
		}
	}

	option = { #Promise to build group
		name = negotiation.1.o6
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				var:negotiation_option_a = 6
				var:negotiation_option_b = 6
				var:negotiation_option_c = 6
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = promise_building_group_tt
		}
		scope:ig = {
			finish_negotiation = "negotiation.1.o6"
			set_variable = {
				name = promise_quest_type
				value = 3 #buildings
			}
		}
		promise_quest = yes
		construction_balance_effects = yes
		add_journal_entry = { #must do this last
			type = je_negotiate_building_group
		}
	}

	option = { #Promise to build group
		name = negotiation.1.o7
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				var:negotiation_option_a = 7
				var:negotiation_option_b = 7
				var:negotiation_option_c = 7
			}
		}

		ai_chance = { #AI should never do this
			base = 0
		}

		custom_tooltip = promise_lower_taxes_tt
		scope:ig = {
			finish_negotiation = "negotiation.1.o7"
			set_variable = {
				name = promise_quest_type
				value = 4 #taxes
			}
		}
		promise_quest = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:ig.var:promise_quest_degree <= 2
			}
			set_tax_level = low
		}
		else = {
			set_tax_level = very_low
		}
		add_journal_entry = { #must do this last
			type = je_negotiate_taxes
		}
	}

	option = { #amendments
		name = negotiation.1.o8
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				var:negotiation_option_a = 8
				var:negotiation_option_b = 8
				var:negotiation_option_c = 8
			}
			exists = scope:ig.var:negotiation_amendment_type
		}

		ai_chance = { #AI should always do this, on the rare occasions it's available
			base = 100
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				var:negotiation_amendment_type ?= amendment_type:amendment_short_term_tax_cuts
			}
			scope:law = {
				add_amendment = {
					type = scope:ig.var:negotiation_amendment_type
					sponsor = scope:ig
					cooldown = 24
					timeout = 60
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:law = {
				add_amendment = {
					type = scope:ig.var:negotiation_amendment_type
					sponsor = scope:ig
					cooldown = 120
				}
			}
		}
		scope:ig = {
			finish_negotiation = "negotiation.1.o8"
			improve_law_stance = yes
		}
	}


	option = { #SOL
		name = negotiation.1.o9
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				var:negotiation_option_a = 9
				var:negotiation_option_b = 9
				var:negotiation_option_c = 9
			}
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 5
			modifier = { #less than 5% in debt, good sign
				trigger = {
					principal < {
						add = credit
						multiply = 0.05
					}
				}
				add = 50
			}
			modifier = { #don't do if in serious debt
				trigger = {
					principal > {
						add = credit
						multiply = 0.15
					}
				}
				add = -200
			}
			modifier = { #if investment pool is good, that's sign things are gonna improve
				trigger = {
					investment_pool_net_income > {
						add = root.income
						multiply = 0.15
					}
				}
				add = 10
			}
			modifier = { #if investment pool is bad, trouble
				trigger = {
					investment_pool_net_income < {
						add = root.income
						multiply = 0.05
					}
				}
				add = -20
			}
			modifier = { #pragmatic promise tends to complete itself
				trigger = {
					scope:ig.var:promise_quest_degree = 2
				}
				add = 15
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = promise_higher_sol_tt
		}
		scope:ig = {
			finish_negotiation = "negotiation.1.o9"
			set_variable = {
				name = promise_quest_type
				value = 5 #SOL
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = heroes_of_the_people
				days = long_modifier_time
				multiplier = scope:ig.var:promise_quest_degree
			}
		}
		promise_quest = yes
		add_journal_entry = { #must do this last
			type = je_negotiate_sol
		}
	}

	#### This Option must be at the bottom
	option = { #cancel
		name = negotiation.1.cancel
		default_option = yes

		ai_chance = { #do if no other option looks good
			base = 1
		}

		scope:ig = {
			finish_negotiation = "negotiation.1.cancel"
			add_modifier = {
				name = failed_negotiations_ig
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	#### The Cancel Option must be at the bottom
}

expedition_events.2 = { #Choose commander
	type = country_event
    placement = ROOT

    title = expedition_events.2.t
    desc = expedition_events.2.d
    flavor = expedition_events.2.f

    event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_jungle_expedition"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

    duration = 3

	trigger = {
		any_scope_character = {
			is_busy = no
			OR = {
				has_role_of_type = general
				has_role_of_type = admiral
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_busy = no
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				OR = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader_1
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_busy = no
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				OR = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}
				NOT = {
					this = scope:expedition_leader_1
				}

			}
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader_2
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_busy = no
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				OR = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}
				NOR = {
					this = scope:expedition_leader_1
					this = scope:expedition_leader_2
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader_3
		}
		set_variable = niger_river_expedition_var
		niger_river_expedition_location = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = expedition_events.2.a
		custom_tooltip = expedition_costs_tt
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_large_expedition_cost
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
		}
		scope:expedition_leader_1 = {
			set_as_expedition_leader = yes
		}
		trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.4 days = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = expedition_events.2.b
		custom_tooltip = expedition_costs_tt
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:expedition_leader_2
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_large_expedition_cost
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
		}
		scope:expedition_leader_2 = {
			set_as_expedition_leader = yes
		}
		trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.4 days = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = expedition_events.2.c
		custom_tooltip = expedition_costs_tt
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:expedition_leader_3
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_large_expedition_cost
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
		}
		scope:expedition_leader_3 = {
			set_as_expedition_leader = yes
		}
		trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.4 days = 30 }
	}
}

expedition_events.30 = { #Help from locals
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location
    title = expedition_events.30.t
    desc = expedition_events.30.d
    flavor = expedition_events.30.f

    event_image = {
		video = "africa_animism"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

    duration = 3

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			je:je_niger_river_expedition ?= {
				"scripted_bar_progress(expedition_progress_bar)" >= 1
			}
			je:je_congo_expedition ?= {
				"scripted_bar_progress(expedition_progress_bar)" >= 1
			}
			je:je_central_africa_expedition ?= {
				"scripted_bar_progress(expedition_progress_bar)" >= 1
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = help_from_locals }
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = on_expedition }
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = help_from_locals
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = congo_river_expedition_var }
			congo_river_expedition_location = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = niger_river_expedition_var }
			niger_river_expedition_location = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = central_africa_expedition_var }
			central_africa_location_effect = yes
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = { has_variable = expedition_leader_var }
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader
		}
	}

	option = { #Look for guides
		name = expedition_events.30.a
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			scope:expedition_leader = {
				NOT = {
					has_trait = bigoted
				}
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			10 = {
				modifier = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							ROOT.modifier:country_expedition_events_explorer_mult > 0
						}
						add = 5
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:expedition_leader.modifier:character_expedition_events_explorer_mult > 0
						}
						add = 20
					}
				}
				trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.31 days = 0 popup = yes }
			}
			10 = {
				trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.32 days = 0 popup = yes}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #Don't look for guides
		name = expedition_events.30.b
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = expedition_event_ongoing_tt
	}
}

						limit = {
							ROOT.modifier:country_expedition_events_explorer_mult > 0
						}
						add = 5
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:expedition_leader.modifier:character_expedition_events_explorer_mult > 0
						}
						add = 20
					}
				}
				trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.82 days = 0 popup = yes}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = expedition_events.80.b
		trigger_event = { id = expedition_events.83 days = 0 popup = yes }
	}
}

expedition_events.110 = { #Leader dies
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location

    title = expedition_events.110.t
    desc = expedition_events.110.d
    flavor = expedition_events.110.f

    event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_jungle_expedition"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = on_expedition }
	}

    duration = 3

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = expedition_new_leader }
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = { has_variable = expedition_leader_var }
			save_scope_as = dead_expedition_leader
			remove_variable = expedition_leader_var
		}
		create_character = {
			ig_leader = no
			female = no
			is_general = yes
			on_created = {
				set_variable = expedition_leader_var
				ROOT = {
					set_variable = { name = expedition_leader_storage_var value = prev }
				}
			}
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = expedition_leader_var
			}
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader
			set_character_busy_and_immortal = yes
		}
		set_variable = expedition_new_leader
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = niger_river_expedition_var }
			niger_river_expedition_location = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = central_africa_expedition_var }
			central_africa_location_effect = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = expedition_events.110.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:dead_expedition_leader = {
			set_character_busy_and_immortal = no
			kill_character = yes
		}
		show_as_tooltip = {
			scope:current_expedition_location = {
				create_character = {
					ig_leader = no
					female = no
					is_general = yes
					on_created = {
						set_character_busy_and_immortal = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		scope:expedition_leader = {
			set_variable = expedition_leader_var
			unassign_from_formation = yes
			ROOT = {
				set_variable = { name = expedition_leader_storage_var value = prev }
			}
		}
		add_small_peril_effect = yes
		expedition_minor_progress_effect = yes
	}
}

expedition_events.120 = { #DR LIVINGSTONE EVENT
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location

    title = expedition_events.120.t
    desc = expedition_events.120.d
    flavor = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = expedition_events.120.f
				trigger = {
					NOT = { has_variable = crazy_explorer_var }
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = expedition_events.120.f2
				trigger = {
					has_variable = crazy_explorer_var
				}
			}
		}
	}

    event_image = {
		video = "africa_prosperous_farm"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = on_expedition }
	}

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			je:je_niger_river_expedition ?= {
				"scripted_bar_progress(expedition_progress_bar)" >= 2
			}
			je:je_congo_expedition ?= {
				"scripted_bar_progress(expedition_progress_bar)" >= 2
			}
		}
		OR = {
			has_variable = failed_congo_river_var
			has_variable = failed_niger_river_var
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = found_explorer_var }
		any_character_in_void = {
			has_variable = failed_expedition_leader_var
			owner = root
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_character_in_void = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = failed_expedition_leader_var
				owner = root
			}
			save_scope_as = old_expedition_leader
		}
		random_list = {
			75 = {
				remove_variable = crazy_explorer_var
			}
			25 = {
				set_variable = crazy_explorer_var
			}
		}
		set_variable = found_explorer_var
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = congo_river_expedition_var }
			congo_river_expedition_location = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = niger_river_expedition_var }
			niger_river_expedition_location = yes
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = { has_variable = expedition_leader_var }
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader
		}
	}

	option = { #take him with us
		name = expedition_events.120.a
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			NOT = { has_variable = crazy_explorer_var }
		}
		scope:expedition_leader = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = found_explorer_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = found_old_explorer
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		random_character_in_void = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = failed_expedition_leader_var
				owner = root
			}
			free_character_from_void = yes
			set_character_busy_and_immortal = no
		}
		custom_tooltip = expedition_event_delayed_tt
		add_small_peril_effect = yes
	}

	option = { #he seems happy here
		name = expedition_events.120.b
		expedition_minor_progress_effect = yes
	}

	option = { #he's a danger to our expedition
		name = expedition_events.120.c
		trigger = {
			has_variable = crazy_explorer_var
		}
		scope:expedition_leader = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = found_explorer_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = found_old_explorer
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		custom_tooltip = expedition_event_delayed_tt
		add_medium_peril_effect = yes
	}

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_realist_household"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
	 	#Triggered by journal entry
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dlc_feature = voice_of_the_people_content
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					c:RUS ?= THIS
					AND = {
						game_date >= 1862.1.1
						game_date <= 1882.1.1
					}
				}
				create_character = {
					template = RUS_varfolomey_zaitsev
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_german
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
					}
					AND = {
						game_date >= 1844.1.1
						game_date <= 1866.1.1
					}
					OR = { #So that the player always has first dibs on Stirner if they're playing a German country.
						is_player = yes
						NOT = {
							any_country = {
								OR = {
									country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_german
									country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
								}
								is_player = yes
							}
						}
					}
					NOT = { has_global_variable = stirner_spawn }
				}
				create_character = {
					template = BAV_max_stirner
					on_created = {
						set_variable = is_stirner_var
						set_global_variable = stirner_spawn
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					c:USA ?= THIS
					AND = {
						game_date >= 1876.1.1
						game_date <= 1930.1.1
					}
				}
				create_character = {
					template = USA_benjamin_tucker
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					c:GBR ?= THIS
					AND = {
						game_date >= 1846.1.1
						game_date <= 1906.1.1
					}
				}
				create_character = {
					template = GBR_george_holyoake
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					c:JAP ?= THIS
					AND = {
						game_date >= 1878.1.1
						game_date <= 1908.1.1
					}
				}
				create_character = {
					template = JAP_kume_kunitake
				}
			}
			else = {
				create_character = {
					is_agitator = yes
					interest_group = ig_intelligentsia
					ideology = ideology_nihilist
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			create_character = {
				is_agitator = yes
				interest_group = ig_intelligentsia
				ideology = ideology_nihilist
			}
		}

		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_role_of_type = agitator
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
			}
			save_scope_as = nihilist_scope
			set_career_length = {
				years = 20
				random_range = { 1.0 1.5 } # 20-30 years
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = nihilism.1.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_nihilist_movement_enhancement
			days = long_modifier_time
			multiplier = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_nihilist
					}
				}
			}
			create_political_movement = { type = movement_nihilist }
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nihilism.1.tt
		}
		scope:nihilist_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = popular_nihilist
			}
		}
		set_variable = nihilism_je_started
	}

	option = {
		name = nihilism.1.b

		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_nihilist_movement_enhancement
			days = long_modifier_time
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nihilism.1.tt
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_nihilist
					}
				}
			}
			create_political_movement = { type = movement_nihilist }
		}
		scope:nihilist_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = less_popular_nihilist
			}
		}
		set_variable = nihilism_je_started
	}
	option = {
		name = nihilism.1.c
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_censorship
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nihilism.1.tt
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_nihilist
					}
				}
			}
			create_political_movement = { type = movement_nihilist }
		}
		scope:nihilist_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = less_popular_nihilist_red
			}
		}
		set_variable = nihilism_je_started
	}
}

# Timeout Event - the nihilist movement transforms into a socialist movement after splitting into oblivion, socialists emboldened.

nihilism.3 = {
	type = country_event

	title = nihilism.3.t
	desc = nihilism.3.d
	flavor = nihilism.3.f

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_agitator_speaking"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {

	}

	immediate = {

	}

	option = {
		name = nihilism.3.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_technology_researched = anarchism
					has_technology_researched = socialism
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = all_tu_nihilists_become_communist_tt
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_technology_researched = socialism
						ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
							any_scope_character = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
							}
						}
					}
					ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
						every_scope_character = {
							limit = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
							}
							set_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = all_non_tu_nihilists_become_anarchist_tt
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_technology_researched = anarchism
						any_scope_character = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
						}
					}
					every_scope_character = {
						limit = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
						}
						set_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = all_nihilists_become_radical_tt
				every_scope_character = {
					limit = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
					}
					set_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
				}
			}
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = small_radicals
			interest_group = ig:ig_intelligentsia
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_active_intelligentsia
			days = normal_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = nihilism.3.b
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_technology_researched = anarchism
					has_technology_researched = socialism
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = all_tu_nihilists_become_communist_tt
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_technology_researched = socialism
						ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
							any_scope_character = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
							}
						}
					}
					ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
						every_scope_character = {
							limit = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
							}
							set_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = all_non_tu_nihilists_become_anarchist_tt
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_technology_researched = anarchism
						any_scope_character = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
						}
					}
					every_scope_character = {
						limit = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
						}
						set_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = all_nihilists_become_radical_tt
				every_scope_character = {
					limit = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
					}
					set_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	type = country_event

	title = nihilism.4.t
	desc = nihilism.4.d

	duration = 3

			ig_approval < 0
		}
		any_scope_character = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = nihilism_level_one
		}
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			save_scope_as = intelligentsia_ig
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_role_of_type = agitator
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
			}
			save_scope_as = nihilist_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:RUS ?= this
			}
			create_character = {
				template = RUS_ivan_turgenev
				save_scope_as = turgenev_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = nihilism.4.a
		default_option = yes
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_fathers_and_sons
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = conservative_intelligentsia
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:RUS ?= ROOT
			}
			scope:turgenev_scope ?= {
				set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				c:FRA ?= ROOT
				has_variable = orleanist_restoration_var
			}
			ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
				leader = {
					set_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				c:FRA ?= ROOT
				has_variable = legitimist_restoration_var
			}
			ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
				leader = {
					set_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				c:FRA ?= ROOT
				has_variable = bonapartist_restoration_var
			}
			ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
				leader = {
					set_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
				leader = {
					set_ideology = ideology:ideology_royalist
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = royalist_ig_leader_cooldown days = short_modifier_time }
	}

	option = {
		name = nihilism.4.b
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {

				name = modifier_fathers_and_sons_ignored
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}

			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_dashing_character
			}
		}
	}
}

nihilism.10 = { #Intellectual leader becomes a nihilist
	type = country_event

	title = nihilism.10.t
	desc = nihilism.10.d
	flavor = nihilism.10.f

	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid
	left_icon = scope:nihilist_leader

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	cooldown = { days = long_modifier_time }

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		has_variable = nihilism_level_two
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			ig_approval < 0
			leader = {
				NOT = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			has_variable = royalist_ig_leader_cooldown
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			save_scope_as = intelligentsia_ig
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					is_heir_of_own_country = no
					is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
				}
			}
			ordered_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					is_heir_of_own_country = no
					is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
				}
				order_by = prominence
				position = 0
				set_career_length = {
					years = 20
					random_range = { 1.0 1.5 } # 20-30 years
				}
				save_scope_as = nihilist_leader
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					c:RUS ?= THIS
					AND = {
						game_date >= 1858.1.1
						game_date <= 1875.1.1
					}
				}
				create_character = {
					template = RUS_dimitry_pisarev
					on_created = {
						set_career_length = {
							years = 20
							random_range = { 1.0 1.5 } # 20-30 years
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = nihilist_leader
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_german
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
					}
					AND = {
						game_date >= 1840.1.1
						game_date <= 1882.1.1
					}
				}
				create_character = {
					template = PRU_bruno_bauer
					on_created = {
						set_career_length = {
							years = 20
							random_range = { 1.0 1.5 } # 20-30 years
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = nihilist_leader
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					c:GBR ?= THIS
					AND = {
						game_date >= 1853.1.1
						game_date <= 1891.1.1
					}
				}
				create_character = {
					template = GBR_charles_bradlaugh
					on_created = {
						set_career_length = {
							years = 20
							random_range = { 1.0 1.5 } # 20-30 years
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = nihilist_leader
				}
			}
			else = {
				create_character = {
					role = character_role_politician
					interest_group = ig_intelligentsia
					ideology = ideology_nihilist
					on_created = {
						set_career_length = {
							years = 20
							random_range = { 1.0 1.5 } # 20-30 years
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = nihilist_leader
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = nihilism.10.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:nihilist_leader ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_role_of_type = agitator
				}
				replace_character_roles = { remove = { agitator } add = { politician } }
			}
			set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_building = building_university
			}
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				strata = middle
				value = medium_radicals
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = nihilism.10.b
		scope:nihilist_leader ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_role_of_type = agitator
				}
				replace_character_roles = { remove = { agitator } add = { politician } }
			}
			set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
		}
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_nihilists_triumphant
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

### Law Auto-Pass Event ###

nihilism.13 = { #Instant law pass for abolishing state religion/instituting atheism
	type = country_event

	title = nihilism.13.t
	desc = nihilism.13.d
	flavor = nihilism.13.f

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_cops_march"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		has_journal_entry = je_nihilist_movement
		OR = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_religion
		}
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_state_atheism
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_total_separation
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			is_in_government = yes
			leader = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			has_modifier = nihilism_averted
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		ig:ig_devout ?= {
			save_scope_as = devout_ig
		}
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = nihilism.13.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					is_enacting_law = law_type:law_state_atheism
					any_interest_group = {
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_state_atheism
							value < neutral
						}
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
				add = -25
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					is_enacting_law = law_type:law_total_separation
					any_interest_group = {
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_total_separation
							value < neutral
						}
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
				add = -25
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_state_atheism
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_state_atheism
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_total_separation
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_total_separation
		}
		# anyone not a fan of this gets VERY angry
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_state_religion
					value > neutral
				}
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_devout }
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = nihilism_triumph
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}

		ig:ig_devout ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_deicide
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = nihilism.13.b
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
		}
		# gain success chance, lose enactment time
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = nihilism_averted
		}
	}
}
﻿namespace = nursing_events
 nursing_events.1 = { #Bad conditions
 	type = country_event
 	placement = scope:ongoing_war_state

 	duration = 3

    #Fired once, by je_war_nursing

 	event_image = {
 		video = "unspecific_sick_in_hospital"
 	}

 	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

 	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

 	title = nursing_events.1.t
 	desc = nursing_events.1.d
 	flavor = nursing_events.1.f

 	trigger = {
 		any_scope_war = {
            any_scope_front = {
                any_scope_general = {
                    owner = ROOT
                    this.commander_military_formation ?= {
                        NOR = {
                            has_mobilization_option = mobilization_option:mobilization_option_first_aid
                            has_mobilization_option = mobilization_option:mobilization_option_field_hospitals
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
 		}
 	}

 	immediate = {
 		set_variable = {
 			name = nursing_cooldown
 			months = 6
 		}
 		random_scope_war = {
 			random_scope_front = {
 				random_scope_state = { save_scope_as = ongoing_war_state }
 			}
 		}
 	}

 	option = {
 		name = nursing_events.1.a
 		default_option = yes
        custom_tooltip = {
            text = for_duration_of_war_tt
        }
 		add_modifier = {
 			name = war_wounded_disease
 			days = long_modifier_time
 		}
 	}

 	option = {
 		name = nursing_events.1.b
 		 custom_tooltip = {
            text = for_duration_of_war_tt
        }
 		add_modifier = {
 			name = war_wounded_civilian_assistance
 			days = long_modifier_time
 		}
 	}
 }

 	type = country_event

 	desc = nursing_events.2.d

 	trigger = {
 		is_at_war = yes

 			num_country_dead = {
 				target = root
 				value > 1000
 			}
 			any_scope_front = {
                any_scope_general = {
                    owner = ROOT

                        OR = {
                            has_mobilization_option = mobilization_option:mobilization_option_first_aid
                            has_mobilization_option = mobilization_option:mobilization_option_field_hospitals
