                    }
                }
                any_scope_state = {	owner = root }
            }
 		}
 		NOT = {
 			has_variable = nursing_cooldown
 		}
 	}

 	immediate = {
 		ordered_scope_war = {
 			order_by = "num_country_dead(root)"
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
 			save_scope_as = ongoing_war

 				random_scope_state = {

 				}
 			}
 		}

 			name = nursing_cooldown
 			months = 6
 		}
 	}

 	option = { #Do it

 		name = nursing_events.2.a

 			add_modifier = {
 				name = medical_hygiene_local
 				days = very_long_modifier_time
 			}
 		}
 	}

 	option = { #This should be taught everywhere
 		name = nursing_events.2.b
 		add_modifier = {
 			name = medical_hygiene
 			days = very_long_modifier_time
 		}
 	}
 }

                }
            }
 		}
 		NOT = {
 			has_variable = nursing_cooldown
 		}
 	}

 	immediate = {
 		ordered_scope_war = {
 			order_by = "num_country_dead(root)"
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
 			save_scope_as = ongoing_war
 			random_scope_front = {
 				random_scope_state = { save_scope_as = ongoing_war_state }
 			}
 		}
 		set_variable = {
 			name = nursing_cooldown
 			months = 6
 		}
 	}
 	option = { #Do it
 		name = nursing_events.3.a
 		default_option = yes
 		add_modifier = {
 			name = prefab_hospital
 			days = short_modifier_time
            multiplier = 2
 		}
 	}

 	option = { #the time and knowledge is better spent on research
 		name = nursing_events.3.b
 		trigger = {
 			OR = {
 				can_research = medical_degrees
 				can_research = quinine
 				can_research = malaria_prevention
 				can_research = antibiotics
 			}
 		}
 		if = {
 			limit = {
 				can_research = medical_degrees
 			}
 			add_technology_progress = { progress = 2500 technology = medical_degrees }
 		}
 		else_if = {
 			limit = {
 				can_research = quinine
 			}
 			add_technology_progress = { progress = 3500 technology = quinine }
 		}
 		else_if = {
 			limit = {
 				can_research = malaria_prevention
 			}
 			add_technology_progress = { progress = 6000 technology = malaria_prevention }
 		}
 		else_if = {
 			limit = {
 				can_research = antibiotics
 			}
 			add_technology_progress = { progress = 5850 technology = antibiotics }
 		}
 	}
 }

# Opportunity to request adding IG to government
obligation_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = obligation_events.1.t
	desc = obligation_events.1.d
	flavor = obligation_events.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "africa_diplomats_negotiating"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		any_country = {
			owes_obligation_to = root
			any_interest_group = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				is_insurrectionary = no
				is_in_government = no
				is_same_interest_group_type = root.ruler.interest_group
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				owes_obligation_to = root
				any_interest_group = {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					is_insurrectionary = no
					is_in_government = no
					is_same_interest_group_type = root.ruler.interest_group
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = obligation_request_target


			random_interest_group = {
				limit = { is_same_interest_group_type = root.ruler.interest_group }
				save_scope_as = obligation_request_ig
			}
		}
		save_scope_as = obligation_request_sender
	}

	option = {
		name = obligation_events.1.a
		scope:obligation_request_target = {
			trigger_event = {
				id = obligation_events.2
				days = 7
			}
		}
		custom_label = obligation_events.a.tt
		show_as_tooltip = {
			scope:obligation_request_target = {
				scope:obligation_request_ig = {
					add_ruling_interest_group = yes
				}
			}
		}
		custom_label = obligation_events.b.tt
		show_as_tooltip = {
			change_relations = {
				country = scope:obligation_request_target
				value = -20
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = obligation_events.1.b
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = obligation_events.tt.no
	}
}

obligation_events.5 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = obligation_events.5.t
	desc = obligation_events.5.d
	flavor = obligation_events.5.f

	gui_window = event_window_1char_propaganda

	left_icon = scope:obligation_request_character

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		any_country = {
			owes_obligation_to = root
			is_at_war = no
			any_scope_character = {
				OR = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}
				is_busy = no
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				is_heir_of_own_country = no # I have SEEN things
				NOT = { has_variable = obligation_request_character }
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				owes_obligation_to = root
				is_at_war = no
				any_scope_character = {
					OR = {
						has_role_of_type = general
						has_role_of_type = admiral
					}
					is_busy = no
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					character_is_valid_for_events = yes
					is_heir_of_own_country = no
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = obligation_request_target
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_role_of_type = general
						has_role_of_type = admiral
					}
					is_busy = no
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					character_is_valid_for_events = yes
					is_heir_of_own_country = no
					NOT = { has_variable = obligation_request_character }
				}
				save_scope_as = obligation_request_character
				set_variable = obligation_request_character
			}
		}
		save_scope_as = obligation_request_sender
	}

	option = {
		name = obligation_events.5.a
		scope:obligation_request_target = {
			trigger_event = {
				id = obligation_events.6
				days = 7
			}
		}
		custom_label = obligation_events.a.tt
		show_as_tooltip = {
			scope:obligation_request_character = {
				transfer_character = scope:obligation_request_sender
			}
			scope:obligation_request_target = {
				set_owes_obligation_to = {
					country = root
					setting = no
				}
			}
		}
		custom_label = obligation_events.b.tt
		show_as_tooltip = {
			change_relations = {
				country = scope:obligation_request_target
				value = -20
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = obligation_events.5.b
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = obligation_events.tt.no
		scope:obligation_request_character = {
			remove_variable = obligation_request_character
		}
	}
}

# Oil!
oil_rush.1 = { #Oil discovery is handled by Toast notification. This is an Oil Rush.
	type = state_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = oil_rush.1.t
	desc = oil_rush.1.d
	flavor = oil_rush.1.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time } #State Cooldown

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = oil_state
		owner = {
			set_variable = {
				name = oil_rush_active
				days = very_long_modifier_time #National Cooldown. Oil rushes will be less frequent.
			}
		}
	}

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_oil_derricks"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"

	trigger = {
		has_potential_resource = building_oil_rig
		state_region = {
			remaining_undepleted = {
				type = building_oil_rig
				amount > 1
			}
		}
		owner = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oil_rush_active }
			NOR = {
				has_variable = always_oil_rush
				has_variable = always_oil_caution
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oil_rush.1.a
		add_modifier = {
			name = state_oil_rush
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_variable = oil_rush_state
			owner = {
				trigger_event = {
					id = oil_rush.2
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oil_rush.1.b
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = state_limited_oil_rush
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_variable = oil_rush_state
			owner = {
				trigger_event = {
					id = oil_rush.2
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oil_rush.1.c
		add_modifier = {
			name = state_oil_rush
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_variable = oil_rush_state
			owner = {
				trigger_event = {
					id = oil_rush.2
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = always_oil_rush_tt
			owner = {
				set_variable = always_oil_rush
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oil_rush.1.e
		add_modifier = {
			name = state_limited_oil_rush
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_variable = oil_rush_state
			owner = {
				trigger_event = {
					id = oil_rush.2
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = always_oil_caution_tt
			owner = {
				set_variable = always_oil_caution
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			exists = scope:oil_state
		}
	}
}

oil_rush.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:oil_state
	title = oil_rush.2.t
	desc = oil_rush.2.d
	flavor = oil_rush.2.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = long_modifier_time } #country event. Oil has not actually run out in this case, it's just the momentum.

	trigger = { #triggered 10 years after Oil Rush, and then won't be seen for 10 more years due to cooldown.
		any_scope_state = {
			has_variable = oil_rush_state
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oil_rush_state
			}
			save_scope_as = oil_state
		}
	}

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_oil_derricks"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"

	option = {
		name = oil_rush.2.a
		scope:oil_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = state_oil_rush_forever
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
		set_variable = { #Remove variable in 10 years.
			name = oil_rush_state
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oil_rush.2.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:oil_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = state_oil_manufacturing_instead
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
		remove_variable = oil_rush_state
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			exists = scope:oil_state
		}
	}
}

	type = state_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = oil_rush.3.t
	desc = oil_rush.3.d
	flavor = oil_rush.3.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

		video = "middleeast_oil_derricks"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_fire.dds"

	immediate = {
		owner = {
			set_variable = {
				name = oil_dangerous_work_fired
				days = very_long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	trigger = {
		has_building = building_oil_rig
		OR = {
			has_modifier = state_oil_rush
			has_modifier = state_limited_oil_rush
			has_modifier = state_oil_rush_forever
		}
		NOR = {
			has_modifier = state_oil_dangerous_work
			has_modifier = state_oil_prevented_dangerous_work
		}
		owner = {
			NOR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_regulatory_bodies
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_worker_protections
				has_variable = oil_dangerous_work_fired
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oil_rush.3.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = state_oil_dangerous_work
			years = 4
		}
		owner = {
			ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = permitted_oil_dangerous_work
					days = short_modifier_time
				}
			}
			ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = permitted_oil_dangerous_work
					multiplier = -1
					days = short_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oil_rush.3.b
		add_modifier = {
			name = state_oil_prevented_dangerous_work
			years = 4
		}
		owner = {
			ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = prevented_oil_dangerous_work
					days = short_modifier_time
				}
			}
			ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = prevented_oil_dangerous_work
					multiplier = -1
					days = short_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

oil_rush.5 = {

	placement = scope:oil_state
	title = oil_rush.5.t
	desc = oil_rush.5.d
	flavor = oil_rush.5.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_capitalists_meeting"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_trade.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			has_variable = bribery_scandal
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			is_in_government = yes
			leader = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				is_busy = no
				is_immortal = no
			}
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			has_variable = oil_rush_state
			has_building = building_oil_rig
			OR = {
				has_modifier = state_oil_rush
				has_modifier = state_limited_oil_rush
				has_modifier = state_oil_rush_forever
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = bribery_scandal
			days = stupidly_long_modifier_time
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oil_rush_state
			}
			save_scope_as = oil_state
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_in_government = yes
				leader = {
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					is_busy = no
					is_immortal = no
				}
			}
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = bribed_politician
			}
		}
	}

	# Jail the politician and the oilmen
	option = {
		name = oil_rush.5.a
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:bribed_politician = {
				retire_character = yes
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = oil_rush.5.tt
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = jailed_oil_barons
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	# Jail the politician
	option = {
		name = oil_rush.5.b
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:bribed_politician = {
				retire_character = yes
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = oil_rush.5.tt
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = let_off_oil_barons
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	# Jail the oilmen
	option = {
		name = oil_rush.5.c
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = jailed_oil_barons
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = corrupt_administration
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
	}

	# Let them off with fines
	option = {
		name = oil_rush.5.e
		default_option = yes
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = let_off_oil_barons
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = corrupt_administration
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			exists = scope:oil_state
		}
	}
}

oil_rush.6 = { #hidden event that does the effects if the player choose C or D on oil rush
	type = state_event
	hidden = yes

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time } #state cooldown

	trigger = {
		has_potential_resource = building_oil_rig
		owner = {
			OR = {
				has_variable = always_oil_rush
				has_variable = always_oil_caution
			}
			NOT = {
				has_variable = oil_rush_active
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = oil_state
		#Notification on on-action or in code.
		owner = {
			set_variable = {
				name = oil_rush_active
				days = very_long_modifier_time  #national cooldown
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = always_oil_rush
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = state_oil_rush
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				set_variable = oil_rush_state
				owner = {
					trigger_event = {
						id = oil_rush.2
						days = long_modifier_time
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = state_limited_oil_rush
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				set_variable = oil_rush_state
				owner = {
					trigger_event = {
						id = oil_rush.2
						days = long_modifier_time
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			exists = scope:oil_state
		}
	}
}
﻿namespace = opium_events

opium_events.1 = {
	type = country_event

	trigger = {
	}

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_factory_opening"
	}

	duration = 3

	placement = scope:opium_state

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_trade.dds"

	title = opium_events.1.t
	desc = opium_events.1.d
	flavor = opium_events.1.f

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_building = {
					is_building_type = building_opium_plantation
					cash_reserves_ratio > 0.5
					weekly_profit > 0
					occupancy >= 0.75
					level >= 10
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = opium_state
			random_scope_building = {
				limit = {
					is_building_type = building_opium_plantation
					cash_reserves_ratio > 0.5
					weekly_profit > 0
					occupancy >= 0.75
					level >= 10
				}
				save_scope_as = opium_building
			}
		}
		random_market = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { owner = root }
				mg:opium ?= {
					market_goods_imports >= 200
				}
				owner = {
					any_primary_culture = {
						NOT = {
							has_cultural_obsession = opium
						}
					}
				}
			}
			owner = {
				save_scope_as = opium_addict_country
				random_primary_culture = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_cultural_obsession = opium }
					}
					save_scope_as = opium_addict_culture
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = opium_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = opium_production_modifier
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = opium_events.1.b
		scope:opium_addict_culture = {
			add_cultural_obsession = opium
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = opium_exporter_modifier
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
}
﻿namespace = opium_wars

# Start event for obsessed country
opium_wars.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = opium_wars.1.t
	desc = opium_wars.1.d
	flavor = opium_wars.1.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_opium_smoker"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = opium_wars_start_var }
		NOR = {
			is_revolutionary = yes
			is_secessionist = yes
		}
		any_primary_culture = {
			has_cultural_obsession = opium
		}
		is_country_type = unrecognized
		total_population > 5000000
		NOT = {
			any_country = {
				has_variable = opium_wars_target
			}
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			any_scope_building = {
				is_building_type = building_trade_center
			}
		}
		is_subject = no
		NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_free_trade }
		any_market = {
            root.market = {
                market_imports_reliance = { target = prev goods = opium value > 0.25 }
            }
			owner = {
				country_rank >= rank_value:major_power
				NOR = {
					any_scope_state = {
						is_treaty_port = yes
						any_neighbouring_state = {
							owner = ROOT
						}
					}
					any_scope_treaty = {
						binds = ROOT
						any_scope_article = {
							has_type = foreign_investment_rights
							source_country = root
						}
					}
				}
			}
        }
		NOT = {
			has_modifier = opium_wars_addiction_modifier
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = opium_wars_start_var
		random_primary_culture = {
			limit = {
				has_cultural_obsession = opium
			}
			save_scope_as = addicted_culture
		}
		random_market = {
			limit = {
				root.market = {
					market_imports_reliance = { target = prev goods = opium value > 0.25 }
				}
				owner = {
					country_rank >= rank_value:major_power
					NOR = {
						any_scope_state = {
							is_treaty_port = yes
							any_neighbouring_state = {
								owner = ROOT
							}
						}
						any_scope_treaty = {
							binds = ROOT
							any_scope_article = {
								has_type = foreign_investment_rights
								source_country = root
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			owner = {
				save_scope_as = opium_exporter
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = opium_wars.1.a
		default_option = yes
		set_variable = opium_wars_target
		set_variable = {
			name = opium_wars_completion_tracker
			value = 0
		}
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_opium_obsession
		}
		# send events to all applicable powers
		# can't just use the scope because we want to catch multiple countries if we can
		random_market = {
			limit = {
				root.market = {
					market_imports_reliance = { target = prev goods = opium value > 0.25 }
				}
				owner = {
					country_rank >= rank_value:major_power
					NOR = {
						any_scope_state = {
							is_treaty_port = yes
							any_neighbouring_state = {
								owner = ROOT
							}
						}
						any_scope_treaty = {
							binds = ROOT
							any_scope_article = {
								has_type = foreign_investment_rights
								source_country = root
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			owner = {
				trigger_event = { id = opium_wars.2 }
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = opium_wars_addiction_modifier
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = opium_wars.1.b
		add_modifier = {
			name = opium_wars_addiction_modifier
			days = very_long_modifier_time
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = medium_radicals
		}
		set_variable = opium_wars_gave_in
		if = {
			limit = { has_journal_entry = je_warlord_china }
			chi_remove_1_fragile_unity = yes
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
	}
}

# Start event for opium importer
opium_wars.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = opium_wars.2.t
	desc = opium_wars.2.d
	flavor = opium_wars.2.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_opium_smoker"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	trigger = {
		# triggered by event
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = opium_wars_aggressor_country
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = opium_wars_target
			}
			save_scope_as = opium_wars_target_country
			random_primary_culture = {
				limit = {
					has_cultural_obsession = opium
				}
				save_scope_as = opium_addicted_culture
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # go opium wars
		name = opium_wars.2.a
		default_option = yes
		set_variable = opium_wars_aggressor
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:opium_wars_target_country
			value = -30
		}
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_opium_wars
			target = scope:opium_wars_target_country
		}
		add_involvement = {
			strategic_region = sr:region_south_china
			value = 2500
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { this = root }
					OR = {
						this = scope:opium_wars_target_country
						has_overlapping_interests = scope:opium_wars_target_country
						has_overlapping_interests = root
					}
				}
				post_notification = opium_wars_british_response_angry
			}

			scope:opium_wars_target_country = {
				set_secret_goal = {
					country = root
					secret_goal = antagonize
				}
			}
			set_secret_goal = {
				country = scope:opium_wars_target_country
				secret_goal = conquer
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 95
		}
	}
	option = { # not interested
		name = opium_wars.2.b
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:opium_wars_target_country
			value = 50
		}

		set_variable = opium_wars_ignored_ban

		every_subject_or_below = {
			limit = {
				is_direct_subject_of = root
				any_scope_building = {
					is_building_type = building_opium_plantation
				}
			}

			add_liberty_desire = 50
			change_relations = {
				country = root
				value = -50
			}
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { this = root }
					OR = {
						this = scope:opium_wars_target_country
						has_overlapping_interests = scope:opium_wars_target_country
						has_overlapping_interests = root
					}
				}
				post_notification = opium_wars_british_response_passive
			}

			set_mutual_secret_goal = {
				country = scope:opium_wars_target_country
				secret_goal = befriend
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 5
		}
	}
}

opium_wars.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = opium_wars.3.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = opium_wars.3.d
				trigger = {
					any_country = {
						has_variable = opium_wars_aggressor
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = opium_wars.3.d2
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = opium_wars.3.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_opium_smoker"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	trigger = {
		# triggered by JE complete
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = opium_wars_won
		if = {
			limit = { has_modifier = opium_wars_addiction_modifier }
			remove_modifier = opium_wars_addiction_modifier
		}
		random_primary_culture = {
			limit = {
				has_cultural_obsession = opium
			}
			save_scope_as = addicted_culture
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					has_variable = opium_wars_aggressor
				}
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = opium_wars_aggressor
				}
				save_scope_as = opium_wars_aggressor_country
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_journal_entry = je_warlord_china }

		default_option = yes

			remove_cultural_obsession = opium
		}

		}

		}
	}

	option = {
		name = opium_wars.3.b
		every_primary_culture = {
			remove_cultural_obsession = opium
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = china_welfare
			days = very_long_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_modifier = opium_wars_addiction_modifier }
			remove_modifier = opium_wars_addiction_modifier
		}
	}
}

		}

		default_option = yes

			name = opium_wars_lost
			days = very_long_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes

			value = large_radicals
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_banning_goods = g:opium
			}
			remove_banned_goods = g:opium
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = opium_ban_authority
			}
			remove_modifier = opium_ban_authority
		}
	}
}

	flavor = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					exists = c:GBR
					c:GBR ?= THIS
					game_date >= 1880.1.1
				}
				desc = oscar_wilde_events.1.flavor_wilde
			}
			desc = oscar_wilde_events.1.flavor_author
		}
		desc = oscar_wilde_events.1.flavor_quote
	}
	duration = 3
	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_london_center"
	}
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	minor_left_icon = scope:oscar_wilde

	trigger = {
		is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
		}
		game_date >= 1880
		NOT = { has_variable = oscar_wilde_var }
		has_technology_researched = behaviorism
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = oscar_wilde_var
		if = {
			limit = {
				capital = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_england_old
				}
			}
			create_character = {
				template = canonic_wilde_character_template
				save_scope_as = oscar_wilde
			}
		}
		else = {
			create_character = {
				template = dynamic_wilde_character_template
				save_scope_as = oscar_wilde
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				game_date >= 1880
			}
			scope:oscar_wilde = {
				set_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
			}
		}

	}

	option = {
		default_option = yes
		name = oscar_wilde_events.1.a
		custom_tooltip = oscar_wilde_tt
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = happy_arts_protected
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		ig:ig_devout ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = unhappy_defended_homosexuality
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oscar_wilde_events.1.b
		ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = imprisoning_gentlemen
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = upheld_ruling
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}

			retire_character = yes

# The Demise of El Supremo
paraguay.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	title = paraguay.1.t
	desc = paraguay.1.d
	flavor = paraguay.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_aristocrats"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = go_policarp_go_scope
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_template = PRG_carlos_antonio_lopez
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_template = PRG_carlos_antonio_lopez
				}
				save_scope_as = carlos_antonio_lopez_scope
			}
		}
		else = {
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = carlos_antonio_lopez_scope
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # Open up a liddle-widdle bit
		name = paraguay.1.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = paraguay.1.tt_1
		remove_variable = francocracia_paraguay_var
		remove_primary_culture = cu:guarani
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_template = PRG_carlos_antonio_lopez
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_template = PRG_carlos_antonio_lopez
				}
				set_character_as_ruler = yes
				remove_as_interest_group_leader = yes
				add_trait = special_character_el_excelentisimo
			}
		}
		else = {
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				leader = {
					set_character_as_ruler = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					is_in_government = yes
					NOT = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
					}
				}
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					is_in_government = yes
					NOT = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
					}
				}
				remove_ruling_interest_group = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_in_government = yes
						is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
					}
				}
			}
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				add_ruling_interest_group = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_isolationism
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_protectionism
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_secret_police
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_national_guard
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_template = PRG_policarpo_patino
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_template = PRG_policarpo_patino
				}
				kill_character = yes
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_modernizing_paraguay
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}
	}
	option = { # Continue Francia's legacy
		name = paraguay.1.b
		custom_tooltip = paraguay.1.tt_2
		remove_variable = francocracia_paraguay_var
		set_variable = patino_paraguay_var
		hidden_effect = {
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_template = PRG_policarpo_patino
				}
				set_character_immortal = no
			}
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = large_radicals
		}
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			leader = {
				kill_character = yes
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = reinstated_hairy_feet_modifier
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
		}
	}
}

		video = "southamerica_factory_opening"
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		g:iron = {
			save_scope_as = iron_scope
		}
		g:steel = {
			save_scope_as = steel_scope
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = paraguay.3.a
		default_option = yes
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				state_region = s:STATE_BAJO_PARAGUAY
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = ybycui_iron_works_modifier
				days = very_long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = paraguay.3.b
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				state_region = s:STATE_BAJO_PARAGUAY
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						any_scope_building = {
							is_building_type = building_steel_mill
						}
					}
				}
				create_building = {
					building = building_steel_mill
					level = 2
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = ybycui_steelworks
					days = very_long_modifier_time
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = ybycui_steelworks
					days = very_long_modifier_time
					multiplier = 1.5
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = paraguay.3.c
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_workers_rights
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				state_region = s:STATE_BAJO_PARAGUAY
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = ybycui_prisoner_workforce_modifier
				days = very_long_modifier_time
			}
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = small_radicals
			}
		}
	}
}

# Paraguay War Start Event
paraguay.11 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:paraguay_scope.capital

	title = paraguay.11.t
	desc = paraguay.11.d
	flavor = paraguay.11.f

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_before_the_battle"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	trigger = {
		exists = c:PRG
		NOR = {
			is_diplomatic_play_ally_of = c:PRG
			has_variable = paraguay_war_var
			c:PRG = this
		}
		is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
		c:PRG ?= {
			has_journal_entry = je_expanding_paraguay
			NOT = {
				has_war_with = root
			}
			any_diplomatic_play = {
				is_war = no
				any_scope_play_involved = {
					this = root
				}
				initiator = prev
				target = {
					any_scope_state = {
						OR = {
							state_region = s:STATE_CORRIENTES
				            state_region = s:STATE_URUGUAY
				            state_region = s:STATE_SANTA_FE
				            state_region = s:STATE_PARANA
				            state_region = s:STATE_RIO_GRANDE_DO_SUL
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_play_goal = conquer_state
					has_play_goal = return_state
					has_play_goal = make_tributary
					has_play_goal = make_protectorate
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = paraguay_war_var
		c:PRG ?= {
			random_diplomatic_play = {
				limit = {
					is_war = no
					any_scope_play_involved = {
						this = root
					}
					initiator = prev
					target = {
						any_scope_state = {
							OR = {
								state_region = s:STATE_CORRIENTES
					            state_region = s:STATE_URUGUAY
					            state_region = s:STATE_SANTA_FE
					            state_region = s:STATE_PARANA
					            state_region = s:STATE_RIO_GRANDE_DO_SUL
							}
						}
					}
					OR = {
						has_play_goal = conquer_state
						has_play_goal = return_state
						has_play_goal = make_tributary
						has_play_goal = make_protectorate
					}
				}
				target = {
					save_scope_as = paraguay_target_scope
				}
			}

﻿namespace = paralegal_discrimination

paralegal_discrimination.1 = { # newly arrived minority group faces resentment by local elites
	type = state_event
	placement = root
	cooldown = { months = never_fire_again_modifier_time } # this only imposes a cooldown for this particular state, cooldown for the country is handled with the paralegal_discrimination_event_cooldown variable

	duration = 3

	title = paralegal_discrimination.1.t
	desc = paralegal_discrimination.1.d
	flavor = paralegal_discrimination.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_realist_household"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	trigger = {
		owner = {
			NOT = { has_variable = paralegal_discrimination_event_cooldown }
		}
		is_mass_migration_target = yes
		any_scope_culture = {
			root = {
				is_mass_migration_target_for_culture = prev
				"cultural_acceptance_delta(prev)" < -10
			}
			save_temporary_scope_as = temp_newcomer_culture
		}
		owner = {
			any_primary_culture = {
				root = {
				   "population_by_culture(prev)" > 0
				}
				NOT = {
					scope:temp_newcomer_culture ?= this
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		ordered_scope_culture = {
			limit = {
				root = {
					is_mass_migration_target_for_culture = prev
				}
			}
			order_by = {
				root = {
					value =	{
						add = "cultural_acceptance_delta(prev)"
						multiply = -1 # revert sort order so the highest penalty delta goes first
					}
				}
			}
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = newcomer_culture
		}
		owner = {
			random_primary_culture = { # Ordering this by size causes an engine-related error, so a random primary culture will have to do instead.
				limit = {
					root = {
						"population_by_culture(prev)" > 0
					}
					NOT = {
						scope:newcomer_culture ?= this
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = biggest_primary_culture
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = paralegal_discrimination_event_cooldown
				days = stupidly_long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
        name = "paralegal_discrimination.1.a"
		default_option = yes
		owner = {
			every_primary_culture = {
				root = {
					add_loyalists_in_state = {
						value = 0.2
						culture = prev
						strata = upper
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_radicals_in_state = {
			value = 0.25
			culture = scope:newcomer_culture
		}
		add_acceptance = {
			target = scope:newcomer_culture
			value = -5
		}
    }

    option = {
        name = "paralegal_discrimination.1.b"
		add_radicals_in_state = {
			value = 0.05
		}
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				add_acceptance = {
					target = scope:newcomer_culture
					value = -5
				}
			}
			2 = {
				add_acceptance = {
					target = scope:newcomer_culture
					value = {
						add = 5
						max = {
							add = "cultural_acceptance_delta(scope:newcomer_culture)"
							multiply = -1 # cannot add more delta than what gets you to 0
						}
					}
				}
			}
			1 = {
				add_acceptance = {
					target = scope:newcomer_culture
					value = {
						add = 15
						max = {
							add = "cultural_acceptance_delta(scope:newcomer_culture)"
							multiply = -1 # cannot add more delta than what gets you to 0
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
    }

    option = {
        name = "paralegal_discrimination.1.c"
		owner = {
			every_primary_culture = {
				root = {
					add_radicals_in_state = {
						value = 0.2
						culture = prev
						strata = upper
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_acceptance = {
			target = scope:newcomer_culture
			value = {
				add = 20
				max = {
					add = "cultural_acceptance_delta(scope:newcomer_culture)"
					multiply = -1 # cannot add more delta than what gets you to 0
				}
			}
		}
    }
}

						}

					}
				}
			}
		}

paris_commune.5 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_springtime_of_nations"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	title = paris_commune.5.t
	desc = paris_commune.5.d
	flavor = paris_commune.5.f

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	trigger = {
		#Triggered by JE
	}

	immediate = {
		c:FRA ?= {
			save_scope_as = france_scope
		}
		ROOT = {
			save_scope_as = recogniser_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = paris_commune.5.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:france_scope.relations:root >= relations_threshold:cordial
				}
				add = 50
			}
		}
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:france_scope
			value = 10
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = paris_commune.5.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 15
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:france_scope.relations:root <= relations_threshold:poor
				}
				add = 30
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
				}
				add = 250
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:france_scope = {
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						NOR = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_census_voting
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_census_voting
					}
				}
				add = 10
			}
		}
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:france_scope
			value = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				ROOT = {
					country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
				}
			}
			c:FRA ?= {
				change_variable = { name = PRC_recognition_level add = 1 }  # Variable exists only for display purposes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ROOT = {
					country_rank >= rank_value:major_power
				}
			}
			c:FRA ?= {
				change_variable = { name = PRC_recognition_level add = 0.5 } # Variable exists only for display purposes
			}
		}
		scope:france_scope = {
			post_notification = foreign_country_supports_commune
		}
		custom_tooltip = will_improve_commune_progress_tt
	}
	option = {
		name = paris_commune.5.c
		ai_chance = {
			base = 75
		}
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:france_scope
			value = -5
		}
	}
}

# 1 - Seizing Church and State
paris_commune_pulse_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:paris_scope
	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_christianity"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	title = paris_commune_pulse_events.1.t
	desc = paris_commune_pulse_events.1.d
	flavor = paris_commune_pulse_events.1.f

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_variable = paris_commune_prc_perspective
		c:PRC ?= {
			any_interest_group = {
				leader = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
					}
				}
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {

		c:PRC ?= {
			save_scope_as = paris_commune_nation_scope
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = seize_church_ig_scope
			}
			capital = {
				save_scope_as = paris_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # Close the church until the commune is better established
		name = paris_commune_pulse_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = commune_progress_add_10
	        change_global_variable = {
	            name = paris_commune_progress_var
	            add = 10
	        }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = communard_effects_header_tt
		}
		c:PRC ?= {
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
						}
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = divine_forclosure_modifier
					days = short_modifier_time
				}
			}
			random_scope_state = {
				convert_population = {
					target = rel:atheist
					value = 0.1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # Find all the gold and silver.
		name = paris_commune_pulse_events.1.b
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = commune_progress_add_10
	        change_global_variable = {
	            name = paris_commune_progress_var
	            add = 10
	        }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = communard_effects_header_tt
		}
		c:PRC ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = the_riches_of_the_church_modifier
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
						}
					}
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = capital_gains_modifier
					days = short_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # Turn it over to [random_faction] for their meetings.
		name = paris_commune_pulse_events.1.c
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = commune_progress_add_5
	        change_global_variable = {
	            name = paris_commune_progress_var
	            add = 5
	        }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = communard_effects_header_tt
		}
		scope:seize_church_ig_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = secret_clubhouse_modifier
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
		c:PRC ?= {
			create_character = {
				is_agitator = yes
				religion = rel:atheist
				culture = cu:french
				interest_group = scope:seize_church_ig_scope
				ideology = ideology_nihilist
			}
		}
	}
}

paris_commune_pulse_events.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:paris_scope
	event_image = {
		video = "votp_prison"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	title = paris_commune_pulse_events.2.t
	desc = paris_commune_pulse_events.2.d
	flavor = paris_commune_pulse_events.2.f

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_variable = paris_commune_prc_perspective
		any_scope_character = {
			has_role_of_type = general
			is_busy = no
			is_heir_of_own_country = no
			is_ruler_of_own_country = no
			character_is_valid_for_events = yes
		#	hq = region_western_europe
		}
		c:PRC ?= {
			any_interest_group = {
				leader = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_social_democrat
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		c:PRC ?= {
			save_scope_as = paris_commune_nation_scope
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					state_region = s:STATE_ILE_DE_FRANCE
				}
				save_scope_as = paris_scope
			}
		}

		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_role_of_type = general
				is_busy = no
				is_heir_of_own_country = no
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes

			}

				kill_character = yes

				limit = {
					any_interest_group = {
						leader = {
							OR = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical

							}
						}
						ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					}

					text = communard_effects_header_tt
				}
				every_interest_group = {
					limit = {
						leader = {
							OR = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_social_democrat
							}
						}
						ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					}
					add_modifier = {
						name = one_hydra_head_claimed_modifier
						days = short_modifier_time
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # Conduct a fair trial. We are not barbarians.

			}

# 3 - For Want of a Nail
paris_commune_pulse_events.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:paris_scope
	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_springtime_of_nations"
	}

	title = paris_commune_pulse_events.3.t
	desc = paris_commune_pulse_events.3.d
	flavor = paris_commune_pulse_events.3.f

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_variable = paris_commune_prc_perspective
		NOT = {
			has_variable = barricades_in_paris_var
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		c:PRC ?= {
			save_scope_as = paris_commune_nation_scope
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					state_region = s:STATE_ILE_DE_FRANCE
				}
				save_scope_as = paris_scope
			}
		}

		set_variable = barricades_in_paris_var
	}

	option = { # The people know their districts best.
		name = paris_commune_pulse_events.3.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = commune_progress_add_10
	        change_global_variable = {
	            name = paris_commune_progress_var
	            add = 10
	        }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = communard_effects_header_tt
		}
		c:PRC ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_popular_defense_commune
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					NOR = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
					}
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no

						level=15
						reserves=1
					}
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_professional_army
		}
		c:PRC ?= {
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					NOR = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces

			text = commune_progress_add_5
	        change_global_variable = {

	            add = 5
	        }
		}

# 9 - Our Bodies, Our Rules
paris_commune_pulse_events.9 = {

	desc = paris_commune_pulse_events.9.d
	flavor = paris_commune_pulse_events.9.f

		has_variable = paris_commune_prc_perspective

			any_interest_group = {
				leader = {
					OR = {

						AND = {
							is_female = yes
							OR = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_social_democrat
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
							}
						}
					}
				}
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no

		}

				value = small_radicals

				value = small_radicals
			}
		}

				limit = {
					NOT = {

					}
				}
				activate_law = law_type:law_council_republic
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_interest_group = {
						leader = {
							OR = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
							}
						}
						ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					}
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = communard_effects_header_tt
				}
				every_interest_group = {
					limit = {
						leader = {
							OR = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
							}
						}
						ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					}
					add_modifier = {
						name = a_glorious_dictatorship_modifier
						days = short_modifier_time
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # The will of the people must be upheld.
		name = paris_commune_pulse_events.15.b
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = commune_progress_add_5
	        change_global_variable = {
	            name = paris_commune_progress_var
	            add = 5
	        }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {

			}

				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			add_radicals = {
				strata = lower

			}
		}
		c:PRC ?= {

					state_region = s:STATE_ARAUCANIA
				}
				save_scope_as = patagonia_state
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					state_region = s:STATE_PATAGONIA
				}
				save_scope_as = patagonia_state
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = patagonia.1.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_andean
			}
			scope:patagonia_state = {
				state_region = {
					add_homeland = cu:south_andean
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:platinean
			}
			scope:patagonia_state = {
				state_region = {
					add_homeland = cu:platinean
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:argentine
			}
			scope:patagonia_state = {
				state_region = {
					add_homeland = cu:argentine
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:chilean
			}
			scope:patagonia_state = {
				state_region = {
					add_homeland = cu:chilean
				}
			}
		}
		scope:patagonia_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = patagonian_settlement
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

					is_country_type = decentralized

						has_modifier = patagonia_supplied_with_weapons
					}
				}
			}
		}
		any_country = {

				who = ROOT
				type = rivalry
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = no
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					owner = {
						is_country_type = decentralized
					}
					NOT = {
						has_modifier = patagonia_supplied_with_weapons
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = patagonia_state
			random_neighbouring_state = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						is_country_type = decentralized
					}
				}
				owner = {
					save_scope_as = patagonia_country
				}
			}
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				has_diplomatic_pact = {
					who = ROOT
					type = rivalry
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = rival_country
		}

			}
		}

			country = scope:patagonia_country
			value = -50
		}
	}
	option = { # if they want a fight they'll get one
		name = patagonia.2.b
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:rival_country
			value = -20
		}
		change_tension = {
			country = scope:patagonia_country
			value = 25
		}
	}
}

# Kingdom of Patagonia and Arucania
bp1_patagonia.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	placement = scope:patagonia_country.capital

	title = bp1_patagonia.1.t
	desc = bp1_patagonia.1.d
	flavor = bp1_patagonia.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_native_american"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time } #This event is quite specific so once off

	trigger = {
		# triggered by je_patagonia
		 NOT = { has_global_variable = patagonia_kingdom_var }
		 any_neighbouring_state = {
		 	owner = {
		 		is_country_type = decentralized
		 		country_has_primary_culture = cu:patagonian
		 	}
		 }
	}

	immediate = {
		set_global_variable = patagonia_kingdom_var
		random_neighbouring_state = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
			 		is_country_type = decentralized
			 		country_has_primary_culture = cu:patagonian
			 	}
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						year >= 1850
						year <= 1878
					}
					create_character = {
						template = PAT_orelie_antoine_de_tounens
					}
				}
				else = {
					create_character = {
						ruler = yes
						culture = cu:french
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = patagonia_country
				ruler = {
					save_scope_as = patagonia_ruler
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # this is ridiculous
		name = bp1_patagonia.1.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:patagonia_country = {
			change_tension = {
				country = root
				value = 50
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}

	option = { # fine, offer them protection
		name = bp1_patagonia.1.b
		scope:patagonia_country = {
			set_country_type = unrecognized
			activate_law = law_type:law_monarchy
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_modifier = native_conscription_10
			}
		}
		create_diplomatic_pact = {
			country = scope:patagonia_country
			type = puppet
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
	}
}

# The Monarchy is overthrown in a landowner/AF coup, ending event
pedro.8 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = pedro.8.t
	desc = pedro.8.d
	flavor = pedro.8.f

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_aristocrats"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_fire.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	trigger = {
		# triggered by je_pedro_brazil
	}

	immediate = {
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			save_scope_as = armed_forces_ig
		}
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			save_scope_as = landowners_ig
		}
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = pedro_scope
		}
		ROOT = {
			save_scope_as = brazil_scope
		}
		set_variable = { name = pedro_republican_coup years = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					has_journal_entry = je_portugal_united_kingdom
					any_scope_treaty = {
						binds = ROOT
						any_scope_article = {
							has_type = amend_succession
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_portugal_united_kingdom
					any_scope_treaty = {
						binds = ROOT
						any_scope_article = {
							has_type = amend_succession
						}
					}
				}
				trigger_event = { id = lusofonia.4 popup = yes }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_landed_voting }
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_landed_voting
		}
		activate_law = law_type:law_presidential_republic
	}

	option = {
		name = pedro.8.a
		default_option = yes
		hidden_effect = {
			ig:ig_landowners ?= {
				remove_ideology = ideology_hierarchic
				add_ideology = ideology_oligarchic
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_landowners ?= {
					is_in_government = no
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				}
			}
			ig:ig_landowners ?= {
				add_ruling_interest_group = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
					is_in_government = no
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				}
			}
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				add_ruling_interest_group = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
					ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				}
			}
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				leader = {
					set_character_as_ruler = yes
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			ig:ig_landowners ?= {
				leader = {
					set_character_as_ruler = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = large_radicals
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					THIS = ROOT
				}
				has_interest_marker_in_region = sr:region_brazil
			}
			post_notification = brz_brazil_coup
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = abolishing_monarchy_var
			value = 0
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_abolish_monarchy }
	}
}

		# triggered by je_pedro_brazil

		ruler = {
			age >= 30
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			#is_powerful = yes
			is_in_government = yes
			NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners }
			leader = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = had_pedro_republican_proposal
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = pedro_scope
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				#is_powerful = yes
				is_in_government = yes
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners }
				leader = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = republican_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = republican_leader
				ideology = {
					save_scope_as = republican_ideology
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = pedro.9.a
		default_option = yes
		remove_pedropoint_effect = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 19
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = pedro.9.b
		default_option = yes
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_pedro_republic }
		# AI very unlikely to do this
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
}

# Death of Pedro's heirs
pedro.12 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = pedro.12.t
	desc = pedro.12.d
	flavor = pedro.12.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_signed_contract"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = pedro_heir_death }
		year > 1849
		exists = heir
		heir ?= {
			culture = cu:brazilian # Will not fire if Portugal has restored the United Kingdom
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = pedro_heir_death
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = pedro_scope
		}
		heir ?= {
			save_scope_as = heir_scope
		}
	}

	option = { # No women allowed
		name = pedro.12.a
		default_option = yes
		create_character = {
			template = brz_isabel_template
			heir = yes
		}
		# appease the landowners slightly
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = princess_isabel
				days = long_modifier_time
				multiplier = -1
			}
		}
		remove_pedropoint_effect = yes
	}
	option = { # Prepare isabel for the throne
		name = pedro.12.b
		default_option = yes
		remove_pedropoint_effect = yes
		create_character = {
			template = brz_isabel_template
			heir = yes
			on_created = {
				save_scope_as = isabel_scope
				set_variable = isabel_var
				add_modifier = {
					name = isabel_heir_popularity
				}
				set_character_immortal = yes
			}
		}
		# pedro's popularity is reduced
		scope:pedro_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = isabel_heir_popularity
			}
		}
		# annoy the landowners
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = princess_isabel
				days = long_modifier_time
				multiplier = 3
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		# add isabel JE
		set_variable = {
			name = isabel_points
			value = 0
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_isabel target = scope:isabel_scope }
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = isabel_je_tt
		}
	}
}

﻿namespace = peoples_springtime

# The Spark
# Country has a revolution including Radicals
peoples_springtime.1 = {
	type = country_event
	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_springtime_of_nations"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	title = peoples_springtime.1.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = peoples_springtime.1.d
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						scope:revolutionary_country ?= {
							has_variable = france_had_revolution
						}
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = peoples_springtime.1.d_france
				trigger = {
					scope:revolutionary_country ?= {
						has_variable = france_had_revolution
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = peoples_springtime.1.f

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by on_action
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_radical
					}
				}
			}
			create_political_movement = { type = movement_radical }
		}
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				is_political_movement_type = movement_radical
			}
			save_scope_as = radical_movement
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_radical
					}
				}
			}
			create_political_movement = { type = movement_liberal }
		}
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				is_political_movement_type = movement_liberal
			}
			save_scope_as = liberal_movement_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
			scope:radical_movement ?= {
					any_supporting_character = {
						has_role_of_type = agitator
					}
				}
			}
			scope:radical_movement ?= {
				random_supporting_character = {
					limit = {
						has_role_of_type = agitator
					}
					save_scope_as = radical_ig_leader
				}
			}
		}
	}

	duration = 3

	option = {
		name = peoples_springtime.1.a
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_radical_movement_enhancement
			days = normal_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = medium_radicals
			strata = lower
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = small_radicals
			strata = middle
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:radical_ig_leader
			}
			scope:radical_ig_leader = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = revolutionary_hero
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

    option = {
		name = peoples_springtime.1.b
        default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_radical_movement_enhancement
			days = normal_modifier_time
			is_decaying = yes
			multiplier = 0.5
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = small_radicals
			strata = lower
		}
        if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:radical_ig_leader
			}
	        scope:radical_ig_leader = {
	        	add_modifier = {
	        		name = treasonous_traitor
	        		days = normal_modifier_time
	        	}
	        }
		}
	}
}

# More Radical Leaders
# Once you have the Journal Entry, more IGs want in on the action
peoples_springtime.3 = {
	type = country_event
	event_image = {
		video = "votp_agitator_speaking"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	title = peoples_springtime.3.t
	desc = peoples_springtime.3.d
	flavor = peoples_springtime.3.f

	trigger = {
		has_journal_entry = je_springtime_of_the_peoples
		has_technology_researched = egalitarianism
		any_interest_group = {
			OR = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
				is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
				is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
			}
			leader = {
				NOT = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical }
			}
		}
		empty_agitator_slots >= 1
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
					is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
					is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
					is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
				}
				leader = {
					NOT = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical }
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = radical_ig
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_character = {
						is_ruler_of_own_country = no
						is_heir_of_own_country = no
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
					}
				}
				random_scope_character = {
					limit = {
						is_ruler_of_own_country = no
						is_heir_of_own_country = no
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
					}
					save_scope_as = radical_ig_leader
				}
			}
			else = {
				ROOT = {
					create_character = {
						role = character_role_politician
						ideology = ideology_radical
						interest_group = scope:radical_ig
						save_scope_as = radical_ig_leader
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = short_modifier_time }

	option = {
		name = peoples_springtime.3.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
		}
		scope:radical_ig_leader ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_role_of_type = agitator
				}
				replace_character_roles = { remove = { agitator } add = { politician } }
			}
			set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = peoples_springtime.3.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 75
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:radical_ig = {
						ig_approval < -5
					}
				}
				add = -50
			}
		}
		scope:radical_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = dissident_radical_faction
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:radical_ig_leader ?= {
			show_as_tooltip = {
				add_character_role = character_role_agitator
			}
			replace_character_roles = { add = { agitator } remove_all = yes }
		}
		default_option = yes
	}
}

# Propagation
# Deliberately spread Radicalism to neighbor
peoples_springtime.4 = {
	type = country_event
	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_political_extremism"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	title = peoples_springtime.4.t
	desc = peoples_springtime.4.d
	flavor = peoples_springtime.4.f

	trigger = {
		has_journal_entry = je_springtime_of_the_peoples
		any_neighbouring_state = {
			owner = {
				has_technology_researched = egalitarianism
				any_interest_group = {
					is_powerful = yes
					OR = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
						is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
						is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
						is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
						is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
					}
					leader = {
						NOR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical }
		}
	}

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	option = {
		name = peoples_springtime.4.a
		random_neighbouring_state = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = egalitarianism
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						OR = {
							is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
							is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
							is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
							is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
							is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
						}
						leader = {
							NOR = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			owner = {
				trigger_event = {
					id = peoples_springtime.2
					days = 0
				}
			}
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical }
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = spread_the_revolution
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = peoples_springtime.4.b
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical }
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = constrained_the_revolution
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
		default_option = yes
	}
}

# The Revolution Vanquished
peoples_springtime.8 = {
	type = country_event

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_police_breaking_door"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	title = peoples_springtime.8.t
	desc = peoples_springtime.8.d
	flavor = peoples_springtime.8.f

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_variable = red_summer_the_revolution_vanquished
			AND = {
				var:springtime_timer_var >= 12
				any_political_movement = {
					OR = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_german_national
						is_political_movement_type = movement_italian_national
						is_political_movement_type = movement_radical
					}
					political_movement_support <= 0.10
					is_being_suppressed = yes
				}
				NOT = {
					any_scope_character = {
						OR = {
							is_interest_group_leader = yes
							has_role_of_type = agitator
						}
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					has_variable = completed_peoples_springtime
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = completed_peoples_springtime
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = red_summer_the_revolution_vanquished
			}
			remove_variable = red_summer_the_revolution_vanquished
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = peoples_springtime.8.a
		add_modifier = {
			name = counter_revolutionary_fervor
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = peoples_springtime.8.b
		default_option = yes
		add_loyalists = {
			value = 0.1
		}
	}

	after = {
		je:je_springtime_of_the_peoples ?= {
			remove_involved_country = ROOT
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_strategy = ai_strategy_reactionary_agenda
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = conservative_distribution_of_power_law
				has_variable = conservative_free_speech_law
				has_variable = conservative_internal_security_law
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_law = var:conservative_distribution_of_power_law
					}
				}
				activate_law = var:conservative_distribution_of_power_law
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_law = var:conservative_free_speech_law
					}
				}
				activate_law = var:conservative_free_speech_law
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_law = var:conservative_internal_security_law
					}
				}
				activate_law = var:conservative_internal_security_law
			}
		}
	}
}

peoples_springtime.9 = {
	type = country_event

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_barricade"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	title = peoples_springtime.9.t
	desc = peoples_springtime.9.d
	flavor = peoples_springtime.9.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		country_has_springtime_revolution = {
			THRESHOLD = 0.25
		}
		NOT = {
			has_variable = had_springtime_revolution
		}
		NOT = {
			has_journal_entry = je_divided_monarchists # french_pretenders.6 happens instead
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = relevant_country
		capital = {
			save_scope_as = relevant_state
		}
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = ruler_scope
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		has_variable = had_springtime_revolution # Cannot fire twice
	}

	option = {
		name = peoples_springtime.9.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 4
		}
		set_variable = had_springtime_revolution
		hidden_effect = {
			set_immune_to_revolutions = yes
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_revolutionary_cabinet
				days = 120
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_right_of_assembly
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_right_of_assembly
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_national_guard
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_national_guard
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_tenant_farmers
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			ordered_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
						leader = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						}
					}
				}
				order_by = ig_clout
				position = 0
				check_range_bounds = no
				add_modifier = { #TODO PRCAL-14137 replace with the modifier that makes revolution impossible
					name = modifier_springtime_kick_out_of_insurrection
					days = 75
				}
			}
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_in_government = yes
				NOR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_revolution_defeated_light
				months = 12
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		show_as_tooltip = {
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					is_in_government = yes
					NOR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
						leader = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						}
					}
				}
				remove_ruling_interest_group = yes
			}
			ordered_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
						leader = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						}
					}
				}
				order_by = ig_clout
				position = 0
				check_range_bounds = no
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_insurrectionary = yes
					}
					abandon_revolution = yes
				}
				add_ruling_interest_group = yes
			}
			call_election = {
				months = 2
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_strategy = ai_strategy_progressive_agenda
			trigger_event = { id = peoples_springtime.91 days = 5 }
		}
	}

	option = {

			base = 4
		}

				name = modifier_revolutionary_cabinet

			}
		}

					has_law = law_type:law_census_voting
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_census_voting
		}
		if = {
			limit = {

				}

		}

				}

# Red Summer
peoples_springtime.10 = {
	type = country_event

	event_image = {
		video = "ip3_agitator_reading_manifesto"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	title = peoples_springtime.10.t
	desc = peoples_springtime.10.d
	flavor = peoples_springtime.10.f

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		AND = {
			OR = {
				has_variable = had_springtime_revolution
				any_interest_group = {
					is_in_government = yes
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
						leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical }
					}
				}
			}
			OR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_census_voting
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			has_variable = completed_peoples_springtime
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					month >= 11
					month < 2
				}
			}
			set_variable = red_winter
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				month >= 2
				month < 5
			}
			set_variable = red_spring
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				month >= 5
				month < 8
			}
			set_variable = red_summer
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				month >= 8
				month < 11
			}
			set_variable = red_autumn
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = completed_peoples_springtime
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = peoples_springtime.10.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = red_summer_tt
			add_journal_entry = { type = je_red_summer }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = peoples_springtime.10.b
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = red_summer_tt
			add_journal_entry = { type = je_red_summer }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = red_summer_counter_revolution_bonus_tt
			set_variable = { name = var_counter_revolution_bonus value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Peru-Bolivia success
peru_bolivia_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = peru_bolivia_events.1.t
	desc = peru_bolivia_events.1.d
	flavor =  peru_bolivia_events.1.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "rp1_brazilian_city"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	trigger = {
		# triggered by JE
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_subject_or_below = {
					has_variable = pbc_member
					any_scope_state = {
						state_region = s:STATE_AREQUIPA
					}
				}
			}
			random_subject_or_below = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = pbc_member
					any_scope_state = {
						state_region = s:STATE_AREQUIPA
					}
				}
				random_scope_state = {
					limit = {
						state_region = s:STATE_AREQUIPA
					}
					save_scope_as = arequipa_state
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_state = {
					state_region = s:STATE_AREQUIPA
				}
			}
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					state_region = s:STATE_AREQUIPA
				}
				save_scope_as = arequipa_state
			}
		}
		else = {
			capital = {
				save_scope_as = arequipa_state
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # Annex Peru
		name = peru_bolivia_events.1.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:NPU ?= {
					is_player = no
					is_subject_of = c:BOL
				}
			}
			annex_with_incorporation = c:NPU
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:SPU ?= {
					is_player = no
					is_subject_of = c:BOL
				}
			}
			annex_with_incorporation = c:SPU
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:IQU ?= {
					is_player = no
					is_subject_of = c:BOL
				}
			}
			annex_with_incorporation = c:IQU
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:PEU ?= {
					is_player = no
					is_subject_of = c:BOL
				}
			}
			annex_with_incorporation = c:PEU
		}
		change_tag = PBC
		root = {
			save_scope_as = pbc_scope
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					THIS = ROOT
				}
				has_interest_marker_in_region = sr:region_andes
			}
			post_notification = pbc_peru_bolivia_success
		}
	}

	after = {
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = pbc_member
			}
			remove_variable = pbc_member
		}
	}
}

		}
	}

	option = { #Yes
		name = peru_bolivia_events.2.a
		default_option = yes
		post_notification = bol_salaverry_death
		scope:salaverry_scope = {
			kill_character = yes
		}
		c:NPU ?= {
			add_radicals = {
				value = medium_radicals
			}
		}
		every_country_in_south_america = {
			limit = {
				has_diplomatic_relevance = root
				NOT = {
					has_variable = pbc_member
				}
				NOT = {
					is_country_type = decentralized
				}
			}
			trigger_event = { id = peru_bolivia_events.4 days = 7 popup = yes }
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
		}
	}

	option = { #No
		name = peru_bolivia_events.2.b
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:salaverry_scope = {
				exile_character_with_martyrdom = yes
			}
		}

			text = salaverry_exile_tt
		}
		c:NPU ?= {
			add_radicals = {
				value = small_radicals
			}
		}
		every_country_in_south_america = {
			limit = {
				has_diplomatic_relevance = root

				NOT = {
