peru_bolivia_events.8 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = peru_bolivia_events.8.t
	desc = peru_bolivia_events.8.d
	flavor =  peru_bolivia_events.8.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_aristocrats"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			c:NPU ?= this
			c:SPU ?= this
		}
		is_subject = no
		NOT = {
			has_variable = peru_has_claims
		}
		OR = {
			AND = { #SPU is either dead or a puppet, will not fire if it is independent.
				c:NPU ?= this
				OR = {
					NOT = {
						exists = c:SPU
					}
					c:SPU ?= { is_subject = yes }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				c:SPU ?= this
				OR = {
					NOT = {
						exists = c:SPU
					}
					c:NPU ?= { is_subject = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	option = {
		name = peru_bolivia_events.8.a
		default_option = yes

			base = 90
		}

							owner = c:SPU
							owner = c:IQU
						}

					}

						add_claim = ROOT
					}
				}
			}

							owner = c:NPU
							owner = c:IQU
						}
						is_incorporated = yes
					}
					state_region = {
						add_claim = ROOT
					}
				}
			}
		}
		restore_peruvian_constitution = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_involved_in_journal_entry = je_peru_bolivia
			}
			change_relations = { country = root value = -10 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = peru_bolivia_events.8.b
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 90
		}
		set_variable = peru_has_claims
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = peruvian_claims_tt
			if = {
				limit = {
					c:NPU ?= THIS
				}
				every_state_in_peru = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							owner = c:SPU
							owner = c:IQU
						}
						is_incorporated = yes
					}
					state_region = {
						add_claim = ROOT
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					c:SPU ?= THIS
				}
				every_state_in_peru = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							owner = c:NPU
							owner = c:IQU
						}

				is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_peru
			}
		}

	immediate = {

	}

	option = {
		name = peru_bolivia_events.9.a
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			any_scope_state = {
				is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_bolivia
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = c:BOL
			}
			play_as = c:BOL
			c:BOL ?= {
				annex_with_incorporation = ROOT
			}
		}
		else = {
			change_tag = BOL
		}

		name = peru_bolivia_events.9.b

# Parish Control
philippines.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc016

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	title = philippines.4.t
	desc = philippines.4.d
	flavor = philippines.4.f

    event_image = {
		video = "ep1_printing_press"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by Journal Entry
		game_date >= 1837.1.1
		game_date <= 1880.1.1
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			has_journal_entry = je_philippines_main
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		create_character = {
			template = PHI_pedro_pelaez
			save_scope_as = relevant_agitator
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = philippines.4.a
		default_option = yes
		add_fervor_target_modifier = { # changes target
			culture = cu:filipino_mestizo
			days = normal_modifier_time
			multiplier = 10
		}
		add_fervor_target_modifier = { # changes target
			culture = cu:tagalog
			days = normal_modifier_time
			multiplier = 5
		}
		add_fervor_target_modifier = { # changes target
			culture = cu:ilocano
			days = normal_modifier_time
			multiplier = 5
		}
		add_fervor_target_modifier = { # changes target
			culture = cu:visayan
			days = normal_modifier_time
			multiplier = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				top_overlord = {
					c:SPA ?= this
				}
			}
			change_relations = {
				country = c:SPA
				value = -10
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					NAND = {
		                has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_right_of_assembly
		                has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_protected_speech
		            }
				}
				add = 25
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = philippines.4.b
		if = {
			limit = {
				top_overlord = {
					c:SPA ?= this
				}
			}
			change_relations = {
				country = c:SPA
				value = 10
			}
		}
		scope:relevant_agitator = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = friar_agitator_popularity
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_loyalists = {
			culture = cu:spanish
			value = medium_radicals
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
		}
	}
}

# Formation of the Guardia Civil
philippines.7 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc016

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	title = philippines.7.t
	desc = philippines.7.d
	flavor = philippines.7.f

    event_image = {
		video = "ep1_transfer_of_authority"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	trigger = {
		game_date >= 1868.1.1
		c:PHI ?= this
		top_overlord ?= {
			c:SPA ?= this
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOR = {
			game_date >= 1868.1.1
			c:PHI ?= this
			top_overlord ?= {
				c:SPA ?= this
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		ig:ig_armed_forces = {
			set_interest_group_name = ig_guardia_civil
		}
		set_variable = ig_guardia_civil_active
	}

	option = {
		name = philippines.7.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_scope_pop = {
						pop_radical_fraction >= 0.25
					}
				}
				add = 15
			}
		}
		add_liberty_desire = 15
		if = {
			limit = {
				top_overlord = {
					c:SPA ?= this
				}
			}
			change_relations = {
				country = c:SPA
				value = -10
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = philippines.7.b
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = ig_guardia_civil_modifier_b
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		add_loyalists = {
			culture = cu:spanish
			value = medium_radicals
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				top_overlord = {
					c:SPA ?= this
				}
			}
			change_relations = {
				country = c:SPA
				value = 10
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					liberty_desire <= 75
				}
				add = 10
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					liberty_desire <= 50
				}
				add = 15
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					liberty_desire < define:NDiplomacy|WAR_GOAL_INFAMY_LOW_LIBERTY_DESIRE_THRESHOLD
				}
				add = 20
			}
		}
	}
}

philippines.11 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = philippines.11.t
	desc = philippines.11.d
	flavor = philippines.11.f

    event_image = {
		video = "ip3_village_school"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by Journal Entry
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	immediate = {
	}
	option = {
		name = philippines.11.a
		default_option = yes
        add_primary_culture = cu:filipino
        start_national_awakening = {
            culture = cu:filipino
            months = 120
            state_region = s:STATE_LUZON
        }
        custom_tooltip = {
            text = filipino_assimilation_tooltip
            every_scope_character = {
                limit = {
                    culture = cu:filipino_mestizo
                }
                change_character_culture = cu:filipino
            }
            every_country = {
                every_scope_pop = {
                    limit = {
                        culture = cu:filipino_mestizo
                    }
                    change_pop_culture = { target = cu:filipino value = 1 }
                }
            }
            every_country = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = {
                        THIS = ROOT
                    }
                    has_interest_marker_in_region = root.capital.region
                }
                post_notification = filipino_culture_genesis
            }
            s:STATE_LUZON = {
                add_homeland = cu:filipino
                remove_homeland = cu:filipino_mestizo
            }
            s:STATE_VISAYAS = {
                add_homeland = cu:filipino
                remove_homeland = cu:filipino_mestizo
            }
            s:STATE_MINDANAO = {
                add_homeland = cu:filipino
                remove_homeland = cu:filipino_mestizo
            }
        }
        every_scope_state = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    state_region = s:STATE_LUZON
                    state_region = s:STATE_VISAYAS
                    state_region = s:STATE_MINDANAO
                }
            }
            add_modifier = {
                name = modifier_popular_genesis
                days = long_modifier_time
            }
        }
	}
}

			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_workers_rights

			}
		}

					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = slowed_down_production

			}
		}
		default_option = yes
	}
}

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			OR = {
				is_production_method_active = {
					building_type = building_food_industry
					production_method = pm_pot_stills
				}
				is_production_method_active = {
					building_type = building_food_industry

			NOR = {

				has_modifier = permitted_unrestricted_liquor_production
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_production_method_active = {
						building_type = building_food_industry
						production_method = pm_pot_stills
					}

		}

		scope:liquor_making_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = liquor_production_ban
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = prohibition_laws_var
			}
			custom_tooltip = prohibition_laws_pm.tt
			change_variable = {
				name = prohibition_laws_var
				add = 5
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = pm_events.3.b
		scope:liquor_making_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = liquor_production_restrictions
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		ig:ig_devout ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = permitted_limited_liquor_production
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = prohibition_laws_var
			}
			custom_tooltip = prohibition_laws_weak_pm.tt
			change_variable = {
				name = prohibition_laws_var
				add = 2
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = pm_events.3.c
		ig:ig_devout ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = permitted_unrestricted_liquor_production
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = prohibition_laws_var
			}
			custom_tooltip = prohibition_laws_bad_pm.tt
			change_variable = {
				name = prohibition_laws_var
				subtract = 5
			}
		}
	}
}

# Polish Unification
poland_events.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	title = poland_events.3.t
	desc = poland_events.3.d
	flavor = poland_events.3.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_monarch_holding_court"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	cooldown = { days = short_modifier_time }


	trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = nationalism
		is_subject = no
		is_at_war = no
		OR = {
			c:POL ?= this
			c:KRA ?= this
			AND = {
				c:GAL ?= this
				ruler = {
					culture = cu:polish
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			AND = {
				NOT = { has_variable = rejected_polish_union_pol_var }
				c:POL ?= {
					is_player = no
					is_subject = no
					is_at_war = no
					relations:root >= relations_threshold:amicable
					OR = {
						this.gdp < root.gdp
						root = { is_player = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { has_variable = rejected_polish_union_kra_var }
				c:KRA ?= {
					is_player = no
					is_subject = no
					is_at_war = no
					relations:root >= relations_threshold:amicable
					OR = {
						this.gdp < root.gdp
						root = { is_player = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { has_variable = rejected_polish_union_gal_var }
				c:GAL ?= {
					is_player = no
					is_subject = no
					is_at_war = no
					relations:root >= relations_threshold:amicable
					ruler = {
						culture = cu:polish
					}
					OR = {
						this.gdp < root.gdp
						root = { is_player = yes }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		cu:polish = {
			save_scope_as = polish_culture_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = rejected_polish_union_pol_var }
				c:POL ?= {
					is_player = no
					is_subject = no
					is_at_war = no
					relations:root >= relations_threshold:amicable
					OR = {
						this.gdp < root.gdp
						root = { is_player = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			c:POL ?= {
				save_scope_as = polish_union_target_scope
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = rejected_polish_union_kra_var }
				c:KRA ?= {
					is_player = no
					is_subject = no
					is_at_war = no
					relations:root >= relations_threshold:amicable
					OR = {
						this.gdp < root.gdp
						root = { is_player = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			c:KRA ?= {
				save_scope_as = polish_union_target_scope
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = rejected_polish_union_gal_var }
				c:GAL ?= {
					is_player = no
					is_subject = no
					is_at_war = no
					relations:root >= relations_threshold:amicable
					ruler = {
						culture = cu:polish
					}
					OR = {
						this.gdp < root.gdp
						root = { is_player = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			c:GAL ?= {
				save_scope_as = polish_union_target_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = poland_events.3.a
		default_option = yes
		annex = scope:polish_union_target_scope
		add_modifier = {
			name = integrating_polish_modifier
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 90
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = poland_events.3.b
		default_option = yes
		add_radicals = {
			culture = cu:polish
			value = large_radicals
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:polish_union_target_scope = {
					c:POL ?= this
				}
			}
			set_variable = rejected_polish_union_pol_var
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:polish_union_target_scope = {
					c:KRA ?= this
				}
			}
			set_variable = rejected_polish_union_kra_var
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:polish_union_target_scope = {
					c:GAL ?= this
				}
			}
			set_variable = rejected_polish_union_gal_var
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
	}
}

		}
	}

		is_subject = yes
	}

		days = stupidly_long_modifier_time
	}

		default_option = yes
		show_as_tooltip = {

positivism.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc008

	title = positivism.3.t
	desc = positivism.3.d
	flavor = positivism.3.f

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_agitator_speaking"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		#Triggered by JE
	}

	immediate = {
		root = {
			save_scope_as = home_country_scope
		}
		set_variable = positivism_done
	}

	option = {
		name = positivism.3.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = positivism_progress_var
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:positivism_progress_var >= 85
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_positivist_society_reward
					days = normal_modifier_time
					multiplier = 1.5
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					var:positivism_progress_var >= 65
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_positivist_society_reward
					days = normal_modifier_time
					multiplier = 1
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_positivist_society_reward
					days = normal_modifier_time
					multiplier = 0.5
				}
			}
		}
		else = { # Backup
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_positivist_society_reward
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = 1
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = positivism.3.b
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = positivism_progress_var
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:positivism_progress_var >= 85
				}
				every_interest_group = {
					limit = {
						any_scope_character = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
							OR = {
								is_interest_group_leader = yes
								prominence >= define:NCharacters|PROMINENCE_IMPORTANT_THRESHOLD
							}
						}
					}
					add_modifier = {
						name = modifier_positivist_leaders_reward
						days = normal_modifier_time
						multiplier = 2
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					var:positivism_progress_var >= 65
				}
				every_interest_group = {
					limit = {
						any_scope_character = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
							OR = {
								is_interest_group_leader = yes
								prominence >= define:NCharacters|PROMINENCE_IMPORTANT_THRESHOLD
							}
						}
					}
					add_modifier = {
						name = modifier_positivist_leaders_reward
						days = normal_modifier_time
						multiplier = 1
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				every_interest_group = {
					limit = {
						any_scope_character = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
							OR = {
								is_interest_group_leader = yes
								prominence >= define:NCharacters|PROMINENCE_IMPORTANT_THRESHOLD
							}
						}
					}
					add_modifier = {
						name = modifier_positivist_leaders_reward
						days = normal_modifier_time
						multiplier = 0.5
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_character = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
						OR = {
							is_interest_group_leader = yes
							prominence >= define:NCharacters|PROMINENCE_IMPORTANT_THRESHOLD
						}
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_positivist_leaders_reward
					days = normal_modifier_time
					multiplier = 1
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = positivist_leaders_spawn_tt
			set_variable = positivist_leaders_reward_var
		}
	}
}

			text = remove_positivism_vars_tt
			remove_variable = positivist_leaders_je_var
			remove_variable = positivist_leaders_less_je_var
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = positivist_leaders_increase_var
				}
				remove_variable = positivist_leaders_increase_var
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = positivist_leaders_large_increase_var
				}
				remove_variable = positivist_leaders_large_increase_var
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = positivism_progress_var
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:positivism_progress_var >= 35
				}
				every_interest_group = {
					limit = {
						any_scope_character = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
							OR = {
								is_interest_group_leader = yes
								prominence >= define:NCharacters|PROMINENCE_IMPORTANT_THRESHOLD
							}
						}
					}
					add_modifier = {
						name = modifier_positivism_fading
						days = normal_modifier_time
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					var:positivism_progress_var >= 15
				}
				every_interest_group = {
					limit = {
						any_scope_character = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
							OR = {
								is_interest_group_leader = yes
								prominence >= define:NCharacters|PROMINENCE_IMPORTANT_THRESHOLD
							}
						}
					}
					add_modifier = {
						name = modifier_positivism_fading
						days = normal_modifier_time
						multiplier = 1.5
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				every_interest_group = {
					limit = {
						any_scope_character = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
							OR = {
								is_interest_group_leader = yes
								prominence >= define:NCharacters|PROMINENCE_IMPORTANT_THRESHOLD
							}
						}
					}
					add_modifier = {
						name = modifier_positivism_fading
						days = normal_modifier_time
						multiplier = 2
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = { # Fallback
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_character = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
						OR = {
							is_interest_group_leader = yes
							prominence >= define:NCharacters|PROMINENCE_IMPORTANT_THRESHOLD
						}
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_positivism_fading
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = positivism.4.b

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = positivism_progress_var
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:positivism_progress_var >= 35
				}
				every_interest_group = {
					limit = {
						any_scope_character = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
							OR = {
								is_interest_group_leader = yes
								prominence >= define:NCharacters|PROMINENCE_IMPORTANT_THRESHOLD
							}
						}
					}
					add_modifier = {
						name = modifier_positivism_fading
						days = normal_modifier_time
						multiplier = 0.5
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					var:positivism_progress_var >= 15
				}
				every_interest_group = {
					limit = {
						any_scope_character = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
							OR = {
								is_interest_group_leader = yes
								prominence >= define:NCharacters|PROMINENCE_IMPORTANT_THRESHOLD
							}
						}
					}
					add_modifier = {
						name = modifier_positivism_fading
						days = normal_modifier_time
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				every_interest_group = {
					limit = {
						any_scope_character = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
							OR = {
								is_interest_group_leader = yes
								prominence >= define:NCharacters|PROMINENCE_IMPORTANT_THRESHOLD
							}
						}
					}
					add_modifier = {
						name = modifier_positivism_fading
						days = normal_modifier_time
						multiplier = 0.75
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_character = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
						OR = {
							is_interest_group_leader = yes
							prominence >= define:NCharacters|PROMINENCE_IMPORTANT_THRESHOLD
						}
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_positivism_fading
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

princely_states.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = princely_states.3.t
	desc = princely_states.3.d
	flavor = princely_states.3.f

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_jungle_expedition"
	}

	dlc = dlc011

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ip2_content
		is_princely_state = yes
        OR = {
            AND = {
            	AND = { exists = c:GBR is_subject_of = c:GBR }
		        any_country = {
		    		is_afghan_nation = yes
		    		has_war_with = c:GBR
		        }
            }
            AND = {
            	AND = { exists = c:BIC is_subject_of = c:BIC }
				any_country = {
		        	is_afghan_nation = yes
		        	has_war_with = c:BIC
		        }
            }
        }
	}

	immediate = {
		ruler = { save_scope_as = ruler_scope }
		if = {
			limit = {
				AND = {
		        	AND = { exists = c:GBR is_subject_of = c:GBR }
			        any_country = {
			        	is_afghan_nation = yes
			        	has_war_with = c:GBR
			        }
		        }
			}
			c:GBR ?= {
				save_scope_as = top_overlord_scope
			}
		}
		else = {
			c:BIC ?= {
				save_scope_as = top_overlord_scope
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
        OR = {
        	is_princely_state = no
        	NOT = {
        		AND = { exists = c:GBR is_subject_of = c:GBR }
        	}
        	NOT = {
        		AND = { exists = c:BIC is_subject_of = c:BIC }
        	}
        }
	}

	option = {
		name = princely_states.3.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:ruler_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = prince_negative_popularity
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = princely_states_camel_stipend
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		post_notification = pack_animal_loan_message
		scope:top_overlord_scope = {
			create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
				type = catalyst_event_positive
				target = root
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = princely_states.3.b
		scope:ruler_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = prince_positive_popularity
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = princely_states_ld_action
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}
}

# The Most Exalted Order of the Star of India
princely_states.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = princely_states.4.t
	desc = princely_states.4.d
	flavor = princely_states.4.f

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_transfer_of_authority"
	}

	dlc = dlc011

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ip2_content
		any_scope_character = {
			OR = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
				has_role_of_type = general
			}
		}
		OR = {
            AND = { exists = c:GBR is_subject_of = c:GBR }
            AND = { exists = c:BIC is_subject_of = c:BIC }
        }
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
					has_role_of_type = general
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = award_winner_scope
		}
		top_overlord = {
			save_scope_as = top_overlord_scope
		}

	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		is_princely_state = no
	}

	option = {
		name = princely_states.4.a
		default_option = yes
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:top_overlord_scope
			value = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dlc_feature = lobbies
				any_political_lobby = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_anti_overlord
				}
			}
			random_political_lobby = {
				limit = { is_political_lobby_type = lobby_anti_overlord }
				change_appeasement = {
					amount = -1
					factor = appeasement_lobby_loss
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = princely_states.4.b
		scope:award_winner_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = prince_positive_popularity
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = rejected_overlord_gesture
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:top_overlord_scope
			value = -10
		}
	}
}

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ip2_content
		AND = {
			ruler = {
				OR = {
					has_trait = direct
					has_trait = persistent
					has_trait = tactful
					has_trait = ambitious
					has_trait = meticulous
					has_trait = brave
					has_trait = innovative
				}
			}
			c:BIC ?= {
				has_variable = doctrine_of_lapse_cooldown
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = ruler_scope
		}
		c:BIC ?= {
			save_scope_as = bic_scope
		}
		c:GBR ?= {
			save_scope_as = top_overlord_scope
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	option = {
		name = princely_states.5.a
		default_option = yes
		post_notification = doctrine_of_lapse_reaction_message
		scope:top_overlord_scope = {
			create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
				type = catalyst_event_negative
				target = root
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = doctrine_of_lapse_upset
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = princely_states.5.b
		add_modifier = {
			name = overlord_lackey
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dlc_feature = lobbies

					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_overlord
				}
			}
			random_political_lobby = {
				limit = { is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_overlord }
				change_appeasement = {
					amount = 1
					factor = appeasement_lobby_gain
				}
			}
		}
	}

princely_state_creation.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:kashmir_state
	title = princely_state_creation.4.t
	desc = princely_state_creation.4.d
	flavor = princely_state_creation.4.f

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_transfer_of_authority"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = ip2_content
		c:BIC ?= this
		is_subject = yes
		NOT = {
			has_global_variable = organised_kashmir
		}
		s:STATE_KASHMIR = {
			NOT = {
				any_scope_state = {
					NOR = {
						owner = ROOT
						owner = {
							top_overlord ?= ROOT.top_overlord
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			exists = c:KAS
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_global_variable = organised_kashmir
		s:STATE_KASHMIR = {
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						owner = ROOT
						owner = {
							top_overlord ?= ROOT.top_overlord
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = kashmir_state
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		exists = c:KAS
	}

	option = { # Princely States
		name = princely_state_creation.4.a
		create_country = {
			tag = KAS
			origin = this
			province = p:xF28F90
			on_created = {
				set_country_type = unrecognized
				activate_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				activate_law = law_type:law_autocracy
				s:STATE_KASHMIR = {
					random_scope_state = {
						limit = {
							c:BIC ?= owner
						}
						set_state_owner = c:KAS
					}
				}
				c:BIC ?= {
					create_diplomatic_pact = {
						country = PREV
						type = puppet
					}
				}
				set_variable = princely_state
				set_state_religion = rel:hindu
				ig:ig_devout ?= {
					set_interest_group_name = ig_hindu_priesthood
					remove_ideology = ideology_moralist
					add_ideology = ideology_hindu_moralist
					set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_pious_fiction
					set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_divine_right
					set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_asceticism
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # Keep the state
		name = princely_state_creation.4.b
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = upset_every_princely_state_tt
			every_princely_state = {
				change_relations = {
					country = ROOT
					value = -10
				}
				add_liberty_desire = annex_subject_intermediate_desire_change
			}
		}
	}
}

			has_global_variable = organised_shan_states

		s:STATE_SHAN_STATES = {

				any_scope_state = {

						owner = ROOT

						}
					}

			}
		}

					OR = {
						owner = ROOT

							top_overlord ?= ROOT.top_overlord
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = shan_state
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	option = { # Princely States
		name = princely_state_creation.5.a

			tag = SHS
			origin = this
			state = scope:shan_state
			on_created = {

					country = ROOT
					value = -10
				}
				add_liberty_desire = annex_subject_intermediate_desire_change
			}
		}
	}
}
﻿ namespace = production_tech_events

production_tech_events.1 = {
	type = country_event

	trigger = {
		any_scope_building = {
			is_building_type = building_rubber_plantation
			cash_reserves_ratio > 0.25
			weekly_profit > 0
			occupancy >= 0.5
			level >= 5
		}
	}

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_factory_opening"
	}

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	placement = scope:rubber_state

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"

	title = production_tech_events.1.t
	desc = production_tech_events.1.d
	flavor = production_tech_events.1.f

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_building = {
					is_building_type = building_rubber_plantation
					occupancy >= 0.5
					level >= 5
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = rubber_state
			random_scope_building = {
				limit = {
					is_building_type = building_rubber_plantation
					occupancy >= 0.5
					level >= 5
				}
				save_scope_as = rubber_building
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = production_tech_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:rubber_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = rubber_production_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = production_tech_events.1.b
		trigger = {
			NOT = { has_technology_researched = vulcanization }
			can_research = vulcanization
		}
		add_technology_progress = { progress = 4150 technology = vulcanization }
	}
}

production_tech_events.102 = {
	type = country_event

	trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = dynamite
		any_scope_building = {
			OR = {
				is_building_type = building_munition_plant
				is_building_type = building_iron_mine
				is_building_type = building_coal_mine
				is_building_type = building_lead_mine
				is_building_type = building_sulfur_mine
			}
		}
		any_scope_building = {
			is_building_type = building_explosives_factory
		}
		market_capital.market = {
			mg:explosives = {
				market_goods_pricier > 0.15
			}
		}
	}

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_factory_opening"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	placement = ROOT

	title = production_tech_events.102.t
	desc = production_tech_events.102.d
	flavor = production_tech_events.102.f

	immediate = {
		g:explosives = {
			save_scope_as = explosives_goods
		}
	}

	option = { # Make national to effect explosives plants to produce more explosives.
		name = production_tech_events.102.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = dynamite_production_modifier
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { # Make national to effect mining industries
		name = production_tech_events.102.b
		add_modifier = {
			name = mining_production_modifier
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { # Make national to effect munitions plants
		name = production_tech_events.102.c
		add_modifier = {
			name = munitions_production_modifier
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}
}

production_tech_events.200 = {
	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_gears_pistons"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	placement = ROOT

	title = production_tech_events.200.t
	desc = production_tech_events.200.d
	flavor = production_tech_events.200.f

	trigger = {
		any_scope_building = {
			filter = {
				is_building_type = building_glassworks
			}

			percent >= 0.5

			occupancy > 0.75
			weekly_profit > 10
			cash_reserves_ratio > 0.25
			weekly_profit > 0
			level >= 5
			has_active_production_method = pm_houseware_plastics
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_building = {
				limit = {
					is_building_type = building_glassworks
				}
				save_scope_as = plastic_building
		}
		random_neighbouring_state = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_technology_researched = plastics }
					has_technology_researched = reinforced_concrete
				}

			}
			owner = {
				save_scope_as = plastic_neighbor
			}
		}
		save_scope_as = plastic_origin
	}

	option = {
		name = production_tech_events.200.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = plastic_production_modifier
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = production_tech_events.200.b
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:plastic_neighbor
			scope:plastic_neighbor = {
				NOT = { has_technology_researched = plastics }
				is_player = no
			}
		}

		scope:plastic_neighbor = {
			hidden_effect = { post_notification = country_shared_plastics_tech }
			if = {
				limit = { can_research = plastics }
				add_technology_progress = { progress = 6000 technology = plastics }
			}
			change_relations = {
				country = ROOT
				value = 20
			}
		}
	}
}

production_tech_events.501 = {
	type = country_event

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_trains"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

	placement = scope:railway_state

	title = production_tech_events.501.t
	desc = production_tech_events.501.d
	flavor = production_tech_events.501.f

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			has_building = building_motor_industry
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			has_building = building_railway
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_building = {
					OR = {
						is_building_type = building_coal_mine
						is_building_type = building_iron_mine
						is_building_type = building_lead_mine
						is_building_type = building_sulfur_mine
						is_building_type = building_logging_camp
						is_building_type = building_oil_rig
					}
				}
			}
			any_scope_building = {
				filter = {
					OR = {
						is_building_type = building_coal_mine
						is_building_type = building_iron_mine
						is_building_type = building_lead_mine
						is_building_type = building_sulfur_mine
						is_building_type = building_logging_camp
						is_building_type = building_oil_rig
					}
				}
				percent > 0.2
				OR = {
				    has_active_production_method = pm_rail_transport_mine
				    has_active_production_method = pm_rail_transport_building_logging_camp
				    has_active_production_method = pm_rail_transport_building_oil_rig
                }
				occupancy >= 0.75
			}
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_building = {
					OR = {
						is_building_type = building_coffee_plantation
						is_building_type = building_cotton_plantation
						is_building_type = building_dye_plantation
						is_building_type = building_opium_plantation
						is_building_type = building_tea_plantation
						is_building_type = building_tobacco_plantation
						is_building_type = building_sugar_plantation
						is_building_type = building_rubber_plantation
						is_building_type = building_banana_plantation
					}
				}
			}
			any_scope_building = {
				filter = {
					OR = {
						is_building_type = building_coffee_plantation
						is_building_type = building_cotton_plantation
						is_building_type = building_dye_plantation
						is_building_type = building_opium_plantation
						is_building_type = building_tea_plantation
						is_building_type = building_tobacco_plantation
						is_building_type = building_sugar_plantation
						is_building_type = building_rubber_plantation
						is_building_type = building_banana_plantation
					}
				}
				percent > 0.2
				has_active_production_method = pm_steam_rail_transport
				occupancy >= 0.75
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_building = building_motor_industry
			}
			save_scope_as = engine_state
			random_scope_building = {
				limit = {
					is_building_type = building_motor_industry
				}
				save_scope_as = engine_building
			}
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_building = building_railway
			}
			save_scope_as = railway_state
			random_scope_building = {
				limit = {
					is_building_type = building_railway
				}
				save_scope_as = railway_building
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = production_tech_events.501.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:railway_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = railway_production_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = production_tech_events.501.b
		trigger = {
			any_scope_state = {
				has_building = building_motor_industry
			}
		}
		scope:engine_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = engine_production_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = production_tech_events.501.c
		trigger = {
			NOT = { has_technology_researched = steel_railway_cars }
			can_research = steel_railway_cars
		}
		add_technology_progress = { progress = 4150 technology = steel_railway_cars }
	}
}

prohibition.1 = { #start the JE
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = prohibition.1.t
	desc = prohibition.1.d
	flavor = prohibition.1.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_temperance_movement"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_trade.dds"

	trigger = {
		#triggered by JE
		is_junior_in_customs_union = no
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			has_distillery = yes
		}
		NOR = {
			ig:ig_devout ?= {
				has_modifier = rejected_prohibition_modifier
			}
			ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
				has_modifier = rejected_prohibition_modifier
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				has_distillery = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = temperance_state
		}
		ig:ig_devout ?= {
			save_scope_as = devout_ig
		}
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			save_scope_as = intelligentsia_ig
		}
	}

	option = { #start the JE
		name = prohibition.1.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 75
		}
		scope:temperance_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = started_temperance_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #no
		name = prohibition.1.b
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ig:ig_devout ?= {
						ig_approval < -5
					}
				}
				add = -25
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
						ig_approval < -5
					}
				}
				add = -25
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = rejected_prohibition_tt
		ig:ig_devout ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = rejected_prohibition_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = rejected_prohibition_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

			}
		}
		scope:alcoholic_leader = {

				name = birthday_raid_leader_modifier #popularity

			}

prohibition.4 = { #raid on a pet shop
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:temperance_state

	title = prohibition.4.t
	desc = prohibition.4.d
	flavor = prohibition.4.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_temperance_movement"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_trade.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		#triggered by JE
		NOT = { has_variable = pet_shop_var }
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_state = {
					is_incorporated = yes
					has_distillery = yes
				}
			}
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					is_incorporated = yes
					has_distillery = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = temperance_state
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					is_incorporated = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = temperance_state
			}
		}
		set_variable = pet_shop_var
	}

	option = { #it's just a pet shop
		name = prohibition.4.a
		custom_tooltip = prohibition_laws_bad_pm.tt
		change_variable = {
			name = prohibition_laws_var
			add = -2
		}
	}

	option = { #(sigh) sir, hand me the papers
		name = prohibition.4.b
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = prohibition_laws_weak_pm.tt
		scope:temperance_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
			}
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = prohibition_laws_var
			add = 2
		}
	}

	option = { #send the police
		name = prohibition.4.c
		highlighted_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = prohibition_laws_pm.tt

				institution_investment_level = {

				institution_investment_level = {
					institution = institution_home_affairs
					value >= 2
				}
			}
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = prohibition_laws_var
			add = 4
		}
		scope:temperance_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						is_incorporated = yes
						owner = ROOT
					}
				}
				random_neighbouring_state = {
					limit = {
						is_incorporated = yes
						owner = ROOT
					}
					add_radicals_in_state = {
						value = medium_radicals
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			is_incorporated = yes
			any_scope_building = {
				occupancy > 0.9
				OR = { #these PMs produce a small amount of liquor
					has_active_production_method = pm_home_workshops_building_subsistence_pasture
					has_active_production_method = pm_home_workshops_building_subsistence_orchard
					has_active_production_method = pm_home_workshops_building_subsistence_farm
					has_active_production_method = pm_potatoes
				}
			}
			NOR = {
				has_modifier = subsistence_liquor_bad_modifier
				has_modifier = subsistence_liquor_modifier
				has_modifier = started_temperance_modifier
			}
		}
		OR = {
			ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
				OR = {
					is_powerful = yes
					is_in_government = yes
				}
			}
			ig:ig_landowners ?= {
				OR = {
					is_powerful = yes
					is_in_government = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				any_scope_building = {
					occupancy > 0.9
					OR = {
						has_active_production_method = pm_home_workshops_building_subsistence_pasture
						has_active_production_method = pm_home_workshops_building_subsistence_orchard
						has_active_production_method = pm_home_workshops_building_subsistence_farm
						has_active_production_method = pm_potatoes
					}
				}
				NOR = {
					has_modifier = subsistence_liquor_bad_modifier
					has_modifier = subsistence_liquor_modifier
					has_modifier = started_temperance_modifier
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = temperance_state
			random_scope_building = {
				limit = {
					occupancy > 0.9
					OR = {
						has_active_production_method = pm_home_workshops_building_subsistence_pasture
						has_active_production_method = pm_home_workshops_building_subsistence_orchard
						has_active_production_method = pm_home_workshops_building_subsistence_farm
						has_active_production_method = pm_potatoes
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = temperance_building
			}
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_powerful = yes
					is_in_government = yes
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
					is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = alcoholic_ig
		}
	}

	option = { #no way!
		name = prohibition.5.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = prohibition_laws_weak_pm.tt
		scope:alcoholic_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = banned_subsistence_liquor #approval
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:temperance_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = subsistence_liquor_bad_modifier #liquor bonus
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = prohibition_laws_var
			add = 2
		}
	}

	option = { #it's their farms they can do what they want with them
		name = prohibition.5.b
		custom_tooltip =  prohibition_laws_bad_pm.tt
		scope:temperance_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = subsistence_liquor_modifier #liquor bonus
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = prohibition_laws_var
			add = -3
		}
	}
}

prohibition.6 = { #Teetotalism
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:temperance_state

	title = prohibition.6.t
	desc = prohibition.6.d
	flavor = prohibition.6.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_temperance_movement"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_trade.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			any_scope_building = {
				is_building_type = building_vineyard
			}
			NOT = { has_modifier = teetoliarism_modifier }
		}
		ig:ig_devout ?= {
			OR = {
				is_powerful = yes
				is_in_government = yes
			}
			NOT = { has_modifier = no_teetoliarism_modifier }
		}
		any_scope_pop = {
			religion = rel:catholic
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_building = {
					is_building_type = building_vineyard
				}
				NOT = { has_modifier = teetoliarism_modifier }
			}
			save_scope_as = temperance_state
			random_scope_building = {
				limit = {
					is_building_type = building_vineyard
				}
				save_scope_as = wine_building
			}
		}
		ig:ig_devout ?= {
			save_scope_as = devout_ig
		}
		random_scope_pop = {
			limit = {
				religion = rel:catholic
			}
			save_scope_as = temperance_pop
		}
	}

	option = { #teetoliarism accepted
		name = prohibition.6.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = prohibition_laws_weak_pm.tt
		scope:temperance_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = teetoliarism_modifier #wine bonus
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			add_loyalists = {
				value = 0.2
				religion = scope:temperance_pop.religion
			}
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = prohibition_laws_var
			add = 1
		}
	}

	option = { #ignore them
		name = prohibition.6.b
		ig:ig_devout ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = no_teetoliarism_modifier #approval
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:temperance_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = very_large_radicals
				religion = scope:temperance_pop.religion
			}
		}
	}
}

			}

		}
		random_scope_state = {

				is_incorporated = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = feminist_cda_state
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_feminist
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = feminist_cda_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = feminist_cda_ig_leader
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = prostitution.2.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:feminist_cda_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = cda_abolished
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:feminist_cda_state = {
			remove_modifier = cda_enacted
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = prostitution.2.c
		set_variable = {
			name = var_abolished_cda_permanently
		}
		scope:feminist_cda_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = cda_abolished
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					OR = {
						leader = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
						}
						AND = {
							OR = {
								is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
								is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
							}
							NOT = {
								leader = {
									has_ideology = ideology:ideology_feminist
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						leader = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
						}
						AND = {
							OR = {
								is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
								is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
							}
							NOT = {
								leader = {
									has_ideology = ideology:ideology_feminist
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = cda_abolished_traditionalists
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = cda_enacted
				is_incorporated = yes
			}

		}

prostitution.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:police_brutality_state
	title = prostitution.4.t
	desc = prostitution.4.d
	flavor = prostitution.4.f

	event_image = {
		video = "africa_soldiers_breaking_protest"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = police_cooldown }
		OR = {
			institution_investment_level = {
				institution = institution_police
				value >= 3
			}
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_militarized_police
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			has_building = building_urban_center
		}
		NOT = {
			any_interest_group = {
				OR = {
					has_modifier = unreasonable_force
					has_modifier = defunded_police
				}
			}
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = police_cooldown
			years = 2
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				has_building = building_urban_center
			}
			save_scope_as = police_brutality_state
		}
	}
	option = { # defund the police
		name = prostitution.4.a
		change_institution_investment_level = {
			institution = institution_police
			investment = -1
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {

# Dynamic Freud
psychology_events.5 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = psychology_events.5.t
	desc = psychology_events.5.d
	flavor = psychology_events.5.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_capitalists_meeting"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = freud_var }
		has_technology_researched = psychoanalysis
		any_scope_building = {
			is_building_type = building_university
			level >= 5
			OR = {
				has_active_production_method = pm_philosophy_department
				has_active_production_method = pm_analytical_philosophy_department
			}
		}
		empty_agitator_slots >= 1
	}

	immediate = {
		set_global_variable = freud_var
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_building = {
					is_building_type = building_university
					level >= 5
					OR = {
						has_active_production_method = pm_philosophy_department
						has_active_production_method = pm_analytical_philosophy_department
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = university_state
			random_scope_building = {
				limit = {
					is_building_type = building_university
					level >= 5
					OR = {
						has_active_production_method = pm_philosophy_department
						has_active_production_method = pm_analytical_philosophy_department
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = university_building
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				game_date >= 1885.1.1
				is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
			}
			create_character = {
				template = aus_sigmund_freud
				on_created = {
					add_modifier = {
						name = freud_modifier
						days = short_modifier_time
						multiplier = 1
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = freud_scope
			}
		}
		else = {
			create_character = {
				is_agitator = yes
				interest_group = ig_intelligentsia
				religion = rel:jewish
				ideology = ideology_nihilist
				traits = {
					ambitious
					charismatic
					cocaine_addiction
				}
				on_created = {
					add_modifier = {
						name = freud_modifier
						days = short_modifier_time
						multiplier = 1
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = freud_scope
			}
		}
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= { save_scope_as = intelligentsia_ig }
	}

	option = { #what a cool guy
		name = psychology_events.5.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = freud_agitator_tt
		add_modifier = {
			name = freud_building_modifier
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		ig:ig_devout ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = freud_ig_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = -1
			}
		}
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = freud_ig_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #make him IG leader
		name = psychology_events.5.b
		scope:freud_scope ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_role_of_type = agitator
				}
				replace_character_roles = { remove = { agitator } add = { politician } }
			}
			set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
		}
		ig:ig_devout ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = freud_ig_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = -2
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #this guy suckssssss
		name = psychology_events.5.c
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = freud_rejected_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		ig:ig_devout ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = freud_rejected_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = -0.5
			}
		}
	}
}

psychology_events.6 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:university_state
	title = psychology_events.6.t
	desc = psychology_events.6.d
	flavor = psychology_events.6.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_engineer_blueprint"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	trigger = {
		any_scope_building = {
			is_building_type = building_university
			occupancy >= 0.9
			level >= 5
			OR = {
				has_active_production_method = pm_philosophy_department
				has_active_production_method = pm_analytical_philosophy_department
			}
		}
		has_technology_researched = psychiatry
		NOT = { has_variable = founded_psycho_journal_var }
		NOT = { has_technology_researched = psychoanalysis }
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_building = {
					is_building_type = building_university
					occupancy >= 0.9
					level >= 5
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = university_state
			random_scope_building = {
				limit = {
					is_building_type = building_university
				}
				save_scope_as = university_building
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #we have no resources for this
		name = psychology_events.6.a
		default_option = yes
		#strike at uni!
		scope:university_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				pop_type = academics
				value = medium_radicals
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #found the journal
		name = psychology_events.6.b
		add_modifier = {
			name = founded_psycho_journal_cost_modifier
			days = normal_modifier_time
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_small
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = founded_psycho_journal_modifier
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_technology_researched = philosophical_pragmatism
					can_research = philosophical_pragmatism
				}
			}
			add_technology_progress = { progress = 4150 technology = philosophical_pragmatism }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_technology_researched = philosophical_pragmatism
				can_research = psychoanalysis
				NOT = {
					has_technology_researched = psychoanalysis
				}
			}
			add_technology_progress = { progress = 6000 technology = psychoanalysis }
		}
		set_variable = founded_psycho_journal_var
	}
}

			add_culture_standard_of_living_modifier = {
				culture = scope:council_republic_culture
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = -3
			}
		}
	}
	option = {

		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_pop = {
					this.culture = scope:council_republic_culture
				}
			}
			order_by = state_population
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no

				days = short_modifier_time
				multiplier = 0.5
			}
			add_radicals_in_state = {

			}

					pop_has_primary_culture = no
					PREV = {
						state_average_culture_pop_acceptance = { culture = prev.culture value < acceptance_status_5 }
					}
				}
				culture = {
					save_scope_as = sacco_and_vanzetti_culture
				}
			}
		}

	}

	option = {
		name = red_scare.12.a
		default_option = yes
		add_radicals = {
			value = small_radicals
			culture = scope:sacco_and_vanzetti_culture
		}
		trigger_event = { id = red_scare.13 years = 3 }
	}
	option = {
		name = red_scare.12.b
		add_radicals = {
			value = small_radicals
			strata = upper
		}
	}
}

red_scare.14 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = red_scare.14.t
	desc = red_scare.14.d
	flavor = red_scare.14.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_gunboat_diplomacy"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_trade.dds"

	trigger = {
		exists = scope:red_scare_target_nation
		scope:red_scare_target_nation ?= {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
		}
		NOT = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_closed_borders
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			has_building = building_port
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			radical_fraction = {
				value > 0.15
				strata = lower
			}
			any_scope_pop = {
				pop_has_primary_culture = no
				pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4
				NOR = {
					is_pop_type = slaves
					is_pop_type = peasants
				}
				AND = { # to limit the number of pops that might get moved
					total_size <= 10000
					total_size >= 1000
				}
			}
		}
		scope:red_scare_target_nation = {
			any_scope_state = {
				has_building = building_port
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		scope:red_scare_target_nation ?= {
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					has_building = building_port
				}
				save_scope_as = deportation_target
			}
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				radical_fraction = {
					value > 0.15
					strata = lower
				}
				any_scope_pop = {
					pop_has_primary_culture = no
					pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4
					NOR = {
						is_pop_type = slaves
						is_pop_type = peasants
					}
					AND = {
						total_size <= 10000
						total_size >= 1000
					}
				}
			}
			random_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					pop_has_primary_culture = no
					pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4
					NOR = {
						is_pop_type = slaves
						is_pop_type = peasants
					}
					AND = { # ensures that only 100 to 1000 total pops of scope:deported_pop are moved in red_scare.14.a
						total_size <= 10000
						total_size >= 1000
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = deported_pop
			}
			save_scope_as = deportation_state
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = red_scare.14.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:deported_pop = {
			move_partial_pop = { # moves 10% of scope:deported_pop
			 	state = scope:deportation_target
			 	population_ratio = 0.1
			}
		}
		scope:deportation_state = {
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				value = small_radicals
				interest_group = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = red_scare.14.b
		ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_refused_soviet_ark
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

red_scare.15 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = red_scare.15.t
	desc = red_scare.15.d
	flavor = red_scare.15.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_politicians_arguing"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_scales.dds"

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_census_voting
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
		}
		any_active_party = {
			party_has_members = yes
			OR = {
				is_party_type = communist_party
				is_party_type = social_democrat_party
			}
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			count >= 2
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_active_party = {
			limit = {
				party_has_members = yes
				OR = {
					is_party_type = communist_party
					is_party_type = social_democrat_party
				}
			}
			random_member = {
				save_scope_as = red_scare_victim_ig
			}
			save_scope_as = red_scare_victim_party
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				is_capital = no
			}
			order_by = state_population
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = red_scare_victim_state
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = red_scare.15.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:red_scare_victim_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
				interest_group = scope:red_scare_victim_ig
			}
		}
		scope:red_scare_victim_ig = {
			add_modifier = { name = modifier_socialist_representatives_expelled days = normal_modifier_time }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = red_scare.15.b
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_council_republic
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = { name = modifier_refused_expulsion_of_reps days = normal_modifier_time }
		}
		scope:red_scare_victim_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = small_radicals
				strata = upper
			}
		}
	}
}
