revolution_pulse2_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = revolution_pulse2_events.1.t
	desc = revolution_pulse2_events.1.d
	flavor = revolution_pulse2_events.1.f

	category = revolution

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_garibaldi"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = revolution_event_cooldown }
		 any_civil_war = {
			civil_war_is_reactionary_revolution = yes
			civil_war_progress_low = yes
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			is_insurrectionary = yes
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			OR = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				leader = { has_role_of_type = general }
			}
		}
		any_country = {
			NOT = { this = ROOT }
			NOT = { is_country_type = decentralized }
			NOT = { is_country_type = unrecognized }
			country_rank >= rank_value:major_power
			relations:root >= relations_threshold:neutral
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			any_civil_war = {
				civil_war_is_reactionary_revolution = yes
				civil_war_progress_low = yes
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_civil_war = {
			limit = {
				civil_war_is_reactionary_revolution = yes
				civil_war_progress_low = yes
			}
			civil_war_save_scopes = yes
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_insurrectionary = yes
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
					leader = { has_role_of_type = general }
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = army_lad_interest_group_scope
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = army_lad_leader_scope
			}
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = ROOT }
				NOT = { is_country_type = decentralized }
				NOT = { is_country_type = unrecognized }
				country_rank >= rank_value:major_power
				relations:root >= relations_threshold:neutral
			}
			save_scope_as = fact_finding_mission_country_scope
			set_variable = fact_finding_mission_country_var
		}
		set_variable = { name = revolution_event_cooldown days = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = revolution_pulse2_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:ongoing_revolution = {
			add_civil_war_progress = revolution_retreat_small
		}
		scope:ongoing_revolution_movement = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = sent_leader_on_military_mission_movement
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:army_lad_interest_group_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = sent_leader_on_military_mission_ig
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = revolution_pulse2_events.1.tt
			trigger_event = { id = revolution_pulse2_events.2 days = 365 popup = yes }
		}
		scope:army_lad_leader_scope = {
			set_character_busy_and_immortal = yes
			set_variable = army_lad_leader_var
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = revolution_pulse2_events.1.b
		scope:army_lad_interest_group_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = ig_amassing_strength
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			80 = {
				scope:ongoing_revolution = {
					add_civil_war_progress = revolution_advance_small
				}
			}
			20 = {
				scope:ongoing_revolution = {
					add_civil_war_progress = revolution_advance_medium
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

revolution_pulse2_events.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root

	duration = 3

	title = revolution_pulse2_events.2.t
	desc = revolution_pulse2_events.2.d
	flavor = revolution_pulse2_events.2.f

	category = revolution

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_steam_ship"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = revolution_event_cooldown }
		any_country = {
			has_variable = fact_finding_mission_country_var
		}
		any_scope_character = {
			has_variable = army_lad_leader_var
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = fact_finding_mission_country_var
			}
			save_scope_as = fact_finding_mission_country_scope
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = army_lad_leader_var
			}
			save_scope_as = army_lad_leader_scope
			interest_group ?= {
				save_scope_as = army_lad_interest_group_scope
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				 any_civil_war = {
					civil_war_is_reactionary_revolution = yes
				}
			}
			random_civil_war = {
				limit = {
					civil_war_is_reactionary_revolution = yes
				}
				civil_war_save_scopes = yes
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = revolution_event_cooldown days = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = revolution_pulse2_events.2.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:army_lad_leader_scope = { set_character_busy_and_immortal = no }
		add_modifier = {
			name = results_of_the_fact_finding_mission
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				 exists = scope:ongoing_revolution
			}
			random_list = {
				50 = {
					scope:ongoing_revolution = {
						add_civil_war_progress = revolution_advance_small
					}
				}
				50 = {
					scope:army_lad_interest_group_scope = {
						add_modifier = {
							name = ig_amassing_strength
							days = normal_modifier_time
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:army_lad_interest_group_scope = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = ig_amassing_strength
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			20 = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:army_lad_leader_scope = {
							NOT = { has_trait = innovative }
						}
					}
					scope:army_lad_leader_scope = {
						add_trait = innovative
					}
				}
			}
			20 = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:army_lad_leader_scope = {
							NOT = { has_trait = meticulous }
						}
					}
					scope:army_lad_leader_scope = {
						add_trait = meticulous
					}
				}
			}
			20 = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:army_lad_leader_scope = {
							NOT = { has_trait = charismatic }
						}
					}
					scope:army_lad_leader_scope = {
						add_trait = charismatic
					}
				}
			}
			10 = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:army_lad_leader_scope = {
							NOT = { has_trait = syphilis }
						}
					}
					scope:army_lad_leader_scope = {
						add_trait = syphilis
					}
				}
			}
			10 = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:army_lad_leader_scope = {
							NOT = { has_trait = cocaine_addiction }
						}
					}
					scope:army_lad_leader_scope = {
						add_trait = cocaine_addiction
					}
				}
			}
			10 = {
				if = {
					limit = {

						}
					}
					scope:army_lad_leader_scope = {
						add_trait = expensive_tastes

				}
			}
			10 = {

					OR = {

						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						NOT = {
							any_interest_group = {
								is_in_government = yes
								OR = {
									is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions

								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

			any_civil_war = {
				OR = {
					civil_war_is_socialist_revolution = yes
					civil_war_is_liberal_revolution = yes
				}
				OR = {
					civil_war_progress_low = yes
					civil_war_progress_high = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

					civil_war_is_socialist_revolution = yes
					civil_war_is_liberal_revolution = yes
				}
				OR = {
					civil_war_progress_low = yes
					civil_war_progress_high = yes
				}
			}
			civil_war_save_scopes = yes
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				turmoil >= 0.20
				any_scope_building = {
					OR = {
						is_industry_building = yes
						is_heavy_industry_building = yes
					}
					level >= 3
					occupancy >= 0.5
				}
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					owner = {
						country_rank >= root.country_rank
						OR = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_autocracy
							has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
							NOT = {
								any_interest_group = {
									is_in_government = yes
									OR = {
										is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
										is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = transnational_unrest_squashing_state_scope
			random_scope_building = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_industry_building = yes
						is_heavy_industry_building = yes
					}
					level >= 3
					occupancy >= 0.5
				}
				save_scope_as = transnational_unrest_squashing_factory_scope
			}
			random_neighbouring_state = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						country_rank >= root.country_rank
						OR = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_autocracy
							has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
							NOT = {
								any_interest_group = {
									is_in_government = yes
									OR = {
										is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
										is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				owner = {
					save_scope_as = transnational_unrest_squashing_country_scope
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = revolution_event_cooldown days = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = revolution_pulse2_events.3.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = transnational_requested_foreign_intervention
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		scope:ongoing_revolution = {
			add_civil_war_progress = revolution_retreat_medium
		}
		scope:ongoing_revolution_movement = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = transnational_bloody_suppression
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = revolution_pulse2_events.3.b
		scope:ongoing_revolution = {
			add_civil_war_progress = revolution_retreat_small
		}
		scope:ongoing_revolution_movement = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = transnational_bloody_suppression
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = 1.5
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = revolution_pulse2_events.3.c
		random_list = {
			25 = {
				scope:ongoing_revolution = {
					add_civil_war_progress = revolution_advance_medium
				}
			}
			50 = {
				scope:ongoing_revolution = {
					add_civil_war_progress = revolution_advance_small
				}
			}
			25 = {
			}
		}
		scope:transnational_unrest_squashing_state_scope = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = transnational_unrest_squashing_strike
				days = short_modifier_time
			}

					occupancy >= 0.5

			}

		}

	}

		NOT = {
			any_civil_war = {
				OR = {
					civil_war_is_socialist_revolution = yes
					civil_war_is_liberal_revolution = yes
				}
				civil_war_progress_low = yes
			}
		}
	}

		default_option = yes

					scope:ongoing_revolution = {
						add_civil_war_progress = revolution_retreat_medium
					}
				}
				60 = {
					scope:ongoing_revolution = {
						add_civil_war_progress = revolution_advance_medium
					}
				}
			}
		}
		scope:arms_depot_raided_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_scouring_countryside
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = revolution_pulse2_events.10.b
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:arms_depot_raided_state = {
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_urban_center
						level > 10
					}
				}
			}
			random_list = {
				80 = {
					scope:ongoing_revolution = {
						add_civil_war_progress = revolution_retreat_medium
					}
				}
				20 = {
					scope:ongoing_revolution = {
						add_civil_war_progress = revolution_advance_medium
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_list = {
				60 = {
					scope:ongoing_revolution = {
						add_civil_war_progress = revolution_retreat_medium
					}
				}
				40 = {
					scope:ongoing_revolution = {
						add_civil_war_progress = revolution_advance_medium
					}
				}
			}
		}
		scope:arms_depot_raided_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_scouring_cities
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

		any_interest_group = {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no

				value < neutral
			}
		}
		NOR = {
			has_modifier = womens_rights_divorce_advance
			has_modifier = womens_rights_divorce_lesser_advance
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_women_own_property
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_women_in_the_workplace
			}
			OR = {
				has_law = law_type:law_no_womens_rights
				has_law = law_type:law_women_own_property
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
    		save_scope_as = current_law_scope
    	}
    	random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				law_stance = {
					law = owner.currently_enacting_law.type
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = anti_women_ig
    	}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = { #
		name = rights_of_women_laws.1.a
		default_option = yes

			name = womens_rights_divorce_advance
		}

		scope:anti_women_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = womens_rights_divorce_ig_anger
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = rights_of_women_laws.1.b
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = womens_rights_divorce_lesser_advance
		}
	}

	type = country_event

	title = romania.2.t
	desc = romania.2.d
	flavor = romania.2.f

	}

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		#Fired by on_action
	}

	immediate = {
        random_country = {
        	limit = {
				is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_greater_romania
	        	NOT = { this = ROOT }
	        	country_has_primary_culture = cu:romanian
	            relations:root >= 25
	            OR = {
	            	AND = {
	            		exists = top_overlord
						is_subject = yes
						top_overlord = {
							THIS = root.top_overlord
						}
					}
					is_subject = no
	            }
				NOR = {
					c:AUS ?= this
					c:KUK ?= this
				}
        	}
        	save_scope_as = romania_lesser_partner
        	set_variable = {
        		name = romania_union_partner
        	}
        }
        set_variable = romania_unification_in_motion
    }

	option = {
		name = romania.2.a
		default_option = yes

		#scope:romania_lesser_partner = {
		#	if = {
		#		limit = {
		#			is_subject = yes
		#		}
		#		make_independent = yes
		#	}
		#}

		set_variable = {
			name = ROM_united_principality
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				scope:romania_lesser_partner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
			}

				text = romania.2.a.tta

					country = scope:romania_lesser_partner
					type = personal_union
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = romania.2.a.ttb
				create_diplomatic_pact = {
					country = scope:romania_lesser_partner
					type = puppet
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = romanian_union_var
			value = 0
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_all_for_one }

		hidden_effect = {
			remove_variable = romania_unification_in_motion
		}
	}
}

# South Bessarabia Cession
romania.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = romania.4.t
	desc = romania.4.d
	flavor =  romania.4.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_aristocrats"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	trigger = {
		# triggered by JE
	}

	immediate = {
        random_scope_state = {
        	limit = {
				state_region = s:STATE_BESSARABIA
        	}
        	save_scope_as = south_bessarabia_cession
        }
        random_country = {
        	limit = {
				OR = {
    				has_variable = ROM_united_principality
    				AND = {
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_greater_romania
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:romanian
    					is_subject = yes
    					top_overlord ?= {
    						has_variable = ROM_united_principality
    					}
						is_country_type = recognized # No colonial administrations
    				}
    			}
        	}
        	save_scope_as = romanian_bessarabia_receiver
        }
	}

	option = {
		name = romania.4.a
		default_option = yes

		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}

		s:STATE_BESSARABIA = {
			set_owner_of_provinces = {
				country = scope:romanian_bessarabia_receiver
				provinces = { xB0E0A0 x6BF7B8 x712161 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				p:x50F5CB = {
					owner = ROOT
				}
			}
			s:STATE_DOBRUDJA = {
				set_owner_of_provinces = {
					country = scope:romanian_bessarabia_receiver
					provinces = { x50F5CB }
				}
			}
		}

		change_relations = {
			country = scope:romanian_bessarabia_receiver
			value = 25
		}
		scope:romanian_bessarabia_receiver = {
			change_relations = {
				country = ROOT
				value = 25
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = romania.4.b

		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
		}
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:romanian_bessarabia_receiver
			value = -25
		}
		scope:romanian_bessarabia_receiver = {
			change_relations = {
				country = ROOT
				value = -25
			}
			remove_variable = south_bessarabia_cession_in_progress
		}
	}
}
﻿namespace = wedding

wedding.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = wedding.1.t
	desc = wedding.1.d
	flavor = wedding.1.f

	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:royal_marriage_character

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		# triggered by marriage.2
		exists = scope:royal_marriage_character
		exists = scope:marriage_country
	}

	immediate = {
		capital = {
			save_scope_as = capital_scope
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_heir_of_own_country = yes
					is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
				}
				age > 16
				NOT = { has_variable = is_married }
			}
			save_scope_as = royal_marriage_character
			set_variable = getting_married # for clothing script
		}
		scope:marriage_country = {
			ruler = {
				save_scope_as = foreign_ruler
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # private wedding for international nobility
		name = wedding.1.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = { # influence mult
			name = royal_marriage
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			remove_variable = getting_married
		}
	}

	option = { # public wedding for the masses
		name = wedding.1.b
		scope:royal_marriage_character = {
			add_modifier = { # popularity
				name = marriage_popularity
				days = very_long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

# Search for a noble spouse
wedding.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = wedding.2.t
	desc = wedding.2.d
	flavor = wedding.2.f

	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:royal_marriage_character

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		# triggered by marry_ruler_or_heir interaction
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = spouse_seeker
			}
			save_scope_as = royal_marriage_character
			set_variable = is_married
			remove_variable = spouse_seeker
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
				NOT = { is_subject_type = subject_type_personal_union }
				has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				religion = scope:actor.religion
				ruler = {
					age > 36
					NOT = {
						has_variable = marriage_target
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = marriage_country_1
			ruler = {
				save_scope_as = foreign_ruler_1
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:marriage_country_1
				any_country = {
					NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
					NOT = { is_subject_type = subject_type_personal_union }
					NOT = { THIS = scope:marriage_country_1 }
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
					religion = scope:actor.religion
					ruler = {
						age > 36
						NOT = {
							has_variable = marriage_target
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
					NOT = { is_subject_type = subject_type_personal_union }
					NOT = { THIS = scope:marriage_country_1 }
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
					religion = scope:actor.religion
					ruler = {
						age > 36
						NOT = {
							has_variable = marriage_target
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = marriage_country_2
				ruler = {
					save_scope_as = foreign_ruler_2
				}
			}
			if = { #In order for this to be searched for, marriage country 2 must also exist.
				limit = {
					exists = scope:marriage_country_2
					any_country = {
						NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
						NOT = { is_subject_type = subject_type_personal_union }
						NOT = { THIS = scope:marriage_country_1 }
						NOT = { THIS = scope:marriage_country_2 }
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						religion = scope:actor.religion
						ruler = {
							age > 36
							NOT = { has_variable = marriage_target }
						}
					}
				}
				random_country = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
						NOT = { is_subject_type = subject_type_personal_union }
						NOT = { THIS = scope:marriage_country_1 }
						NOT = { THIS = scope:marriage_country_2 }
						relations:root >= 0
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						religion = scope:actor.religion
						ruler = {
							age > 36
							NOT = {
								has_variable = marriage_target
							}
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = marriage_country_3
					ruler = {
						save_scope_as = foreign_ruler_3
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # marry noble 1
		name = wedding.2.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:marriage_country_1 = {
			ruler = {
				set_variable = marriage_target
			}
			save_scope_as = marriage_country
			change_relations = {
				country = ROOT
				value = 20
			}
		}
		trigger_event = {
			id = wedding.1
			#days = 7
		}
	}

	option = { # marry noble 2
		name = wedding.2.b
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:marriage_country_2
		}
		scope:marriage_country_2 = {
			ruler = {
				set_variable = marriage_target
				save_scope_as = marriage_country_ruler
			}
			save_scope_as = marriage_country
			change_relations = {
				country = ROOT
				value = 20
			}
		}
		trigger_event = {
			id = wedding.1
			popup = yes
		}
	}

	option = { # marry noble 3
		name = wedding.2.c
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:marriage_country_3
		}
		scope:marriage_country_3 = {
			ruler = {
				set_variable = marriage_target
				save_scope_as = marriage_country_ruler
			}
			save_scope_as = marriage_country
			change_relations = {
				country = ROOT
				value = 20
			}
		}
		trigger_event = {
			id = wedding.1
			popup = yes
		}
	}
}

wedding.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = wedding.3.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = wedding.3.d1
				trigger = {
					ruler.interest_group ?= {
						OR = {
							ig_approval <= angry
							ig_clout < define:NPolitics|MARGINAL_IG_THRESHOLD
						}
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = wedding.3.d2
				trigger = {
					ruler = {
						popularity <= -50
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = wedding.3.d3
				trigger = {
					ruler = {
						OR = {
							has_trait = psychological_affliction
							age >= 75
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = wedding.3.f

	gui_window = event_window_2char

	left_icon = scope:abdicating_monarch
	right_icon = scope:heir_scope

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/2Characters"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	trigger = {
		# triggered by abdicate_monarch interaction
	}

	immediate = {
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = abdicating_monarch
			interest_group ?= {
				save_scope_as = monarch_ig
			}
		}
		heir ?= {
			save_scope_as = heir_scope
		}
		law_type:law_monarchy = {
			save_scope_as = monarchy_law
		}
	}

	option = { # reassure the aristocracy
		name = wedding.3.a
		default_option = yes
		add_loyalists = {
			value = 0.1
			pop_type = aristocrats
		}
		scope:heir_scope ?= {
			set_character_as_ruler = yes
		}
		scope:abdicating_monarch ?= {
			resign_and_retire = yes
		}
	}

	option = { # reassure the people
		name = wedding.3.b
		add_loyalists = {
			value = 0.01
		}
		scope:heir_scope ?= {
			set_character_as_ruler = yes
		}
		scope:abdicating_monarch ?= {
			resign_and_retire = yes
		}
	}
}
﻿namespace = rubber_events

# You move rubber to a new state
rubber_events.1 = {
	type = state_event
	placement = ROOT

	event_image = {
		video = "rp1_amazon_exploitation"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"

	title = rubber_events.1.t
	desc = rubber_events.1.d
	flavor = rubber_events.1.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time } #cooldown for state. Rubber can only be transplanted "for the first time" once.
	trigger = {
		has_potential_resource = building_rubber_plantation
		NOT = { region = sr:region_brazil }
		state_region = {
			remaining_undepleted = {
				type = building_rubber_plantation
				amount > 1
			}
		}
		owner = {
			NOT = { #cooldown
				has_variable = rubber_rush_event_var
			}
			NOR = { #auto-fire event triggers
					has_variable = rubber_always_spread
					has_variable = rubber_always_concentrate
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = rubber_state
		owner = {
			set_variable = { name = rubber_rush_event_var days = very_long_modifier_time } #national cooldown. Rubber rushes are no longer so frequent.
		}
		owner = {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					has_building = building_rubber_plantation
				}
				order_by = b:building_rubber_plantation.level
				position = 0
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = rubber_centre
				b:building_rubber_plantation = {
					save_scope_as = rubber_plantation
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #plant more rubber here
		name = rubber_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:rubber_state = {
			force_resource_discovery = building_rubber_plantation
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = state_rubber_modifier
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = { #focus on the existing rubber nexus
		name = rubber_events.1.b
		trigger = {
			owner = {
				exists = scope:rubber_centre
				scope:rubber_centre = {
					has_building = building_rubber_plantation
				}
			}
		}
		scope:rubber_state = {
			force_resource_discovery = building_rubber_plantation
		}
		owner = {
			scope:rubber_centre = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = state_rubber_nexus_modifier
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #always spread rubber
		name = rubber_events.1.c
		trigger = { #Only available if both options are visible or else player may not realise what choice they're making.
			owner = {
				exists = scope:rubber_centre
				scope:rubber_centre = {
					has_building = building_rubber_plantation
				}
			}
		}
		scope:rubber_state = {
			force_resource_discovery = building_rubber_plantation
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = state_rubber_modifier
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = rubber_always_spread_tt
			owner = {
				set_variable = rubber_always_spread
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #Always focus on the existing rubber nexus
		name = rubber_events.1.e
		trigger = {
			owner = {
				exists = scope:rubber_centre
				scope:rubber_centre = {
					has_building = building_rubber_plantation
				}
			}
		}
		scope:rubber_state = {
			force_resource_discovery = building_rubber_plantation
		}
		owner = {
			scope:rubber_centre = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = state_rubber_nexus_modifier
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = rubber_always_concentrate_tt
			owner = {
				set_variable = rubber_always_concentrate
			}
		}
	}
}

rubber_events.2 = { #hidden event that does the effects if the player chooses option c or d
	type = state_event
	hidden = yes

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time } #state cooldown

	trigger = {
		has_potential_resource = building_rubber_plantation
		NOT = { region = sr:region_brazil }
		state_region = {
			remaining_undepleted = {
				type = building_rubber_plantation
				amount > 1
			}
		}
		owner = {
			OR = {
				has_variable = rubber_always_spread
				has_variable = rubber_always_concentrate
			}
			NOT = {
				has_variable = rubber_rush_event_var
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = rubber_state
		#Notification on on-action or in code.
		owner = {
			set_variable = { name = rubber_rush_event_var days = very_long_modifier_time } #national cooldown. Rubber rushes are no longer so frequent.
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = rubber_always_spread
				}
			}
			force_resource_discovery = building_rubber_plantation
			add_modifier = {
				name = state_rubber_modifier
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
		else = {
			force_resource_discovery = building_rubber_plantation
			owner = {
				ordered_scope_state = {
					limit = {
						has_building = building_rubber_plantation
					}
					order_by = b:building_rubber_plantation.level
					position = 0
					check_range_bounds = no
					add_modifier = {
						name = state_rubber_nexus_modifier
						days = long_modifier_time
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					game_date >= 1871.1.1

				}

		}
	}

russo_chinese.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:outer_manchuria_scope

	title = russo_chinese.1.t
	desc = russo_chinese.1.d
	flavor = russo_chinese.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_poor_people_moving"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_scales.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		# triggered by decision
	}

	immediate = {
		s:STATE_OUTER_MANCHURIA ?= {
			random_scope_state = {
				save_scope_as = outer_manchuria_scope
			}
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:manchu
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:han
				}
				any_scope_state = {
					state_region = s:STATE_OUTER_MANCHURIA
					is_split_state = no
					is_capital = no
				}
				is_country_type = unrecognized
				is_player = no
			}
			save_scope_as = china_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = russo_chinese.1.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:china_scope ?= {
					owes_obligation_to = c:RUS
				}
			}
			scope:china_scope ?= {
				set_owes_obligation_to = {
					country = c:RUS
					setting = no
				}
			}
		}
		s:STATE_OUTER_MANCHURIA ?= {
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					scope:china_scope ?= owner
				}
				set_state_owner = c:RUS
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_ruler_of_the_east
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = russo_chinese.1.b
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:china_scope = {
					owes_obligation_to = c:RUS
				}
			}
			scope:china_scope = {
				set_owes_obligation_to = {
					country = c:RUS
					setting = no
				}
			}
		}
		s:STATE_OUTER_MANCHURIA ?= {
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					scope:china_scope ?= owner
				}
				set_state_owner = c:RUS
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_ruler_of_the_east_navy
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				c:JAP ?= this
			}
			c:CHI = {
				save_scope_as = rival_scope
			}
		}
		else = {
			c:JAP = {
				save_scope_as = rival_scope
			}
		}
		c:RYU = {
			save_scope_as = ryukyu_scope
		}
	}

    option = { # Formal Protest
        name = ryukyu_rivalry.1.a
        default_option = yes
		scope:rival_scope ?= {
			create_incident = {
				country = ROOT
				value = 10
			}
		}
    }

	option = { # Diplomatic Push
        name = ryukyu_rivalry.1.b
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = ryukyu_rivalry.1.tt1
					c:RYU = {
						is_subject_of = ROOT
						liberty_desire <= 25
					}
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = ryukyu_rivalry.1.tt2
					c:RYU = {
						NOR = {
							is_subject_of = ROOT
							relations:root < relations_threshold:amicable
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		highlighted_option = yes

		change_relations = {  
			country = scope:ryukyu_scope
			value = 50  
		}

		ig:ig_landowners = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_ryukyu_rivalry_diplomatic_appeasement
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
    }

	option = { # Economic Blackmail
        name = ryukyu_rivalry.1.c
		show_as_unavailable = {
			c:RYU.capital = {
				any_scope_building = {
					#is_building_type = building_trade_center
					levels_owned_by_country = {
						target = ROOT
						value  < 3
					}
				}
			}
		}
		trigger = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = ryukyu_rivalry.1.tt3
				c:RYU.capital = {
					any_scope_building = {
						levels_owned_by_country = {
							target = ROOT
							value  >= 3
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		highlighted_option = yes
		ROOT ?= {
			create_incident = {
				country = scope:ryukyu_scope
				value = 5
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = ryukyu_rivalry_small_influence_gain_self_tt
			if = {
				limit = {
					c:JAP = this
				}
				je:je_ryukyu_rivalry = {
					set_bar_progress = { value = 2 name = je_ryukyu_rivalry_score_bar }
				}
			}
			else = {
				je:je_ryukyu_rivalry = {
					set_bar_progress = { value = -2 name = je_ryukyu_rivalry_score_bar }
				}
			}
		}

    }
	option = { # Do nothing
        name = ryukyu_rivalry.1.e

		ig:ig_armed_forces = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_ryukyu_rivalry_armed_forces_discontent
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
    }
}

# Final Event
ryukyu_rivalry.5 = {
	type = country_event
    placement = ROOT

    duration = 3

	title = ryukyu_rivalry.5.t

	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {	scope:loser_scope = this }
				desc = ryukyu_rivalry.5.d_loser
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:victor_scope = this }
				desc = ryukyu_rivalry.5.d_victor
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { c:RYU = this }
				desc = ryukyu_rivalry.5.d_ryu
			}
		}
	}

	flavor = {
		first_valid = {
			# If Ryukyu was annexed
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					NOT = { exists = c:RYU }
				}
				desc = ryukyu_rivalry.5.f_annexed
			}
			# If Ryukyu became subject
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					c:RYU = {
						is_subject_of = c:JAP
					}
				}
				desc = ryukyu_rivalry.5.f_subject
			}
		}
	}

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_transfer_of_authority"
	}

	dlc = dlc018

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by JE when Japan or China wins
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:victor_scope = this
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_ryukyu_rivalry_succeeded_ryukyu
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
			if = { #my subject
				limit = {
					any_subject_or_below = {
						c:RYU ?= this
					}
				}
				annex = c:RYU
				if = {
					limit = {
						c:JAP = this
					}
					ig:ig_armed_forces = {
						add_modifier = {
							name = modifier_ryukyu_rivalry_southern_secured
							days = normal_modifier_time
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = { #opponent subject
				limit = {
					c:RYU = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
				}
				transfer_subject = c:RYU
				if = {
					limit = {
						c:CHI = this
					}
					ig:ig_intelligentsia = {
						add_modifier = {
							name = modifier_ryukyu_rivalry_scholars_pleased
							days = normal_modifier_time
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else = { 
				create_diplomatic_pact = {
					country = c:RYU
					type = puppet
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						c:CHI = this
					}
					ig:ig_intelligentsia = {
						add_modifier = {
							name = modifier_ryukyu_rivalry_scholars_pleased
							days = normal_modifier_time
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:loser_scope = this
			}
			scope:loser_scope = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_ryukyu_rivalry_failed_ryukyu
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = ryukyu_rivalry.5.a

		show_as_tooltip = {
			scope:victor_scope = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_ryukyu_rivalry_succeeded_ryukyu
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_subject_or_below = {
							c:RYU ?= this
						}
					}
					custom_tooltip = ryukyu_rivalry_ryukyu_vassalise_tt
					if = {
						limit = {
							c:CHI = this
						}
						ig:ig_intelligentsia = {
							add_modifier = {
								name = modifier_ryukyu_rivalry_scholars_pleased
								days = normal_modifier_time
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							exists = c:RYU
						}
					}
					custom_tooltip = ryukyu_rivalry_ryukyu_annex_tt
					if = {
						limit = {
							c:JAP = this
						}
						ig:ig_armed_forces = {
							add_modifier = {
								name = modifier_ryukyu_rivalry_southern_secured
								days = normal_modifier_time
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					custom_tooltip = ryukyu_rivalry_ryukyu_vassalise_tt
					if = {
						limit = {
							c:CHI = this
						}
						ig:ig_intelligentsia = {
							add_modifier = {
								name = modifier_ryukyu_rivalry_scholars_pleased
								days = normal_modifier_time
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		show_as_tooltip = {
			scope:loser_scope = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_ryukyu_rivalry_failed_ryukyu
					days = long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	}

    option = { # The play is at an end
        name = ryukyu_rivalry.7.a
        default_option = yes

			c:RYU = this
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				c:RYU = this
			}

				name = modifier_ryukyu_rivalry_secured_neutrality
				days = stupidly_long_modifier_time
			}
		}
		else = {

				c:RYU = {
					add_modifier = {
						name = modifier_ryukyu_rivalry_secured_neutrality
						days = stupidly_long_modifier_time
					}
				}
			}
		}
    }
	option = { # The play is at an end
        name = ryukyu_rivalry.7.b
        default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				c:RYU = this
			}
		}

		show_as_tooltip = {
			c:RYU = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = modifier_ryukyu_rivalry_secured_neutrality
					days = stupidly_long_modifier_time
				}
			}

    }

### Early Stage Situations

# Manifesto of the Secession
secession_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = secession_events.1.t
	desc = secession_events.1.d
	flavor = secession_events.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_union_leader"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		any_political_movement = {
			is_secessionist = yes
			exists = culture
			civil_war ?= {
				civil_war_progress < 0.3
			}
		}
	}

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	immediate = {
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				is_secessionist = yes
				exists = culture
				civil_war ?= {
					civil_war_progress < 0.3
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = secessionist_movement
			culture ?= {
				save_scope_as = secessionist_culture
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = secession_events.1.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
		scope:secessionist_movement = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_refuting_secessionist_manifesto_movement
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			civil_war ?= {
				add_civil_war_progress = revolution_retreat_medium
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = refuting_secessionist_manifesto
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = secession_events.1.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:secessionist_movement ?= {
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.65
					}
				}
				add = -5
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:secessionist_movement ?= {
						political_movement_radicalism >= 0.125
					}
				}
				add = -3
			}
		}
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_censorship
			}
		}
		scope:secessionist_movement = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_censoring_secessionist_manifesto_movement
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			civil_war ?= {
				add_civil_war_progress = revolution_retreat_large
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = suppressing_secessionist_manifesto
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = secession_events.1.c
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
		scope:secessionist_movement = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_secessionist_manifesto_circulating
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			civil_war ?= {
				add_civil_war_progress = revolution_advance_medium
			}
		}
	}
}

		any_political_movement = {
			is_secessionist = yes
			exists = culture

				civil_war_progress < 0.3
			}
		}
	}

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	immediate = {
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				is_secessionist = yes
				exists = culture
				civil_war ?= {
					civil_war_progress < 0.3
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = secessionist_movement
			culture ?= {
				save_scope_as = secessionist_culture
			}
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_in_government = no
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						c:BIC ?= root
					}
					NOR = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
						is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = secessionist_ig
		}
		create_character = {
			role = character_role_politician
			interest_group = scope:secessionist_ig
			culture = scope:secessionist_culture
			ideology = ideology:ideology_sovereignist_leader
			traits = {
				charismatic
				basic_political_operator
			}
			save_scope_as = secessionist_politician_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = secession_events.3.a
		add_radicals = {
			value = small_radicals
			culture = scope:secessionist_culture
		}
		custom_tooltip = {

			}
		}
		scope:secessionist_movement = {
			civil_war ?= {
				add_civil_war_progress = revolution_retreat_medium
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = secession_events.3.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:secessionist_politician_scope ?= {
			set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
		}
	}

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		any_political_movement = {
			is_secessionist = yes
			exists = culture
			civil_war ?= {
				civil_war_progress >= 0.3
				civil_war_progress < 0.7
			}
		}
	}

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	immediate = {
		random_political_movement = {
			limit = {
				is_secessionist = yes
				exists = culture
				civil_war ?= {
					civil_war_progress >= 0.3
					civil_war_progress < 0.7
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = secessionist_movement
			culture ?= {
				save_scope_as = secessionist_culture
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = secession_events.4.a
		add_modifier = {
			name = suppressing_secessionist_protest
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_right_of_assembly
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_protected_speech
				}
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_right_of_assembly
							value > neutral
						}
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_protected_speech
							value > neutral
						}
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = curtailed_free_speech
					years = 5
				}
			}
		}
		scope:secessionist_movement = {
			civil_war ?= {
				add_civil_war_progress = revolution_retreat_medium
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = secession_events.4.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:secessionist_movement = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_secessionist_rallies
				days = normal_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

sepoy_mutiny_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_redcoats"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	title = sepoy_mutiny_events.1.t
	desc = sepoy_mutiny_events.1.d
	flavor = sepoy_mutiny_events.1.f

	duration = 3

	immediate = {
		create_character = {
			template = SAT_nana_saheb_template
			save_scope_as = nana_saheb_scope
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					has_variable = sepoy_mutiny_revolter_var
					NOT = {
						root ?= this
					}
				}
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = sepoy_mutiny_revolter_var
				}
				save_scope_as = other_revolter_nation_scope
			}
		}
	}

	trigger = {
	}

	option = {
		name = sepoy_mutiny_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		show_as_tooltip = {
			create_character = {
				template = SAT_nana_saheb_template
			}
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_template = SAT_nana_saheb_template
			}
			set_as_interest_group_leader = yes
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = sepoy_mutiny_peshwa_power
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = sepoy_mutiny_reinstated_peshwa
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = sepoy_mutiny_events.1.b
		show_as_tooltip = {
			create_character = {
				template = SAT_nana_saheb_template
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = sepoy_mutiny_bhat_family_generals
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = sepoy_mutiny_events.1.c
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = sepoy_mutiny_turned_away_peshwa
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:other_revolter_nation_scope
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_template = SAT_nana_saheb_template
				}
				transfer_character = scope:other_revolter_nation_scope
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_template = SAT_nana_saheb_template
				}
				retire_character = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		trigger = {
			game_date < 1851.1.28
		}
		name = sepoy_mutiny_events.1.e
		create_character = {
			template = SAT_baji_rao_template
		}
		show_as_tooltip = {
			create_character = {
				template = SAT_nana_saheb_template
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = sepoy_mutiny_peshwa_power
			days = normal_modifier_time
			multiplier = 1.5
		}
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = sepoy_mutiny_reinstated_peshwa
				days = long_modifier_time
				multiplier = 1.5
			}
		}
	}
}

sepoy_mutiny_events.4 = {

	placement = root

	desc = sepoy_mutiny_events.4.d
	flavor = sepoy_mutiny_events.4.f

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_sepoy_mutiny"
	}

	}

				exists = c:BIC

				save_scope_as = eic_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = sepoy_mutiny_events.4.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					gdp >= 2000000
				}
				add = 40
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_diplomatic_play = {
					any_scope_play_involved = { c:SAT ?= THIS }
					any_scope_play_involved = { c:BIC ?= THIS }
					is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_sepoy_mutiny
				}
				OR = {
					capital = {
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_bombay_old
					}
					root = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:marathi
					}
				}
			}
			random_diplomatic_play = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_play_involved = { c:SAT ?= THIS }
					any_scope_play_involved = { c:BIC ?= THIS }
					is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_sepoy_mutiny
				}
				add_target_backers = { root }
				add_war_goal = { holder = c:BIC target_country = root type = annex_country } # Historically, all princely states that rebelled were annexed.
				sepoy_mutiny_tag_specific_war_goals = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_diplomatic_play = {
					any_scope_play_involved = { c:KNO ?= THIS }
					any_scope_play_involved = { c:BIC ?= THIS }
					is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_sepoy_mutiny
				}
				capital = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_madras_old
				}
			}
			random_diplomatic_play = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_play_involved = { c:KNO ?= THIS }
					any_scope_play_involved = { c:BIC ?= THIS }
					is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_sepoy_mutiny
				}
				add_target_backers = { root }
				add_war_goal = { holder = c:BIC target_country = root type = annex_country } # Historically, all princely states that rebelled were annexed.
				sepoy_mutiny_tag_specific_war_goals = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_diplomatic_play = {
					any_scope_play_involved = { c:MUG ?= THIS }
					any_scope_play_involved = { c:BIC ?= THIS }
					is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_sepoy_mutiny
				}
				capital = {
					OR = {
						region = sr:region_north_india
						region = sr:region_himalayas
						region = sr:region_greater_persia
					}
				}
			}
			random_diplomatic_play = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_play_involved = { c:MUG ?= THIS }
					any_scope_play_involved = { c:BIC ?= THIS }
					is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_sepoy_mutiny
				}
				add_target_backers = { root }
				add_war_goal = { holder = c:BIC target_country = root type = annex_country } # Historically, all princely states that rebelled were annexed.
				sepoy_mutiny_tag_specific_war_goals = yes
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = war_for_independence
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = {

					}

				save_scope_as = delvidek_scope
			}
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = capital_state
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		days = normal_modifier_time
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			has_journal_entry = je_serbian_throne
		}
	}

	option = {
		default_option = yes
		name = serbian_throne.6.a
		add_modifier = {
			name = serbia_aided_magyarized_serbs_mod
			days = short_modifier_time
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_small
		}
			custom_tooltip = serbian_dethrone_loyalty_progress_increase_tt
	}

	option = {
		name = serbian_throne.6.b
		trigger = {
			NOT = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_DELVIDEK }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_DELVIDEK }
			}
			s:STATE_DELVIDEK = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = serbian_throne.6.b_move_pops_tt
					every_scope_state = {
						every_scope_pop = {
							limit = {
								culture = cu:serb
							}
							move_partial_pop = {
								state = root.capital
								population_ratio = 0.1
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = serbia_greatly_aided_magyarized_serbs_mod
			days = short_modifier_time
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_very_large
		}
		custom_tooltip = serbian_dethrone_loyalty_progress_greatly_increase_tt
	}

}

# "The Reckoning", loyalty bar is depleted and the Obrenovic's fate must be decided while Alexander becomes the new prince
serbian_throne.10 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = serbian_throne.10.t
	desc = serbian_throne.10.d
	flavor = serbian_throne.10.f
	duration = 3
	dlc = dlc014
	event_image = {
		video = "votp_agitator_speaking"
	}
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by JE
	}

	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			serbian_throne_modifier_cleanser = yes
			serbian_throne_variable_cleanser = yes
		}
		je:je_serbian_throne ?= {
			set_bar_progress = { value = 250 name = serbian_dethrone_bar }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				ser_exists_contender_of_other_dynasty = yes
			}
			ser_save_contender_of_rival_dynasty_as_scope = yes
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		days = 365
	}

	option = {
		name = serbian_throne.10.a
		set_variable = { name = hide_ruler_change_notification days = 7 }
		every_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				ser_character_is_of_current_ruling_dynasty = yes
			}
			kill_character = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:rival_dynasty_contender_scope
			}
			scope:rival_dynasty_contender_scope ?= {
				set_character_as_ruler = yes
				add_trait = ruthless
			}
		}
		else = {
			ser_generate_rival_dynasty_ruler = yes
			scope:rival_dynasty_contender_scope ?= {
				add_trait = ruthless
			}
		}
		scope:rival_dynasty_contender_scope.interest_group ?= {
			add_ruling_interest_group = yes
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = serbia_karadordevic_changover_mod
				}
				remove_modifier = serbia_karadordevic_changover_mod
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = serbia_karadordevic_changover_mod
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
	}
	option = {
		default_option = yes
		name = serbian_throne.10.b
		set_variable = { name = hide_ruler_change_notification days = 7 }
		every_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				ser_character_is_of_current_ruling_dynasty = yes
			}
			exile_character_with_role_cleanup = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:rival_dynasty_contender_scope
			}
			scope:rival_dynasty_contender_scope ?= {
				set_character_as_ruler = yes
				add_trait = meticulous
			}
		}
		else = {
			ser_generate_rival_dynasty_ruler = yes
			scope:rival_dynasty_contender_scope ?= {
				add_trait = meticulous
			}
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_in_government = yes
			}
			remove_ruling_interest_group = yes
		}
		scope:rival_dynasty_contender_scope.interest_group ?= {
			add_ruling_interest_group = yes
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = serbia_karadordevic_changover_mod
				}
				remove_modifier = serbia_karadordevic_changover_mod
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = serbia_karadordevic_changover_mod
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = serbian_throne.10.c
		set_variable = { name = hide_ruler_change_notification days = 7 }
		every_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				ser_character_is_of_current_ruling_dynasty = yes
			}
			exile_character_with_role_cleanup = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:rival_dynasty_contender_scope
			}
			scope:rival_dynasty_contender_scope ?= {
				add_trait = honorable
				set_character_as_ruler = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			ser_generate_rival_dynasty_ruler = yes
			scope:rival_dynasty_contender_scope ?= {
				add_trait = honorable
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = serbia_karadordevic_changover_mod
				}
				remove_modifier = serbia_karadordevic_changover_mod
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = serbia_karadordevic_changover_mod
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
	}
}

	# "Prince's Accord", to decide which IG to bolster during the campaign

		clear_saved_scope = campaign_state
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_state = {
					NOT = {
						this = scope:campaign_state
						serbia_throne_campaign_state_check = yes
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = serbian_throne.14_next_state_tt
				trigger_event = {
					id = serbian_throne.14
					days = 180
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text =  serbian_throne.14_campaign_ends_tt
				trigger_event = {
					id = serbian_throne.15
					days = 90
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

﻿namespace = set_hierarchy_event


set_hierarchy_event.1 = {
	type = country_event
	hidden = yes

	trigger = {
		has_social_hierarchy = default_social_hierarchy
		AND = {
			AND = { exists = c:GBR is_subject_of = c:GBR }
			religion_percent_country = {
				target = rel:hindu
				value >= 0.50
			}
			owner = {
				any_primary_culture = {
					has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_south_asian
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = { # Replaces the default hierarchy and sets the Caste Not Enforced law
		owner = {
			save_scope_as = relevant_country_scope
		}
		set_social_hierarchy = british_indian_caste_system
		activate_law = law_type:law_hindu_caste_not_enforced
		post_notification = caste_hierarchy_appears
	}

}


set_hierarchy_event.2 = {
	type = country_event
	hidden = yes

	trigger = {
		has_social_hierarchy = british_indian_caste_system
		religion_percent_country = {
			target = rel:hindu
			value <= 0.10
		}
	}

	immediate = { # Replaces the British Indian Caste System
		owner = {
			save_scope_as = relevant_country_scope
		}
		set_social_hierarchy = default_social_hierarchy
		post_notification = caste_hierarchy_disappears
	}
}

		video = "unspecific_factory_closed"
	}

	trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = sick_man_complete
		remove_modifier = outmoded_bureaucracy
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = ottoman_sultan
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = sick_man.3.a
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject = no
				any_subject_or_below = {
					NOT = { any_overlord_or_above = { NOT = { ROOT = this } } }
					NOT = {
						is_country_type = unrecognized
					}
				}
			}
			every_subject_or_below = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { any_overlord_or_above = { NOT = { ROOT = this } } }
					OR = {
						NOT = {
							is_country_type = unrecognized
						}
						is_subject_type = subject_type_protectorate
						is_subject_type = subject_type_dominion
						is_subject_type = subject_type_puppet
						is_subject_type = subject_type_colony
						is_subject_type = subject_type_chartered_company
					}
				}
				make_independent = yes
			}
		}
		set_country_type = unrecognized
		ruler = {
			kill_character = yes
		}
		if = { #failure of JE immediately triggers eastern_crisis, showing here
			limit = {
				has_dlc_feature = ip3_content
			}
			show_as_tooltip = {
				add_contextless_journal_entry = je_great_eastern_crisis
			}
		}
	}
}

# Death of the Sher-e-Punjab (Maharaja Ranjit Singh's Death)
sikh_empire.3 = {
	type = country_event
	title = sikh_empire.3.t
	desc = sikh_empire.3.d
	flavor = sikh_empire.3.f

	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:relevant_ruler

	dlc = dlc011

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# triggered by je_sikh_sovereignty
		c:PAN ?= this
		any_scope_character = {
			has_template = pan_ranjit_singh
		}
		any_diplomatically_relevant_country = {
			owner = {
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:pashtun
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_template = pan_ranjit_singh
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_ruler
		}
		random_diplomatically_relevant_country = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:pashtun
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_country
		}
		c:BIC ?= {
			save_scope_as = bic_scope
		}
		save_scope_as = pan_scope
	}
	option = {
		name = sikh_empire.3.a
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = ranjit_singh_death_tt
			heir ?= {
				set_character_immortal = no
			}
			scope:relevant_ruler = {
				kill_character = yes # Ranjit Singh dies, Kharak Singh will become ruler
			}
			create_character = {
				# Nau Nihal Singh is the new heir
				template = pan_nau_nihal_singh
			}
		}
		c:BIC ?= {
			post_notification = eic_encroaching_pan_message
			change_relations = {
				country = c:PAN
				value = -10
			}
			create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
				type = catalyst_event_negative
				target = root
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = intrigue_reduced_by_20_tt
			je:je_sikh_sovereignty ?= {
				add_progress = { value = -20 name = sikh_empire_intrigue_bar }
			}
		}
	}
}

# A Grave Injury (Pillar Falls on Nau Nihal Singh)
sikh_empire.6 = {
	type = country_event
	title = sikh_empire.6.t
	desc = sikh_empire.6.d
	flavor = sikh_empire.6.f

	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:relevant_ruler

	dlc = dlc011

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# triggered by je_sikh_sovereignty
	}

	immediate = {
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = relevant_ruler
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_template = pan_dhian_singh
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_template = pan_dhian_singh
				}
				save_scope_as = dhian_singh_scope
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					owner = {
						AND = {
							NOT = {
								c:PAN ?= this
							}
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:pashtun
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_neighbouring_state = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						AND = {
							NOT = {
								c:PAN ?= this
							}
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:pashtun
						}
					}
				}
				owner = {
					save_scope_as = relevant_country
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = sikh_empire.6.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nau_nihal_dies_tt
			scope:relevant_ruler = {
				kill_character = yes # Nau Nihal Singh dies, Sher Singh will become ruler
			}
			create_character = {
				# Duleep Singh is the new heir
				# Duleep is the last heir from a character template we spawn in this chain of events for the Sikh Sovereignty JE
				template = pan_duleep_singh
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_template = pan_dhian_singh
				}
			}
			scope:dhian_singh_scope = {
				remove_trait = experienced_political_operator
				add_trait = expert_political_operator
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:relevant_country
			}
			post_notification = neighbor_encroaching_pan_message
			change_relations = {
				country = c:BIC
				value = -5
			}
			scope:relevant_country ?= {
				create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
					type = catalyst_event_negative
					target = ROOT
				}
			}
		}
		je:je_sikh_sovereignty ?= {
			add_progress = { value = -50 name = sikh_empire_intrigue_bar }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = sikh_empire.6.b
		trigger = { # Player can choose to try to save Nau Nihal Singh against the Wazir's advice. If Nau Nihal Singh survives he is very injured.
			is_player = yes
		}
		random_list = {
			50 = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = nau_nihal_dies_tt
					scope:relevant_ruler = {
						kill_character = yes # Nau Nihal Singh dies, Sher Singh will become ruler
					}
					create_character = {
						# Duleep Singh is the new heir
						# Duleep is the last heir from a character template we spawn in this chain of events for the Sikh Sovereignty JE
						template = pan_duleep_singh
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = scope:relevant_country
					}
					post_notification = neighbor_encroaching_pan_message
					scope:relevant_country ?= {
						create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
							type = catalyst_event_negative
							target = ROOT
						}
					}
				}
				je:je_sikh_sovereignty ?= {
					add_progress = { value = -50 name = sikh_empire_intrigue_bar }
				}
			}
			50 = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = nau_nihal_lives_tt
				}
				scope:relevant_ruler = {
					add_trait = wounded
					add_trait = psychological_affliction
					add_trait = scarred
					remove_trait = expensive_tastes
					remove_trait = pious
					add_modifier = {
						name = nau_nihal_survives # Character health impacted for life, he was definitely near death
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = scope:relevant_country
					}
					post_notification = neighbor_encroaching_pan_message
					change_relations = {
						country = scope:relevant_country
						value = -5
					}
					scope:relevant_country ?= {
						create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
							type = catalyst_event_negative
							target = ROOT
						}
					}
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = intrigue_reduced_by_20_tt
					je:je_sikh_sovereignty ?= {
						add_progress = { value = -20 name = sikh_empire_intrigue_bar }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# End of a Dynasty (je_sikh_sovereignty, on fail)
sikh_empire.7 = {
	type = country_event

	title = {

				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = sikh_empire.7.t2 # Loc if JE failed with 5 Majaraja deaths
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = sikh_empire.7.d
				trigger = {
					is_subject = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = sikh_empire.7.d2 # Loc if JE failed with 5 Majaraja deaths
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = sikh_empire.7.f # Loc if GBR becomes overlord
				trigger = {
					AND = {
						is_subject = yes
						top_overlord = {
							c:GBR ?= this
						}
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = sikh_empire.7.f2 # Loc if JE failed with 5 Majaraja deaths or has a top overlord that is not GBR
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_transfer_of_authority"
	}

	dlc = dlc011

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		# triggered by je_sikh_sovereignty
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_template = pan_duleep_singh
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_template = pan_duleep_singh
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_character
		}
		else = {
			ruler = {
				save_scope_as = relevant_character
			}
		}

	}

	cancellation_trigger = {

	}

	option = {
		name = sikh_empire.7.a
		default_option = yes
		hidden_effect = {
			set_variable = sikh_empire_je_done
		}
		if = { # For exiling Duleep Singh if he is very young
			limit = {
				ruler = {
					is_adult = no
					has_template = pan_duleep_singh
				}
			}
			ruler = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = duleep_goes_to_gbr_tt
					place_character_in_void = 1200
				}
			}
			create_character = {
				ruler = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = { # For sending Duleep Singh to GBR if he happens to be at least 18
			limit = {
				ruler = {
					is_adult = yes
					has_template = pan_duleep_singh
				}
				top_overlord = {
					c:GBR ?= this
				}
			}
			ruler = {
				replace_character_roles = { add = { agitator } remove_all = yes }
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = duleep_goes_to_gbr_tt
					transfer_character = c:GBR
				}
				change_character_religion = rel:protestant
			}
		} # For exiling any other ruler if Sikh Empire becomes a subject
		else = {
			ruler = {
				exile_character_with_role_cleanup = yes
			}
			create_character = {
				ruler = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	flavor = sikh_empire.9.f

			}
			save_scope_as = duleep_character
		}

	}

		OR = {
			NOT = { exists = c:PAN }

		}
	}

	option = {
		name = sikh_empire.9.a
		default_option = yes

			hidden_effect = {
				free_character_from_void = yes
			}

				text = duleep_goes_to_gbr_tt

			}
			change_character_religion = rel:protestant
		}
	}

			hidden_effect = {
				free_character_from_void = yes
			}

		}
	}
}

# Generic assassination
sikh_empire.11 = {
	type = country_event
	title = sikh_empire.11.t
	desc = sikh_empire.11.d
	flavor = sikh_empire.11.f

	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:relevant_ruler

	dlc = dlc011

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		# triggered by je_sikh_sovereignty
		c:PAN ?= this
	}

	cooldown = { days = 100 }

	immediate = {
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_ruler
		}
		c:BIC ?= {
			save_scope_as = bic_scope
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = sikh_empire.11.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				ruler = { has_template = pan_kharak_singh }
			}
			scope:relevant_ruler = {
				kill_character = yes # Kharak Singh dies, Nau Nihal Singh will become ruler
			}
			create_character = {
				# Sher Singh is the new heir
				template = pan_sher_singh
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ruler = { has_template = pan_nau_nihal_singh }
			}
			scope:relevant_ruler = {
				kill_character = yes # Nau Nihal Singh dies, Sher Singh will become ruler
			}
			create_character = {
				# Duleep Singh is the new heir
				# Duleep is the last heir from a character template we spawn in this chain of events for the Sikh Sovereignty JE
				template = pan_duleep_singh
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ruler = { has_template = pan_sher_singh }
			}
			scope:relevant_ruler = {
				kill_character = yes # Sher Singh dies, Duleep Singh will become ruler
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					heir ?= {
						has_template = pan_duleep_singh
					}
				}
				heir ?= {
					disinherit_character = yes
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:relevant_ruler = {
				kill_character = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_scope_character = {
						OR = {
							has_template = pan_sher_singh
							has_template = pan_duleep_singh
							has_template = pan_kharak_singh
							has_template = pan_nau_nihal_singh
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_character = {
						has_role_of_type = general
					}
				}
				random_scope_character = {
					limit = {
						has_role_of_type = general
					}
					set_character_as_ruler = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				ordered_scope_character = {
					limit = {
						has_role_of_type = politician
					}
					order_by = interest_group.ig_clout
					position = 0
					check_range_bounds = no
					set_character_as_ruler = yes
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = intrigue_reduced_by_50_tt
			je:je_sikh_sovereignty ?= {
				add_progress = { value = -50 name = sikh_empire_intrigue_bar }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Pebrine Outbreak Start
silkworm_diseases.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:pebrine_state
	event_image = {
		video = "asia_dead_cattle_poor_harvest"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	#only fires once

	title = silkworm_diseases.1.t
	desc = silkworm_diseases.1.d
	flavor = silkworm_diseases.1.f

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	trigger = {
		has_dlc_feature = voice_of_the_people_content
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			any_scope_building = {
	            is_building_type = building_silk_plantation
	            level >= 5
	        }
		}
		OR = {
			can_research = pasteurization
			is_researching_technology = pasteurization
		}
		OR = {
			is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
			is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_america
		}
		NOT = {
			has_variable = pebrine_outbreak_event
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = pebrine_outbreak_event
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				any_scope_building = {
		            is_building_type = building_silk_plantation
		            level >= 5
		        }
			}
			save_scope_as = pebrine_state
			random_scope_building = {
				limit = {
					is_building_type = building_silk_plantation
		            level >= 5
				}
				save_scope_as = pebrine_building
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = silkworm_diseases.1.a
		default_option = yes
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_silkworm_diseases
		}
		scope:pebrine_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_pebrine_state_modifier
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}


# Pebrine Outbreak Spread
silkworm_diseases.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:pebrine_state
	event_image = {
		video = "asia_dead_cattle_poor_harvest"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	desc = silkworm_diseases.2.d

	trigger = {

			is_incorporated = yes

	            is_building_type = building_silk_plantation

	        }

	        	has_modifier = modifier_pebrine_state_modifier
	        }
			NOT = {
				has_variable = var_has_had_pebrine
			}
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			has_modifier = modifier_pebrine_state_modifier
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_building = {
		            is_building_type = building_silk_plantation
		            level >= 2
		        }
		        NOT = {
		        	has_modifier = modifier_pebrine_state_modifier
		        }
			}
			save_scope_as = pebrine_state
			random_scope_building = {
				limit = {
					is_building_type = building_silk_plantation
		            level >= 2
				}
				save_scope_as = pebrine_building
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = silkworm_diseases.2.a
		trigger = {
			can_research = pasteurization
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_pebrine_research_funds

				name = modifier_pebrine_state_modifier

			}

		}
	}
	option = {

# Pebrine Outbreak Spread - International
silkworm_diseases.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:pebrine_state
	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_trains"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	title = silkworm_diseases.3.t

	desc = silkworm_diseases.3.d

	flavor = silkworm_diseases.3.f

	duration = 3

	dlc = dlc004

	trigger = {
		#Triggered by the JE
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = pebrine_outbreak_event
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_neighbouring_state = {
				is_incorporated = yes
					owner = {
						any_scope_state = {
							is_incorporated = yes
							has_modifier = modifier_pebrine_state_modifier
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_neighbouring_state = {
				limit = {
					is_incorporated = yes
					owner = {
						any_scope_state = {
							is_incorporated = yes
							has_modifier = modifier_pebrine_state_modifier
						}
					}
				}
				owner = {
					save_scope_as = pebrine_origin
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
					market = ROOT.market
					any_scope_state = {
						has_modifier = modifier_pebrine_state_modifier
					}
				}
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
					market = ROOT.market
					any_scope_state = {
						has_modifier = modifier_pebrine_state_modifier
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = pebrine_origin
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
					has_journal_entry = je_silkworm_diseases
				}
				save_scope_as = pebrine_origin
			}
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				any_scope_building = {
		            is_building_type = building_silk_plantation
		            level >= 2
		        }
			}
			save_scope_as = pebrine_state
			random_scope_building = {
				limit = {
					is_building_type = building_silk_plantation
		            level >= 2
				}
				save_scope_as = pebrine_building
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = silkworm_diseases.3.a
		default_option = yes
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_silkworm_diseases
		}
		scope:pebrine_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_pebrine_state_modifier
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = silkworm_diseases.3.b
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_silkworm_diseases
		}
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:pebrine_origin
			value = -10
		}
		scope:pebrine_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_pebrine_state_modifier
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

﻿namespace = single_party_state

# Advance Event
single_party_state.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = single_party_state.1.t
	desc = single_party_state.1.d
	flavor = single_party_state.1.f

	category = enactment

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_political_extremism"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_scales.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		is_enacting_law = law_type:law_single_party_state
		ruler.interest_group ?= {
			has_party = yes
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			law_stance = {
				law = law_type:law_single_party_state
				value >= neutral
			}
			NOT = {
				this = ruler.interest_group
				this.party = ruler.interest_group.party
				OR = {
					AND = {
						owner.ruler = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
						}
						this.leader = {
							has_socialist_ideology = yes
						}
					}
					AND = {
						owner.ruler = {
							has_socialist_ideology = yes
						}
						this.leader = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		ruler.interest_group.party = {
			save_scope_as = ruling_party
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_single_party_state
					value >= neutral
				}
				NOT = {
					this = ruler.interest_group
					this.party = ruler.interest_group.party
					OR = {
						AND = {
							owner.ruler = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
							}
							this.leader = {
								has_socialist_ideology = yes
							}
						}
						AND = {
							owner.ruler = {
								has_socialist_ideology = yes
							}
							this.leader = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = party_switch_ig
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = single_party_state.1.a
		trigger = {
			enactment_phase < 2
		}
		highlighted_option = yes
		add_enactment_phase = 1
		add_loyalists = {
			value = small_radicals
			interest_group = scope:party_switch_ig
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = single_party_state.1.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:party_switch_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_model_ig_in_system
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = modifier_parties_supporting_sps
			multiplier = 1
		}
		add_loyalists = {
			value = medium_radicals
			interest_group = scope:party_switch_ig
		}
	}
}

		}

			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = small_radicals
				interest_group = scope:protester_ig

		}

				has_socialist_ideology = yes
			}
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			leader = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
			}
		}
	}

		NOT = {
			currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		ruler.interest_group.party = {
			save_scope_as = ruling_party
		}
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
				}
			}

		}
	}

			name = modifier_fascists_hate_one_party_state

		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_fascist_repressed
			}
			owner = {
				add_radicals = {
					value = medium_radicals
					interest_group = prev
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	}

		is_enacting_law = law_type:law_single_party_state

				has_socialist_ideology = yes
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		ruler.interest_group.party = {
			save_scope_as = ruling_party
		}
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		ruler.interest_group.leader = {
			save_scope_as = communist_leader_scope
		}
		capital = {
			save_scope_as = capital_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = single_party_state.6.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_interest_group = {
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_single_party_state
							value < neutral
						}
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
				add = -15
			}
		}
		activate_law = law_type:law_single_party_state
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_single_party_state
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_death_of_democracy
				days = long_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_death_of_nation
				days = long_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = large_radicals
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = single_party_state.6.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 15
		}
		add_radicals = {
			value = very_large_radicals
			interest_group = ruler.interest_group
		}
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = modifier_revolution_averted
		}
		ruler = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_betrayed_revolution
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}
