			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		ig:ig_devout ?= {
			save_scope_as = priests_scope
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_pop = {
					religion = {
						is_state_religion = ROOT
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = blasphemy_state
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = {
		name = theocracy.2.a
		default_option = yes
		# enactment time reduced
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = blasphemy_laws
		}
		random_list = {
			50 = {
				scope:blasphemy_state = {
					add_radicals_in_state = {
						religion = ROOT.religion
						value = medium_radicals
					}
				}
			}
			50 = {
				scope:blasphemy_state = {
					add_loyalists_in_state = {
						religion = ROOT.religion
						value = medium_radicals
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = theocracy.2.b
		# lose success chance
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = relaxed_blasphemy_laws
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = theocracy.2.c
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
		}
		currently_enacting_law = {
			add_amendment = {
				type = amendment_draconian_blasphemy_laws
				sponsor = scope:priests_scope
				cooldown = 60
			}
		}
		# enactment speed
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = blasphemy_laws
		}
		scope:blasphemy_state = {
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				religion = ROOT.religion
				value = 0.1
			}
		}
	}
}

# Stall event - religious pogroms
theocracy.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = theocracy.3.t
	desc = theocracy.3.d
	flavor = theocracy.3.f

	category = enactment

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_vandalized_storefront"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_theocracy
			is_enacting_law = law_type:law_state_religion
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			any_scope_pop = {
				PREV = {
					state_religious_acceptance = {
						target = PREV.religion
						value < religious_acceptance_medium
					}
				}
			}
			any_scope_pop = {
				religion = ROOT.religion
				pop_has_primary_culture = yes
			}
		}
		NOR = {
			has_modifier = pogroms_law_success
			has_modifier = pogroms_law_time
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				any_scope_pop = {
					PREV = {
						state_religious_acceptance = {
							target = PREV.religion
							value < religious_acceptance_medium
						}
					}
				}
				any_scope_pop = {
					religion = ROOT.religion
					pop_has_primary_culture = yes
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = pogrom_state
			random_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					religion = ROOT.religion
					pop_has_primary_culture = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = perpetrator_pop
			}
			random_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					PREV = {
						state_religious_acceptance = {
							target = PREV.religion
							value < religious_acceptance_medium
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = target_pop
				religion = {
					save_scope_as = target_religion
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = {
		name = theocracy.3.a
		default_option = yes
		# massively lose success chance
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = pogroms_law_success
		}
		scope:pogrom_state = {
			add_religion_standard_of_living_modifier = {
				religion = scope:target_religion
				multiplier = -4
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = theocracy.3.b
		# massively slow down enactment
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = pogroms_law_time
			multiplier = 2
		}
		scope:pogrom_state = {
			add_religion_standard_of_living_modifier = {
				religion = scope:target_religion
				multiplier = -2
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = theocracy.3.c
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			institution_investment_level = {
				institution = institution_police
				value >= 3
			}
		}
		# less slow enactment
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = pogroms_law_time
		}
		scope:pogrom_state = {
			add_religion_standard_of_living_modifier = {
				religion = scope:target_religion
				multiplier = -1
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

	}

	immediate = {

	}

	option = {
		name = the_grand_collapse.4.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_monarchy
		}
		add_loyalists = {
			value = large_radicals
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = the_grand_collapse_complete_mod
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = {
		trigger = {
			country_has_state_religion = rel:sunni
			is_player = yes
		}
		name = the_grand_collapse.4.b
		activate_law = law_type:law_theocracy
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_millet_system
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_millet_system
		}
		add_loyalists = {
			value = medium_radicals
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = the_grand_collapse_complete_mod
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
	}
}

	trigger = {

	cancellation_trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		set_global_variable = ottoman_grand_collapse
		the_grand_collapse_happens_balkans = yes
		the_grand_collapse_happens_asia_africa = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = the_grand_collapse.5.a
		default_option = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_autocracy
				}
				has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
		}
		else = {
			activate_law = law_type:law_presidential_republic
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = the_grand_collapse_timeout_tt
		}
	}
}

tibet_expedition_events.2 = { #Choose commander
	type = country_event
    placement = ROOT

    title = expedition_events.2.t
    desc = expedition_events.2.d
    flavor = expedition_events.2.f

    duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_ca_mountain_pass_civilian"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	trigger = {
		any_scope_character = {
			OR = {
				has_role_of_type = general
				has_role_of_type = admiral
			}
			is_ruler_of_own_country = no
			character_is_valid_for_events = yes
			is_busy = no
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOR = {
			exists = scope:expedition_leader_1
			exists = scope:expedition_leader_2
			exists = scope:expedition_leader_3
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					is_busy = no
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					character_is_valid_for_events = yes
					OR = {
						has_role_of_type = general
						has_role_of_type = admiral
					}
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					has_trait = explorer
				}
			}
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					is_busy = no
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					character_is_valid_for_events = yes
					OR = {
						has_role_of_type = general
						has_role_of_type = admiral
					}
					has_trait = explorer
				}
				save_scope_as = expedition_leader_1
			}
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_busy = no
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				OR = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:expedition_leader_1 }
					NOT = {
						this = scope:expedition_leader_1
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader_2
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				is_busy = no
				is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				character_is_valid_for_events = yes
				OR = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}
				NOR = {
					AND = {
						exists = scope:expedition_leader_1
						this = scope:expedition_leader_1
					}
					this = scope:expedition_leader_2
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader_3
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = expedition_events.602.a
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:expedition_leader_1
		}
		scope:expedition_leader_1 = {
			set_as_expedition_leader = yes
		}
		trigger_event = { id = tibet_expedition_events.3 days = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = expedition_events.602.b
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:expedition_leader_2
		}
		scope:expedition_leader_2 = {
			set_as_expedition_leader = yes
		}
		trigger_event = { id = tibet_expedition_events.3 days = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = expedition_events.602.c
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:expedition_leader_3
		}
		scope:expedition_leader_3 = {
			set_as_expedition_leader = yes
		}
		trigger_event = { id = tibet_expedition_events.3 days = 30 }
	}
}

### Phase 1: Preparing the ground for an expedition ###

tibet_expedition_events.4 = { # Yaks cross the border
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location

    title = tibet_expedition_events.4.t
    desc = tibet_expedition_events.4.d
    flavor = tibet_expedition_events.4.f

    duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_ca_mountain_pass_civilian"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			any_interest_group = {
				OR = {
					has_modifier = hostility_resisted
					has_modifier = resisted_being_hostile
				}
			}
		}
		var:tibet_expedition_progress_var < 4
	}

	immediate = {

		random_scope_character = {
			limit = { has_variable = expedition_leader_var }
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_variable = expedition_leader_var
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				exists = c:TIB
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.4.a
		default_option = yes

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}

		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
 					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = hostility_resisted
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_interest_group = {
						NOT = {
							is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
						}
	    				OR = {
	    					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist
	    					leader = {
	    						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
	     					}
	  					}
					}
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					NOR = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
						is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk # RF is not normally a valid IG for Jingoists
						leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader }
					}
				}
				leader = {
					set_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = hostility_resisted
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = je_tibet_expedition_advance
			change_variable = { name = tibet_expedition_progress_var add = 1 }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.4.b


		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
		}

		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_isolationist
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pacifist
 					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = resisted_being_hostile
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

tibet_expedition_events.5 = { # The Great Trigonometrical Survey Goes North (Mount Everest named)
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location

	trigger = {
		var:tibet_expedition_progress_var < 4
		NOT = {
			any_scope_character = {
				has_variable = everest_encountered
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {

			limit = { has_variable = expedition_leader_var }

		OR = {

					has_variable = expedition_leader_var
				}

			NOT = {
				exists = c:TIB
			}
		}
	}

			base = 1
		}

		create_character = {
			is_general = yes

			}

				add_trait = engineer
			}
		}

		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.5.b
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				c:GBR ?= this
				c:BIC ?= this
			}
			NOT = { has_global_variable = andrew_scott_waugh_is_real_and_my_friend }
			game_date < 1870.1.1
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}

		create_character = {
			template = GBR_andrew_scott_waugh
		}

		scope:expedition_leader = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = sidelined_mountaineer
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = je_tibet_expedition_advance
			change_variable = { name = tibet_expedition_progress_var add = 1 }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.5.c
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				c:GBR ?= this
				c:BIC ?= this
			}
			NOT = { has_global_variable = charles_granville_bruce_is_real_and_my_friend }
			game_date > 1892.1.1 # First expedition to Mongolia and the Karakoram mountain range
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}

		create_character = {
			template = GBR_charles_granville_bruce
		}

		scope:expedition_leader = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = sidelined_mountaineer
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = je_tibet_expedition_advance
			change_variable = { name = tibet_expedition_progress_var add = 1 }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.5.dd

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}

		random_list = {
			1 = {
				scope:expedition_leader = {
					kill_character = yes
				}
			}
			1 = {
				modifier = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							ROOT.modifier:country_expedition_events_explorer_mult > 0
						}
						add = 1
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:expedition_leader.modifier:character_expedition_events_explorer_mult > 0
						}
						add = 2
					}
				}
				scope:expedition_leader = {

					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { has_trait = surveyor }
						}
						add_trait = surveyor
					}
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = je_tibet_expedition_advance
					change_variable = { name = tibet_expedition_progress_var add = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

tibet_expedition_events.6 = { # Leeches!
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location

    title = tibet_expedition_events.6.t
    desc = tibet_expedition_events.6.d
    flavor = tibet_expedition_events.6.f

    duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_jungle_expedition"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	trigger = {
		var:tibet_expedition_progress_var < 4
	}

	immediate = {

		random_scope_character = {
			limit = { has_variable = expedition_leader_var }
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { any_scope_character = { has_variable = expedition_leader_var } }
			NOT = {
				exists = c:TIB
			}
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_tibet_expedition }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.6.a
		default_option = yes

		random_list = {
			1 = {
				scope:expedition_leader = {
					kill_character = yes
				}
			}
			1 = {
				modifier = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							ROOT.modifier:country_expedition_events_explorer_mult > 0
						}
						add = 0.5
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:expedition_leader.modifier:character_expedition_events_explorer_mult > 0
						}
						add = 2
					}
				}
				trigger = {
					scope:expedition_leader = {
						NOT = { has_trait = sickly }
					}
				}
				scope:expedition_leader = {
					add_trait = sickly
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = je_tibet_expedition_advance
					change_variable = { name = tibet_expedition_progress_var add = 1 }
				}
			}
			2 = {
				modifier = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							ROOT.modifier:country_expedition_events_explorer_mult > 0
						}
						add = 1
					}
				}
				modifier = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:expedition_leader.modifier:character_expedition_events_explorer_mult > 0
						}
						add = 4
					}
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = je_tibet_expedition_advance
					change_variable = { name = tibet_expedition_progress_var add = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.6.b

		random_list = {
			1 = {
				trigger = { scope:expedition_leader = { has_trait = sickly } }
				scope:expedition_leader = {
					remove_trait = sickly
				}
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { scope:expedition_leader = { has_trait = beetle_ear } }
				scope:expedition_leader = {
					remove_trait = beetle_ear
				}
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { scope:expedition_leader = { has_trait = wounded } }
				scope:expedition_leader = {
					remove_trait = wounded
					if = {
						limit ={
							NOT = { has_trait = scarred }
						}
					}
					add_trait = scarred
				}
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { scope:expedition_leader = { has_trait = opium_addiction } }
				scope:expedition_leader = {
					remove_trait = opium_addiction
				}
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { scope:expedition_leader = { has_trait = cocaine_addiction } }
				scope:expedition_leader = {
					remove_trait = cocaine_addiction
				}
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { scope:expedition_leader = { has_trait = alcoholic } }
				scope:expedition_leader = {
					remove_trait = alcoholic
				}
			}
		}
		scope:expedition_leader = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = well_rested_leader
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

tibet_expedition_events.8 = { # Cross the border
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location

    title = tibet_expedition_events.8.t
    desc = tibet_expedition_events.8.d
    flavor = tibet_expedition_events.8.f

    duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_ca_mountain_pass_military"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	trigger = {
		var:tibet_expedition_progress_var >= 4

		NOR = {
			has_variable = delayed_expedition_events
			has_variable = entered_into_tibet
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = expedition_country
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = { has_variable = expedition_leader_var }
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader
		}
		set_variable = entered_into_tibet
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { exists = c:TIB }
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_tibet_expedition }
			NOT = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_variable = expedition_leader_var
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.8.a
		default_option = yes

		if = {
			limit = {
				c:TIB ?= {
					is_subject = yes
				}
			}
			c:TIB ?= {
				overlord = {
					trigger_event = { id = tibet_expedition_events.9 days = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			c:TIB ?= {
				trigger_event = { id = tibet_expedition_events.10 days = 1 }
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = je_tibet_expedition_advance
			change_variable = { name = tibet_expedition_progress_var add = 1 }
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			c:TIB ?= {
				trigger_event = { id = tibet_expedition_events.11 days = 14 }
			}
		}
	}
}

tibet_expedition_events.9 = { # Cross the border (Overlord alert)
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location

    title = tibet_expedition_events.9.t
    desc = tibet_expedition_events.9.d
    flavor = tibet_expedition_events.9.f

    duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_ca_mountain_pass_military"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	immediate = {
		scope:expedition_leader = {
			owner = {
				save_scope_as = expedition_country
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { exists = scope:expedition_country }
			scope:expedition_country = {
				NOR = { has_journal_entry = je_tibet_expedition }
				any_scope_character = {
					has_variable = expedition_leader_var
				}
			}
			NOT = { exists = c:TIB }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.9.a
		default_option = yes

		change_relations = {
			country = scope:expedition_country
			value = 5
		}

		c:TIB ?= {
			add_liberty_desire = 5
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			c:TIB ?= {
				set_secret_goal = {
					country = ROOT
					secret_goal = antagonize
				}
			}
		}

		c:TIB ?= {
			trigger_event = { id = tibet_expedition_events.10 days = 1 }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.9.b

		# Diplomatically object

		change_relations = {
			country = scope:expedition_country
			value = -15
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			set_secret_goal = {
				country = scope:expedition_country
				secret_goal = antagonize
			}
		}

		c:TIB ?= {
			trigger_event = { id = tibet_expedition_events.10 days = 1 }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.9.c

		# Reinforce Tibet!

		change_relations = {
			country = scope:expedition_country
			value = -30
		}

		add_modifier = {
			name = himalayan_affairs # temp hit to authority
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}

		scope:expedition_country = {
			create_incident = {
				country = ROOT
				value = 2
			}
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			set_secret_goal = {
				country = c:TIB
				secret_goal = dominate
			}
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			c:TIB ?= {
				set_secret_goal = {
					country = ROOT
					secret_goal = befriend
				}
			}
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			set_secret_goal = {
				country = scope:expedition_country
				secret_goal = antagonize
			}
		}

		c:TIB ?= {
			add_liberty_desire = -5
		}

		c:TIB ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_modifier = overlord_military_support }
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = overlord_military_support
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
			trigger_event = { id = tibet_expedition_events.10 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

tibet_expedition_events.11 = { # (Tibet) Block their advance?
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location

    title = tibet_expedition_events.11.t
    desc = tibet_expedition_events.11.d
    flavor = tibet_expedition_events.11.f

    duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_ca_mountain_pass_military"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	immediate = {
		scope:expedition_leader = {
			owner = {
				save_scope_as = expedition_country
			}
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_modifier = expedition_disturbs_the_people }  }
			save_scope_as = disturbed_state
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { exists = scope:expedition_leader }
			scope:expedition_leader = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_tibet_expedition }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.11.a
		default_option = yes

		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_modifier = government_cowardice }
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
							has_trait = brave
							has_role_of_type = general
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = government_cowardice
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_state = {
					NOT = { has_modifier = expedition_disturbs_the_people }
				}
			}
			scope:disturbed_state = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = expedition_disturbs_the_people
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.11.b

		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_modifier = government_bravery }
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
							has_trait = brave
							has_role_of_type = general
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = government_bravery
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:expedition_country = {
			trigger_event = { id = tibet_expedition_events.12 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

tibet_expedition_events.19 = { # Unsanctioned pillaging
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location

    title = tibet_expedition_events.19.t
    desc = tibet_expedition_events.19.d
    flavor = tibet_expedition_events.19.f

    duration = 3

		video = "middleeast_police_breaking_door"
	}

	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			has_variable = pillaged_tibet
		}
		var:tibet_expedition_progress_var >= 4

		NOT = {
			has_variable = delayed_expedition_events
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		c:TIB ?= {
			save_scope_as = tibet_scope
		}

		random_scope_character = {
			limit = { has_variable = expedition_leader_var }
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader
		}

		set_variable = {
			name = pillaged_tibet
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { exists = c:TIB }
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_tibet_expedition }

				any_scope_character = {
					has_variable = expedition_leader_var
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.19.a
		default_option = yes

		change_relations = { # boy you really like upsetting Tibet at this point, huh
			country = c:TIB
			value = -10
		}

		c:TIB ?= {
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					is_capital = yes
				}
				state_region = {
					add_devastation = 10
				}
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = je_tibet_expedition_advance
			change_variable = { name = tibet_expedition_progress_var add = 1 }
		}
	}

		name = tibet_expedition_events.19.b
		default_option = yes

		change_relations = {
			country = c:TIB
			value = 10
		}

		add_modifier = {
			name = tibetan_restitution
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_very_small
			days = short_modifier_time
		}

		random_list = {
			1 = { }
			1 = {
				modifier = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							ROOT.modifier:country_expedition_events_explorer_mult > 0
						}
						add = 1
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:expedition_leader.modifier:character_expedition_events_explorer_mult > 0
						}

					}
				}

					text = je_tibet_expedition_advance
					change_variable = { name = tibet_expedition_progress_var add = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

### Phase 3: Negotiations with Tibet ###

tibet_expedition_events.20 = { # Who to address the ultimatum to?
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location

    title = tibet_expedition_events.20.t
    desc = tibet_expedition_events.20.d
    flavor = tibet_expedition_events.20.f

    duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_ca_mountain_pass_military"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	trigger = {
		var:tibet_expedition_progress_var >= 6
		NOR = {
			has_variable = delayed_expedition_events
			has_variable = ultimatum_event
		}
		any_scope_character = {
			has_variable = expedition_leader_var
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_variable = expedition_leader_var
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				exists = c:TIB
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		c:TIB ?= {
			save_scope_as = tibet_scope
		}
		save_scope_as = expedition_country
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:TIB ?= {
					is_subject = yes
				}
			}
			c:TIB ?= {
				overlord = {
					save_scope_as = overlord_of_tibet
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = ultimatum_event
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = expedition_leader_var
			}
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.20.a
		default_option = yes

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = sending_tibet_ultimatum_tt
			c:TIB ?= {
				trigger_event = {
					id = tibet_expedition_events.21
					days = 1
				}
			}
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			set_variable = ultimatum_sent
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:overlord_of_tibet ?= {
						is_player = yes
					}
					c:TIB ?= {
						is_player = no
					}
				}
				add = -25
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.20.b # ISN'T THERE SOMEONE YOU FORGOT?
		trigger = {  # trigger tibet_expedition_events.22 only if overlord exists & c:TIB is subject (so this is not sent to an independent c:TIB with top_overlord)
			exists = scope:overlord_of_tibet
			c:TIB ?= {
				is_subject = yes
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = sending_tibet_overlord_ultimatum_tt
			scope:overlord_of_tibet = {
				trigger_event = {
					id = tibet_expedition_events.22
					days = 1
				}
			}
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			set_variable = ultimatum_sent
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:overlord_of_tibet ?= {
						is_player = no
					}
					c:TIB ?= {
						is_player = yes
					}
				}
				add = -25
			}
		}
	}
}

tibet_expedition_events.21 = { # Ultimatum sent (Tibet)
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location

    title = tibet_expedition_events.21.t
    desc = tibet_expedition_events.21.d
    flavor = tibet_expedition_events.21.f

    duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_union_leader"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	immediate = {

		scope:expedition_leader = {
			owner = {
				save_scope_as = expedition_country
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:TIB ?= {
					is_subject = yes
				}
			}
			c:TIB ?= {
				overlord = {
					save_scope_as = overlord_of_tibet
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { exists = scope:expedition_country }
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.21.a
		default_option = yes

		if = { # trigger tibet_expedition_events.26 only if overlord exists & c:TIB is subject (so this is not sent to an independent c:TIB with top_overlord)
			limit = {
				exists = scope:overlord_of_tibet
				c:TIB ?= {
					is_subject = yes
				}
			}
			scope:overlord_of_tibet = {
				trigger_event = {
					id = tibet_expedition_events.26 days = 1
				}
				set_variable = former_tibetan_overlord
			}
		}

		scope:expedition_country = {
			trigger_event = {
				id = tibet_expedition_events.27 days = 1
			}
		}

		hidden_effect = { # clearing out existing relations
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_subject = yes
				}
				make_independent = yes
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				country_rank <= rank_value:minor_power
				scope:expedition_country = {
					OR = {
						is_country_type = recognized
						country_is_colonial_or_company = yes
					}
					country_rank >= rank_value:minor_power
				}
			}
			scope:expedition_country = {
				create_diplomatic_pact = {
					country = c:TIB
					type = protectorate
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_rank <= rank_value:minor_power
				scope:expedition_country = {
					is_country_type = unrecognized
					country_rank >= rank_value:unrecognized_regional_power
				}
			}
			scope:expedition_country = {
				create_diplomatic_pact = {
					country = c:TIB
					type = tributary
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:expedition_country = {
				create_diplomatic_pact = {
					country = c:TIB
					type = vassal
				}
			}
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					has_dlc_feature = lobbies
					any_political_lobby = {
						is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
						target = {
							scope:expedition_country = this
						}
					}
				}
				add = 25
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.21.b

		change_relations = {
			country = scope:expedition_country
			value = -40
		}
		scope:expedition_country = {
			set_variable = received_subjugation_refusal_var # variable for expedition_country to fail their Tibet Expedition JE if this option is selected
		}

		scope:expedition_country = {
			post_notification = tibet_refuses_demands
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_scope_character = {
						is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
						OR = {
							has_trait = ambitious
							has_trait = arrogant
							has_trait = imperious
						}
					}
				}
				add = 25
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					has_dlc_feature = lobbies
					any_political_lobby = {
						is_political_lobby_type = lobby_anti_country
						target = {
							scope:expedition_country = this
						}
					}
				}
				add = 25
			}
		}
	}
}

﻿namespace = titanic

titanic.1 = { #you build the titanic
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:titanic_state

	event_image = {
		video = "ep2_active_shipyard"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	title = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					exists = c:GBR
					c:GBR = ROOT
				}
				desc = titanic.1.t
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { exists = c:GBR }
						NOT = { c:GBR = ROOT }
					}
				}
				desc = titanic.1.t2
			}
		}
	}
	desc = titanic.1.d
	flavor = titanic.1.f

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = built_the_titanic }
		has_technology_researched = radio
		any_scope_building = {
			is_building_type = building_shipyard
			has_active_production_method = pm_metal_shipbuilding #will need ironclad_tech to do this
		}
		OR = {
			any_interest_group = {
				is_in_government = yes
				leader = {
					OR = {
						has_trait = ambitious
						has_trait = romantic
						has_trait = innovative
					}
				}
			}
			ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
				OR = {
					is_in_government = yes
					is_powerful = yes
				}
			}
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
				OR = {
					is_in_government = yes
					is_powerful = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				set_variable = custom_titanic_var
			}
			1 = {
				set_variable = custom_olympic_var
			}
			1 = {
				set_variable = custom_gigantic_var
			}
			1 = {
				set_variable = custom_colosssal_var
			}
			1 = {
				set_variable = custom_herculean_var
			}
			1 = {
				set_variable = custom_gargantuan_var
			}
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_building = {
					is_building_type = building_shipyard
					#has_active_production_method = pm_metal_shipbuilding
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = titanic_state
			set_variable = titanic_state_var
			random_scope_building = {
				limit = {
					is_building_type = building_shipyard
					has_active_production_method = pm_metal_shipbuilding
				}
				save_scope_as = titanic_building
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					is_in_government = yes
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_trait = ambitious
							has_trait = romantic
							has_trait = innovative
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					is_in_government = yes
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_trait = ambitious
							has_trait = romantic
							has_trait = innovative
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = titanic_ig
				set_variable = titanic_ig_var
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = titanic_leader
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
					OR = {
						is_in_government = yes
						is_powerful = yes
					}
					NOT = { has_variable = titanic_ig_var }
				}
			}
			ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
				save_scope_as = titanic_ig
				set_variable = titanic_ig_var
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = titanic_leader
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
					NOT = { has_variable = titanic_ig_var }
				}
			}
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
				save_scope_as = titanic_ig
				set_variable = titanic_ig_var
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = titanic_leader
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = titanic_ig_var }
				}
				save_scope_as = titanic_ig
				set_variable = titanic_ig_var
			}
		}
	}

	duration = 3

	option = { #focus on making it luxurious
		name = titanic.1.a
		default_option = yes
		set_global_variable = built_the_titanic
		add_modifier = {
			name = titanic_modifier
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			random_list = {
				80 = {
					trigger_event = { id = titanic.2 days = 90 }
					#it's implied in the flavour text that the first event is about finishing the last touches, so getting this event later would probably make the player forget about it
				}
				20 = {
					trigger_event = { id = titanic.3 days = 90 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

    option = { #focus on making it more efficient
		name = titanic.1.b
		set_global_variable = built_the_titanic
		scope:titanic_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = titanic_building_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			random_list = {
				80 = {
					trigger_event = { id = titanic.2 days = 90 }
				}
				20 = {
					trigger_event = { id = titanic.3 days = 90 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #dont
		name = titanic.1.c
		scope:titanic_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = no_titanic_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:titanic_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = small_radicals
				pop_type = laborers #they may lose they job
			}
		}
		#rival company approves
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {	ig:ig_industrialists = scope:titanic_ig }
			}
			ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = rival_titanic_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {	ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie = scope:titanic_ig }
			}
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = rival_titanic_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

trade_route_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = trade_route_events.1.t
	desc = trade_route_events.1.d
	flavor = trade_route_events.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_aristocrats"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_fire.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			any_scope_state = { has_building = building_arms_industry }
		}
        any_market = {
            root.market = {
                market_imports_reliance = { target = prev goods = small_arms value > 0.25 }
            }
            "owner.relations(root)" <= 0
        }
	}

	immediate = {
		random_market = {
			limit = {
				root.market = {
                    market_imports_reliance = { target = prev goods = small_arms value > 0.25 }
                }
                "owner.relations(root)" <= 0
			}
			owner = {
                save_scope_as = arms_seller_threat
            }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = trade_route_events.1.a
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_build_local_arms_industry
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = trade_route_events.1.b
		default_option = yes
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = ig_unreliable_weapon_imports
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

trade_route_events.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = trade_route_events.2.t
	desc = trade_route_events.2.d
	flavor = trade_route_events.2.f

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_engineer_blueprint"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
        any_market = {
            OR = {
                AND = {
                    root = { is_researching_technology = gunsmithing }
                    owner = { has_technology_researched = gunsmithing }
                }
                AND = {
                    root = { is_researching_technology = percussion_cap }
                    owner = { has_technology_researched = percussion_cap }
                }
                AND = {
                    root = { is_researching_technology = rifling }
                    owner = { has_technology_researched = rifling }
                }
                AND = {
                    root = { is_researching_technology = repeaters }
                    owner = { has_technology_researched = repeaters }
                }
                AND = {
                    root = { is_researching_technology = bolt_action_rifles }
                    owner = { has_technology_researched = bolt_action_rifles }
                }
            }
            root.market = {
                market_imports = { target = prev goods = small_arms value >= 5 }
            }
        }
	}

	immediate = {
		random_market = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
                    AND = {
                        root = { is_researching_technology = gunsmithing }
                        owner = { has_technology_researched = gunsmithing }
                    }
                    AND = {
                        root = { is_researching_technology = percussion_cap }
                        owner = { has_technology_researched = percussion_cap }
                    }
                    AND = {
                        root = { is_researching_technology = rifling }
                        owner = { has_technology_researched = rifling }
                    }
                    AND = {
                        root = { is_researching_technology = repeaters }
                        owner = { has_technology_researched = repeaters }
                    }
                    AND = {
                        root = { is_researching_technology = bolt_action_rifles }
                        owner = { has_technology_researched = bolt_action_rifles }
                    }
                }
                root.market = {
                    market_imports = { target = prev goods = small_arms value >= 5 }
                }
			}
            owner = {
                save_scope_as = arms_seller_gun_tech
            }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = trade_route_events.2.a
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_researching_imported_weapons
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_small
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_researching_technology = gunsmithing }
			add_technology_progress = {
				technology = gunsmithing
				progress = 2500
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_researching_technology = percussion_cap }
			add_technology_progress = {
				technology = percussion_cap
				progress = 3500
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_researching_technology = rifling }
			add_technology_progress = {
				technology = rifling
				progress = 3500
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_researching_technology = repeaters }
			add_technology_progress = {
				technology = repeaters
				progress = 4150
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_researching_technology = bolt_action_rifles }
			add_technology_progress = {
				technology = bolt_action_rifles
				progress = 6000
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = trade_route_events.2.b
		default_option = yes
	}
}

﻿namespace = trains

# Colliding for Sport
trains.1 = {
	type = country_event
	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_trains"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	title = trains.1.t
	desc = trains.1.d
	flavor = trains.1.f

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		has_technology_researched  = steel_railway_cars
		any_scope_state = {
			has_building = building_railway
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			is_revolutionary = no
			is_insurrectionary = no
			leader = {
				is_busy = no
				is_immortal = no
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_building = building_railway }
			save_scope_as = train_crashing_state
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_revolutionary = no
				is_insurrectionary = no # people who are angrily plotting doom in a smoky backroom will not make a happy public showing at a fair
				leader = {
					is_busy = no
					is_immortal = no
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = train_crash_attendee_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = train_crash_attendee
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = trains.1.a
        default_option = yes
        scope:train_crash_attendee = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = a_smashing_appearance
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
        }
        random_list = {
        	90 = {
        		scope:train_crashing_state = {
		        	add_modifier = {
		        		name = the_desire_to_smash_things_up
						days = short_modifier_time
		        	}
	        	}
        	}
        	10 = {
        		scope:train_crash_attendee = { kill_character = yes }
		        scope:train_crashing_state = {
					add_radicals_in_state = {
						value = small_radicals # People get mad about the mishandled event
					}
		        }
        	}
        }
	}
	option = {
		name = trains.1.b
		scope:train_crash_attendee_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = the_desire_to_smash_things_up_has_been_denied
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
        random_list = {
        	90 = {
        		scope:train_crashing_state = {
		        	add_modifier = {
		        		name = the_desire_to_smash_things_up
						days = short_modifier_time
		        	}
	        	}
        	}
        	10 = {
		        scope:train_crashing_state = {
					add_radicals_in_state = {
						value = small_radicals # People get mad about the mishandled event
					}
		        }
        	}
        }
	}
}
﻿namespace = treaty_of_london_events

treaty_of_london_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = treaty_of_london_events.1.t
	desc = treaty_of_london_events.1.d
	flavor = treaty_of_london_events.1.f

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_aristocrats"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		c:NET ?= this
		NOT = {
			has_variable = treaty_of_london_initiation_var
		}
		year >= 1838
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = treaty_of_london_initiation_var
		c:BEL ?= {
			save_scope_as = belgium_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = treaty_of_london_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 95
		}
		c:BEL ?= {
			trigger_event = { id = treaty_of_london_events.2 popup = yes }
		}
		custom_tooltip = if_they_accept_tt
		custom_tooltip = treaty_of_london_explanation_tt
		show_as_tooltip = {
			add_journal_entry = {
				type = je_conference_of_london
			}
			c:BEL ?= {
				add_journal_entry = {
					type = je_conference_of_london
				}
			}
			every_country_in_europe = {
				limit = {
					country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
					NOR = {
						root ?= this
						c:BEL ?= this
					}
				}
				trigger_event = { id = treaty_of_london_events.3 popup = yes }
			}
		}
	}


	option = {
		name = treaty_of_london_events.1.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 5
		}
		c:BEL ?= {
			change_relations = { country = root value = -80 }
			create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
				type = catalyst_event_negative
				target = root
			}
		}
		every_country_in_europe = {
			limit = {
				country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
				NOT = { this = root }
			}
			change_relations = { country = root value = -40 }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_secret_goal = {
				country = c:BEL

treaty_of_london_events.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = treaty_of_london_events.4.t
	desc = treaty_of_london_events.4.d
	flavor = treaty_of_london_events.4.f

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_transfer_of_authority"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		c:BEL ?= {
			save_scope_as = belgium_scope
		}
		c:NET ?= {
			save_scope_as = netherlands_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = treaty_of_london_events.4.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 95
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:NET ?= this
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = treaty_of_london_outcome_tt
				enforce_treaty_of_london = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			show_as_tooltip = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = treaty_of_london_outcome_tt
					enforce_treaty_of_london = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					c:BEL ?= this
					c:NET ?= this
				}
				NOT = {
					any_scope_treaty = {
						binds = c:BEL
						any_scope_article = {
							has_type = guarantee_independence
						}
					}
				}
			}
			create_treaty = {
				first_country = root
				second_country = c:BEL

				is_draft = no
				binding_period = { years = 5 }

				articles_to_create = {
					{
						article = guarantee_independence
						source_country = root
						target_country = c:BEL
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					c:BEL ?= this
					c:NET ?= this
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = guarantors_of_peace_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		show_as_tooltip = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_variable = favour_belgium_global_var
				}
				c:BEL ?= {
					take_on_scaled_debt = {
						who = c:NET
						value = c:NET.scaled_debt
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_variable = favour_netherlands_global_var
				}
				c:NET ?= {
					take_on_scaled_debt = {
						who = c:BEL
						value = c:BEL.scaled_debt
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

﻿namespace = treaty_port_inheritance_events

# Fired when a country inherits the treaty ports a defeated host had ceded to a foreign power (won revolution, annexation, conquest)
# Root = New host country
# scope:target_country = Foreign power holding the inherited treaty port(s)
treaty_port_inheritance_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	event_image = {
		video = "asia_westerners_arriving"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	title = treaty_port_inheritance_events.1.t
	desc = treaty_port_inheritance_events.1.d
	flavor = treaty_port_inheritance_events.1.f

	duration = 3

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = new_host
	}

	# Honor the inherited treaty
	option = {
		name = treaty_port_inheritance_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:target_country = {
				trigger_event = { id = treaty_port_inheritance_events.2 }
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 55
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					"relations(scope:target_country)" >= relations_threshold:cordial
				}
				add = 50
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					"relations(scope:target_country)" < relations_threshold:hostile
				}
				add = -40
			}
		}
	}

	# Renege: void the treaty and reclaim the ports
	option = {
		name = treaty_port_inheritance_events.1.b
		renege_treaty_ports_with = scope:target_country
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:target_country = {
				# Remember who reneged on us so our colonial AI is keen to retake the ports by force
				set_variable = { name = wants_treaty_port_revenge_against value = root days = 3650 }
				trigger_event = { id = treaty_port_inheritance_events.3 }
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 45
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					"relations(scope:target_country)" >= relations_threshold:cordial
				}
				add = -40
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					"relations(scope:target_country)" < relations_threshold:hostile
				}
				add = 50
			}
		}
	}
}

﻿namespace = trench_warfare

trench_warfare.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = trench_warfare.1.t
	desc = trench_warfare.1.d
	flavor = trench_warfare.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_battlefield_trenches"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		any_scope_war = {
			any_scope_front = {
				any_military_formation = {
					owner = ROOT
					OR = {
						formation_army_unit_type_fraction = {
							target = unit_type:combat_unit_type_trench_infantry
							value >= 0.25
						}
						formation_army_unit_type_fraction = {
							target = unit_type:combat_unit_type_squad_infantry
							value >= 0.25
						}
					}
					exists = commander
					commander ?= {
						NOT = { has_trait = trench_rat }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		ROOT = { save_scope_as = trench_warfare_home }
		random_scope_war = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_front = {
					any_military_formation = {
						owner = ROOT
						OR = {
							formation_army_unit_type_fraction = {
								target = unit_type:combat_unit_type_trench_infantry
								value >= 0.25
							}
							formation_army_unit_type_fraction = {
								target = unit_type:combat_unit_type_squad_infantry
								value >= 0.25
							}
						}
						exists = commander
						commander ?= {
							NOT = { has_trait = trench_rat }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = trench_warfare_war
			random_scope_front = {
				limit = {
					any_military_formation = {
						owner = ROOT
						OR = {
							formation_army_unit_type_fraction = {
								target = unit_type:combat_unit_type_trench_infantry
								value >= 0.25
							}
							formation_army_unit_type_fraction = {
								target = unit_type:combat_unit_type_squad_infantry
								value >= 0.25
							}
						}
						exists = commander
						commander ?= {
							NOT = { has_trait = trench_rat }
						}
					}
				}
				random_scope_general = {
					limit = {
						owner = ROOT
						NOT = { has_trait = trench_rat }
						commander_military_formation ?= {
							owner = ROOT
							OR = {
								formation_army_unit_type_fraction = {
									target = unit_type:combat_unit_type_trench_infantry
									value >= 0.25
								}
								formation_army_unit_type_fraction = {
									target = unit_type:combat_unit_type_squad_infantry
									value >= 0.25
								}
							}
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = trench_warfare_general
				}
				random_scope_state = {
					save_scope_as = trench_warfare_state
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # We must entrench, entrench, and entrench some more!
		name = trench_warfare.1.a
		default_option = yes

		scope:trench_warfare_general  = {
			add_trait = trench_rat
		}
		scope:trench_warfare_state = {
			add_modifier = { # mortality and reduction in outputs
				name = zone_rouge
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
			state_region = {
				add_devastation = 10
			}
		}
	}
	option = { # We can't let our defenses stagnate.
		name = trench_warfare.1.b

		trigger = {
			NOT = { has_technology_researched = defense_in_depth }
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				can_research = defense_in_depth
			}
			add_technology_progress = {
				progress = 6000
				technology = defense_in_depth
			}
		}

		scope:trench_warfare_state = {
			add_modifier = { # smaller negative modifier because the front isn't static
				name = zone_rouge
				days = long_modifier_time
				multiplier = 0.75
			}
			state_region = {
				add_devastation = 5
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # We need a breakthrough.
		name = trench_warfare.1.c

		trigger = {
			has_technology_researched = wargaming
			NOT = { has_technology_researched = stormtroopers }
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				can_research = stormtroopers
			}
			add_technology_progress = {
				progress = 8000
				technology = stormtroopers
			}
		}

		scope:trench_warfare_state = {
			add_modifier = { # smaller negative modifier because the front is moving more
				name = zone_rouge
				days = long_modifier_time
				multiplier = 0.75
			}
			state_region = {
				add_devastation = 5
			}
		}
	}
}

			days = short_modifier_time
		}

			add_devastation = 20
		}

			add_devastation = 20
		}
	}
	option = { # can we mine it?
		name = tunguska.1.d
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
				is_in_government = yes
			}
		}
		scope:tunguska_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = tunguska_mining
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
		s:STATE_UPPER_YENISEYSK = {
			add_devastation = 20
		}
	}
}

		# Triggered by Journal Entry
	}

	}

	}

		}
		if = {

			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_libertad_igualdad_fraternidad_no_voting
				days = stupidly_long_modifier_time
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
		ig:ig_armed_forces = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_conservative_praetorian
				}
				remove_ideology = ideology_conservative_praetorian
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_praetorian
					}
				}
				add_ideology = ideology_liberal_praetorian
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = two_spains.2.b
		custom_tooltip = two_spains_liberal_ideologies_tt
		custom_tooltip = two_spains_military_liberal_ideologies_tt
		set_variable = spa_liberal_military_var
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			add_modifier = { name = modifier_republican_spirit days = stupidly_long_modifier_time is_decaying = yes }
			remove_ideology = ideology_patriotic
			add_ideology = ideology_republican
		}
		ig:ig_armed_forces = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_conservative_praetorian
				}
				remove_ideology = ideology_conservative_praetorian
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_praetorian
					}
				}
				add_ideology = ideology_liberal_praetorian
			}
		}
	}
}

﻿namespace = unable_to_enact

# Unable to continue enacting law
unable_to_enact.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = unable_to_enact.1.t
	desc = unable_to_enact.1.d
	flavor = unable_to_enact.1.f

	category = enactment

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "africa_leader_arguing"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = legislative_failures_event }
		enacting_any_law = yes
		enactment_chance <= 0
		num_pending_events:enactment = 0
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = legislative_failures_event days = 100 }

		currently_enacting_law = {
			save_scope_as = current_law_scope
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { currently_enacting_law = scope:current_law_scope }
	}

	option = {
		name = unable_to_enact.1.a
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			enactment_setback_count < max_setbacks_minus_one
			enactment_chance_without_enactment_modifier > 0
		}
		add_enactment_setback = 1
		clear_enactment_modifier = yes

		remove_variable = legislative_failures_event
	}

	option = {
		name = unable_to_enact.1.b
		default_option = yes
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				enactment_setback_count > 1
				enactment_chance_without_enactment_modifier <= 0
			}
		}
		fallback = yes
		cancel_enactment = yes

		remove_variable = legislative_failures_event
	}
}

# people use the urban centers to go full on Social Hour(tm)
urbanization_events.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:urbanization_state

	title = urbanization_events.2.t
	desc = urbanization_events.2.d
	flavor = urbanization_events.2.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_london_center"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = city_of_plenty_var }
		any_scope_state = {
			any_scope_building = {
				is_building_type = building_urban_center
				level >= 10 #London will get it at game start, but for everyone else this is quite hard
			}
			is_incorporated = yes
			any_scope_pop = {
				standard_of_living >= 32
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = city_of_plenty_var #won't hit the same city twice
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_building = {
					is_building_type = building_urban_center
					level >= 5
				}
				is_incorporated = yes
				any_scope_pop = {
					standard_of_living >= 32
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = urbanization_state
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		scope:urbanization_state = {
			NOT = {
				any_scope_pop = {
					standard_of_living > 32
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #let them celebrate!
		name = urbanization_events.2.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:urbanization_state = {
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				strata = upper
				value = 0.1
			}
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				strata = middle
				value = 0.1
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # party forever
		name = urbanization_events.2.b
		scope:urbanization_state = {
			add_modifier = { # rich people expect more parties
				name = luxurious_parties
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				strata = upper
				value = 0.25
			}
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				strata = middle
				value = 0.25
			}
		}
	}
}

# Other IGs aren't happy that you're favouring the Industrialists
urbanization_events.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = urbanization_events.4.t
	desc = urbanization_events.4.d
	flavor = urbanization_events.4.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_factory_opening"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = industrialists_favouring_var }
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			OR = {
				is_in_government = yes
				is_powerful = yes
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = industrialists_favouring_var
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			save_scope_as = industrialist_ig
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists }
			}
			save_scope_as = opposing_ig
		}
	}

	option = { #appease them
		name = urbanization_events.4.a
		scope:opposing_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_ig_happy_urbanization
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = 2
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						c:FRA ?= this
						has_journal_entry = je_divided_monarchists
					}
				}
				fra_favor_leader_ig_dynasty = yes
			}
		}
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_ig_happy_urbanization_bad
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = 2
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #ignore them
		name = urbanization_events.4.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:opposing_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_ignored_ig_urbanization
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						c:FRA ?= this
						has_journal_entry = je_divided_monarchists
					}
				}
				fra_disfavor_leader_ig_dynasty = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Subsistence Farms
urbanization_events.6 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:subsistence_state

	title = urbanization_events.6.t
	desc = urbanization_events.6.d
	flavor = urbanization_events.6.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_realist_household"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = subsistence_farms_var }
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			has_subsistence_building = yes
		}
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			AND = {
				is_powerful = yes
				is_in_government = yes
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = subsistence_farms_var
			days = stupidly_long_modifier_time
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_subsistence_building = yes
			}
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = subsistence_state
		}
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			save_scope_as = industrialist_ig
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = urbanization_events.6.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:subsistence_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_factories_no_subsistence_farming
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
		ROOT = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_listened_to_advice
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = urbanization_events.6.b
		scope:subsistence_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_better_farms_no_subsistence_farming
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = urbanization_events.6.c
		scope:subsistence_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = subsistence_farms_ignored

# Good Governance For All, on JE completion
utilitarian.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = utilitarian.1.t
	desc = utilitarian.1.d
	flavor = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = utilitarian.1.f # Loc if a Utilitarian character exists
				trigger = {
					any_scope_character = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utilitarian_leader
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = utilitarian.1.f2 # Loc if no Utilitarian character exists
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	event_image = {
		video = "ip2_india_factory_floor"
	}

	dlc = dlc011

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by Imperialism of Promise JE
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utilitarian_leader
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_ig
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utilitarian_leader
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_character
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				exists = c:BIC
			}
			NOT = {
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:british
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = utilitarian.1.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = utilitarian_bonus
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_malthusian
				}
				remove_ideology = ideology_malthusian
				add_ideology = ideology_utilitarian_millian
			}
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					OR = {
						has_role_of_type = agitator
						AND = {
							prominence >= define:NCharacters|PROMINENCE_IMPORTANT_THRESHOLD
							has_role_of_type = politician
						}
					}
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utilitarian_leader
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = util_colonial_admin_success
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

# A Project Without Progress, on JE time out
utilitarian.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = utilitarian.3.t
	desc = utilitarian.3.d
	flavor = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = utilitarian.3.f # Loc if a Utilitarian character exists
				trigger = {
					any_scope_character = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utilitarian_leader
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = utilitarian.3.f2 # Loc if no Utilitarian character exists
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_politician_parliament_motion"
	}

	dlc = dlc011

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		# Triggered by Imperialism of Promise JE
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utilitarian_leader
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_ig
			random_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utilitarian_leader
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_character
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = util_end_var
			value = 0
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				root.average_sol >= 10
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = util_end_var
				add = 1
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				AND = {
					approaching_bureaucracy_shortage = no
					bureaucracy >= 0 
				}
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = util_end_var
				add = 1
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = util_end_var
				add = 1
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_proportional_taxation
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_graduated_taxation
				}
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = util_end_var
				add = 1
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_compulsory_primary_school
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = util_end_var
				add = 1
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_public_schools
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = util_end_var
				add = 1
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_womens_rights
				}
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = util_end_var
				add = 1
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				exists = c:BIC
			}
			NOT = {
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:british
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = utilitarian.3.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = utilitarian_partial_malus
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:util_end_var >= 1
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_character = {
						OR = {
							has_role_of_type = agitator
							AND = {
							prominence >= define:NCharacters|PROMINENCE_IMPORTANT_THRESHOLD
							has_role_of_type = politician
						}
						}
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utilitarian_leader
					}
				}
				add_modifier = {
					name = util_colonial_admin_partial_success
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:util_end_var > 2
			}
			ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_malthusian
					}
					remove_ideology = ideology_malthusian
					add_ideology = ideology_utilitarian_millian
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

utilitarian.5 = {

	title = utilitarian.5.t
	desc = utilitarian.5.d
	flavor = utilitarian.5.f

	event_image = {
		video = "ip2_intercommunal_tensions"
	}

	dlc = dlc011

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			has_variable = utilitarian_effort_underway
			any_scope_pop = {
				pop_has_primary_culture = no
				state = {
					state_cultural_acceptance = {
						target = PREV.culture
						value < acceptance_status_4
					}
				}
			}
			any_scope_pop = {
				culture = {
					has_discrimination_trait = language_anglophone
				}
			}
		}
		any_scope_character = {
			OR = {
				has_role_of_type = agitator
				AND = {
					prominence >= define:NCharacters|PROMINENCE_IMPORTANT_THRESHOLD
					has_role_of_type = politician
				}
			}
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utilitarian_leader
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			random_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					pop_has_primary_culture = no
					state = {
						state_cultural_acceptance = {
							target = PREV.culture
							value < acceptance_status_4
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = discriminated_culture_pop
				culture = { save_scope_as = discriminated_culture }
			}
			random_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait = language_anglophone
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = primary_culture_pop
				culture = { save_scope_as = not_discriminated_culture }
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_state
		}
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_role_of_type = agitator
					AND = {
						prominence >= define:NCharacters|PROMINENCE_IMPORTANT_THRESHOLD
						has_role_of_type = politician
					}
				}
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utilitarian_leader
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_character
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				exists = c:BIC
			}
			NOT = {
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:british
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # "favored" option for Utilitarian ideology
		name = utilitarian.5.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:relevant_state = {
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
				culture = scope:discriminated_culture
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = restrained_fortune_seekers
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = utilitarian.5.b
		scope:relevant_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
				culture = scope:discriminated_culture
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = unrestrained_fortune_seekers
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

utilitarian.6 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = utilitarian.6.t
	desc = utilitarian.6.d
	flavor = utilitarian.6.f

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_power_blocs"
	}

	dlc = dlc011

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		is_subject = yes
		any_political_lobby = {
			OR = {
				is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
				is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_overlord
			}
			any_lobby_member = {
				leader = {
					is_ruler_of_own_country = no
				}
			}
			target = { c:GBR ?= this }
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_political_lobby = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
					is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_overlord
				}
				any_lobby_member = {
					leader = {
						is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					}
				}
				target = { c:GBR ?= this }
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_lobby
			random_lobby_member = {
				limit = {
					leader = {
						is_ruler_of_own_country = no
					}
				}
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = relevant_character
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_lobby_member
			}
			target = {
				save_scope_as = relevant_lobby_country
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { exists = c:BIC }
			NOT = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:british }
			NOT = { exists = scope:relevant_lobby }
			NOT = { exists = c:GBR }
		}
	}

	option = { # distancing from GBR
		name = utilitarian.6.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:relevant_lobby = {
			change_appeasement = {
				amount = -2
				factor = appeasement_lobby_loss
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = utilitarian.6.b
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:relevant_lobby_country
			value = 10
		}
		add_loyalists = {
			value = medium_radicals
			interest_group = scope:relevant_lobby_member
		}
	}
}

# Equal Opportunities
utilitarian.8 = { # Success event for schooling
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = utilitarian.8.t
	desc = utilitarian.8.d
	flavor = utilitarian.8.f

	category = enactment

	event_image = {
		video = "ip2_india_urban_scene"
	}

	dlc = dlc011

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = { # is fired by the enactment pulse
		has_dlc_feature = ip2_content
		is_subject = yes
		has_journal_entry = je_imperialism_of_promise
		OR = {
			AND = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_compulsory_primary_school
				any_interest_group = {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_compulsory_primary_school
						value > neutral
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_public_schools
				any_interest_group = {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_public_schools
						value > neutral
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		c:BIC ?= {
			save_scope_as = bic_scope
			top_overlord = {
				save_scope_as = relevant_overlord
				ruler = {
					save_scope_as = relevant_overlord_ruler
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_enacting_law = law_type:law_compulsory_primary_school
				any_interest_group = {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_compulsory_primary_school
						value > neutral
					}
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_compulsory_primary_school
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_ig
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_public_schools
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_ig
			}
		}
		currently_enacting_law = {

    	}
	}

		OR = {

				exists = c:BIC
			}
			NOT = {
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:british
			}
			NOT = {
				currently_enacting_law = scope:relevant_law_scope
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = utilitarian.8.a
		default_option = yes
		add_enactment_modifier = {
			name = util_law_enactment_progress
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = utilitarian.8.b
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = clerk_state_radicals_increase_tt
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					ig_state_pol_strength_share = {
						target = scope:relevant_ig
						value > 0.10
					}
				}

					value = medium_radicals
				}
			}
		}
		every_interest_group = {

					law = scope:relevant_law_scope
					value < neutral
				}

utilitarian.10 = {

	duration = 3

	# Would only want this to happen once for the Imperialism of Promise JE
	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			any_scope_pop = {
				pop_has_primary_culture = no
				pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4
			}
		}
		any_scope_character = {
			OR = {
				has_role_of_type = agitator
				AND = {
					prominence >= define:NCharacters|PROMINENCE_IMPORTANT_THRESHOLD
					has_role_of_type = politician
				}
			}
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utilitarian_leader
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_pop = {
					pop_has_primary_culture = no
					pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4
				}
			}
			random_scope_pop = {
				limit = {
					pop_has_primary_culture = no
					pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						state = {
							state_cultural_acceptance = {
								target = PREV.culture
								value < acceptance_status_4
							}
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = discriminated_culture_pop
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						state = {
							state_religious_acceptance = {
								target = PREV.religion
								value < religious_acceptance_medium
							}
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = discriminated_religion_pop
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_state
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				exists = c:BIC
			}
			NOT = {
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:british
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = utilitarian.10.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = {
			name = utilitarian_census_in_progress_cost
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		scope:relevant_state = {
			set_variable = utilitarian_effort_underway
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = util_caste_divisions
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = utilitarian.10.b
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					OR = {
						has_role_of_type = agitator
						AND = {
							prominence >= define:NCharacters|PROMINENCE_IMPORTANT_THRESHOLD
							has_role_of_type = politician
						}
					}
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utilitarian_leader
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = utilitarian_no_census
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = util_authority
			days = normal_modifier_time

		}

					interest_group = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
					ideology = ideology_authoritarian
					traits = {
						erudite
						meticulous
						ambitious
					}
					on_created = {
						set_variable = vargas_variable
						set_career_length = {
							years = 100
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = vargas_scope
				}
			}
		}
	}
